Each of our wineries and their brands come together under a concept that challenges the conventional. While preserving their character, personality, and identity, they are all guided by a unique philosophy. And we do so with a specific goal in mind: to elevate everything we expect from wine through quality, continuous improvement, and excellence, always thinking about what the consumer seeks at every moment. Currently, we bring together seven wineries rooted in six prestigious wine regions of Spain: Palacio de Bornos (D.O. Rueda), Señorío de Sarría (D.O. Navarra), Lleiroso and Dominio de Bornos (D.O. Ribera del Duero), Martínez Corta (D.O.Ca. Rioja), Bucrana (D.O. Toro), and Guelbenzu (Finca la Lombana). To all of this, we add the spirits we produce at Casa D’Aristi, originating from Mexico.

Product 2 Description: It shows an intense cherry red color. On the nose, it offers powerful aromas of ripe black fruit, perfectly integrated with toasted and spicy notes and a balsamic finish. It offers an intense aroma with notes of ripe and candied red fruit, complemented by toasted nuances from the barrel. On the palate, it is powerful, expressive, and elegant, with characteristic balsamic touches that reflect the mineral-rich area where it originates.
Product 6 Description: It has an intense cherry red colour with ruby reflections, with a high layer, clean and bright. On the nose it offers a high aromatic intensity, where ripe black fruit is elegantly integrated with notes of wood, spices, cloves, smoky nuances and a delicate background of liquorice. On the palate it is voluminous, round and velvety, with a balanced and very pleasant mid-palate, which leads to a long and persistent aftertaste.
Product 7 Description: It displays a cherry red color with garnet hues. On the nose, it shows intense aromas of red and black fruit, accompanied by floral and spicy notes, with a balsamic finish that adds freshness. On the palate, it is flavorful, fresh, and well-balanced, with pronounced fruity and spicy character complemented by creamy nuances, vanilla, and subtle toasted notes, revealing power and good structure.
Product 8 Description: Narano captures the bright, spicy profile of the Yucatan's endemic bitter orange, a common and versatile fruit that grows in the region and is often used in local cuisine, for example, in marinades or sauces. Its acidic touch, together with its herbaceous notes, make it very accessible in a wide range of cocktails to which it adds a citrus touch. Perfect for an all-Mexican margarita.
Product 9 Name: Palacio de Bornos Verdejo Colección de Familia Sergio Hernández
Product 9 Description: Family Collection is a range of limited editions where wine and art come together through the work, passion and inspiration of the winemaker in the cellar and the artist in the studio. In each edition, a winery, an origin and a prestigious artist come together in a unique dialogue, but under the same vision: to create a unique and captivating work that is both wine and art culture. The label of Palacio de Bornos Gran Vino de Rueda Edición Sergio Hernández reproduces the work of the renowned Mexican artist, reflecting, thanks to his unmistakable style full of luminosity and liveliness, the origin of wine: the grape, the bunch. Verdejo from old bush vines, double grape selection, fermentation in ceramic amphorae, ageing on lees for nine months and prolonged subsequent rest in the bottle make this wine something extraordinary, creating an unforgettable sensation that leaves its mark.

Product 1 Description: Una vinificación al estilo de los íberos de s VII ac que colonizaron nuestra comarca, para ofrecer un vino muy de hoy. Un vino que busca ser el mejor reconocimiento a nuestros antepasados y a nuestra tierra. Un visual de oro, limpio y con reflejos brillantes pajizos. Intenso y distinguido con aromas florales en nariz. Complejo, seco y salino en banco.
Product 2 Description: 100% giró, la garnacha de nuestra comarca, más ligera y menos alcohólica.
Product 3 Description: Uvas de moscatel, pasificadas en la planta, para un dulce lleno de frutos secos, orejones y mucha tensión.
Product 4 Description: Las viñas viejas de 70 años nos dan muy pocos racimos que fermentaremos en barricas de roble.
Product 5 Description: VITICULTURA 100% moscatel de Alejandría plantado en espaldera a doble guyot sobre suelos arcillosos, con una producción media por hectárea de 4000 kg/ha. Este viñedo de 17 años de 6 ha, solo recibe enmiendas naturales y además de una poda en seco, continuas podas en verde. Vendimiamos manualmente en cajas de 12kg con mesa de selección y despalillado la primera semana de agosto. ELABORACIÓN Y CRIANZA Tras una maceración de 24 h, arranca la fermentación con levaduras propias y la mantenemos con la temperatura controlada a 15ºC en depósitos de inox. Con una ligera filtración y un nivel de sulfitos bajo. NOTAS DE CATA En visual es amarillo pajizo claro, brillante y con reflejos verdes típicos de la moscatel y en nariz es un moscatel lleno de flores frescas, jazmín, flor de azahar, manzanilla, rosa y polvos de talco. En boca, seco totalmente, placentero, citrico con limoncillo, pétalos carnosos y su retrogusto es largo en boca, de hinojo, jengibre y pimienta blanca, salino y toque a pomelo.
Product 6 Description: In our obsession to find the happiest Muscat vines in our region, we found an "albino" Hamburg Muscat or pink Muscat plant and began vinification soon there after. The Muscat grape family includes about two hundred varieties of the Vitis vinifera grape. The breadth and number of Muscat varieties suggest that it may be the oldest cultivated grape variety in the world, thus an aspiration of Les Freses. After more than twelve years and a huge amount of work by our botanist friend Jaume X. Soler in the laboratory, we managed to plant a vineyard of 400 plants with which we vinify this still rosé on the estate.
Product 7 Description: Vinificación sobre lías en damajuanas de 54L.
Product 8 Description: De una pequeña parcela de viñas de más de 70 años, la moscatel se vuelve sabia y tranquila.
Product 9 Description: Un coupage 100% valenciano: Giró, Forcallat, Monastrell, Bobal y Tardana. Baja graduación y cuerpo.
Product 10 Description: La variedad Forcallat nos encanta: poco tanino y mucha fruta, poco alcohol y muchas posibilidades de maridaje.

Winery Description: Sidras Bereziartua is a family company that has been dedicated to the cider activity since 1870. It was then when we made the first elaborations of Bereziartua Ciders in our old facilities in Ergobia. A century later, in 1970, our cider maker bet definitively for the elaboration of "sagardua" in its current facilities in Astigarraga, the place where we are nowadays. Since then, and after different modernization processes, Bereziartua has become a reference in the elaboration of natural cider maintaining the family character at the service of tradition, respect and gratitude to our loyal customers.

Product 2 Description: This juice is obtained from our 100% organic apples from which we extract the juice and pasteurize it so that it does not lose the essence and freshness of the product.
Product 3 Description: Cider made from a blend of different 100% native apples from the Basque Country. The elaboration is made using traditional methods, followed by fermentation in wooden tanks for at least 4 months and with apples duly selected beforehand. It has an aged golden color that is characteristic of the apple itself. Its aroma is intense, deep and fruity, with a very pleasant taste on the palate.
Product 4 Description: The elaboration of this cider is made by blending different wild apples such as Txalaka, Urtebia, Gezamina, etc.... The elaboration is made using traditional methods, followed by fermentation in wooden tanks for at least 4 months and with apples duly selected beforehand. It has a fine and expressive golden color. Its aroma is intense and fruity. In the mouth it is a cider with very characteristic features, with a deep and pleasant taste.
Product 5 Description: Blend of the best wild apples selected by hand. Its elaboration is made by joining the wisdom of our ancestors, respecting their customs about the moons, types of apples and their different acidity, optimal harvesting moments, etc... It is then fermented in wooden barrels and we collect the natural carbon dioxide it produces. We make a small filtering and introduce the natural carbonic previously collected to give a fresher touch to the final product.

We select grapes from different places and vinify them with modern techniques and minimal intervention, so that each wine preserves the essence of the variety and honestly expresses the landscape where is coming from. *** Respect for the environment: We prioritize ecological practices in the vineyard and winery, reducing our impact: sustainable vineyards, responsible management of resources and clean processes that allow nature to express itself with purity. *** Artisanal quality: We work with limited batches with an artisanal approach, combining the experience of small winegrowers and oenological precision to create honest wines with their own character in each variety. *** Constant innovation: We explore new terroirs, winemaking methods and ageing, integrating current tools without sacrificing our essence: minimal intervention and maximum expression of the origin.

Product 1 Description: It is an organic Mediterranean coupage of 70% Garnacha Tintorera from the Gamellón area, 15% Monastrell and 15% Airén. We seek to maintain the maturity and depth of the Garnacha Tintorera, providing fluidity and color stability thanks to the Airén. Monastrell adds acidity and aromatic complexity, with more red fruit and spicy nuances. It completes a seven-month aging in barrels, mainly French and American, to integrate the wood without detracting from the fruit. It has a very covered cherry colour, with a deep bluish rim and dense tears. On the nose it is shown with high intensity, very expressive, with abundant very ripe black and red fruit, hints of blackberries and plums, balsamic that refresh the whole, delicate notes of blue flowers and a marked mineral background with subtle iodized and saltpeter nuances. On the palate it is broad and juicy, tasty and powerful but fluid, with polished tannins, good acidity and a very long, enveloping and aromatic finish.
Product 2 Description: Coming from old ungrafted vines located at an altitude of more than 800 metres, it is aged for eleven months in used French oak barrels. It is the deepest and most serious wine of the house, with great structure, outstanding minerality and remarkable aging capacity. Very limited production: only 1,151 bottles. It has a dark cherry color with a bright garnet rim. On the nose it displays a precise and elegant intensity, with blackberries and ripe cherries in the foreground, accompanied by fine spices, Mediterranean mountain herbs and subtle hints of fine cabinetry. On the palate it is juicy and sapid, with excellent balance, polished tannins and light toasted touches perfectly integrated. The good acidity provides nerve and balsamic freshness, culminating in a long, elegant, persistent finish of marked complexity.
Product 3 Description: Monovarietal airén organic wine, made with a cold maceration with its skins for 3 days and slow fermentation at low temperature in stainless steel tanks to preserve its varietal character to the maximum. It comes from a unique place in La Hoya de Torres, DOP Jumilla, with old vines on ungrafted feet located at an altitude of more than 800 metres. Production limited to 1,487 bottles and aged for more than 5 months in used 225 liters French oak barrels. It has a bright golden color. On the nose it is intense and complex, with a range of apples ranging from fresh fruit to roasted apple and cider, accompanied by delicate touches of fine wood, bay leaf, ripe citrus and peach, with subtle hints of honey and light smoky nuances. On the palate it has great volume and well-integrated acidity, it is enveloping, sapid and slightly liqueur, with a creamy texture and a very long, persistent and aromatic finish that invites you to continue drinking.

Product 1 Description: Abadal was a pioneer in Bages in recovering this variety. Abadal Mandó is a tribute to the Bages region and our innovative spirit. This variety takes longer to ripen and is resistant to high temperatures, making it a variety that adapts well to climate change. The native variety of Mandó takes us into the heart of Bages’ woodlands, with it floral aromas, carob, undergrowth and traces of spices, liquorice and ripe fruit. In the mouth it is balanced, lush and rounded. It finishes with an aromatic character typical of this variety and with a lively acidity which gives it great length in the glass. Fresh, elegant and the identity of a varietal.
Product 2 Description: Ours was the first 100% Picapoll varietal to go on the market, and by recovering this local variety Abadal is making a clear statement to reaffirm Abadal’s commitment to the identity of Bages. The Picapoll grape grows in small compact clusters, with tiny spherical berries that very often show “picades” or marks on the grape skin, which is where the name originated. Elegant and seductive; it is a fusion of citric tones, white fruit (pineapple and peach) as well as floral tones from a forest landscape (fennel, lavender and mint).

Guests enjoy Michelin-starred dining, a state-of-the-art wellness sanctuary, and curated art collections, all designed to deliver an unparalleled sensory experience. Today, Abadía Retuerta produces award-winning Pago wines under its own Protected Designation of Origin (DOP), reflecting the unique terroir of the Duero Valley. This perfect blend of heritage and modernity makes Abadía Retuerta a benchmark in luxury hospitality and fine winemaking.

Winery Description: Behind Saíñas are Jorge and Saleta, a couple of electrical engineers, guided by the winemaker Luis Seabra. We left a life full of travels, science, and light to return to our homeland and continue with a family project. This is a story full of challenges but also filled with love. Love for wine, love for the land, and love for well-made things. Our name is due to an old vineyard called SAÍÑAS, recovered on the banks of the Cabe River, in the heart of the Ribeira Sacra. Our brand image is not by chance but represents the terraces or "socalcos" that our ancestors sculpted on the river hillsides to enable grape cultivation. Specifically, the incline of the name, and that stepped form coincides with the slope and terraces of our SAÍÑAS vineyard. For our wines, we use only grapes grown on our own vines, cultivated sustainably and carefully hand-harvested. As winegrowers, our wines are intimately connected to the land from which they originate. The result is wines faithful to our principles and our way of understanding viticulture, expressing in a unique way the identity of the terroir they come from.

Winery Description: Our vineyards are located at an altitude of 500 m, and 300 m from the Miño river near a Celtic village, Lansbricae, dating from the 2nd century BC, until its Romanisation. We are surrounded by a cirque of mountains that shelter our vineyards in winter, the climate is oceanic-Mediterranean, with average annual temperatures of 14ºC and rainfall that exceeds 1,000 mm per year, with warm summers, usually dry. Our soil is made up of formations that have not evolved and settled on source rocks of great hardness, basically made up of ancient granitic materials from the Hercynian period and large quantities of quartz. We are talking about a peculiar "granite viticulture", based on acidic, loose and well-oxygenated soil. On this farm we know of its cultivation, from documents, which take us back to the sixteenth century, the time from which the house and nearby buildings date. Subsequently, it is racked for 2-3 days at low temperature. Once cleaned, fermentation begins in 5,000-litre stainless steel tanks for 30 days at 14°C with selected yeasts. Subsequently, it is kept on its lees for 3-4 months with a gentle battonage. Finally, the wine is clarified, stabilized and filtered. Tasting notes. Bright green/yellow color. Notes of citrus, green apple and white flowers (orange blossom) in a tropical yet refreshing scent

Winery Description: In the mountains of inland Valencia lies Baldovar 923, one of the most fascinating and promising wine projects on the Spanish scene. This small boutique winery has recovered historic vineyards of the Merseguera variety, native to the area. Its old vines, at over 1,000 meters above sea level, are cultivated on limestone soils under a Mediterranean climate with continental influence. Behind Baldovar 923, we find a team that committed to this remote corner with a clear vision: to produce mountain wines with a unique personality, respecting the character of the terroir. Their production philosophy is based on traditional methods that are respectful of the environment. Organic-biodynamic viticulture and low yields guarantee grapes of extraordinary quality, processed through minimal intervention winemaking. Our wines are recognized by the most prestigious international critics, such as Sarah Jane Evans, Pedro Ballesteros, Tim Atkin, and Beth Willard, among others.

Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 316
Product 1 Description: Arquela is born from our relentless quest to discover the soils where Merseguera reaches its ultimate expression. This wine is the result of two exceptional plots, selected for their singular geology: siliceous schists bathed in limestone that produce small, saline, and golden berries. These unique soils give Arquela a more defined and evident personality. In the glass, it unfolds a crisp citrus fruit expression, accompanied by a deep minerality that reveals the complexity of the terroir. It maintains perfect balance in its alcohol level, yet its character is more intense, profound, and complex than any other expression from our winery. Arquela is proof that Merseguera, when it finds the perfect soil, can create wines of extraordinary personality and elegance.
Product 2 Description: Berandía is the expression of high-altitude Bobal, grown at over 1,000 meters above sea level. This long-aged wine captures the freshness and vibrancy of our mountain plots, where altitude and climate transform the personality of this Mediterranean variety. Elegant and silky in tannins, Berandía contrasts with the more opulent Bobals of the Mediterranean. After two vintages aging in old wood, a different Bobal emerges: saline, with evocative aromas of pines and junipers, spicy and fresh. Each sip reveals layers of complexity that speak of its mountainous origin. There is landscape in the glass. Berandía is a wine that transports you to the heights where its grapes are born, a tribute to mountain viticulture and Bobal's ability to express unique terroirs.
Product 3 Description: Cañada París is the purest expression of Baldovar's terroir. This wine captures the essence of Merseguera grown in our highest plots, at 1,050 meters altitude, where sandy-loam calcareous soils and high stoniness impart a unique personality. In the glass, Cañada París reveals a pronounced minerality that interplays with saline notes, while the smooth and persistent acidity, characteristic of Merseguera, brings freshness and elegance. It is a mountain wine that speaks unfiltered of the variety-terroir pairing, crafted with minimal intervention to preserve the authenticity of this singular corner of Valencia. A tribute to high-altitude viticulture and the indomitable character of our old vines.
Product 4 Description: Cerro Negro is born from old massal selection Mencía vines, planted between 1,000 and 1,200 meters altitude. This wine seeks the perfect balance between depth and delicacy, between power and elegance. Its soils, with a high rocky content surrounded by loams and clays, allow for ripening that concentrates acidity and provides a medium-high tannic structure. To preserve the elegance characteristic of high-altitude Mencía, we vinify 30% using carbonic maceration and the remaining 70% in semi-carbonic, thus regulating the tannic structure without losing intensity. The result is a deep and complex wine, yet delicate and refined at the same time. Cerro Negro is proof that Mencía, in the heights of Valencia, can express a unique personality: mountainous, fresh, and sophisticated.
Product 5 Description: Rascaña is a skin-contact wine that explores the aromatic complexity of Merseguera through contact with its skins. Using controlled and time-limited maceration and fermentation, we seek to enhance the natural expression of the varieties, with Merseguera as the protagonist and Macabeo as a harmonious companion. The result is a wine with gastronomic personality, enveloping texture, and intense aromatics. The skins provide structure, depth, and a subtle tannic dimension that expands pairing possibilities at the table, while maintaining the freshness and elegance characteristic of our mountain wines. Rascaña is our commitment to Mediterranean skin-contact wines, a tribute to ancestral techniques applied with modern sensibility to create complex, versatile wines deeply connected to the terroir.

This land is one-of-a-kind, and we aim to showcase it alongside world-renowned companies also born and raised in Yecla. Our bond with Yecla is strong, and we proudly uphold its enterprising and innovative spirit. We offer a complete experience. Barahonda is wine, Yecla, gastronomy, and landscape. It’s the love of wine and the joy of tasting, a journey through our roots, history, and winery. Barahonda is a complete experience.

Winery Description: The company was born from the interpretation of a vineyard located in Haro (La Rioja), acquired by my parents and which came to me, Bárbara Palacios, as a gift. Since 2005, my learning has been closely linked to this vineyard and this area. Touring it, observing it and working on it, I have come to understand the style of wines it is capable of offering. My first wine, Barbarot, which I started making in 2005, is produced only in those vintages in which the climate allows full phenolic maturity to be reached. It represents a classic Rioja with a contemporary vision. Puppi Barbarot is a fresher wine, designed for everyday consumption. Last year, four new references were launched on the market: Vlatracones Blanco and Puppi Blanco, from a plot of white Grenache, along with Vlatracones and Los Escaños. These additions expand our range of wines and reinforce the winery's diversity of styles.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 450
Product 1 Description: Barbarot 2016 es un vino de terroir elaborado a partir de Tempranillo y Merlot procedentes de viñedos situados en Haro, en el corazón de Rioja Alta, sobre suelos arcillo-calcáreos a 480 metros de altitud y protegidos por los Riscos de Bilibio y la Sierra Cantabria. La añada se caracterizó por un invierno húmedo que aseguró buenas reservas hídricas y un verano muy cálido, permitiendo alcanzar una madurez fenólica completa con excelente estado sanitario. Vendimiado manualmente a mediados de octubre, fermenta en depósitos de acero inoxidable con una vinificación precisa y respetuosa. Tras la fermentación maloláctica en barrica, el vino envejece durante 15 meses en barricas bordelesas usadas de roble francés. Presenta un perfil equilibrado, con fruta roja y negra, notas especiadas y ahumadas, taninos elegantes y bien integrados, y una estructura que le permite una larga evolución en botella.
Product 2 Description: Los Escaños 2021 is a singular wine made from a small historic vineyard recovered in 2016, located next to Carasoles de Bilibio at 480 meters above sea level, with original vines dating back to 1935 and newer Tempranillo plantings. The vintage was marked by climatic contrasts that favored balanced ripening and high grape quality. Hand-harvested on October 15th, fermentation takes place with native yeasts after cold pre-fermentative maceration, with manual cap management and a post-fermentative maceration guided by daily tasting. Malolactic fermentation occurs in first-use French oak barrels, followed by 10 months of aging. It is a deep and elegant wine, with fresh red fruit, spice notes, fine tannins and excellent aging potential, conceived as a tribute and an extreme selection of the vineyard.
Product 3 Description: Puppi Barbarot 2021 represents the youthful expression of the Barbarot project, integrating grapes from young vineyards located in Haro, in plots such as Carasoles de Bilibio and Valtracones, on clay-limestone soils at 480 meters above sea level. The vintage was shaped by a cold winter with snowfall, a warm and very dry spring that advanced the growing cycle and reduced yields, and a summer with strong temperature contrasts that allowed balanced ripening and high quality. Hand-harvested in mid-October, it ferments with native yeasts after cold pre-fermentative maceration, followed by a three-week post-fermentative maceration. Aging takes place for 10 months in second- and third-use French oak barrels. The wine is fresh and expressive, with concentrated fruit, cherry and redcurrant aromas, rounded tannins and a long, harmonious finish.
Product 4 Description: Valtracones Garnacha Blanca 2022 procede de un viñedo plantado en vaso a 520 metros de altitud en el entorno del barranco de Valtracones, sobre suelos arcillo-calcáreos con alta concentración de cal activa. La añada estuvo marcada por un inicio de ciclo equilibrado y un verano seco y caluroso que aceleró la maduración, manteniendo una excelente sanidad de la uva. Vendimiado manualmente a mediados de septiembre, se elabora mediante prensado de racimo entero tras una breve maceración en frío. La fermentación se realiza a baja temperatura y la crianza durante 10 meses en barrica de roble francés de 500 litros con batonnage periódico, seguida de un reposo sobre lías finas. El vino presenta un perfil fresco y tenso, con notas cítricas e hinojo, marcada acidez, carácter salino y mineral, y una gran capacidad de guarda pese a la juventud del viñedo.
Product 5 Description: Valtracones Tempranillo 2021 is produced from a selection of parcels located around the Valtracones ravine, at 480 meters above sea level, on clay-limestone soils that favor balance and concentration. The vintage was influenced by a cold winter, a dry spring and a summer with strong diurnal temperature variations, allowing optimal ripening and good accumulation of phenolic and aromatic compounds. Hand-harvested on October 12th, the wine is made using partial carbonic maceration with whole clusters and controlled fermentation. Malolactic fermentation takes place in third-use French oak barrels, followed by 12 months of aging. The wine offers aromas of fresh red fruit, flowers and spices, with fine, elegant tannins, well-integrated oak notes and a balanced, persistent palate.

Winery Description: In 2015 Bardinet, S.A. acquired the Mont Marçal winery and the Lacrima Baccus brand. In 2017 Xavier Freixedas took over as Director. In 2020, the Lacrima Baccus location was incorporated and in 2022 the purchase of Marqués del Puerto was closed, consolidating the offer in wines and cavas. That same year, Bardinet Wines, S.A.U. was born, which brings together three wineries: Mont Marçal (Penedès, founded in 1975, a cava production centre), Lacrima Baccus (Castellet i la Gornal, 2007, bottling and DO Penedés wines) and Marqués del Puerto (La Rioja, 1972, DO Ca Rioja wines). The strategy focuses on industry risks and customer requirements. The organization has 35 people, promoting diversity and equality.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 104
Product 1 Description: Summum Brut Nature 2019 (DO Cava) Cava premium elaborado con Xarel·lo, Macabeu, Parellada, Chardonnay y Pinot Noir, con crianza mínima de 24 meses sobre sus propias lías. Presenta un color amarillo pálido con reflejos dorados y burbuja fina, persistente y de evolución lenta. En nariz, destaca por su gran intensidad aromática y complejidad: notas de albaricoque, fruta madura como melocotón y membrillo, combinadas con frutos secos y un delicado fondo de confitería. En boca, entrada fresca y voluminosa, carbónico fino y cremoso, perfectamente integrado, con acidez equilibrada y un final armónico que recuerda al brioche. Sin azúcar (0 g/l), acidez total 6,2-6,9 g/l, SO₂ total 70-75 mg/l, 12% vol. Ideal para mariscos, pescado azul, patés, carnes en salsa, estofados, quesos y arroces. Servir entre 10 y 12 ºC en botella especial de vidrio de 75 cl. Representa la esencia del trabajo vitivinícola tradicional bajo la Denominación de Origen Cava
Product 2 Description: Mont Marçal Extremarium Brut 2021 ECO (DO Cava) Cava ecológico elaborado con Xarel·lo, Macabeo, Parellada, Chardonnay y Pinot Noir, con crianza mínima de 18 meses sobre sus propias lías. Presenta un color amarillo pálido y brillante, con burbuja fina y continuada, formando una corona perfecta. En nariz, agradable y fresco, con riqueza aromática entre notas envejecidas de vainilla, fruta como melocotón, matices cítricos de pomelo y delicadas flores blancas. En boca, entrada amable y versátil, carbónico suave, textura sedosa, madurez equilibrada y recuerdo de almendra, con sensación final larga y fresca. Acidez total 5,8-6,0 g/l, azúcar 8 g/l, SO₂ total 70-75 mg/l, 11,5% vol. Servir entre 10 y 12 ºC en botella grabada especial de 75 cl. Maridaje ideal con viandas condimentadas, aves como faisán o perdiz, risottos, pescados azules y postres clásicos como pan, aceite y chocolate negro.
Product 3 Description: Railway by Marqués del Puerto 2022 (DOCa Rioja) 100% Tempranillo red wine, with 14 months in barrel and 7 months in bottle. It has an intense cherry red color with ruby meniscus and excellent shine. On the nose, fruit aromas predominate, hints of fresh must, red fruits and spices; When shaking the glass, notes of liquorice, rosewood, cloves, blackberry and pink pepper emerge, with an interesting minerality that enhances its fruitiness. On the palate, it is fresh, balanced in acidity, quality tannins, abundant tears that provide a sweet memory, very long and without edges, with subtle wood despite its aging. Total acidity 5.2 g/l, sugar 0.5 g/l, 13.5% vol. Serve between 16 and 18 ºC in a cinnamon glass bottle (75 cl). Versatile pairing: legume stews, Iberian meats, red meats and roasts. Made in Fuenmayor, Km 0 of the DOCa Rioja, it combines tradition and modern style, aged in barrels toasted with Jade volcanic stone to preserve the varietal character.

Winery Description: La Baronía de Turís is a centenary winery, founded in 1920 in the interior of the province of Valencia, where the Mediterranean landscape and winemaking tradition mark the character of our wines. We are part of the Valencia Designation of Origin, a seal that supports the authenticity and quality of our wines. We work mainly with Tempranillo, Merlot, Malvasia and our variety of origin, Moscatel, which defines the personality of many of our wines and mistelas. This commitment to excellence has been internationally recognized: in 2025, our Mistela won second award in the Muscat du Monde competition, an achievement that reaffirms the uniqueness of our work. With more than a century of history, we combine tradition and modern techniques to create wines that express the essence of our territory.

BEST SPANISH SINGLE MALT 2020

Winery Description: Bellpla Vins was born from a dream rooted in the soil — the desire to preserve a vineyard lovingly tended by four generations of the Boada family. At the heart of the project are sommeliers Natàlia Boada and César Cánovas, who bring new life to this legacy through small-batch wines crafted to capture the soul of their landscape. The vineyard, planted between 1939 and 2016, is a patchwork of macabeu and xarel·lo parcels, each with its own character. From these voices emerge our three wines: a vibrant, mineral-driven Xarel·lo; an old-vine Macabeu that is delicate and sincere; and Parcel·la Singular 1939, the deepest expression of Bellpla, aged in chestnut barrels from the Montseny forests. Guided by a respect for nature, every decision is rooted in sustainability: local corks, natural wax seals, and cotton labels. Local chestnut wood for ageing completes a journey that seeks honesty, coherence, and a true connection to the land that inspires us.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 234
Product 1 Description: Delicate Macabeo from old vineyards. 100% Macabeo from vines planted in 1939 and 1978. Grown on the Penedès plain with clay-limestone soils, Mediterranean climate with warm summers and mild, ideally rainy winters. The 2024 vintage brought a later-than-usual harvest with healthy and balanced grapes. Rain and mild temperatures allowed slow ripening, with low yield but good concentration. Grapes are hand-picked in 20 kg boxes. 1939 plot fermented and aged in chestnut barrels for 2 months; 1978 plot in stainless steel tanks. Final blend: 60% 1978, 40% 1939. This wine shows aromas of white and stone fruit, gentle tropical notes, and menthol nuances. On the palate it is fresh, full-bodied, silky, and round, with subtle acidity and a persistent finish.
Product 2 Description: The most honest expression of local varieties in a unique vineyard. Macabeo and Xarel·lo co-planted in 1939 on the Penedès plain, with clay-limestone soil, Mediterranean climate with warm summers and mild, ideally rainy winters. The 2024 vintage brought a later-than-usual harvest with healthy, balanced grapes. Rain and mild temperatures allowed slow ripening, with low yield but good concentration. Hand-harvested in 20 kg boxes, grapes are cold-pressed whole. Macabeo and Xarel·lo ferment and age for 3 months in new chestnut barrels with lees work; the final blend is made afterward (30% Macabeo, 70% Xarel·lo) and rest in stainless steel until bottling. It is an expressive wine, with aromas of stone fruit, toasted chestnut, aromatic herbs, and ripe pear, very complex. Silky with hints of white chocolate, broad, round, soft acidity, luscious and persistent, with minerality and good mouthfeel, where the fruit lingers.
Product 3 Description: The most traditional expression of Xarel·lo in our area. 100% Xarel·lo from vines planted in 1939, 1992, and 2016. Grown on the Penedès plain with clay-limestone soil, Mediterranean climate with warm summers and mild, rainy winters. The 2024 harvest was later than usual, with healthy and balanced grapes. Rain and mild temperatures allowed slow ripening, producing a less acidic and well-concentrated profile. Grapes were hand-picked and vinified by plot. Fermentation and aging in 500 l chestnut barrels for 3 months, with regular lees work. Final blend: 50% young vines, 30% 1992 vines, 20% 1939 vines. The wine shows aromas of stone fruit, white chocolate, and butter. Broad, round, with soft acidity and a subtly bitter finish, typical of Xarel·lo.

Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 165

Winery Description: What a fascinating and authentic project! Berta Valgañón seems to have an incredibly respectful approach to both the winemaking tradition and the environment. La Rioja Alta, with its history and terroir, is a special place to produce wines, and it seems that Berta has managed to perfectly integrate that heritage with sustainable and ecological practices. The fact that their winery is a fourteenth-century construction, rehabilitated and located in a "Magical Town" in Spain, gives it an even more unique and culturally enriched touch. In addition, the use of a cave for the maturation of the wines, where the temperature remains so stable, is a really interesting detail that surely influences the quality and character of the wines. Have you tried any of their wines or are you interested in knowing more about how this whole process influences the taste and style of the wine?

Winery Description: En Bertha elaboramos cava desde 1989. Empezamos en la capital del cava: en el centro de Sant Sadurní d’Anoia, pero desde 2014 tenemos una bodega nueva y moderna, preparada con un exclusivo winebar, para recibir a nuestros clientes, en uno de los lugares más privilegiados del mundo. Josep Torres, enólogo y propietario, ha logrado imprimir un estilo propio en sus botellas, en buena medida por la regularidad de la magistral elección de los vinos base, y por el aporte de las levaduras apropiadas. Desde Bertha, queremos transmitir la identidad de nuestro territorio, nuestras variedades autóctonas y la magia de nuestro paisaje. Elaboramos todos los productos ecológicos y trabajamos principalmente con las variedades autóctonas clásicas de nuestro territorio, la Xarel·lo, macabeu y parellada.

Product 1 Description: Acopinyat is a surprising version from Dalt Turó, a family estate located in Campos, Mallorca, known for its artisanal approach and sustainable viticulture. This unusual white wine, which combines red and white varieties, offers marine aromas, tropical fruits, and a hint of vegetation. On the palate, it is dry, structured, with lively acidity and a long, refreshing finish. It is an original wine, ideal for surprising guests as an aperitif or pairing with blue fish and rice dishes from the island.
Product 2 Description: Paloma Mínguez Bobal 2022 is a magnificent single-varietal Bobal wine made from vines over 40 years old in the El Ardal vineyard in the province of Valencia. Passionate winegrowers Manuel Manzaneque and Paloma Mínguez use organic viticulture techniques to produce a wine that surprises with its balance and lively freshness, without losing any of its Mediterranean essence. The 40-year-old vineyard, planted on well-aerated sandy clay soils with a large amount of limestone on the surface, was cultivated organically with the aim of obtaining ripe, healthy, and balanced grapes. In terms of vinification, the selection of bunches in the winery gave way to cold pre-fermentation maceration, temperature-controlled alcoholic fermentation, and subsequent maceration with the skins. The wine was then subjected to a fermentation process. Ideal for accompanying local dishes (migas, pisto) as well as rice dishes and cold meats.

Product 1 Description: Aistear, "the journey" in Gaelic, is a mosaic wine obtained from old mountain vineyards in the easternmost and westernmost areas of Rioja Alavesa (Labastida, Lanciego, Elvillar and Kripán). We select the best grapes, harvesting only the highest parts of the slopes, which are not very fertile and have very low yields, which give grapes of higher quality. Winery Description: Family winery, we are winegrowers and since 1998 we have been selecting our best grapes to make honest wines with Bullas Protected Designation of Origin. In Murcia, in the southeast of Spain. The winery and vineyards are located in the magical Aceniche Valley, on the estate that my grandmother Josefa, nicknamed La Balcona, bought in the 1940s. Totally surrounded by mountains, some of the highest in the Region of Murcia, it is an area of ​​high ecological value, with an average height of 825 metres above sea level and a diversity of soils. Cold winters allow organic farming and summers with a contrast of day-night temperatures of over 15ºC allow the slow ripening of the grapes, which gives our wines freshness and a long life in the bottle. Wines made from Monastrell that ferment spontaneously: yeasts present in the grape. Minimal intervention in the winery: our terroir in your glass. Since 2017, all our wines have been certified organic. In addition to our indigenous grape, Monastrell other grapes same Syrah, Tempranillo, Merlot and Macabeo find their perfect habitat here. Merlot for Mabal Rosé and Macabeo for our barrel-fermented white wine.

Winery Description: Located in Torroja de Priorat, in the heart of Priorat, specializes in producing wines from native grape varieties such as Cariñena and Garnacha, as well as Merlot and Syrah. We also craft an exceptional white wine from Macabeo and Garnacha Blanca—a true gem in a region renowned primarily for its reds. We carefully select our vineyards to best express the terroir of each plot. Our unique combination of slate, loamy-clay, clay-sandy, and loamy-limestone soils, together with old vines of Garnacha, Cariñena, and Macabeo, allows us to produce wines of exceptional quality. During the 2008 harvest they started new adventures going out from the Cebreros vineyards and locating diferent sites at El Barraco and El Tiemblo. The project, Daniel Ramos, makes wines that show the personality of the diferent soils, varieties (Garnacha, Sauvignon Blanc y Albillo Real) and terroirs of where the vineyards are planted: these are the Zerberos Finca wines. Winery Description: Eslava is a small town of about 100 inhabitants. Most of the families in this town have always lived and live by working their land and vineyards. The history of Bodega Eslava is the life and history of its neighbors and cannot be understood without them. Due to the continuous emptying of rural areas and the aging of its inhabitants, the winery has decreased in number of members and today, 14 enthusiastic and brave members fight to keep alive what they love most, which has meant the identity of a community. But Eslava's tradition of winemaking comes from far beyond. Thanks to the heritage found in the archaeological excavations of Santa Criz de Eslava, there is evidence that shows that the Romans cultivated these same lands to make wine for more than 2,000 years. Grenache has been the variety par excellence at Bodega Eslava since our origins thanks to the loyalty of the families of Eslava.

Product 1 Description: Bodega Eslava Blanc was born to express the diversity of the territory of Eslava, which is why it is part of the family of Vinos de Villa, a true reflection of its origin. The story goes that, among the Garnacha Tinta vines, from time to time vines with bunches of white grapes appeared, a curiosity that surprised generation after generation in wine-growing families. Today it is known that Garnacha Tinta and Garnacha Blanca share a close relationship, and in Eslava these white vines are being recovered in different places to rediscover that living memory of the vineyard. Its characteristics include aromas of white fruit intermingled with herbal notes so characteristic of the Baja Montaña and a very refreshing palate provided by its acidity. Preparation: Fermented with native yeast selected from the territory in Galileo concrete tanks. Variety: 100% White Grenache exclusive to the Villa de Eslava Viticulture: Regenerative with microbial population
Product 2 Description: The cultivation of vines in Slavia is characterized by its great diversity in terms of altitudes, soils and orientations. The richness and uniqueness of the landscape are our hallmark. This village wine is born from the union of different places: the youngest vineyard in our winery, located in the Paraje de Zabalea, at an altitude of 611 m, and the Paraje de Zubaldea, at 570 m, of saso soil, give us delicate floral notes and freshness in the mouth. This complements perfectly with the herbal profile notes of the young grape from the Argabidea, Pisaldea and Guezari areas, with altitudes of around 500 m and clay soils, as well as from Sirgún, also with a saso soil. Our rainfed agriculture, the influence of the Pyrenean climate and the great diversity of altitudes and soils of our vineyard are expressed in our collection of Villa wines. Preparation: Fermented bleeding method in 80-year-old concrete tank. Variety: 100% Garnacha Tinta from young vines.
Product 3 Description: Malagata is a century-old plot of red Grenache in goblet and grown in dry land that, from today, gives its name to a wine with the shape, flavour and aroma of Navarrese Baja Montaña. A vineyard, and now also a wine, which symbolises the tireless work of several generations of Eslava to defend what is already a sign of identity of the territory: Grenache. It is a single-vineyard wine made in concrete tanks over 80 years old with Garnacha grapes exclusive to the Malagata plot. Aged for 10 months in 500 L French oak barrels and a limited production of 936 bottles The vines are kept in goblet and the grapes are harvested by hand by the winegrower himself.
Product 4 Description: In Eslava there is a high of saso soil called "Guezari" where there have always been vineyards. It is an exceptional place for rainfed cultivation. It is home to two small plots of Garnacha Tinta that are more than 40 years old. These plots are the origin of our mountain wine "Paraje de Guezari". Paraje de Guezari is a Paraje wine in which the Grenache expresses the landscape of mountain vegetation that surrounds the vineyard. Transmitting herbal aromas that come from thyme, sores, fennel and rosemary accompanied by aromas of wild fruits such as juniper and spider mite. Paraje de Guezari is the maximum expression of the profile of an authentic Grenache wine marked by the mountains. Ageing: 4 months in French oak barrels Variety: 100% Red Grenache. Exclusive grapes from the plot of the Paraje de Guezari Production: Limited. 2,944 bottles Preparation: Fermentation in 80-year-old concrete tanks

Winery Description: Bodega del Abad is situated in the most prestigious and historic district of the Bierzo region. With around 20 hectares under vine, we focus solely on the two renowned varietals indigenous to the region-Godello and Mencia-with some of our vines being over 80 years old. Our winery is uniquely located on the original route of the Camino de Santiago, the world-famous pilgrimage trail. The circular insignia in our logo represents the single window of the tiny village church, which historically served as a clinic for weary pilgrims seeking medical assistance. At Bodega del Abad, Godello & Mencia are our Heart & Soul. Our winemaking philosophy is rooted in harnessing the unique features of our growing area, characterized by a special mix of climate and landscape. This results in wines that are not only potent and well-structured but also fine and elegant. We elaborate our wines with honesty and respect for our terroir, people, and traditions.

On the nose it shows great aromatic complexity, with notes of ripe black and red fruit, hints of graphite, cocoa, damp earth and a subtle spicy background, a reflection of the terroir and its careful aging. On the palate it is balanced and fresh, with fine and well-integrated tannins, an elegant structure and a marked mineral character. The finish is long, tasty and precise, confirming a wine with identity, ageing capacity and a clear gastronomic vocation. A signature Mencía that reflects the know-how of the winemaker Ramiro Carbajo and the philosophy of Bodega del Abad. Winery Description: Bodega Eruption does not adapt to the landscape: it submits to it. While many seek to tame the land, here the volcano is accepted in all its harshness. It is dug in black ash, the vine is protected from the wind with volcanic stone and worked by hand, because there is no other possible way. It's not an aesthetic choice: it's a necessity. That difference changes everything. The vineyard decides the rhythm and leads the way, where 100% of the grapes are produced in-house, with integral organic maintenance, and the intervention in the winery is reduced to the essential minimum. It is not corrected, it is not disguised, it is not softened. It is heard. The result is not a friendly wine. It is a wine that takes your breath away, that tenses the palate, that leaves a mark. A wine where salt, fire and the Atlantic meet in a vertical, deep and honest expression. An experience that is not explained: it is felt. Bodega Eruption does not seek to please everyone. Fermentation takes place spontaneously in stainless steel tanks, after which the wine is aged for four months in new 500-liter French oak barrels, adding complexity while preserving finesse. It was decided to focus on the recovery of native varieties. Grapes that convey the essence of the soil, climate, and people of El Terrerazo. It combines old bush vines and strictly dry farming with the most modern cultivation techniques, seeking a balance between climate, plant, and soil. There are no magic formulas; the winemaking process must be the path that the grapes take in the winery to obtain a wine that expresses what happened that year in the vineyard.

Product 1 Description: At Finca Calvestra, we strive to express all the nuances of the estate through Merseguera, a Mediterranean variety that we are attempting to recover and understand. Merseguera is a difficult variety to work with, with a long cycle and historically low quality. It is shy in aroma and not very expressive in its youth, with white almond blossom and white stone fruit. It becomes complex over time, developing aromas of fennel, thyme and honeycomb. The expression of the estate, at 920 metres surrounded by pine trees and tertiary limestone soil, with yellow silt and a loamy-clay texture, offers us slow ripening and gives the wine great acidity, balance and a certain salinity, with the harvest taking place at the end of September. Strict dry farming gives us weight and natural smoothness on the palate, making it very special. We would define it as a medium-bodied, fresh, long and elegant Mediterranean wine that faithfully reflects the place where it is born.
Product 2 Description: The idea behind this wine is to offer the best expression of our Bobal grape, expressing all the personality of the soil, landscape and climate of El Terrerazo. Product 3 Description: Mestizaje is an honest wine that reflects our dynamism and commitment to a job well done. With this wine, we seek to respect the expression of the vintage and the fruit, allowing our soils and climate to shine through. We want it to be a Mediterranean wine.
Product 4 Description: We seek to offer a Mediterranean white wine, but with altitude, where freshness and minerality prevail. The blend is practically made in the vineyard, with Merseguera vines grown in goblet and lyre styles, grafted onto old Bobal vines, and Viognier, Xarello, Macabeo and Malvasia vines grown on trellises. The entire vineyard is dry-farmed and organically grown. Mestizaje Blanco is a fresh wine, with an aromatic intensity typical of the Mediterranean, well balanced and with good acidity. It is a wine that aims to introduce consumers to our winery through a different kind of wine.
Product 5 Description: The idea behind this wine is to offer the best expression of our old Bobal vines. Personally crafted and entirely handmade. A unique and singular wine.

Las producciones de estas cepas son muy bajas no superando en ninguna ocasión los 3.000 kg/ha., por lo que se obtiene unos frutos con unos marcados caracteres del terreno de la zona de producción. Una vez vendimiada la uva, los vinos maceraron durante 35 días. El vino se metió en barricas seleccionas de roble francés de los mejores bosques. Durante su permanencia en barrica su cuidado fue máximo, rellenando las barricas, realizando periódicamente el Batonage y trasegándolo en primavera y otoño. Finalmente se clarificó y embotelló. Fase visual: Rojo picota muy cubierto, con tonos granates en capa fina. Glicérico y brillante. Fase olfativa: Una vez reposado en la copa, fruta negra: grosella negra, arándano y mora, fruta en compota, cacao, chocolate, sutiles torrefactos, pimienta y clavo. Fase gustativa: Potente, carnoso, redondo.
Product 3 Description: Para la elaboración de este vino se emplea exclusivamente uva procedente de nuestros mejores viñedos. Tras una rigurosa vendimia manual, parcela por parcela, se obtiene unos frutos en su mejor momento de maduración. Una vez vendimiada la uva, los vinos maceraron durante 25 días, para dar paso a una crianza en barricas seleccionadas de roble americano y francés de los mejores bosques, permaneciendo en ellas durante 6 meses. Durante su permanencia en barrica su cuidado fue máximo, rellenando las barricas y trasegándolo en primavera. Finalmente se clarificó y se embotelló. Fase visual: Limpio, brillante, rojo cereza muy cubierto con tonos violáceos en capa fina. Fase olfativa: Intensa fruta roja fresca, fresa, frambuesa, grosella, perfectamente ensamblada con la madera, recuerdos balsámicos, finos especiados, y de fondo, ligeros tostados. Fase gustativa: Taninos rotundos redondos que aportan finura con gran persistencia en un equilibrio perfecto con la acidez
Product 4 Description: La vendimia se realiza de forma manual, seleccionando los mejores racimos en el momento óptimo de maduración. Una vez vendimiada y encubada la uva, el mosto maceró en frío con los hollejos durante unas 12 horas. El mosto obtenido de este sangrado se metió en barricas nuevas de roble francés, allí se realizó la fermentación alcohólica, y posteriormente se mantuvo en las mismas barricas durante 7 meses en función de la añada. Durante el periodo de crianza en barrica, permaneció en contacto con las lías, realizando el battonage (removido de las lías) y rellenado de las barricas, periódicamente.Finalmente se clarificó y se embotelló. Fase visual : rojo fresa, limpio, brillante y glicérico. Fase olfativa : aroma de intensidad alta, fruta madura, tonos de madera y ligeros tostados. Fase gustativa: buena acidez, potente y amable; redondo y complejo.
Product 5 Description: La vendimia se realiza en el momento óptimo de maduración, siempre por la noche con el fin de recoger la uva a baja temperatura, de esta manera se evitan oxidaciones y se mantiene todo el potencial aromático de la uva. La uva se somete a una criomaceración con el fin de extraer todo su potencial aromático. El mosto obtenido se desfanga y se fermenta a baja temperatura. Una vez terminada la fermentación, el vino se mantiene con las lías finas aproximadamente dos meses con el fin de obtener un vino muy aromático, fresco y complejo, con una boca amplia y elegante. Finalmente se clarificó y se embotelló. Fase visual: amarillo pajizo verdoso, limpio, brillante y glicérico. Fase olfativa: aroma de intensidad alta, con aromas de fruta exótica, cítricos, flores blancas, ligeros tonos de hierba fresca. Fase gustativa: amplio ,fresco ,equilibrado. Tonos de hinojo y manzana.

Winery Description: Santa Catarina’s story began in the 1980s when Swedish native Stellan Lundqvist moved to Mallorca to pursue an ambitious wine project. The winery gained prominence for its innovative use of French grape varieties, a pioneering approach on the island. However, in 2002, the family paused winemaking, leasing their vineyards to local producers. After Stellan's passing in 2012, his family revived the winery to honor his dream. In 2016, guided by Italian oenologist Roberto Cipresso and Mallorcan winemaker Joan Gutiérrez, the winery transformed. French vines were replaced with native varieties like Prensal, Girò Ros, Manto Negro, and Callet, alongside Mediterranean ones. A new facility at finca Son Aloy in Sencelles, spanning 40 hectares, became the heart of production. Mallorca, famed for its beaches, also boasts a millennia-old wine tradition. The island’s unique terroir, Call Vermell, features red earth, calcareous crusts, and compact clay. Santa Catarina employs sustainable practices, including subterranean irrigation and a 2024 transition to organic farming. Its wines embody the harmony of native grapes, unique terroir, and Mediterranean climate, blending tradition with innovation.

Product 1 Description: - 100% Merlot - Unfortified red wine, aged for 4 months in French oak barrels - 12.5% alcohol by volume. The grapes for this unfortified wine come from Ronda, however, the essence of this wine, beyond the grapes’ origin, lies in the Málaga’s Axarquía, where its complex development takes place. At the winery the grapes are placed on “floating racks” for 3-4 days allowing a balanced drying process as the currents of air circulate below the bunches. The grapes are collected, bunch by bunch, de-stemmed and placed in stainless steel tanks, for a week-long cold maceration pre-fermentation. Following this the grapes are extracted and gently pressed. Temperature controlled fermentation of the musts (without skins) at 15ºC. The resulting wine is aged in French oak barrels of various ages for 8 months.
Product 2 Description: - 100% Moscatel de Alejandría - Unfortified sweet white wine. The grapes selected for this unfortified wine come from Malaga’s Axarquía. The vineyards are found on the steep slopes of the hillsides that characterise the area. The 80-100 year old vines grow in slate soils dotted with white quartz at altitudes of 500-850m and with the Mediterranean sea just a few kilometres away. The traditional bush vines are short pruned to the trunk. Production per vine is 0,5-1 kg. The grapes are sun-dried in the historic ‘paseros’ - raisin beds typical of the region. The harvest is manual, with grapes collected in 15 kilo crates. They are carefully transferred to the paseros where they are laid out bunch by bunch. Once the desired sugar level has been reached they are re-collected, destemmed and gently pressed obtaining low volume, high quality musts. Fermentation takes place in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks. The wine is micro-filtered before bottling. Matured in bottle: 3 years.
Product 3 Description: - 100% Romé - Dry rosé wine matured for 8 months on fine lees - 12,5%. VINEYARD & VINIFICATION: The steep old vineyards of Malaga’s Axarquía maintain much of the diversity of grapevines that makes them unique. Among the varieties is Romé, the rare indigenous red grape, small quantities of which are found planted randomly, here and there. Our desire to preserve this variety led us to developing the rosé, a wine faithful to the terroir and with great typicality, a result of the variety’s adaptation to its environment. The vines are grown ‘en vaso’ – in a shallow pit, their branches creeping horizontally along the ground. The harvest is manual, using 15 kilo crates, with selection in the vineyard. The fruit are de-stemmed and lightly pressed. There is no maceration pre-fermentation; instead spontaneous fermentation occurs in stainless temperature controlled stainless steel tanks.
Product 4 Description: - Moscatel de Alejandría - Dry white wine with 8 months of ageing on the lees - 13% alcohol by volume - Bottle 0.75 lt. VINEYARD AND VINIFICATION The Axarquía region is known for its steep and rugged mountain range. The old vineyards give us the fruit for this unique dry white wine. The slate soils, speckled with white quartz are about 500-850 metres above sea level and the influence of the nearby Mediterranean Sea is of great importance. Here viticulture is hard, yet gratifying. The traditional bush vines receive a short pruning in winter, and in spring the branches grow in a low bush near to the soil. Yields per vine are 0,5-1 kg.After the thoroughly monitored ripening process is complete, at the start of August the grapes are harvested manually in cases of 15 kilos, with careful selection in the vineyard. The bunches are de-stemmed and gently pressed. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel tanks under temperature control, followed by an extended period of ageing on the lees

Winery Description: Our family has been always dedicated to growing grapes and elaborating wine in our old cellars at our home town Briones.In 2000 the brand “Betolaza” was created, selling only young red wine, it was until 2006 that we started elaborating crianza and we built a little winery, were my sister and myself are actually working (Clara and Fran, third generation of winemakers).We own small vineyards situated in Briones, most of them with clay calcareous soils and an atlantic influenced climate. Each one of our small parcels give to our wines different personalities because of the grape varieties, the terroir, and the age of our vines. Calvario, Calitrancos, el Cantillo, etc. all names full of old local reminiscences. Our philosophy is to hand-pick our grapes in their optimal ripening moment and selecting the clusters in the vineyard for the different wines we’re going to elaborate. The good wine starts in the vine.

Winery Description: Located in the Basque country, Bodegas Bhilar is our boutique winery in Elvillar, Rioja Alavesa. We are a husband and wife team, David Sampedro and Melanie Hickman, dedicated to producing unique wines that reflect a sense of place through biodynamic viticulture and minimal intervention in the winery. Bhilar is the name of our village, Elvillar, in the Basque language. David started this journey in 1999 with just three hectares of vines. An Agricultural Engineer, Licensed Enologist, and Vine Grower from Elvillar, he chose to blaze his own path by converting our vineyards to organic viticulture to reveal a different side of Rioja in a bottle. Shortly after converting to Organic, David discovered Biodynamic Agriculture and we embraced its principles to restore Harmony Between Man, Earth, Vines, and the Cosmos. In 2014, we eliminated tractors and reintroduced horses to plough the soil. Our estate was certified Biodynamic by Demeter International in 2021.

Product 1 Description: Phinca Abejera takes its name from the paraje, or vineyard site, “Abejera,” a nod to its history as a sanctuary for bees (abejas). Planted in 1929, this gently sloping, west-facing vineyard has been part of David’s life since childhood, reflecting his deep, lifelong connection to this land. Surrounded by Mediterranean flowers and herbs, the vineyard exudes aromas of garrigue that subtly enhance the wine’s character. A neighboring orchard further evokes the vineyard’s history as a haven for pollinators and biodiversity. The old bush vines, rooted in shallow limestone clay soils, yield a distinctive blend of Graciano, Tempranillo, and Viura. Biodynamically farmed and worked by plow horse, Phinca Abejera encapsulates the harmony of its environment, offering a wine of complexity, character, and a profound sense of place.
Product 2 Description: David has worked the soils of La Revilla since his youth, developing a profound understanding of the vines and their unique character. Planted in 1925, this small parcel features limestone clay soils and individually staked vines planted al cuadro at 1.8 x 1.8 meters, a traditional square pattern historically used for horse plowing—a practice we continue today as part of our biodynamic farming. Named after the area’s historical designation, “La Revilla,” the vineyard is carefully tended, with a strip of native herbs left between rows to enhance soil health and promote biodiversity. Produced in both red and white expressions, this single-vineyard wine pays homage to Rioja’s tradition of long-aging wines while introducing a refreshing vibrancy not often found in aged styles. Its limited production is a result of meticulous care in the vineyard, where every task is done by hand.
Product 3 Description: The name Phincas draws inspiration from PHI, the Golden Ratio, symbolizing balance and harmony, and finca, the Spanish word for estate. Together, they reflect our philosophy: the pursuit of equilibrium between the land and the winemaking process. As the flagship wines of our winery, available in both red and white, Phincas represents the essence of our biodynamic vineyards. The grapes are sourced from older, horse-plowed parcels, where deep roots and careful farming cultivate vines of profound character and expression. These wines spend additional time in the winery to achieve their balance, maturing in oak and concrete to develop a rounded, seamless profile. By focusing on the care of the land and a thoughtful, low-intervention approach in the winery, Phincas allows the terroir to truly shine.

Winery Description: Welcome to Bodegas Bigardo I am Kiko Calvo, and I welcome you to my little big winery. This is our philosophy: to create free, genuine wines, without unnecessary additives, expressing everything our vineyard has to offer. This is not just another winery; here, the Tinta de Toro is not merely Tempranillo. The Tinta de Toro grape variety is the reason we rise early every morning—to make wines that you can enjoy and that will accompany you in life’s moments. Bigardo is not a "family winery that combines tradition and innovation." It is the pursuit of a dream to bottle my land. This sweet effort is reflected in every sip and allows me to share these DO Toro wines with countless corners of the world. We need you to continue growing. Come and discover Bodegas Bigardo; you won’t regret it. If you want to talk about tannins and pH, I’m ready—it's one of my favorite topics. See you in Barcelona!

Product 2 Description: PELLEJO: D.O.TORO SINGLE-VINEYARD RED WINE PELLEJO IS AN EXCEPTIONAL RED WINE, DESIGNED FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS AND NOT SUITABLE FOR ALL AUDIENCES. Winery Description: Bocopa was founded in 1987 by cooperatives in Alicante with the aim of defending traditional viticulture, native grape varieties and the value of working in the countryside. Thanks to cooperativism, Bocopa has invested in innovation, sustainability, quality and design, becoming Alicante's most emblematic winery. From its winery in Petrer, Bocopa produces brands such as Marina Alta, Marina Espumante, Laudum and Fuego Lento, which represent different expressions of the Mediterranean lifestyle, from freshness and celebration to elegance, tradition and a careful gastronomic vocation. All wines are vegan, gluten-free and made exclusively from grapes grown by local winegrowers.

Winery Description: The history of Bodegas Cano dates back to 1860, when Blas Cano García founded the old winery in Higueruela (Albacete). Although the coast is only 70 km away, Yecla has a continental climate, with long winters and summers, little rainfall and more than 3000 hours of sunshine, ideal conditions for Monastrell and Garnacha Tintorera. Poor, calcareous and deep soils favour quality reds, where the cultivation of Macabeo and Chardonnay also offers excellent results. Product 1 Description: Our most emblematic and widely enjoyed wine, the direct heir to the first young wines that EL GRIFO produced in Lanzarote from 1980 onwards. It was then that the winery marked a milestone in Canarian oenology, introducing for the first time stainless steel tanks and temperature control systems that preserved the freshness and natural aromas of Malvasía Volcánica, the island’s native and predominant variety. The result is a fresh, elegant and deeply Atlantic white wine, with notes of white fruit, flowers and subtle mineral touches that evoke the volcanic landscape of La Geria. On the palate, it is balanced and vibrant, with an acidity that enhances its varietal character and unmistakable island identity. A wine that embodies the renewal of Lanzarote’s viticulture and El Grifo’s enduring fidelity to its roots.
Product 2 Description: An age-worthy white wine, the natural evolution of our Seco Colección. Its extended aging on fine lees —both in tank and barrel— followed by bottle refinement, gives it a depth and structure rarely found in Malvasía Volcánica wines. The result is a wine as complex as it is long-lived, where notes of ripe fruit, honey, and white flowers blend with hints of toasted bread and subtle smoky undertones. On the palate, it is broad, silky, and enveloping, supported by a vibrant acidity that ensures lasting freshness. A white wine with the soul of a red, showcasing the potential of Malvasía Volcánica to produce great age-worthy wines of identity, balance, and elegance.
Product 3 Description: Undoubtedly one of the wines that most faithfully reflects the character of Listán Negro, a pre-phylloxera and native variety of the Canary Islands. The brief maceration of the must with the skins allows the aromatic essence of the grape to be extracted while softening the natural tannins of the varietal. The result is a pale, delicate rosé in colour, yet surprisingly intense in aroma and expression, with notes of strawberry, raspberry and rose petals, accompanied by a subtle mineral background. On the palate, it is smooth, fresh and well-balanced, with a silky texture and a persistent finish that reflects the volcanic identity of Lanzarote.
Product 4 Description: An exceptional symbiosis between two grape varieties that ferment separately and come together to undergo malolactic fermentation in barrel, achieving a perfect balance between typicity and elegance. The Listán Negro, an indigenous and pre-phylloxera variety, contributes its distinctive aroma and volcanic expression, while the Syrah, planted in 2000, adds color, structure, and depth, allowing for a harmonious aging in French oak. After its time in barrel, the wine refines in bottle, developing aromatic complexity with interwoven notes of ripe fruit, spices, and subtle toasted hints, supported by a broad, balanced, and persistent palate. The result is a sophisticated red wine with an Atlantic soul, reflecting the singularity of Lanzarote’s vineyards and the innovative spirit of EL GRIFO.
Product 5 Description: The Vijariego grape variety arrived in the Canary Islands from Andalusia in the 16th century, initially valued as a table grape and for raisin making. This wine fermented and matured on its lees in a 500-liter French oak barrel, designed with a methacrylate base that allows visitors to observe the resting lees, as well as the seductive cloudiness that emerges after batonage, or shaking. After fermentation, it remained in the barrel for a year on its fine lees. It comes in a captivating straw yellow, adorned with light golden tones that shine with cleanliness and luminosity. On the nose, it unfolds an olfactory feast featuring notes of acidic fruit, such as grapefruit, and citrus, evoking the freshness of orange peel. Chamomile flowers and hay add an ethereal touch, while a balsamic nuance of fennel reflects the terpenic nature of this variety. Complex aromas, such as flint or flint, subtly emerge, complemented by hints of pastries and dairy, resulting from the autolysis of the yeasts

Winery Description: Bodegas El Tanino is a small cooperative located in Hoya Gonzalo (Albacete) that was established in 2006 by thirty members from the area, with the aim of transforming their grapes into high quality wines. Today the cooperative manages more than 700 hectares located within the DO Almansa, at more than 900 meters of altitude, in which a type of agriculture that is respectful of the quality of the grapes is carried out, always seeking low yields and thus obtaining better maturation and concentration. The main variety in the area is Garnacha Tintorera, which produces wines with high color and alcohol content. In the westernmost area of ​​the DO Almansa, which is where Hoya Gonzalo is located, and other neighboring municipalities, is where the Garnacha Tintorera wines show the most color intensity due to the altitude of the area and the thermal oscillation between day and night. Other varieties are also grown such as Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Chardonnay, which produce excellent wines thanks to the climatic conditions that are so favorable for slow and longer maturation than in other areas.

Fermented in temperature-controlled stainless-steel tanks with gentle skin contact to enhance colour and aromas. Aged in fine-grained French oak barrels from Nevers, which give subtle spicy notes to enrich the wine’s finesse and elegance. On the palate, it has a silky, almost velvety texture that enhances its balanced and deep character. Ideal with strong cheeses, red meats, and traditional Spanish cuisine. Made as always. Tastes like never before. AWARD: SILVER MEDAL AT THE ZARCILLO AWARDS 2025 FOR BEST VILLAGE WINE OF LA RIOJA
Product 2 Description: 100% red Tempranillo from our estate vineyards, planted on clay-limestone and alluvial soils that favour phenolic richness and balanced ripeness. Low-yielding vines which are cultivated using traditional methods and dry-farmed, produce grapes of exceptional aromatic intensity and structure. This wine from the latest vintage is bottled straight from the tank to preserve its vibrant fruit character and the grapes at their optimal ripeness. An authentic example of the terroir and the unique characteristics of its vintage. Fermented in open 8,000 L stainless-steel tanks with manual pump-overs for gentle, controlled extraction, then finished in concrete to enhance volume while preserving the fruit’s freshness. It has an intense colour with purple-red hues and violet reflections. Full-bodied, it reveals red fruit notes on the nose and a lively, vibrant palate—a direct expression of the grape’s natural concentration. Made as always. Tastes like never before.
Product 3 Description: Our signature wine is an interpretation of the heart of Rioja Alta. Made from a carefully selected manual harvest of our oldest plots in Cenicero, it seeks the purest expression of this exceptional terroir through a calm, limited approach to winemaking. Aged for 20 months in new French oak barrels, which not only ensure the wine longevity but also shape a complex, subtle, and silky structure on the palate. Fine-grained oak from Nevers, France, reveals delicate hints of sweet spice, cacao, and toasted notes, enhancing and celebrating the pureness of the fruit. A fine and expressive wine, defined by elegance, depth, and a distinctive sense of place.

Winery Description: Bodegas Frontonio is a terroir-driven wine project based in Alpartir (Zaragoza, Aragón), in the heart of the Sierra del Jalón, working with 30 hectares of estate-owned vineyards, old dry-farmed bush vines planted between 450 and over 1,000 metres on poor, steep soils that provide freshness, tension and a strong mineral identity. Viticulture is certified organic, with the entire estate in conversion to biodynamic farming (Demeter). Winemaking is based on sensitive intervention, with spontaneous fermentations, use of whole clusters when appropriate, and ageing in concrete, clay, neutral wood and 17th-century underground cellars, where wines evolve slowly under natural conditions. The aim is to interpret the landscape and translate it into precise, vibrant and authentic wines. The project is led by Fernando Mora, whose vision has positioned Frontonio among the most highly regarded producers in Aragón and Spain, with top scores from leading international wine critics.

The grapes are 100% foot-crushed and fermented with native yeasts for 40 days in cement, followed by 12 months of aging in foudres and used barrels, preserving freshness and complexity. With 13.5% alcohol, this vintage is defined by balance and precision. In the glass, it shows a bright red color. Aromas of red fruit, wildflowers, and mountain herbs emerge, with a subtle spiced background. On the palate, it is vibrant, with pronounced freshness, firm yet soft tannins, and a long, elegant finish, faithfully reflecting its terroir.

A palmerina and a cacabelense who try to combine the art of wines from La Palma del Condado (Huelva) with the philosophy of El Bierzo wines.

En su elaboración no añadimos ni quitamos nada, nuestros vinos son solo uva. Color amarillo pajizo. Nariz con aromas a manzana, levadura, panadería y cítricos. En boca es fresco, de burbuja fina y elegante, con un final largo.

The must ferments in a 2000L stainless steel tank with controlled temperature. The wine completes its aging in American oak barrels for approximately 4-6 months. In our winemaking process, we neither add nor subtract anything; our wines are simply grapes. Amber color with orange highlights. Intense aromas of bread, banana, coconut, peanuts, and tobacco. On the palate, it envelops you with a powerful freshness, a touch of bitterness, and a long finish.
Product 3 Description: 100% Zalema organic "Orange wine", macerated with skins in amphora. We subject the Zalema grape to a pre-fermentative skin maceration in clay jars. After a few days with temperature control, it is pressed and returned to the jar to begin fermentation. In its production we do not add or remove anything, our wines are only grapes. Orange color. Nose with citrus aromas, honey, Mediterranean herbs and cardamom. On the palate it is intense and complex, with crisp and smooth acidity, with saline and mineral touches. Hints of dried apricots and stone fruit in jam.

Responsible viticulture is key for the winery’s philosophy, working with vegetation covers in the soils, producing an active soil with microbial life. Godelia almost owns 50 hectares of vineyards distributed among several areas of El Bierzo Appellation, at different altitudes and orientations. The age of the vines ranges from 25 to 100 years old and they settled down on slate, pebbles, quartzes and clays soils. In the vineyards, all the works we made by hand, with manual harvest in 15 kg boxes. Each grape variety pass through a double manual sorting table, then a gentle de-stemming, taking care of the grapes from the selection in the vineyards until the arrival of the grapes at the winery to start the fermentation process.
