Product 1 Description: This wine comes from a blend of Bobal, Syrah, Petit Verdot, Merlot and Cabernet Franc, all of them vinified separately, fermented in new French oak barrels and then aged for 20 months in new 300-litre French oak barrels. On the nose it appears with ripe red fruits, notes of vanilla and toasted oak, with spicy and balsamic touches; On the palate it shows high body, acidity that provides depth and a long and elegant finish, reminiscent of red fruits, soft chocolate and a well-integrated wooden background. It is an ideal option to accompany red meats, cured cheeses and powerful stews, maintaining its gastronomic identity without losing personality.
Product 2 Description: Monovarietal de Pinot Noir fermentado en barricas de 400 litros de Roble francés nueva y envejecido posteriormente por un mínimo de 10 meses en barricas nuevas de roble francés de 300 litros. Es un tinto que presenta ligero a medio cuerpo, con un enfoque en la elegancia y la definición varietal del Pinot Noir, buscando frescura y finura en un terruño tradicionalmente más asociado a otras variedades.En notas de cata, muestra claramente una nariz de frutos rojos frescos (fresa, frambuesa) y toques florales, con matices especiados y ligeramente balsámicos, mientras que en boca se percibe acidez vivaz, taninos suaves y un final limpio y ligeramente especiado que invita a tomar otra copa.
Product 3 Description: Bobos Finca Casa la Borracha es un monovarietal de la autóctona Bobal. Elaborado con un manejo cuidadoso de la barrica para extraer complejidad sin perder la frescura que caracteriza a la finca. La vinificación emplea barricas de 300 litros de roble nuevo francés para la fermentación, lo que aporta notas especiadas y un toque cremoso al inicio, manteniendo la fruta visible. Posteriormente, la crianza se realiza en barricas nuevas de 400 litros, con un mínimo de 10 meses de envejecimiento, para integrar la madera con la fruta y aumentar la profundidad del conjunto. En nariz ofrece fruta roja madura junto a notas de vainilla, humo suave y un matiz cálido propio del roble francés nuevo, también toques de cacao. En boca muestra estructura alta, taninos bien integrados, buena acidez y un final largo que persiste con recuerdos de fruta y madera bien integrada.
Product 4 Description: Cava made in Requena, the highest altitude area of the DO Cava, where the greater thermal amplitude between day and night favours a slower ripening of the grapes, better preserving the natural acidity, refining the fruit aromas and providing freshness and tension to the wine that will allow us to have long-aged cavas of the highest expression. This blend of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir expresses itself in the glass with a pale yellow color with greenish reflections, very fine and constant bubbles, and on the nose it displays a high intensity of ripe white fruit, floral notes, nuances of pastries and nuts as a result of its prolonged aging (minimum 22 months in a bottle lying down on lees). On the palate it is a powerful and elegant cava, creamy, broad and very long, with a balanced acidity that reinforces the sensation of freshness.
Product 5 Description: Cava made in Requena, the highest altitude area of the DO Cava, where the greater thermal amplitude between day and night favours a slower ripening of the grapes, better preserving the natural acidity, refining the fruit aromas and providing freshness and tension to the wine that will allow us to have long-aged cavas of the highest expression. On the nose it offers aromas of ripe red fruit and floral notes, with light citrus touches that provide liveliness; on the palate it is perceived dry as it is a Brut Nature, with good minerality, fine bubbles and a clean and persistent finish.

Winery Description: Bodegas Hydria was founded in 2013 to express the identity of the Hoya de los Hermanos area, one of the most unique enclaves in the D.O. Bullas. Since then we have recovered and brought life back to the vineyards of this place, Monastrell vines over 60 years old. At 830 metres, on the north face of the Sierra de Lavia, one of its coolest slopes, I make low-intervention wines where the Monastrell speaks of the landscape, expressing itself with freshness and character. I am Marina Sánchez and Hydria is a small and very personal project, born from the land and the vineyard.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 258
Product 1 Description: From a high-altitude vineyard over 50 years old, located on the highest parcel of the Hoya de los Hermanos valley, this 100% Monastrell is produced in very limited quantities. The vineyard is organically farmed, with extremely low yields of just 700 kg per hectare, allowing for maximum concentration and expression. Vinified parcel by parcel with a low-intervention approach, the wine undergoes gentle extraction and a long, slow maturation. The limestone clay-loam soils extend ripening and contribute structure, depth, and finely textured tannins, resulting in a powerful yet balanced wine with strong ageing potential.
Product 2 Description: A restored vineyard of more than 60 years, naturally low-yielding. 100% Monastrell, micro-vinified by individual parcels, with organic viticulture currently undergoing certification. Minimal intervention in the winery. Stony limestone soils with a clay-loam profile.
Product 3 Description: From a restored vineyard over 60 years old, this wine is crafted from carefully selected parcels of 100% Monastrell, vinified separately through small-scale micro-vinifications. The vineyard is farmed organically, currently in the process of certification. In the winery, a low-intervention approach is followed to allow the terroir to speak clearly. The stony limestone soils with a clay-loam texture bring freshness, tension, and depth to the wine.
Product 4 Description: Vino de parcela procedente de nuestras viñas recuperadas de más de 60 años, con una producción excepcionalmente baja de aproximadamente 1000 kg por hectárea. La maceración prefermentativa en frío resalta su complejidad aromática y la intensidad de su color. La fermentación, realizada a baja temperatura con remontados suaves, preserva su frescura. De mínima intervención, no se estabiliza ni clarifica. Crianza de 12 meses en barricas de roble francés y americano de 500L.
Product 5 Description: Elaborado con Garnacha de vendimia temprana y prensado directo, sin maceración, este vino nace en viñedos a 800 metros de altitud, rodeados de montañas que aportan noches frescas y días luminosos, ideales para preservar frescura y aromas delicados. Su fermentación a baja temperatura y 4 meses en contacto con lías finas le otorgan una ligera cremosidad y una profundidad única. Elegante y vibrante, es un rosado único, casi etéreo.

Winery Description: Bodega Sierra Almagrera is a unique wine project in the Levante of Almeria, dedicated to the production of red and white wines that reflect the character, history and terroir of Almeria. We make wines in the same land where, more than 4,000 years ago, the Argaric culture flourished and, centuries later, the Phoenicians introduced the first vines to the Iberian Peninsula. AN EXTREME TERROIR THAT CREATES EXTRAORDINARY WINES: Mediterranean breezes, altitude, mineral soils and thermal contrasts give life to elegant, voluminous wines with a unique acidity. OUR VINEYARD : The silver roots of our three vineyards, located at different heights - from the coastal vineyards of Burjulú, through the 400 meters of Antas to the high mountain slopes of Laujar - feed bunches of Tempranillo, Syrah, Grenache, Monastrell, Malbec, Petit Verdot and Macabeo. Each plot is worked and harvested individually to preserve the identity of each variety and its unique character.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 629
Product 1 Description: Un tributo líquido a las reinas del Argar, elaborado con Garnacha cultivada en las tierras históricas de Antas.
Product 2 Description: Un vino criado con el mismo proceso que Caballo Español, pensado para ofrecer una calidad excepcional con identidad propia. En las estribaciones de la Sierra de Almagrera se asienta nuestro viñedo, en un suelo rojizo formado de la descomposición de las rocas y minerales de las altas cumbres que albergaban las antiguas minas de plata y hierro. Las raíces plateadas de la viña alimentan las hojas y los racimos de nuestras variedades tempranillo, shiraz, garnacha y monastrell. Sierra de Almagrera es un vino único que nace de una tierra donde nunca hubo vid, tan solo los vestigios de nuestros antecesores fenicios, quienes se atrevieron a plantar en la costa dejando las sierras y partes altas por imposible.
Product 3 Description: SIERRA ALMAGRERA® MACABEO Un vino blanco fresco, vibrante y elegante, elaborado en viñedos de alta montaña a más de 1.200 metros.
Product 4 Description: Elegant fusion of Syrah and Tempranillo, enriched with delicate notes that add depth and character. Winner of the Gold medal in the Wines from Spain Trends competition, Prowein 2025.
Product 5 Description: A wine with a noble soul, blended from the best barrels and aged for more than three years between wood and bottle. Type of wine: Red wine aged for 18 months in French oak barrels (80%) and American oak barrels (20%) with a minimum of 3 years in the bottle. Grape variety: Syrah, Tempranillo and Monastrel.

The essence of Ignacio Marín lies in the meticulous work that emanates from the vineyard, with the affection and knowledge transmitted over time. Our founder, Mr. Ignacio Marín, marked the beginning of a path that has led our wines to conquer palates on five continents. Each generation of the family has brought its skills and experience to this arduous process, from the selection of the grapes to the expert vinification and careful ageing. This work is reflected in every bottle that leaves our cellars.

Bodegas MAM is a signature wine cellar, where wines are made to tell stories. The Colombard, Zalema and Listan varieties are used in terms of white wine varieties. Syrah, Tintilla de Rota and Petit Verdot for red wines. Our vineyards are located in the Doñana area. In the case of red wines, red wine is aged for 6 months and red wine is aged for 15 months.

Product 2 Description: White wine made with the Colombard variety, fermented in stainless steel and aged 9 months in French oak casks.
Product 3 Description: White wine macerated with skins. Made with Zalema and Listan macerated with skins during alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel. Product 4 Description: Red wine made with the Tintilla de Rota, Petit Verdot and Syrah varieties. Fermented in 600 L French Oak spins with Cherry tops. Once fermentation is finished, it is kept for 15 months in the spines.

Our History About us Our wine production is the result of a combination of tradition, technology and a strict control throughout the entire winemaking process. Product 1 Description: ISLA ORO AIREN: Made entirely from the white Airén grape variety, selected from the vineyards owned by the winery. The Airen grape is the most traditional white grape of La Mancha, perfectly adapted to the arid and harsh climatic conditions. We are faced with a pleasant surprise: the extraordinary quality that this variety gives to its wines when the winemaking process is based on technology and fermentation control. Treated in the right way, the Airén grape is among the highest quality standards of the world-renowned white varieties. TASTING NOTES: Pale, bright and crystalline wine. This wine expresses the virtues of our stony limestone soil. The nose is aromatic and fruity, with banana and pineapple standing out. In the mouth it is a tasty, mineral wine with a very balanced acidity. It maintains a persistent, round and smooth finish. Recommended to accompany seafood, white fish, rice dishes and uncured cheeses.
Product 2 Description: Young rosé wine made entirely from Grenache grapes from the Monte Milla estate in Villarta de San Juan (Ciudad Real). The selected clone is an Aragonese Garnacha with little colour, resistant to the heat of the centre of the Iberian Peninsula, a hardy, fresh, productive and very aromatic grape, perfectly adapted to limestone soils. It is mainly used for rosés and non crianza reds, aromatic and fruity. TASTING NOTES: Bright pink colour, brilliant and intense. It is a very fruity wine, with aromas of strawberries and roses. In the mouth it is smooth, fresh and sweet, not at all astringent and very clean. Long and persistent on the palate. Made with grapes from the Monte Milla estate, after a brief maceration at a very low temperature, seeking to exploit the youth and fruit. Recommended to accompany salads, pasta, rice dishes, fish, seafood and white meats. TECHNICAL DATA: Geographical Indication: Denomination of Origin La Ma
Product 3 Description: Made with Cencibel grapes selected from our vineyards in Monte Milla and Castellanos. It is undoubtedly the most prestigious red grape in Spain, known in other regions of Spain as Tempranillo or Tinto Fino. This variety has its origin in the Iberian Peninsula and adapts perfectly to our soils and cultivation methods. It is a low-yielding variety, with an early development and resistant to diseases and climatic variations. To elaborate this wine we make a fresh and fast alcoholic fermentation, with immediate racking and complete malolactic fermentation. In this way we seek to exploit the fruit and reduce the greenness and astringency without the need for ageing. TASTING NOTES: Intense cherry colour, covered and clean with wide tears. Purple and violet tones. Fruity aromas typical of its youth, highlighting red fruits and plums. In the mouth it expresses the freshness of the grape and the lack of ageing. Its youth is expressed with a medium astringency, enjoying a smooth and lively pass

A wine with a very fine, rich, complex and expressive palate. Dry and structured, with a long and immesirve aftertaste.

Winery Description: Javier San Pedro was named revelation winemaker of the year by Tim Atkin in his report on Rioja in 2021. Our family has been attached to Rioja viticulture for centuries. Javier is the fifth generation of winegrowers in the Laguardia area, the heart of the Rioja Alavesa Subzone. The love and passion of our ancestors for their land and their wine have come down to us to the present day. We make our wines in front of the slopes of the Sierra de Cantabria where our winery was built in 2016. The wines are based on three main ranges, on the one hand, Cueva de Lobos, modern, aromatic and fun that are made with the youngest vineyards of the family; On the other hand, Viuda Negra, which aims to recover old plots to extract the highest quality from each one, without forgetting our Anahi range, semi-sweet white and rosé, born and made in honor of her mother. For a few years we have embarked on the production of a Vermouth to complete our range of wines.

Winery Description: Founded in 1931 in Binissalem, Bodegas José L. Ferrer is a benchmark of tradition and innovation in the Mediterranean. Pioneers in quality winemaking and oak aging on the island, our winery is now led by the third and fourth generations of the family, upholding the visionary spirit of our founder. We manage 130 hectares of estate vineyards, recently certified organic, where indigenous varieties such as Mantonegro, Moll, and Gorgollassa take center stage. At this edition of BWW, we present wines that blend nearly a century of expertise with a steadfast commitment to sustainability and the authentic expression of Mallorcan terroir. Discover the elegance of our flagship ranges and our vision for the future in every glass. Mallorca's past, present, and future, united by excellence.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 692

Winery Name: Bodegas José Pariente Bodegas José Pariente
Winery Description: At the top of a moorland and in the heart of the Rueda vineyard, Victoria Pariente founded Bodegas José Pariente in 1998 with the production of a wine that made a dream come true, that of capturing her way of understanding the Verdejo variety and its environment. We are a family winery with roots, of which today Victoria's children, Martina and Ignacio Prieto Pariente, are also part. Raised in the terroir, the varietal and the winemaking, in 2013 they decided to continue the winemaking journey that their mother had begun, creating Bodegas Prieto Pariente, a project of unique vineyards that was born from the interest in valuing the oenological richness of different landscapes. The journey continues and at the beginning of 2024 a dream comes true. Pariente takes over from the Galician winegrower Arsenio Paz in his work to recover native varieties in Ribeiro, thus continuing the legacy of A Vilerma, a historic estate of 6 hectares of vineyards, located in the Avia valley.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 513
Product 1 Description: La tipicidad e identidad de la DO Ribeiro en un ensamblaje tradicional de variedades autóctonas cultivadas en la finca A Vilerma - desde 1977 - VARIEDADES - Treixadura, albariño, godello, loureira, lado y torrontés. Fermentación y crianza en depósitos de acero inoxidable, barrica usada de 500 litros y depósitos ovoides de hormigón. Ligera crianza sobre lías. A Vilerma es un vino de influencia atlántica, que destaca por su notable intensidad de aromas primarios. Destacan los matices de plantas como el hinojo y laurel y toques frutales (manzana, fruta de hueso y cítricos) recuerdo a piedra húmeda y un ligero toque floral. En boca se presenta complejo y elegante. La presencia de fruta es muy notable (manzana, melón, fruta de hueso), combinada con el recuerdo herbáceo. Destaca su acidez equilibrada y su final persistente y salino.
Product 2 Description: 100% Verdejo. Ecológico “Elegancia, sutileza y complejidad: Una mayúscula expresividad mineral de la variedad Verdejo.” Tras años de estudios de suelo y de un trabajo intenso de zonificación, surge nuestro segundo vino de Finca. Una interpretación elegante y sutil de la variedad verdejo a partir de un único viñedo viejo plantado sobre suelo arenoso en Hornillos de Eresma.
Product 3 Description: 100% Verdejo. Ecológico. “Untuoso, salino y con una gran elegancia: Nuestro vino de finca.” Elaborado exclusivamente en añadas excepcionales. Este vino procede del viñedo que le da nombre, Las Comas, plantado en vaso en 1910 sobre suelo calizo y pedregoso, características que han hecho de él una interpretación única y muy personal de la uva Verdejo de Rueda. Finca Las Comas es un vino intenso y untuoso, elaborado en fudre. Muestra una extraordinaria elegancia y gran volumen en boca, destacando los aromas de monte bajo, hinojo, sutiles toques cítricos y salinidad.
Product 4 Description: “La afirmación más fresca y elegante de nuestra variedad autóctona” La selección de viñedos plantados entre 1962 y 1991, propiedad de la familia, unida a la selección de uvas de viñas viejas, nos permite ensamblar la complejidad y diversidad de los diferentes suelos de nuestra zona.
Product 5 Description: 100% Verdejo. Ecological. "Deep, unctuous and complex" The result of years of work in zoning and the detailed study of the different types of soil, this wine reflects the complexity of the terroir. Made exclusively with grapes of the Verdejo variety, it comes from old vineyards planted on stony and sandy soils, which give the whole a remarkable aromatic richness and a balanced structure. Alcoholic fermentation in 500 and 228 litre French oak barrels and partial malolactic fermentation. Aged for 11 months, with the wine in permanent contact with its lees, thanks to the batoneo.

Product 3 Description: Manzanilla clásica sanluqueña con una vejez media de más de 15-20 años. Elaborada siguiendo los métodos más tradicionales de las antiguas manzanillas de Sanlúcar. Sistema muy dinámico con sacas muy pequeñas para favorecer la longevidad del velo de flor.
Product 4 Description: Variedad 100% Palomino. Envejecimiento lento expuesto a la acción del oxígeno mediante sistema de criaderas y solera cuyo origen se confunde en el tiempo. Con Certificación de Vejez Calificada por el Consejo Regulador.
Product 5 Description: Variedad 100% Palomino fino. Palo Cortado procedente de una cuidada selección de botas de las últimas criaderas de manzanilla. Tras una primera y breve fase de crianza biológica —de apenas 1 a 2 años—, el vino evoluciona hacia una prolongada crianza oxidativa que se extiende durante muchos años. De finura excepcional y marcada elegancia, presenta una crianza media de 12 años, combinando la delicadeza de su origen con la profundidad propia de su larga evolución.

Winery Description: Winery located in the Sierra de la Contraviesa (Alpujarra) of Granada. We are located at an altitude of more than 1300 metres and 9 km from the Mediterranean Sea, on a quartz slate terroir, with plants ranging from 23 to 108 years old, planted in goblet and trellis. We are dedicated to minimal intervention, our wines being organic and vegan. We are going to rescue old vines and native varieties, but we also experiment with varieties from other areas, to see how they adapt to our terroir. We look for fruit, acidity, freshness and touches of astringency, with deep colors. We do not have irrigation but we do have a microclimate that allows us to differentiate ourselves, added to the fact that we make single-vineyard wines which are recognizable, and we are committed to small productions since we have 18 wines, of which 15 are monovarietal, with a total production of 20,000 bot./year Commercially we only work with high-end gastronomy and wine bars or specialized stores
Winery Location: CORTIJO JUAN DE REYES, CTRA. GR-5204 KM. 4, 18430, TORVIZCÓN , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 160

Winery Description: Bodegas La Eralta is a family run winery, founded in 1990. Located in the heart of La Rioja, land par excellence of great crops and wines, Bodegas la Eralta has facilities of more than 16,000m2. The Company and its team of specialists and technicians controls and tends to 360 hectares of vineyards composing of different plots throughout the region. In addition, it has family vineyards in the village of Bergasa, planted by the winery’s founder Francisco Sanz. The winery produces a wide range of Rioja’s of exceptional quality, all true to the classical Rioja style. Combining modern technology with meticulous, traditional wine making methods, the wines are a true expression of the land and the Tempranillo grape. Bodegas La Eralta has a capacity throughput of 4 million kilos of grapes on an annual basis and produces in excess of 3 million bottles per year. The barrel hall houses over 10,000 French and American oak barrels for the ageing of their Crianzas, Reservas and Gran Reservas. Our experience and particular taste in making classic Rioja wines has earned us important awards such as Gold and Silver Medals in different competitions.
Winery Location: Avda. de Cameros 27, 26150, Agoncillo
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 321

Winery Description: Lagar de Costa is a family winery, where the effort and dedication of 3 generations are linked to the care of the Albariño vines and winemaking. Its construction dates back more than a century and has undergone several renovations, always trying to maintain its original stone and wood structure. Our family has direct control of all of the processes, both in the vineyard and in the winery. The result is a combination of the traditional and the modern, in order to obtain a wine with its own characteristics. 90% of the grape production comes from their own vineyards, some of them being more than 50 years old, which can be found in the parish of Castrelo, located in the Umia-O Grove Intertidal Complex (Red Natura 2000), in front of the island of A Toxa. The vineyards are in lowlands very close to the sea with altitudes that range from 0 to 30 m. The terroir has a sandy-loam texture and is therefore a loose soil with good water penetration capacity and easy drainage. The vineyard is trained in a system that is perfectly adapted to the area due to the high humidity, mild temp. and high rainfall, which are well distributed throughout the year. The planting frame is 4×4 (1,200 vine/ha)
Winery Location: LUGAR CASTRELO 8, 36630, CAMBADOS , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 415

Winery Description: Bodegas La Granadilla is the winemaking dream of the Descalzo Matos brothers, who have spent over twenty years of passion for viticulture into a family project with strong character. Located in Nava del Rey, within the Rueda Designation of Origin, the winery is founded on respect for the land, grape quality, and the area’s unique terroir. With over 104 hectares of estate-owned vineyards, trained on trellises between Villaverde de Medina and Nava del Rey, the grapes are grown with great care and constant attention. Hands-on vineyard management and dedicated winemaking allow each wine to reflect the landscape, the continental climate, and the Atlantic influence at 750 metres above sea level. From aromatic Verdejo and Sauvignon Blanc to barrel-aged wines that express complexity and balance, each label conveys the essence of the terroir and the winery’s philosophy. For distributors, this represents an opportunity to add wines with identity, consistency, and a true family soul t
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 406
Product 1 Name: DOMINIO DE LA GRANADILLA SAUVIGNON BLANC 2025
Product 1 Description: 100% Sauvignon blanc, organic Produced at Dominio de La Granadilla, Nava del Rey, Spain, at 750 m above sea level with a continental climate and Atlantic influence. Vineyards: 70 ha, stony soil rich in calcium and magnesium, vines over 10 years old, trellis-trained. Harvested mechanically at night, de-stemmed and sorted at optimal ripeness. Fermentation: stainless steel, slow, below 15 ºC, with selected yeasts; tangentially filtered. Estate bottled. Straw yellow with light green reflections, this Sauvignon Blanc shows intense aromas of exotic fruits like passion fruit and lychee. On the palate, it is fresh and approachable, with tropical flavors complemented by a subtle herbal note typical of the variety. Balanced and expressive, it combines the extract of dry-land vineyards with the aromatic intensity of irrigated ones, making it ideal for Sauvignon Blanc lovers.
Product 2 Description: 100% Verdejo, Organic Produced from 20 ha of stony, trellised vineyards over 25 years old, farmed organically with exceptional care. Harvested mechanically at night with cold maceration, fermented in small stainless steel tanks at controlled temperature, and aged 5–6 months on lees. Attractive, bright straw yellow with a greenish rim. Intense and elegant nose, combining fruity, citrus, and herbaceous notes with minerality and hints of scrubland. On the palate, it is balanced, well-structured, and unctuous, with a persistent finish and the characteristic subtle bitterness of Verdejo.
Product 3 Name: DOMINIO DE LA GRANADILLA VERDEJO BARREL FERMENTED 2023
Product 3 Description: 100% Verdejo - Barrel fermented 9 months in new french oak The wine is made from the best grapes of our oldest vineyards, carefully cultivated in our estate with full respect for the environment. Vines are selected in the field, and analyses determine the optimal harvest date. Pre-fermentative maceration is carried out at 8 ºC to extract maximum precursors before fermentation in French and Hungarian oak barrels. The wine ages on its lees with constant bâtonnage for 9 months and continues evolving in the bottle to achieve perfect balance. Pale yellow with golden reflections. Intense and expressive, with well-integrated citrus notes and toasted oak nuances. Fresh and tasty, with memories of fresh fruit and balsamic notes, complemented by the toasted complexity from barrel aging.

Winery Description: Bodegas LA HORRA, located in Ribera del Duero, inaugurated its new winery last June. Designed by Carme Pinós, winner of Spain’s National Architecture Prize, and conceived according to sustainability criteria, it is perfectly integrated into the landscape and inspired by the traditional architecture of the local wineries. The new winery, whose construction began in 2023 and where the 2024 vintage of CORIMBO has already been produced, marks the consolidation of the Bodegas LA HORRA project, which began its journey in 2009. In this new winery, Bodegas LA HORRA fully embodies its philosophy of preservation and absolute respect for the land. It is a winery where sustainability is present from beginning to end, from vineyards that champion biodiversity and meticulous vine growing to an architectural project in harmony with the surrounding landscape. The entire winemaking process is conceived in the pursuit of excellence.
Winery Location: Camino de Anguix s/n, 09311, La Horra , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 322
Product 1 Description: A flavorful, characterful Ribera del Duero where ripe fruit and energy define the style. Aromas of blackberry and plum mingle with spice and an earthy touch that makes it distinctive. On the palate it’s straightforward and generous, with good structure, approachable tannins and a balance that makes it very versatile at the table, always retaining a sense of freshness.
Product 2 Description: The more ambitious, deeper version of the Ribera del Duero, with greater complexity, concentration and length. The nose combines ripe fruit with spices, cocoa, balsamic notes and an earthy/mineral background that adds seriousness. On the palate it’s broad and structured, with firmer yet beautifully tamed tannins, excellent balance and a long, memorable finish. A wine with clear ageing potential, ideal for richer dishes and special moments.

Winery Description: We are a family winery founded in 1989 in Roa (Burgos), in the heart of the Ribera del Duero. We currently own over 70 hectares of vineyards of tempranillo grape variety, including centenary vineyard.After a manual harvest and rigorous grapes selection, we produce, age, and bottle high-quality wines, offering the market a complete range of wines with excellent value.

Product 1 Description: A high-quality crianza from Ribera del Duero, made from Tempranillo vines over 40 years old. Careful vineyard management and precise winemaking produce a wine with rich aromas and a smooth, rounded palate. Tasting notes: Ruby-red color with cherry tones, bright and intense. On the nose, complex aromas of black fruits, spices, licorice and subtle mineral notes. On the palate, broad and meaty, balanced, with round tannins and a long finish. Pairing: Red meats, roasts, aged cheeses. Serving temperature: 16 oC.
Product 2 Description: Deep in color, almost jet black, obtained through long macera- tions of acidic, high-alcohol grapes. A structured wine, with pronounced minerality and abundant red fruit. After 4 months of barrel aging, made from Tinto Fino grapes grown at over 800 meters of altitude, it offers unique power and finesse. Tasting notes: Deep cherry-red color with purple hues. On the nose, ripe black fruit, floral notes and licorice stand out, with subtle mineral and roasted hints. On the palate, it is structured and balanced, with well-integrated sweet tannins. Pairing:White meats, pasta and rice dishes. Serving temperature: 14ºC.
Product 3 Description: Aged for 16 months in barrel and several years in bottle until reaching its peak. A complex wine that faithfully reflects our terroir. Crafted from the finest grapes of the harvest, sourced from the highest-altitude vineyards. Tasting notes: Bright ruby-red with purple nuances. On the nose, highly complex, with spicy aromas of pepper, cinnamon and vanilla, truffle, and ripe fruit over a mineral background. On the palate, broad and elegant, meaty, with a long finish. Pairing: Game meats, stews, ox beef. Serving temperature: 17ºC.
Product 4 Description: 100% Tempranillo grape. Sourced from 40-year-old vine- yards, the harvest is carried out manually and selectively, with green harvesting to regulate the number of clusters. The soil is mainly composed of sandstone and clay sedi- ments with limestone subsoil. Tasting notes: Pale cherry color, clean and bright. On the nose, fresh aromas of red fruit and rose petals with subtle mineral hints. On the palate, it is broad, flavorful, with balanced acidity that gives it great personality. Pairing: Appetizers, starters, smoked and salted fish. Serving temperature: 8 oC.
Product 5 Description: From century-old, low-yield vines, aged 24 months in Ameri- can and French oak. We produce this wine only in suitable vintages, when the vines have performed optimally. Limited production. Tasting notes: Deep cherry-red with ruby hues. On the nose, powerful and complex, with ripe black fruit, spices, truffle and mineral notes. On the palate, fleshy and silky, broad and balanced, with marked minerality. Pairing: Game stews, steak tartar, aged cheeses. Serving temperature: 19ºC.

Winery Description: Composed of LAN (D.O.Ca. Rioja), Santiago Ruiz (D.O. Rías Baixas), AURA (D.O. Rueda) and Viña Mayor (D.O. Ribera de Duero). Bodegas LAN is linked to Spain's four most historic designations of origin, where it puts into practice its decided commitment to the earth and its maxim that winemaking starts in the vineyard. The winery group is present in more than sixty international markets. Founded in 1942 by Fernando Van Zeller Guedes, Sogrape was created to show the quality of Portuguese wines to the rest of the world. Starting with a sole vineyard in the Douro Valley and focusing on the production of Mateus Rosé, it has now become an international company, doing business in more than 120 markets and owning 1.600 hectares of vineyards across Portugal, Spain, Chile, Argentina and New Zealand. Driven by the desire to bring friendship and happiness to all those who are brought together thanks to its great wines, Sogrape's has built its success over the past 80 years.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street C, Stand 460

Winery Description: Bodegas La Purísima was founded in 1946 by several farmers who joined forces in order to improve the quality of Yecla wines. Their determination and desire to produce great wines finally led, in 1975, to their receiving the Denomination Origin title. This was a huge achievement for these farmers who, limited by the border of the municipality, registered the Yecla Denomination of Origin nº 27 in line with the prestigious French AOC. Bodegas La Purísima is located in the southeast of Spain within the small DO Yecla, (Región de Murcia) just 78 km from the Mediterranean Sea. Mild temperatures in winter and warm summers, perfect conditions for a proper maturation of the grape. Over 300 sunny days per year ¡¡¡¡¡ The variety queen of our land is Monastrell, thanks this exotic grape we create different wines to the rest of Spain. Intensity, deep colour and powerful aromas are the words that best define our wines, structure and character together. Also we produce great Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet, Macabeo, Sauvignon Blanc. Also organic wines, sweet and white wine made from black grapes

Winery Description: Bodegas La Remediadora was founded in 1946 to produce wines of the highest quality. The winery has modern facilities to obtain the best wines. It has a cellar with more than 500 American and French oak barrels to produce aged wines, crianzas and reservas. All our wines are certified by the La Mancha Designation of Origin and are marketed under our brands: La Villa Real and Topical, where the grapes have been selected to make clean, fresh, fruity wines, etc. In addition, the aged wines have been aged in American and French oak barrels to achieve well-balanced, long, fruity wines, round tannins and with a very pleasant taste.

On the palate, it is well-structured and balanced, with velvety tannins, lively fruit, subtle spice, and a long, elegant finish. Awards: Gold Medal – Berliner Wein Trophy 2022. Roble Tempranillo La Villa Real 2021 – 86 points, Peñín Guide 2024.

A 36-hour cold maceration at 10ºC enhances the aromas, followed by gentle pressing to obtain the highest-quality must. Fermentation takes place in stainless steel tanks at a controlled 16ºC for 24 days, preserving purity and elegance. After filtration and cold stabilization, the wine is bottled to ensure exceptional freshness and clarity. Tasting Notes: Bright, transparent yellow-green colour. Intense, clean aromas with floral and tropical notes. On the palate, it is complex, aromatic, and vibrant, with fresh citrus nuances and a long, expressive finish. Awards: Gold Medal at Asian Wein Trophy 2025
Product 3 Name: Sweet Sparkling Wine - Muscat Blanca Petits Grains - La Villa Real
Product 3 Description: Crafted from carefully selected Muscat Blanc à Petits Grains grapes harvested at peak ripeness, this wine is partially fermented at low temperature to preserve its intense varietal aromas. Fermentation is halted by chilling, keeping the natural sugars, and the wine is gently carbonated to achieve a fine, elegant bubble. Tasting Notes: Pale yellow colour with greenish hues and delicate bubbles. Aromas are intense and floral, with orange blossom, citrus notes (orange, tangerine, lemon), tropical fruits, and a touch of honey. On the palate, it is sweet, fresh, fruity, and beautifully balanced, with soft, persistent bubbles. Pairing: Ideal as an aperitif or paired with desserts, chocolate, fresh fruit, Asian cuisine, or to enjoy on any festive or informal occasion. Serving: Best served well chilled, between 6–8°C.

Winery Description: Almacántara is more than a winery, it is the continuation of a family tradition that dates back generations. Our project was born from the passion for the land and the vineyard, a legacy passed down by our grandfather Bernabé, who dedicated his life to taking care of his vineyards in the Ribera del Duero, in Baños de Valdearados, at an altitude of 870 metres, in the heart of the Castilian plateau. Between landscapes of cereals, mountains and vineyards, Bernabé taught us that wine is the result of years of work, patience and respect for the cycle of the earth. Grandfather Bernabé was a winegrower with a deep knowledge of the countryside, which he acquired throughout his life working hand in hand with the land. He pruned the vines in the cold winters, took care of them during their growth, and looked forward to the exact moment for the harvest. Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 96

Winery Description: Bodegas Lecea is a family-owned winery located in San Asensio, in the heart of Rioja Alta, with a winemaking tradition spanning more than five generations. Since then, four generations have already managed the winery. Always counting on the good work and the use of traditional techniques in the elaboration. We currently have presence in the five continents: Europe, Africa, Asia, Oceania and America. The growth has been exponential, and we have 3 commercial offices: Madrid, California and Shanghai.

Winery Description: At Bodegas Luis Pérez, we began our project in 2002 with a clear belief: Jerez must return to the vineyard. Since then, we have followed a personal approach, focused on interpreting the terroir and expressing the identity of each individual plot through our wines. We work according to the historic zoning of the Jerez pagos, vinifying each vineyard separately and combining our oenological expertise with respect for the traditional wines of each area. Where history offers no defined path, such as in the pago of Corchuelo, we explore new possibilities with international grape varieties, creating wines such as Garum and Samaruco. In historic pagos like Balbaína, Añina, Macharnudo and Carrascal, we remain true to local varieties and their heritage. Although the project was formally established in 2002, our family’s connection to wine spans several generations, driven by a shared passion to craft wines with identity, origin and character.

Product 1 Description: VARIETY 100% Palomino Fino. VITICULTURE Old vines pruned with a stick and thumb, planted on Tosca de Barajuelas albariza soils. Southwest-facing vineyard, located on a gentle north-facing slope within the emblematic Cerro del Obispo, an enclave of great historical and wine-growing value. HARVEST Manual harvest carried out at the beginning of August, at a time of relatively early ripeness. The grapes are harvested in small boxes of up to 14 kg to preserve the integrity of the bunches and guarantee the highest quality. WINEMAKING Fermentation in stainless steel at low temperature. Subsequently, the wine undergoes an 18-month biological aging on its lees in Jerez casks that are more than 80 years old, with previous use in the aging of Finos.
Product 2 Description: VARIETY 100% Palomino Fino. VITICULTURE A 40-year-old vineyard, pruned with a stick and thumb, with an approximate yield of 5,000 kg/ha due to its age and pruning system. The soil is Barajuelas albariza, characterised by its laminar structure, similar to a deck of cards, which gives uniqueness and character to the wine. HARVEST Manual and selective harvesting, carried out continuously for almost two months, from the beginning of August to the end of September. The bunches are selected in different passes according to their state of ripeness, being destined for different styles of wine: from bases with low alcohol content and high acidity to elaborations such as sparkling, Muelle de Olaso, Palmas, Cortados and Rayas. WINEMAKING 90% of the wine ferments in stainless steel. The remaining 10% is sunbathed and fermented in Jerez butts, with defoliation in December. After blending, the wine is aged on lees for approximately 4 to 6 months in tanks.
Product 3 Description: VARIETY 100% Palomino Fino. VITICULTURE Old vines pruned with a stick and thumb, planted on Tosca de Barajuelas albariza soils. South-west facing vineyard, located in the emblematic Cerro del Obispo, a historic enclave of great wine-growing value. HARVEST Manual harvest carried out during the month of August, at its optimum point of ripeness and in small boxes of up to 14 kg to preserve the integrity of the bunches. Previously, a green harvest was carried out to reduce yields and obtain a wine with a low alcohol content and high acidity, which is later used to balance the final wine. WINEMAKING Fermentation in stainless steel at low temperature. Subsequently, the wine undergoes a biological aging of 12 months on its lees in Jerez casks of more than 80 years, previously used for the aging of Finos.

Winery Description: Bodegas Lustau is one of the most respected names in the Sherry Triangle and a leading ambassador of Andalusian wines worldwide. Founded in 1896, Lustau brings together over a century of winemaking heritage with a modern, market-driven vision, showcasing the unique character of sherry across the world’s key wine markets. Driven by a commitment to quality and authenticity, Lustau works with a carefully selected range of vineyards, ageing systems and soleras to craft a diverse and highly regarded portfolio. From fresh, elegant Finos and Manzanillas to complex Amontillados, Olorosos and long-aged wines, each expression delivers a clear sense of origin and style. Consistently recognised by top international wine guides and competitions, Lustau represents sherry at its finest: distinctive, versatile and relevant for today’s consumers, while remaining firmly rooted in tradition.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 565
Product 1 Description: V.O.R.S TRUE OLD GEMS Lustau Amontillado VORS (Very Old Rare Sherry) has its origins in the searching and selecting process that Manuel Lozano, former Cellar Master of Lustau, made among the oldest solera casks of this wine. This amontillado comes from a selection of 8 casks.
Product 2 Description: A GENUINE ICON OF JEREZ Each wine (Oloroso and Pedro Ximénez) is matured, separately in its own solera for 12 years. Once blended together, the resulting sherry is returned to a 45-cask solera for a further 3 years aging. Its aging process recreates that of the wines which crossed the oceans in the 17th century voyages.
Product 3 Description: MANZANILLA IN IT’S HIGHEST EXPRESSION Very dry and very floral. Aging under flor in Sanlucar de Barrameda, in a humid microclimate under the influence of the sea breeze from the mouth of the Guadalquivir River, which marks his character extremely dry, light and sharp. A unique manzanilla sherry within that year after year has earned the highest awards in competitions most prestigious international wines. The origin of the name Papirusa is Argentina and means “beautiful and elegant” and was the name of Emilio Lustau doll gift to the daughter of the manager of Bodegas Lustau in the 40s.
Product 4 Description: COMPLEXITY, DEPTH AND REFLECTION Aged in Jerez de la Frontera since the foundation of its Solera by Mr. Emilio Lustau in 1921 to commemorate the visit to Jerez of Eugenia de Montijo, the last Empress of France.
Product 5 Description: DRY, SPICY AND SMOKED This Palo Cortado combines the fineness and delicacy of Amontillado, along with the body and structure of an odorous. Aged in Jerez de la Frontera in the cellar of the Empress Eugenia.

Winery Description: Bodegas Luzón and Bodegas Corral bring together the strength and character of two iconic Spanish wine regions: Jumilla and Rioja. In Jumilla, Bodegas Luzón, with more than 180 years of history, crafts expressive, modern wines from its native Monastrell grape, grown on 415 hectares of estate-owned vineyards. Old, dry-farmed bush vines yield wines full of fruit, intensity, and Mediterranean personality. In Rioja, Bodegas Corral, founded in 1898 in Navarrete, embodies the elegance and balance of Rioja Alta, combining tradition and innovation in the production of wines aged carefully in oak barrels to achieve their finest expression. Both wineries share the same philosophy: respect for the land, passion for wine, and a firm commitment to sustainability. From innovation in the cellar to responsible viticulture, Luzón and Corral create authentic wines with soul and origin—true reflections of two unique regions celebrated around the world.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 547
Product 1 Description: The Altos de Corral range represents the highest expression of Bodegas Corral wines. Iconic Rioja wines crafted from grapes grown on our Altos de Corral estate, located in the Moncalvillo area (Navarrete) at about 600 meters above sea level, one of the highest points in Rioja. With an intense cherry-red color and violet hues, it is deep and elegant on the nose, showing ripe black fruit, blackberry, plum, hints of wild herbs, fine spices, and a mineral background that evokes its altitude. On the palate, it is serious and structured, with firm, mature tannins, lively acidity, and a long finish. Altos de Corral Crianza is a wine of strong personality and authenticity, evolving beautifully in the glass and expressing the true essence of its origin.
Product 2 Description: With Altos de Luzón, we pay tribute to the unique identity of the land of Jumilla. A harsh climate at an average altitude of 650 meters gives the soil its rough and dry character. The Monastrell grape finds here its inspiration and reason for being, surpassing itself to show its finest expression. The winemaking history and the spirit of the people of Jumilla are defined by this landscape—depicted on its label—rugged, with a strong character, yet full of singular beauty and richness. Deep red in color with ruby highlights, its aromas are expressive and intense, featuring notes of red and black fruits, sweet spices, and subtle hints from barrel aging. On the palate, it is lively and agile, with a fresh vibrancy that reflects the vintage and emphasizes its fruity character. It offers a smooth, fresh mouthfeel with fine tannins and a persistent finish that reveals its complexity. This is a distinctive red wine that conveys our terroir and philosophy.
Product 3 Description: Don Jacobo wines pay tribute to the unique setting of our winery, located alongside the French Route of the Camino de Santiago. They represent our most renowned range and reflect a commitment to winemaking that respects nature. Made from 90% Tempranillo and 10% Garnacha, Don Jacobo Crianza honors traditional craftsmanship through meticulous production that allows Tempranillo to fully express itself. Its 12 months of aging in carefully selected oak barrels shape the fruit while preserving its freshness, resulting in a balanced and vibrant wine. With a garnet-red color and ruby highlights, it reveals aromas of fresh fruit, fine spices, cocoa, and subtle toasted notes. On the palate, it is smooth and harmonious, with soft tannins, lively acidity, and a persistent finish that invites conversation.

Winery Description: Maeste is extreme altitude, old vineyard. Maeste is the rural winery in Honrubia de la Cuesta, in the highlands at the southern end of the Ribera del Duero. Project linked to the recovery of the rural environment and abandoned centenary vineyards. Traditional production together with innovation resulting in modern and fresh wines, respecting our terroir and identity. Unique, mineral, clayey soils, combined at the height of the area, places us in a privileged area of the appellation. In our 1800's mansion converted into a winery, we make direct wines, without intervention, with a very fresh and fruity profile and respectful and elegant aging.

Product 1 Description: With a bright strawberry colour, it attracts with its fresh and sweet aromatic intensity, and makes you repeat with its fluidity and clarity of unmistakable fruity flavours of strawberry, candy and currant. A wine made with Tempranillo and Albillo grapes from our old vineyards at altitude. Produced on the one hand by the bleeding of red grape must and on the other hand by pressing red and white grapes, to later make the blend. Without a doubt, a novelty to highlight in a different portfolio, without forgetting the commercial power of the new claret of the Ribera.
Product 2 Description: The freshness of the high-altitude vineyards, the complexity of refining in long barrels of more than 12 months and the raw material of old Tempranillo, Merlot and Albillo grapes, make Maeste Alma del Moral one of the great exponents of the new Ribera del Duero. La Ribera de Altura, at the southern end of the appellation, in a privileged spot in Segovia, is Bodegas Maeste, a winery in a restructured rural house from 1800. A very complex wine but easy to drink due to the freshness provided by the acidity of the altitude. Hints of red and black fruit, elegant oaks, a round and silky wine on the palate, harmonious and with a long finish.
Product 3 Description: Ribera del Duero in its purest form, vineyards at altitude, fresh and elegant wine, complex nuances but easy to drink. Very old Tempranillo Tinta Fina, a differentiating touch of Merlot, and a bit of Albillo from the older vines. Refined in French, American and Spanish oak barrels for more than 6 months, mostly second-use barrels, light and elegant touches. Ribera del Duero Segoviana. Very old vineyards and environmental sustainability. Little intervention. To enjoy on any occasion, very versatile and gastronomic wine.

Winery Description: The wines and vineyards of Bodegas Magasé are a family project by the Mañes Izquierdo Company, S.L., where all family members are involved, from the eldest to the youngest. Integrated into the traditions of Doñana environment and respectful of its biodiversity, it essentially revitalizes the winemaking past of La Palma del Condado, where the most widespread grape variety is Zalema. This grape comes from centuries-old bush vines located in the so-called Campo Alto, surrounded by Roman remains and marine fossils. Convinced that wine is born in the vineyard, we embrace the motto "From the vine to bottle." We produce natural wines with the certainty that quality products come from respecting the land, hard work, and a way of understanding viticulture that has been preserved through oral tradition for thousands of years

Winery Description: Bodegas Marco Real is the result of generations of the Belasco Family, with a project firmly rooted in the vineyard and the identity of Navarra. We manage 60 hectares of our own vineyards, and the first 10 hectares of Syrah and Merlot are currently being converted to organic farming. We are the only winery cultivating in the Sonsierra Navarra at nearly 600 meters above sea level, a unique area that brings freshness and distinctive character to our grapes. Beyond Garnacha and Graciano, we also focus on international varieties such as Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc, showing how Navarra shapes their aromas and profiles differently from the rest of the world. Our winemaker, Kepa Sagastizabal, leads this vision by crafting wines that authentically express each parcel and this singular territory.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 247
Product 1 Description: Finca La Pared is the purest expression of our finest single vineyard located in the Sonsierra Navarra at nearly 500 meters above sea level. Covering 10 hectares and planted over 20 years ago, it stands out for its unique U-shaped layout, with both north & south facing exposures that create an exceptional balance between freshness and ripeness. From this,come deep, elegant wines with outstanding ageing potential. They are crafted through an extremely precise and coherent process, in which winemaker Kepa is fully involved at every stage, from vineyard work to bottling, treating each wine as a personal creation. Fermentations are carried out separately in small stainless-steel tanks, with gentle extractions and carefully tailored barrel ageing according to each variety, without racking or fining. Production is very limited, with around 3,500 bottles, resulting in wines that are generous, fresh, complex and long-lasting, faithfully reflecting the unique identity of Finca La Pared.
Product 2 Name: HOMENAJE WHITE, ROSADO AND RED ROBLE
Product 2 Description: The Homenaje range captures the youthful, relaxed and authentic spirit of the winery, a collection created for everyday enjoyment that reflects the freshness and diversity of Navarra. The Sauvignon Blanc + Chardonnay showcases the most vibrant and aromatic side of the brand, made from selected grapes and fermented at low temperatures to preserve purity and fruit expression. The Rosé, crafted in the traditional Navarra style, gains its color and character from a brief contact of the must with the skins, resulting in a fresh, juicy wine ideal for social occasions. Homenaje Roble completes the range with a smooth, approachable red made from selected varietals aged for four months in oak, offering balance, structure and a gentle touch of complexity without losing its easy-drinking nature. Together, they form a modern and versatile collection designed to be shared.
Product 3 Description: The Marco Real Pequeñas Producciones range reflects the winery’s commitment to crafting limited-edition wines that express the unique identity of the vineyards in La Sonsierra Navarra. Each wine is produced in small batches from carefully selected plots, allowing winemaker Kepa Sagastizabal and his team to capture the purest expression of each variety and terroir. The range includes Garnacha, Garnacha Rosé by bleeding, Syrah, Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay, with a Garnacha Blanca Oak and a sulfite-free Merlot Oak coming soon. Partially aged in oak according to each wine’s style, the collection balances fruit, structure and elegance while maintaining varietal character. Pequeñas Producciones embodies the Belasco Family’s philosophy: authentic, expressive wines rooted in the land and crafted with precision, designed for those seeking distinctive Navarra expressions.

Winery Description: Founded in 1970 in Rioja, Bodegas Marqués de Cáceres is today one of the Spanish family wineries with the greatest international projection. Present in more than 140 countries, its trajectory has been built on a clear idea: to offer quality wines, faithful to their origin, designed to be enjoyed in your own way. The winery works with a careful selection of vineyards in different denominations of origin – Rioja, Rueda, Rías Baixas, Cariñena and Cava – and develops a portfolio that combines accessible and expressive wines with more unique wines. Precise work in the vineyard and cellar gives shape to balanced, elegant wines with an authentic expression. Tradition and contemporaneity come together in a proposal open to today's consumers and to the different ways of enjoying wine.

Winery Description: Welcome to BWW, Barcelona Fair At the heart of the Barcelona Fair, BWW, lies Bodega Marqués de Reinosa, a benchmark of tradition and excellence in the world of wine. This year, in addition to our classics that have delighted palates for generations, we want to surprise you with an exclusive selection of single-varietal wines that celebrate the richness of our native grapes. Discover the elegance of Graciano, with its aromatic intensity and firm structure; the unique freshness of Maturana, a rediscovered variety that captivates with its vibrant character; and the purest expression of Garnacha, with its silkiness and fruity notes that enchant from the first sip. At Marqués de Reinosa, every bottle tells a story, and at BWW, we want to share it with you. We invite you to explore these vinous treasures, savor their uniqueness, and experience an unforgettable sensory journey. Visit our stand and let yourself be seduced by the art and passion that make every glass exceptional! Bodegas Marqués de Reinosa: because trends fade, but history endures. We are rewriting the history of Eastern Rioja and its wonderful people, lands, and wine.

Product 1 Description: El vino blanco Marqués de Vizhoja es el más afamado de la familia Peláez. Es su vino blanco más personal. Este vino blanco, conocido como el vino de la hoja de parra, cuenta con varias menciones y sellos. Es un vino blanco afrutado certificado por V-Label con el sello vegano. Marqués de Vizhoja presenta un color amarillo pajizo con unas notas verdosas. Su aroma es fresco, fino y penetrante, con toques frutales. Ofrece un sabor equilibrado que recuerda a manzana y pera, con suaves notas cítricas.
Product 2 Description: Señor da Folla Verde es el vino blanco más exclusivo de nuestra bodega con una producción de botellas limitada. Solo comercializamos 20.800 botellas al año de este albariño Rías Baixas. Para su elaboración empleamos uvas albariño (70%), loureira (15%) y treixadura (15%). Todas son cultivadas en la Finca La Moreira, donde las seleccionamos manualmente. En el viñedo elegido para la elaboración de este albariño realizamos lo que se conoce como “poda verde” en verano. Es decir, se poda un 40% de los racimos para asegurar el óptimo crecimiento de los restantes. Este Rías Baixas rinde homenaje a las uvas tradicionales, autóctonas, del Condado do Tea.
Product 3 Description: Presenta un color amarillo limón brillante, limpio y atractivo, con reflejos dorados que denotan su crianza prolongada en botella. Su burbuja es fina, elegante y persistente, resultado del método tradicional de elaboración, aportando viveza sin perder sutileza. Elaborado con 70% Albariño, 15% Treixadura y 15% Loureira, este espumoso Brut Nature refleja el carácter de las variedades autóctonas del Condado do Tea. Elaborado con el método tradicional, cuenta con una crianza de 5 meses sobre lías en cubas y 38 meses en rima. El degüelle tuvo lugar el 26 de abril de 2021.
Product 4 Description: Torre la Moreira es el albariño más puro de Bodegas Marqués de Vizhoja. Elaboramos este albariño Rías Baixas empleando uvas propias que seleccionamos y recolectamos a mano en nuestra Finca la Moreira y en otras fincas del Condado do Tea. Solo utilizamos uva albariña, lo que lo convierte en un Rías Baixas 100%. Torre la Moreira tiene un color amarillo pajizo con notas verdosas. Su aroma recuerda a la manzana, la pera y a hierbas aromáticas. Es intenso y complejo. Ofrece un sabor goloso, franco, suave y afrutado.
Product 5 Description: Torre La Moreira Brut Nature es un espumoso, elaborado al 100% con uvas Albariño. La vinificación se realiza siguiendo el método tradicional o champenoise, el mismo utilizado en Champagne, lo que permite una segunda fermentación natural en botella. En nariz, despliega un perfil aromático refinado con notas de frutas blancas, cítricos maduros, flores blancas y elegantes matices de frutos secos. En boca se muestra seco (Brut Nature), fresco y envolvente, con una burbuja integrada y un final largo y mineral.

Winery Description: Cesar Mate WINEMAKER of the year 2023 for Tim Atkin MW in his last Ribera report. Marta Maté was born with the aim of doing something extraordinary in a privileged region like Ribera del Duero. In 2013 the Bodegas Marta Maté project took definitive shape and we acquired a small winery in Tubilla del Lago in the province of Burgos, a little known place in Ribera del Duero, located at the northern end of the D.O. at an altitude of over 900 m. In the following years and up to now we have developed the work of recovering the soils of the centenary vineyards, and transitioning from conventional to organic viticulture management, which puts more than 40 “majuelos” in value. In our range we produce 6 red wines and one rosé and we have expanded and adapted the facilities to the new production needs and our image We are committed to biodiversity, minimal ecological intervention and field work so that at least 99% of our grapes pass the selection table in each harvest, thus guaranteeing an ideal result in each of our bottles. The knowledge about our vineyard is the best tool for the correct decision making in the vineyard. Our wines have been highly appreciated by international wine critics.
Winery Location: CAMINO DE CALERUEGA S/N, 09453, TUBILLA DEL LAGO , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 415

Winery Description: Bodegas Martínez Paiva is a family business with a tradition spanning more than five generations in vine cultivation and the production of quality wines in Extremadura. We are pioneers in the introduction of cultivation techniques and varietals in the Tierra de Barros area, near Almendralejo (Badajoz), the true wine capital of Extremadura. Bodegas Martinez Paiva wines are made from grapes selected from our own vineyards, allowing us to control and guarantee the production process from the vine to the bottle, thus giving them their own personality. Our vineyards are located on loam and clay soils, cool vertisols with a high limestone content and sufficient depth, which allow the roots to seek the necessary moisture during our harsh summers. The combination of the soil with the orientation and microclimates of the area allows us to obtain quality grapes for producing complex wines.
Winery Location: CRTA. N 630 KM 646, 06200, ALMENDRALEJO , Spain

Winery Description: Bodegas Más Que Vinos is the small winery founded by the three winemaker friends Margrita Madrigal, Alexandra Schmedes and Gonzalo Rodriguez in 1999 located in Cabañas de Yepes, on the high plateau of Toledo. The winemaking philosophy is based on the old family vineyards some over 100 years old, planted exclusively with the local grape varieties: Cencibel (Tempranillo), Garnacha, Airén and Malvar. All vineyards are farmed organically and manually. Fermentation is spontaneous and in small inox tanks and cement & clay amphorae. 3 wine ranges are produced: Ercavio, Los Conejos Malditos (natural Wines), and the Premium edition of single vineyard wines including: La Plazuela, Viña el Señorito de Ercavio, La Malvar, La Garnacha de la Madre. Mas Que Vinos is one of the few Spanish wineries with the seal: Sustainable Wineries for Climate Protection. The wines receive continuously high accolades from Wine Advocate and other international and national critics.
Winery Location: CAMINO DE LOS MOLINOS S/N, 45312, CABAÑAS DE YEPES , Spain

En boca es muy jugoso y sabroso, con un tanino suave y redondo, pero con una boca estructurada que llena todo el paladar.
Product 2 Description: Un vino blanco elegante y vibrante: un monovarietal expresivo que despliega aromas de frutas tropicales, cítricos maduros y sutiles notas florales. En boca destaca por su frescura y equilibrio, sostenidos por una acidez precisa. El final es largo y persistente, fiel a nuestro propósito de elaborar un Chardonnay donde la fruta, la claridad y la armonía sean protagonistas.
Product 3 Description: Elaborado con la variedad de uva blanca Gewürztraminer. Esta variedad es la primera en ser vendimiada cada año, con el objetivo de preservar la frescura natural, acidez equilibrada y las características a notas florales. Es un vino blanco aromático, ligero y refrescante, que resalta por su perfil floral y su expresión limpia en boca. Con una capacidad para equilibrar sabores intensos con elegancia.
Product 4 Description: Un coupage de Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah y Tempranillo. Cada variedad envejece por separado en barricas de roble francés durante 12 meses. Después de definir el coupage, el vino reposa durante doce meses más en botella. Presenta un color rojo cereza con ribetes violáceos. Aromas a ciruela y guinda negra, y notas especiadas como clavo y pimienta negra. Con taninos dulces y redondos.
Product 5 Description: Tiaso procede de viñas viejas de Garnacha plantadas entre 1920 y 1970 en suelos de pizarra y esquisto, caracterizados por sus pronunciadas pendientes y su bajo contenido en materia orgánica. Presenta un color rojo cereza con reflejos violetas, con aromas de frutas rojas, carácter floral y una distintiva sensación ferrosa aportada por la pizarra. Una personalidad marcada por el suelo. En boca presenta una acidez afiliada y taninos ligeros, poco estructurados que recuerda mucho a sensaciones minerales

As a member of Vi de la Terra Mallorca, we stand for authenticity, sustainability, and a welcoming spirit.

Winery Description: Bodegas Paco García (DOCa Rioja) is a modern family project in Murillo de Río Leza focused on redefining Rioja wine. Their philosophy emphasizes fruit-forward, vibrant, and fresh wines, moving away from more traditional styles. They use estate-grown grapes (Tempranillo, Garnacha) cultivated at an altitude of 500m. Their iconic handprint label symbolizes artisanal work and a generational shift aimed at attracting new consumers to the world of wine.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street C, Stand 355
Product 1 Description: Paco García La Villa is the winery's crown jewel, a signature (Reserva) red wine that pays homage to Murillo de Río Leza. Crafted with a blend of 85% Tempranillo and 15% Mazuelo from vines over 30 years old, it is aged for 24 months in French oak barrels. It presents an intense garnet color and a powerful nose of ripe fruit (plum, blueberry) fused with notes of vanilla, clove, and anise. The palate highlights a superb balance between structure and elegance, with velvety tannins and a persistent, spicy finish. It is a sophisticated wine, ideal for elaborate meat dishes and grand celebrations, served between 16ºC and 18ºC.
Product 2 Description: Paco García Cantamilano is a 100% Garnacha single-varietal that embodies freshness and conviviality. Sourced from the Las Canteras vineyard (540m), it is aged for 10 months in seasoned French oak barrels. The nose is explosive, featuring notes of red fruits, cherry, orange peel, and white flowers. On the palate, it is a "sexy," creamy wine with a striking entry and a perfect balance between acidity and freshness. Ideal for meats, pasta, or tapas.
Product 3 Description: Paco García Crianza is the expression of modern elegance in DOCa Rioja. Crafted with Tempranillo and Garnacha, this premium wine stands out for its perfect balance between ripe fruit and 12 months of aging in French oak. It offers a complex nose of red fruits, spices, and toasted notes. On the palate, it is silky, structured, and persistent. It is the winery's flagship wine, designed for those seeking the sophistication of contemporary Rioja with a unique character.
Product 4 Description: Paco García El Yergo is a single-varietal white wine made from Tempranillo Blanco, a grape variety native to Murillo de Río Leza. It is aged for 6 to 8 months in French oak barrels on its lees. The nose features citrus, floral, and tropical notes like pineapple and mango, with subtle creamy hints of vanilla. On the palate, it is voluminous, fresh, and elegant, with a fleshy structure. It pairs perfectly with fish, seafood, and white meats.
Product 5 Description: Paco García Seis is a 100% Tempranillo red wine aged for six months in new French oak barrels. It features a bright cherry color and intense fruit aromas of strawberries, raspberries, and blackberries, with floral hints of violets. On the palate, it is fresh, round, and perfectly balanced, designed to be a direct and highly enjoyable wine. It is ideal for casual drinking, BBQs, and light meals, best served between 12°C and 16°C. Paco García Seis es un vino tinto monovarietal de Tempranillo (100%) con una crianza de seis meses en barricas nuevas de roble francés. Destaca por su color cereza brillante y una intensa carga frutal de fresas, frambuesas y moras, con matices florales a violetas. En boca es fresco, redondo y muy equilibrado, diseñado para ser un vino directo y "disfrutón". Es ideal para copeo, barbacoas y comidas ligeras, servido entre 12° y 16°C

Winery Description: At Bodegas Pandora we make unique, subtle wines with soul, where variety is always the protagonist. Wines that are born from respect for the origin, care for the vineyard and precise production that preserves the authenticity and expression of each plot. The winery is the dream come true of three winegrower friends who decided to join their plots and their experience to shape a common project. Located in the heart of the Rueda Designation of Origin, on the outskirts of the municipality that gives its name to the appellation, Pandora is integrated into a natural environment surrounded by vineyards. We have vineyards spread between Rueda, Nueva Villa de las Torres, El Campillo, Torrecilla de la Orden and Olmedo, with different soils and altitudes that add complexity and character to our wines. As a reflection of our restless spirit, the winery also houses an ampelographic garden with more than 20 varieties, a symbol of our vocation for diversity and exploration.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street A, Stand 188
Product 1 Description: Rosa Zarza is our most exclusive wine. It is born from a historic pre-phylloxera vineyard on ungrafted foot, planted in 1895, in the heart of the DO Toro. Century-old vines on sandy soils with pebbles, at an altitude of 810 metres, which provide freshness, character and an elegance unusual in Toro. Very limited production. A wine with history, origin and personality. A jewel of Castilla y León in every bottle.
Product 2 Description: The Yemayá DO Rueda range is a collection of modern, gastronomic whites with their own identity. We work with Verdejo and Sauvignon Blanc, looking for freshness, volume and varietal expression. Our Yemayá Verdejo on lees stands out for its texture and balance. The complexity comes from the vineyard: plots in different areas of the DO, with different soils and altitudes that provide depth and character. The Yemayá Verdejo Organic is born from a single selected plot, with organic certification and aging on lees that provides structure and persistence without losing purity. We complete the range with our barrel whites, unique and very differentiating wines in Rueda. Whites with subtle ageing, elegant, spacious and designed to position themselves in international high-end ranges.
Product 3 Description: Yemayá DO Toro is our most elegant interpretation of Tinta de Toro, an intense variety with great personality. Made 100% with selected grapes, this wine combines power and balance, always maintaining freshness and structure. It undergoes a minimum aging of 6 months in French oak barrels, which adds complexity, spicy notes and a rounder texture, without covering the fruit. The result is a red wine with character, deep and gastronomic, ideal for the Horeca channel and for consumers looking for authentic wines with a modern touch. A unique wine within our range, which expands the portfolio with the strength and prestige of the DO Toro.

Winery Description: Bodegas Paniza was founded in 1953 in the town from which it takes its name, Paniza—a small village near Zaragoza, where we embarked on a journey to share the best of this land: our wine. Today, we continue our work with the same passion our founders had, keeping our values and love for our vineyard intact. Always adapting and evolving to meet the challenges of the future, we are now a community of 360 winegrowing members. Together, we manage around 3,000 hectares of vineyards, with diverse grape varieties from which we harvest high-quality grapes each year.

Located on an unbeatable environment, right in the heart of the Ribera del Duero and under the watchful eye of the Castle of Peñafiel; we exert ourselves everyday to be able to offer you our more painstaking and intimate interpretation of the art of crafting wines. We select our finest vineyards, harvest our grapes at its optimal maduration level. A refined care through the entire process, rested in selected barrels for elegance and refinement, followed by the necessary time of bottle ageing for you to enjoy at its best.

Winery Description: With its origins in 1912, Bodegas Perica is a family winery with strong traditional values. We have more than 150 hectares of our own vineyards in the best areas of Rioja Alta, which allows us to have total control of the growing cycle and to know each plot, with its different soils-orientations-altitude and ages for the production of the different wines. Don Juan García, founder of the winery, destined these wines for local consumption and for sale in neighbouring villages. Gradually, due to the success achieved, it was his son Don David García, affectionately nicknamed Perica, who inherited the project and consolidated it, building the winery and registering it in the DOCa Rioja in 1950. Nowadays, it is Mario Entrena who leads the project, grandson of Don David Garcia ‘Perica’ and who surrounded by a team of professionals has decided to carry out different changes and to bet on the elaboration of a wide range of wines according to the origin and knowledge of the vineyards.
Winery Location: AVENIDA DE LA RIOJA 59, 26340, SAN ASENSIO , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street C, Stand 355
Product 1 Description: GRAPE VARIETIESES Tempranillo and Maturana tinta. ALCOHOL CONTENT 13,5-14% vol. WINEMAKING The grapes are harvested in boxes of 10 kilos and always at the optimum moment to guarantee a perfect alcoholic and phenolic maturation. Two selections are made on these grapes before entering the winery, a first selection in the field, where only the perfect bunches are harvested, and then a selection of the grapes in the winery. Cold pre-fermentation maceration for 24 hours. Alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in French oak vats. Aging in French oak barrels for 16 months and subsequent transfer to bottle, where it will remain for a minimum of 12 months in our cellars.
Product 2 Description: GRAPE VARIETIESES Viura. ALCOHOL CONTENT 13,55% vol. WINEMAKING Harvesting is done manually and in 10 kg boxes, selecting the best bunches in the vineyard. Once the grapes are received at the winery, they are gently pressed. The must obtained from the pressing will remain for 24 hours in stainless steel tanks at a temperature of 10-12 ºC in order to separate the gross lees. The clean must finished its fermentation in French oak barrels and remained there with its fine lees for 6 months. After these processes, the wine was aged in French oak barrels for 15 months and bottled in August 2022. Total bottles: 4,661 units of 750 ml.
Product 3 Description: GRAPE VARIETIES:Tempranillo. ALCOHOL CONTENT 13,5-14% vol. WINEMAKING Once the grapes are harvested at optimum ripeness from our vineyards located in the Rioja Alta, the alcoholic and malolactic fermentation will take place in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks. Aging in 225-liter Bordeaux barrels of American oak for 12-16 months. Subsequent refining in bottle in our cellars before its release to the market.
