Product 1 Description: Our premium wine, with an extra limited production, made only with the best grapes from excellent vintages (the only vintages produced in the winery's history: 2006, 2011, 2015, and 2022). For the production of this wine, grapes from plots over 15 years old were selected, with an average yield of 4000 kg/Ha. It is a wine that has been aged for 15 to 18 months in French and American oak barrels. It has over 15 color points, more than 15 seconds of persistence in the mouth. It has 15% alc. vol. This great wine has not undergone any type of filtration or stabilization before bottling. Its subsequent aging in the bottle gives it roundness and elegance, resulting in this complex and amazing wine.
Product 2 Description: Our signature sweet wine, with a delicate balance between the expected sugar level and the genuine flavour of the grape it comes from. Awarded Best in its Category by "La Cofradía Navarra del Vino" in 2025.
Product 3 Description: Special selection of old-vine Garnacha from our own vineyards. One of our flagship crianzas, aged in oak barrels for 9 months. An intense cherry-red wine with garnet highlights. Intense flavors and aromas, smooth with predominant notes of ripe fruit, mineral and balsamic touches, soft lactic nuances, and light licorice hints. Tasty, elegant, and perfectly balanced on the palate, inviting enjoyment paired with a wide range of culinary options: cured meats, stews, game, and meats in general.
Product 4 Description: Our white wine with the soul of a red. A wine that challenges conventions, where the nobility of red Garnacha expresses itself in the form of a surprising and elegant white. Piedemonte Blanc de Noir is a very special white wine. An uncommon and highly interesting proposal for those seeking distinctive whites. Made 100% from red Garnacha grapes. This variety brings volume and a special fruity profile, without losing the freshness of whites. Highly versatile and food‑friendly. Unique in its concept within the Navarra region, this Blanc de Noir offers unparalleled balance, perfect for enjoying with or without food pairings.

Winery Description: Bodegas Piedra is a Family State in Toro where we elaborate Sustainable, low intervention fine wines, all the vineyard is Certified Organic & 85% is Pre-Phylloxera being the oldest vineyard planted in 1927 We are proud owners of the biggest extension of old vineyard of all DO Toro!! In our Portfolio you can find both red and white wines, all of them are Certified Organic, some are Natural and some are Low Alcohol Wines. We focus on elaborating elegant, fresh wines, staying away from the typical Hard, Rough, Tannic Wines that the DO Toro have been known to be!
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 452

Winery Description: Bodegas Pincerna is a contemporary interpretation of a historic territory. In the D.O. León, where a continental climate meets Atlantic influence, a project is born that understands wine as culture, memory, and emotion. The name Pincerna—the ancient guardian of wine—reflects our philosophy: to safeguard origin and express it with honesty and elegance. We work mainly with indigenous grape varieties such as Prieto Picudo and Albarín Blanco, distinctive grapes that define the character of our wines and can only be fully understood in this land. Each wine seeks balance, freshness, and precision, with limited production and minimal intervention. The result is a range of wines with tension, depth, and a clear gastronomic vocation, created for those who value authenticity and singular origins.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 484
Product 1 Description: Fáfila Pétriz is one of the most distinctive and gastronomic expressions of Bodegas Pincerna. Made from Albarín Blanco sourced from selected vineyards in the D.O. León, it represents a more ambitious and complex interpretation of the variety. Following a night harvest and a carefully controlled winemaking process aimed at preserving aromatic expression, the wine undergoes partial barrel fermentation and is aged on its lees for around ten months, gaining volume, richness and depth. On the nose it is elegant and expressive, with notes of ripe white fruit such as apple and pear, complemented by creamy and fine pastry nuances. On the palate it is broad, silky and enveloping, with an almost indulgent texture balanced by natural freshness that provides excellent gastronomic versatility. Designed for fine dining, specialist retailers and demanding consumers seeking white wines with personality, structure and a strong sense of origin. A high value-added reference within the Pincerna portfolio.
Product 2 Description: Pincerna Albarín Blanco is a clear expression of one of Spain’s most distinctive and lesser-known white grape varieties, native to the north-west of the country. This wine stands out for its aromatic intensity, natural freshness and strong personality, offering a truly differentiating alternative to more conventional white wines on the market. On the nose it is clean, expressive and highly appealing, with notes of white fruit, citrus and subtle floral nuances. On the palate it shows excellent acidity, balance and persistence, making it particularly food-friendly and easy to pair. Its modern, fresh style, combined with a very clear varietal identity, makes it especially well suited to the horeca channel. Designed for curious consumers looking to discover new grape varieties with character, without sacrificing accessibility or an excellent quality–price ratio. A white wine with strong growth potential in international markets.
Product 3 Description: Pincerna Prieto Picudo Red represents the most direct and honest interpretation of this distinctive grape variety from León. It is a wine that focuses on fruit, freshness and expressiveness, offering a modern and approachable profile without losing its identity. On the nose, ripe red fruit aromas appear alongside subtle spicy notes, while on the palate it is well-balanced, with smooth tannins and a pleasant finish. This is an easy-to-understand red wine for the consumer and an ideal introduction to the Prieto Picudo variety in new markets. Its style makes it particularly attractive for the horeca channel. Designed for regular consumption, it offers an excellent quality–price ratio and a clear positioning as an alternative to more widely known grape varieties.
Product 4 Description: Pincerna Prieto Picudo Rosado is a representative example of the style offered by the indigenous Prieto Picudo grape when crafted as a rosé wine. Made from this unique native variety, it stands out for its intense, bright colour, fresh and fruit-driven aromatic profile, and well-defined personality. The wine combines tradition with a modern, approachable style, closely aligned with current consumer trends. On the nose, fresh red fruit notes dominate, while on the palate it is lively, well-balanced and very easy to drink. Its versatility makes it suitable for both casual consumption and food pairing. From a commercial perspective, it is a highly attractive reference thanks to its strong visual impact, rotation potential and clear differentiation from generic rosés. A solid choice for buyers seeking a rosé with origin, character and authenticity.
Product 5 Description: Pincerna Sumiller is one of the most complete and food-oriented expressions of the Pincerna project. Made primarily from Prieto Picudo, complemented by Mencía, Garnacha and Tempranillo, it comes from a selection of vineyards located in different areas of the D.O. León, including plots of very old vines, some close to a century in age. This diversity of origins and soils adds complexity and balance to the wine. After fermentation, part of the wine is aged in oak barrels, aiming to bring structure and elegance without losing freshness or varietal identity. On the nose, it is intense and seductive, with notes of macerated black fruits, chocolate, coffee and spices. On the palate it is round, rich and long, with an enveloping texture and great persistence. It is especially suited for gastronomy, fine dining and wine professionals, capable of accompanying an entire meal. A wine with strong personality, depth and high added value for portfolios seeking differentiation and authenticity.

Winery Description: We are a leading winery located in Alicante, in the inland Mediterranean of Spain. Since 1932, we have combined tradition with innovation to develop an ambitious project deeply rooted in our territory. We work our vineyards with utmost respect for the traditions of our winegrowers. We are among Spain's most important producers of organic and vegan wines. Since 1997, 50% of our total production has come from organic farming, promoting biodiversity around our vineyards and using minimal additives. Our main indigenous grape is Monastrell, complemented by Syrah, Merlot, Sauvignon Blanc, Tempranillo, Alicante Bouschet, Petit Verdot, Airén, Macabeo and Merseguera — a nearly extinct variety from Alicante featured in our unique Diapiro white wine. We truly believe that great wines come from passion and respect for nature — values we live every day at Bodegas Pinoso.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 475
Product 1 Description: After a selection of only the best and oldest bush vines with more than 70 years of age, Camarillas is the noblest version of the Pinoso land. This 100% Monastrell wine comes from a very small plot of land where the harvest is carried out by hand and the shade takes care of the vineyards, offering good acidity and a very balanced wine. In the winery, malolactic fermentation takes place in new French oak barrels for 6-8 months to provide a special character, raising the Monastrell grape to the highest level. A limited 1000 bottles edition of this wine with a sense of place.
Product 2 Description: With our brand-new wine Diapiro White, the winery brings back a very peculiar grape variety called Merseguera, traditionally growed in the region. For the technical team, this is a dream come true after years of research. For this project, bush vines from limestone soils, located at more than 650 meters altitude have been used. Controlled yields and nonirrigated vineyards, barely supported by very few and occasional watering during the hottest month of the summer. The Mediterranean-Continental climate, with its dry winters, generally cold springs and very warm summers, where fresh nights predominate, surrounds the vineyards, getting this way grapes with a good level of sugar as well as a very good gathering of acids and bouquets. Once the hand-harvesting has been carried out during the very early hours of the day, a de-stemming and soft crushing process is being applied. The grape juice is macerated with its skins at 8ºC around 6-8 hours. Part of the grape juice is fermented in stain steal deposits at 14ºC on the thin lees, whereas the other part is fermented in new French oaked barrels, followed by a slight aging on the lees during two months.
Product 3 Description: The wine, from a limited edition, is made exclusively with an indigenous grape variety of the area called Monastrell. It is a clear gamble on obtaining maximum benefits from the land of Pinoso and its surroundings. Grapes used for this wine come from our selection of un-irrigated vineyards which are more than 40 years old, carefully tended for the whole year following the strict rules of organic farming. Due to very low yields per vine, we get very complex and concentrated grapes. Traditional winemaking by controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks at 28 to 30ºC with continuous over-pumping and long maceration after-fermentation to achieve maximum expression of each grape. Its long stay for 9-12 months in new oak barrels and subsequent maturing in bottle caused a harmonious evolution of this extraordinary author wine.

Winery Description: Bodega Pinuaga is the third generation taking care of our family's centenary vineyards, producing red white and rosé wines at an altitude of over 700 meters above sea level in clay loam and limestone soils. All the vineyards are our own property and are farmed using organic and biodynamic methods. We are the only winery in our area that has impacted the respect pruning and bet on regenerative agriculture. Our vineyards are planted in goblet and preserving the historical heritage of these unique vines. We bet for unique and autochthonous varieties such as cencibel, viura and garnacha totally adapted to our soil and climate.
Winery Location: CARRETERA NACIONAL 301 KM 95, 45880, CORRAL DE ALMOGUER , Spain

Winery Description: Bodegas Pío del Ramo, founded in 2007 by Pío del Ramo Núñez, is located between the Madroño and Parda mountain ranges, in lands historically tied to winemaking. The winery combines traditional processes with modern facilities spanning 2,500 m², equipped with state-of-the-art machinery, ensuring the production of high-quality wines under the certifications D.O. Jumilla and I.G.P. Tierra de Castilla. Its vineyards, located in areas such as Jumilla, Ontur, Albatana, and Chinchilla, thrive in an extreme continental climate and calcareous soils. These conditions, along with sustainable farming practices, result in eco-friendly and healthy wines. The region's "terroir," characterized by low organic matter and sandy-loam textured soils, contributes to the uniqueness of the wines. With The Quiet Life, Pío del Ramo innovates by using semi-buried concrete tanks, reviving traditional techniques.

Our technical team, formed in wineries as prestigious as Villa María Estate (New Zealand) and Bodegas Vega Sicilia (Ribera del Duero), squeeze the best of our grapes to the maximum, obtaining unique wines recognized for their quality in more than 40 countries.

Winery Description: Bodegas PITA is a small, deeply personal project led by Emilio Pita in Rubí de Bracamonte, Castilla y León. Its aim is to reveal a different way of understanding terroir and to offer a unique interpretation of the Verdejo grape. Working with organically farmed vineyards, the wines move away from the variety’s usual aromatic profile, focusing instead on texture, freshness, and the distinctive character of the Pago de la Cantera estate. Emilio’s training in viticulture and oenology at the University of Bordeaux, combined with his international experience, is reflected in a careful, low-intervention approach in both the vineyard and the cellar. Every decision stems from respect for the grape and the place. The result is a range of honest, balanced wines that clearly express their origin and offer a contemporary vision of Verdejo, deeply rooted in its land.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 368

Winery Description: PROTOS, from the Greek "First"; A pioneering winery that since 1927 has remained faithful to its motto of BEING FIRST, as an attitude of constant improvement on a daily basis and in all processes, being present in more than 100 countries. Thanks to its winery designed by the prestigious architect winner of the Priztker Award Sir Richard Rogers, it is once again at the forefront of the wine and wine tourism scene, becoming the most visited winery in the Ribera del Duero and the first in Spain to obtain the "mark of excellence" certificate by Superbrands. In 2013 it was selected as "Winery of the Year" by the American magazine "Wine and Spirits", and since 2022, as one of the 50 most admired wineries in the world by the prestigious international organization Drinks International.

Product 1 Description: Del singular paraje Corazabe, una tierra muy cerca de Sajazarra llena de colinas y viña vieja, surge Coraz de Puente del Ea. Sus cepas viejas de tempranillo, variedad autóctona de la DOC. Rioja, guardan toda la riqueza de la zona, un marco idí­lico donde fauna y flora se expresan en su hábitat natural. De sus parcelas obtenemos un vino de gran definición y viveza que expresa el paisaje que se extiende al pie de la sierra. Una edición limitada que nace del cielo y la tierra, representado por las Águilas reales que sobrevuelan el viñedo y los corzos que habitan en el entorno.
Product 2 Description: El guardián del viñedo se merecí­a su propio vino, en una edición especial de 2.670 botellas. Con su astucia y sabidurí­a, protege nuestras tierras altas al pie de los Montes Obarenes. Allá­, en el paraje de Corazabe, traspasando frondosos bosques y caminos sinuosos, entre viñas viejas se encuentra Finca La Esclavitud, una ermita con forma de guardaviñas. Con sus uvas elaboramos un vino excepcional, profundo, equilibrado y lleno de carácter. Un homenaje a la cueva monástica de tiempos visigóticos donde se respira espiritualidad, naturaleza y vida.
Product 3 Description: Como homenaje a la sierra que protege a nuestras viñas del clima del norte (los majestuosos Montes Obarenes) nace Obar de Puente del Ea. Un blanco de viura, variedad tradicional en Rioja Alta, lleno de viveza, estructura y profundidad con un alma mineral que le aporta frescura. Sobre las cepas de uva blanca que decoran su etiqueta posa tranquila y majestuosa una perdiz, ave autóctona que surca los cielos pero que también está muy arraigada a la tierra, simbolizando con su imagen la fauna silvestre de la zona.
Product 4 Description: Saiaz es un homenaje a Sajazarra, pueblo con gran tradición vitícola considerado uno de los más bonitos de España. Situado en la comarca de Haro en torno a la confluencia de los rí­os Aguanal y Ea, está envuelto por un paisaje extenso de viñedos que se entremezclan con edificaciones de gran valor arquitectónico y cultural. Monovarietal de tempranillo, expresa la identidad y el terroir de la zona. La liebre autóctona que aparece en su imagen representa su carácter vivo, enérgico y vibrante.
Product 5 Description: Este vino monovarietal de garnacha de cepas viejas del Alto Najerilla recibe su nombre, Saiaz, del precioso pueblo en el que se encuentra nuestra bodega, Sajazarra. Un municipio bello rodeado de naturaleza, escenario imponente sobre el que baten sus alas aves de la zona. De ahí­ su imagen, ya que, además de fresco y lleno de vitalidad, es ligero como el vuelo de los pájaros que surcan los cielos de nuestros viñedos de Rioja Alta.

Winery Description: Since 1945, Bodegas Puente de Rus has been growing and evolving with its surroundings. Today it has modern facilities that, combined with our privileged land and the knowledge of our people, allow us to produce wines of a young and creative character. Our winery combines tradition and innovation, offering a quality, healthy and natural product, which highlights the benefits that wine offers us. The soils of varied composition feed the roots of our vineyards and give them their own particularities linked to this region. Similarly, the characteristics of the orographic system and rainfall guarantee its full maturation and adequate production of acidity, sugars, tannins and polyphenols, thus providing grapes with great balance and structure. Bodegas Puente de Rus respects those aspects of the elaboration process that make wines an artisan product, but at the same time applying the knowledge provided by current science and technology, but to the new technologies and processes we must add the human factor as an essential element for success

Winery Description: BODEGAS QUINTA DE AVES is located in the heart of the LATEST D.O.P. CAMPO DE CALATRAVA, a UNIQUE REGION with VOLCANIC SOILS that give our wines an UNMISTAKABLE MINERAL CHARACTER and EXCEPTIONAL FRESHNESS. We craft our wines EXCLUSIVELY FROM OUR OWN GRAPES, grown in a 100% ORGANIC VINEYARD, following a philosophy of MINIMAL INTERVENTION to preserve the purity of the terroir. Our name reflects the EXTRAORDINARY BIODIVERSITY of our estate, home to MORE THAN 100 BIRD SPECIES, a symbol of our commitment to NATURE and SUSTAINABILITY. Our PORTFOLIO includes SEMI-SWEET WINES, ROSÉS, WHITES, and BARREL-AGED REDS, offering DIVERSITY without compromising QUALITY. Each bottle is the AUTHENTIC EXPRESSION of a UNIQUE LANDSCAPE, designed for those who seek DIFFERENTIATION, QUALITY, and ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITY in a COMPETITIVE MARKET.

Product 1 Description: Tempranillo 100% – “La Capitana” Single Vineyard From old bush-trained vines in our exclusive parcel “La Capitana”, located on the highest soils of the estate, this is our signature single-vineyard wine. On the palate, it is unctuous, structured, and elegant, with a long, mineral finish. Aged in new French oak barrels for 15 months, crafted with four different cooperages, it delivers depth, sophistication, and a unique identity.
Product 2 Name: Red Wine Quinta de Aves Syrah Organic
Product 2 Description: Syrah 100% From trellised vineyards rooted in deep, stony soils, this wine displays brilliant tones with violet hues. On the nose, it offers intense aromas of strawberries and red fruits with a subtle spicy touch. The palate is velvety, persistent, elegant, and distinctly mineral. Aged on its own lees in stainless steel tanks for at least 5 months, it delivers complexity and finesse, ideal for pairing with sophisticated dishes
Product 3 Name: Vino Blanco Quinta de Aves Sauvignon Blanc & Moscatel
Product 3 Description: White Wine – Sauvignon Blanc & Muscat à Petits Grains Planted on fertile soils with abundant foliage, this wine is fragrant and complex, offering aromas of white flowers, citrus notes, and a subtle tropical touch, yet finishing dry on the palate. Fresh and vibrant, its minerality delivers a well-balanced acidity and a long, lingering finish. Aged on its own lees in stainless steel tanks for at least 3 months, it combines elegance and depth, making it an ideal choice for sophisticated pairings

Winery Description: Bodegas Quitapenas is one of the oldest wineries in Málaga. Founded in 1880, it remains a family-owned business that has preserved its winemaking tradition across generations. Since our beginnings, we have produced a wide range of products, including sweet wines, white and red wines, sangrias, vermouths and quality natural sparkling wines. This broad porfolio allows us to comprehensively meet our customers’ needs, always with a firm and consistent commitment to quality. We believe that our customers’ satisfaction is, ultimately, the true measure of our own success. We also have extensive experience exporting to international markets throughout Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The combination of quality, tradition, and expertise is the guarantee of the success of Quitapenas wines, an authentic Sabor a Málaga. Cheers!

Product 1 Description: Finca Ernite 2022 is an Oak red wine with Denomination of Origin Sierras de Málaga. It is made with the Tempranillo grape variety from vineyards in the Serranía de Ronda that are located at an altitude of 700 meters in the province of Malaga. Aged for 6 months in American oak and French oak barrels and after being refined in the bottle for another 12 months, it is one of our latest additions to our winery's catalogue. Different, with a marked personality and high quality, Finca Ernite 2022 has established itself as one of our latest great successes, already endorsed by important distinctions in renowned wine competitions.
Product 2 Description: Vegasol, a dry organic white wine and more with a clear exponent of Malaga's winemaking tradition. It is a dry wine that reflects the Mediterranean character of the area. Its intense aromatic profile evokes the sun and the climate of the Malaga coast. Balanced, friendly, persistent, of great elegance and different. It represents Bodegas Quitapenas commitment to tradition and sustainability in the production of wines. With numerous awards in international competitions, it is a wine that will never cease to surprise you.
Product 3 Description: Following our commitment to sustainability, in 2019 we started our project to work in organic. The result has been Vegasur. A white, dry wine, made with Pedro Ximénez grapes, organic with 6 months of aging on its fine lees. It is a powerful wine, of the highest quality and above all, different. Because we believe that success is in differentiation. In addition, our commitment to the total quality of all our wines is confirmed with Vegasur, where not only has the entire production process been taken care of, but also their design, presentation, and their placing on the market.

Winery Description: Bodegas Riojanas is one of the eight century-old wineries in Rioja, founded in 1890 by the Frías Artacho family, after obtaining a Gold medal at the Universal Exhibition in Barcelona. The passion for viticulture and sustainable respect for nature have been at the heart of Bodegas Riojanas' philosophy since its foundation. This commitment has recently earned it the SUSTAINABLE WINERIES FOR CLIMATE PROTECTION (SWFCP). Another key factor has been the satisfaction of the needs and tastes of its customers, to which Bodegas Riojanas has been adapting thanks to its dynamic drive. Its diversification strategy has led it to be present in the main designations of origin in addition to Rioja; Rueda, Toro, Rías Baixas, Ribera de Duero and Bierzo. The stabilizing factor since its inception has been the Frías-Artacho family of owners. Santiago Frías has been at the helm of the company since 2009. As technical director, he is assisted by the expert Oenologist Emilio Sojo, also a member of the family who was named in 2023 as BEST RIOJA WINEMAKER by the prestigious British magazine The Drinks Business.

Product 1 Name: MONTE REAL COLECCIÓN LARRENDANT GRAN RESERVA 2019
Product 1 Description: In honour of our legendary winemaker, creator of our Monte Real brand, we decided to launch a project called Colección Larrendant under the Monte Real brand To make our first Colección Larrendant Blanco Gran Reserva we chose the Viura and Malvasía grape varieties. Larrendant turned to the vineyard in search of excellence, he knew exactly which vineyards he must use to achieve his purpose. We perpetuate his philosophy and vision by continuing to sort the best small vineyards capable of delivering distinction and expressive character with which we strive to reproduce in our wines till this day. Tradition and origin provide the tools for innovation. “We build our future upon the pride of our past”. “Origin and tradition bottled in 3,150 bottles”
Product 2 Name: MONTE REAL RESERVA "EL BAGAZO" COLECCIÓN LARRENDANT 2020
Product 2 Description: In honor of the renowned winemaker Gabriel Larrendant, founder of the Monte Real brand, we have launched the Colección Larrendant project. Following in Larrendant’s footsteps of terroir-driven wines, we decided to create a red wine in tribute to the birthplace of our vineyards and winery. This wine aims to capture and share the essence and excellence of the Tempranillo from our town, Cenicero, in Rioja Alta. We named this project “El Bagazo” which translates to “Skin” in Spanish. This name was chosen because the key to preserving the authenticity and concentration of aromas and flavors of our Tempranillo lies in selecting the finest bunches with small berries and an ideal balance between the “skin” and the pulp. To capture the authentic essence of Tempranillo, we selected two historic vineyards established in 1970 in Cenicero. Tradition and origin serve as the keys to innovation. “We construct the future on the foundation of our pride in our history.”
Product 3 Description: Monte Real wines symbolize authenticity and the essence of BODEGAS RIOJANAS which are the reflections of a family legacy. Monte Real was launched in 1933 as a local wine, “El Monte”, a modern concept for the time. Monte Real's character is defined by the perfect exemplification and depth of Tempranillo grapes from Cenicero. Aromas of black fruits such as blackberries, blueberries and ripe plums combine with the spicy tones of liquorice or chocolate. A wine with structure, concentration and volume. Monte Real Reserva de Familia comes from small plots, with over half being defined as “Old Vines” planted more than 40 years ago, located between 430 and 530 metres above sea level and a composition of the clayey-calcareous soil with rounded pebbles, which naturally provides low yields, ideal for producing the best wines. Since its inception, Monte Real wines have spoken proudly of their Rioja origin and the singularity of a unique vineyard.
Product 4 Description: With Monte Real Tempranillo Blanco, we want to pay tribute to a rare grape variety in Rioja: the Tempranillo Blanco. With this wine we preserve Monte Real’s essence and identity: a terroir-driven, single-varietal wine focused on the vineyards as the timeless and authentic essence of the brand. Two vineyards located in Rioja Alta were selected to make this wine: “Los Campillos” in Cenicero and “Camino Arenzana” in Tricio. The 10-year-old "Los Campillos" plot is planted at 480 meters above the sea level. Its fruit has a floral and spicy character while the "Camino Arenzana" plot located in Tricio at 600 meters above the sea level adds very fresh fruit aromas. The characteristics of Tempranillo Blanco in both plots are the ideal complement to obtain a complex, elegant and high-quality white wine. This wine is a true discovery in constant evolution that will surprise palates longing for complex and unique whites wine.
Product 5 Description: The character of Viña Albina reflects the classic elegance of the Rioja Alta terroir; smooth reds, light red and black fruit, delicate but enormously complex with excellent balanced acidity that allows them to age in the bottle for decades To produce Viña Albina Gran Reserva with the same elegance and delicacy that has always characterized these wines, we seek freshness in vineyards located in the highest parts of Rioja Alta The softness of Tempranillo grapes was found in the vineyards planted around San Vicente de la Sonsierra, such as "Montebuena", "Vizcarral", "La Liende" and "El Bosque", head-pruned vines located in the foothills of the Sierra de Cantabria. We combine these with Mazuelo and Graciano grapes from vineyards in Cenicero, an area at lower altitude. Viña Albina was created with the aim of being different and enduring in time.

Winery Description: The Robles family located in Montilla has been making wines since 1927. At the end of the nineties, the 3rd generation understood that, more than progress, we are in favor of return. We grow organic grapes with the greatest intensity and quality of flavors and aromas that we know, we monitor their natural process and transfer all that richness of the fruit into the wine. In the vineyard we manage a plant cover with native wild species with short roots and nitrogen fixers (trebolinas, poppies, legumes). This plant cover releases the necessary nutrients at the optimal time to guarantee healthy growth of the vine and great quality of grape aromas, attracts beneficial insects that control pests, improves soil fertility and prevents erosion. In the winery we take care of the use of native yeasts and the physical treatment of the wine. Thus, the fermentation of our wines is carried out with native yeasts that are present in the soil of the vineyard and arrive at the winery attached to the skin of the grapes. We make wines that belong to their land. Generous wines, still wines, vermouths and the FIRST SPARKLING, all made exclusively with PEDRO XIMENEZ grapes
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 105
Product 1 Description: The natural bubbles of the Pedro Ximénez grape. Robles Brut Nature has been crafted using the traditional Champagne method from hand-harvested and hand-selected organic Pedro Ximénez grapes. Its persistent bubbles are the result of a double fermentation in the bottle, aged horizontally on the lees by hand for 24 months, from a blend with fortified wines. Straw yellow in color with golden highlights. Aromas of bread, characteristic of the yeasts of the Pedro Ximénez grape variety, while also displaying honeyed notes, aromatic intensity, and great expressiveness. Ripe stone fruit, apricot, dried herbs, and bread. Powerful entry on the palate with great structure. Bubbles that melt into the wine, leaving a velvety texture. Fresh and enveloping with a subtle touch of bitterness. Long and harmonious finish. This is a truly gastronomic wine. Thanks to the balance between structure, creaminess, and freshness, it pairs well with countless dishes.
Product 2 Description: Wine from raisin grapes of the Pedro Ximénez variety from nuestro pago de Villargallegos. During the "sunning" we spread the grapes harvested in August in the pastures, a place in the vineyard with a gentle slope where we take special care that the pasificación is regular and homogeneous by turning the bunches by hand. Bodegas Robles is one of the few wineries that still preserves its own paseras, which allows us to take extreme care in what is considered the last artisan work of the countryside in Andalucía. In the cellar, the pacified grapes are spread in capachos and a press hydraulics takes care of extracting the must, which at that moment displays an impressive range of aromas of cherry resin, quince jellies and honey that flood the whole cellar Bright amber color (reminiscent of cherry resin). The nose unfolds a wide range of quince jelly aromas and tones of honey. A wine of great complexity, intense, powerful, with strong notes of raisins, fig bread, caramel, dried fruits
Product 3 Description: Bodegas Robles has crafted the vermouth "VRMT. Andalusian Recipe" using an organic Oloroso wine aged for eight years in oak barrels, which imparts an elegant vanilla aroma. A touch of Pedro Ximénez unfolds a wide array of aromas of quince jelly and honey notes. The complex Solera and Criaderas aging system produces a very old Oloroso wine that is gently refreshed each year with younger wines. A unique experience of maturity and freshness. VRMT by Robles is macerated with ten aromatic plants grown in our organic vineyard in an attempt to convey the full terroir experience to the vermouth. We have incorporated aromas and memories of Andalusian cuisine, such as clove and cinnamon. Aroma of vanilla, quince jelly, and honey notes. Among the spicy aromas, wormwood, gentian, and elderflower stand out. Cloves and cinnamon are primarily responsible for the warm Andalusian aroma characteristic of our vermouth.

Winery Description: Bodegas RODA, owned by the Rotllant Daurella family, was founded in the late 1980s with the passionate intention of creating a new concept in the world of wine. Its innovative vision and working philosophy placed the wines of Bodegas RODA on the podium of the world’s finest. Located in the renowned Barrio de la Estación in Haro (La Rioja), this new concept proved revolutionary for Rioja wines thanks to the winery’s modern approach, its way of understanding viticulture, and its emphasis on the importance of old vineyards. Bodegas RODA leads international R&D&I projects and pioneering strategies in the fight against climate change. Under the D.O.Ca. Rioja, the winery produces four globally recognized brands: SELA, RODA, RODA I and CIRSION. Since 2022, it has had its first white wine: RODA I Blanco, whose history begins with the 2019 vintage.
Winery Location: AVENIDA VIZCAYA 5, 26200, HARO , Spain

Product 1 Description: A very limited, exacting selection wine, designed to showcase the vineyard’s most precise, intense and elegant expression. On the palate it’s powerful and concentrated yet refined, with high-quality tannins, volume and an extraordinarily long finish. Ideal for special occasions—give it time in the glass (or in bottle) to reveal its full complexity.
Product 2 Description: A deeper interpretation of the Tempranillo, with greater concentration, complexity and ageing potential. Aromatically it offers riper, darker fruit, balsamic tones, hints of Mediterranean scrub and nuanced oak that supports rather than dominates. The palate shows more structure and tension: generous yet focused, with firm but very fine tannins, superb balance and remarkable persistence. Enjoy now or cellar to see it evolve.
Product 3 Description: A high-expression white with a clearly gastronomic profile, combining volume, freshness and finesse. Aromas include white and stone fruit, citrus, aromatic herbs and subtle ageing notes that add complexity without taking over. The palate is broad and enveloping, with bright acidity, a textured mouthfeel and a persistent mineral finish. A serious white with the ability to evolve.

Winery Description: BODEGAS RODRÍGUEZ Y SANZO Wines with soul, from the North of Spain www.rodriguezysanzo.com Nonconformists since 1968 Bodegas Rodríguez y Sanzo S.L. is a family-run winery with deep roots in the Duero Valley. Javier, an internationally acclaimed winemaker, has brought our philosophy beyond our own facilities, crafting wines in other iconic regions such as Rioja, Rías Baixas, Bierzo, Ribera del Duero. We are driven by a clear conviction: the soil and its influence define the soul of each wine. That’s why we work with a deep, honest focus on the terroir, striving to capture its essence in every bottle.

The winery is committed to sustainability and respect for the environment, standing out especially in the production of organic wines and cavas. Bodegas Romale works both in the national and international markets, taking the essence of Extremadura wine to different countries and adapting to the demands of each market.

Product 1 Description: Este vino es un lienzo de color amarillo pálido y brillante quedespliega una frescura juvenil y suavidad incomparable. En nariz, es marcadamente aromático; las notas de manzanaverde, pera, cítricos y frutas tropicales danzan al unísono contoques florales. En boca, es una celebración de dulzura agradable, ligereza yfrescura, una fusión verdaderamente espectacular.
Product 2 Description: Exuding a deep ruby red color with a bright cherry flash, this wine promises and delivers. More than a year in barrel has allowed the development of a seductive complexity on the nose: notes of vanilla, the subtle elegance of wood, a whisper of coffee and the intriguing presence of smoked notes. On the palate, the wine is silky, deep, with tannins as polished and round as river stones. Its permanence in the mouth is no less than a spectacle worthy of being remembered.
Product 3 Description: Dressed in an elegant ruby tone and exhibiting tile nuances as a testimony of its ageing, this wine is expressed through a complex and intense aroma. It will intoxicate you with its seductive aromas of ripe fruit and spices. On the palate, it unfolds a dance of silkiness, elegance and character, leaving behind a long and persistent aftertaste that invites you to continue the experience.
Product 4 Description: Mezcla de cuatro variedades que aporta profundidad, frescura y complejidad, creando un vino con personalidad propia y un carácter excepcionalmente equilibrado. Cada sorbo refleja la mano experta de Diego Nieto, quien convierte esta cuidad combinación en un vino exclusivo, memorable y verdaderamente especial. Elaboración especial, Denominación de Origen.
Product 5 Description: Al igual que su homólogo Brut Nature, este cava rosado sepresenta en un atractivo color rosa fresa. Sus burbujas, finas y persistentes, proporcionan un hermosomarco visual. Aroma fresco, frutal y agradable que inunda la nariz. En boca es redondo, equilibrado, y parece susurrar historias deviñedos bañados por el sol de Almendralejo.

Winery Description: Rudeles is a family project created with the idea of continuing the work of our ancestors who, generation after generation, have been transmitting the passion for the vineyard, its fruit, as well as a wine culture that is almost forgotten. Most of our wines come from century-old vines, from small plots located almost at 950m with extreme temperatures that give great uniqueness to our wines. Without a doubt, another of our great props, because between all of us: family, friends, winegrowers, as well as other experts in the sector, we work together to make Rudeles a wine that makes us enjoy. From the first day we started this project we have tried to reflect in wine the qualities of our land, our great asset, together with our vines, planted more than 120 years ago.
Winery Location: C/ San Roque 78, 42345, PEÑALBA DE SAN ESTEBAN , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 248
Product 1 Description: Vineyards: The vines that give rise to Rudeles Aire are in the area of the valley that delimits the villages of Atauta and Peñalba de San Esteban; those that are found in places with unique characteristics, of hundreds of vines of very low production. Grape varieties: Albillo Mayor 100%, from our selected vines over 125 years old, with low load and slow ripening Vinification: The grapes were hand-picked in 12 kg boxes from September 16 and carefully chosen on a selection table upon entering the winery. Fermentation was done at a controlled temperature of 15ºC, in a clay jar to preserve the aromas. The maceration time was 7 days. Aged for 96 days in French oak barrels.
Product 2 Description: Viñedos: Las cepas de albillo mayor, una variedad autóctona de la región, se encuentran intercaladas en las mismas pequeñas parcelas de tempranillo. En una tierra seca y fría, estas viñas se localizan en el valle entre Peñalba de San Esteban y Atauta, a una altitud aproximada de 850 metros. Variedades de uva: Albillo 100 %, viñas viejas de más de 125 años. Vinificación: La uva se recogió a mano en cajas de 12 Kg a partir del 17 de septiembre y fue cuidadosamente escogida en una mesa de selección al entrar en bodega. La fermentación se hizo a una temperatura controlada de 15ºC, en una tina de acero inoxidable para conservar los aromas. El tiempo de maceración fue de 1 día. Crianza de 25 días en barrica de roble francés.
Product 3 Description: Viñedos: 23 es el número de parcelas situadas a 950 metros de altitud y que se utilizan para elaborar este vino afrutado y redondo. Cada una de estas parcelas fue bautizada por los ancestros de los actuales viticultores de RUDELES. Variedades de uva: 95% Tempranillo (el 70% procedente de viñas de entre 27 años y el 25% de viñas viejas de más de 120 años) y 5% garnacha de viñas de más de 120 años. Vinificación: La uva se recogió a mano en cajas de 12 Kg a partir del 7 de octubre y una vez en la bodega pasó por la mesa de selección. La fermentación se realizó a temperatura controlada de 23ºC. El tiempo total de maceración fue de 14 días.
Product 4 Description: Vineyards: The vines that give rise to Rudeles Aire are in the area of the valley that delimits the villages of Atauta and Peñalba de San Esteban; those that are found in places with unique characteristics, of hundreds of vines of very low production. Grape varieties: Albillo Mayor 100%, from our selected vines over 125 years old, with low load and slow ripening Vinification: The grapes were hand-picked in 12 kg boxes from September 16 and carefully chosen on a selection table upon entering the winery. Fermentation was done at a controlled temperature of 15ºC, in a clay jar to preserve the aromas. The maceration time was 7 days. Aged for 96 days in French oak barrels.
Product 5 Description: Vineyards: The grapes come from the 1-hectare estate of Los Arenales, which as the name suggests, is very sandy; This hinders the growth of the vines, which give little production but it is of high quality. Pebbles are mixed in the sand, such as the one that appears on the label, accompanied by some animal footprints that haunt the vineyard. Grape varieties: 100% Tempranillo. Fermentation was carried out at a controlled temperature of 25º C and maceration lasted 10 days.

Winery Description: Ruiz de Viñaspre is family-owned in Laguardia Rioja Alavesa and dates back to 1910, although the family has been growing grapes for more than two centuries. Effort, determination, a passion for things done well and a clear philosophy focussed on the vineyard. There have been four generations which have written the history of our family, the “Ruiz de Viñaspre”. Julian Ruiz de Viñaspre vine-grower, oenologist and the soul of Ruiz de Viñaspre began a new project in 2007 at Laguardia. Following the family education and supporting our own elaborated wines, the fourth generation has created different wines, all of them prepared to satisfy the most demanding national and international palates.Today, it is one of the leading winegrowers of Rioja Alavesa. Ruiz de Viñaspre understand wine and life as the pursuit of excellence through a balance between the past and today, free from trends. This philosophy is apparent not only in how we work and in our winery; it is also present in each of our wines.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 235

Winery Description: We are one of the oldest family wineries in Extremadura, we have been producing since 1870, with a young team and the best technology at the service of quality. We are located in the imposing Villuercas-Ibores-Jara Geopark and we have 140 hectares of our own vineyards. We work with low yields to ensure the maximum expression of each plot. We produce wines, cavas and vermouth that are recognized and awarded in the main wine competitions. I am at your disposal at our stand, Hall 8, No. 723, so that you can taste them.

Winery Description: Family tradition, modern vision, and the people who elevate our wine. Since 2003, Bodegas Salzillo has transformed the essence of our land into authentic and competitive wines. What began as Agustín’s dream is now carried forward by the second generation, combining tradition and innovation to craft wines with a unique identity and exceptional value for money. Our native grape, Monastrell, is the heart of the winery, but we also work with Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc, Macabeo, and more… as well as producing wine-based products such as vermouth and sangría. We are currently present in more than 13 countries, with over 600,000 bottles produced annually and the capacity to vinify up to 2,000,000 kg of grapes. We stand out for: • Strong personal relationships. • Close, personalized service. • A broad catalog and tailor-made solutions. • An innovative, proactive approach to new projects. • Excellent value for money.

Product 2 Description: Güertano is a 4-month oak-aged Monastrell red wine with a distinctive and special character. It is the flagship wine of our winery. Color Intense cherry red with purple hues. Nose Shows fruity and floral aromas, such as rose, combined with creamy notes. Hints of smoke, coffee, vanilla, and various spices appear thanks to its time in our special selection of barrels. Palate Expressive, full-bodied, chocolate-toned, and persistent.
Product 3 Description: Red wine aged for 12 months, made from Monastrell, Syrah, and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. Color: Picota cherry with purple hues and a seductive rim. Nose: Great aromatic diversity, highlighting ripe fruit aromas blended with subtle spicy tones, cacao, and wood, where the focus remains on the land and the grape. Palate: A velvety, round, balanced, and balsamic wine.

Winery Description: Bodegas San Alejandro, founded in 1962 in Miedes de Aragón, Calatayud, is the benchmark winery of the Calatayud Appellation. Specialized in the production of Garnacha wines, it is the winery of reference in our area. BSA combines tradition and modernity to craft high-quality wines, supported by vineyards located at altitudes between 800 and 1,075 meters. With a strong focus on excellence (a proof of this is that we hold the highest scores in the most demanding Quality Standards in the industry such as IFS or the WfCP seals), we export 85% of our production to more than 40 countries all over the world, establishing ourselves as a key player in the international wine market. A proof of this is that we ellaborate several bestselling products in certain markets like the Norwegian, where we have been producing the bestselling red wine there for 8 years in a raw, we ellaborate one of the TOP10 Garnachas in the USA and one of the most popular Garnacha wines in Asia (Evodia). Winery Description: Wellcome to Bodegas San Dionisio, the largest winery in the Origin Denomination Jumilla, responsable for producting the highest quantity of the Monastrell. Our Monastrell wines show a strong personality and a true representation of our area. Stands out for its freshness a fundamental characteristic of the Monastrell grown in the Fuentealamo area where the continental climate with Mediterranean influence and the altitudes betwen 900 and 1100 meters above sea level allow the grapes to ripen slowly and evenly. In our area we find Monastrell grown on ungrafted vines (pie franco), which allow us to obtain wines with unique concentration elegance. Additionally the calcareous well drained soils combined with careful viticultural management, ensure that each bottle is full of intensity body and a perfect balance between acidity and alcohol. At Bodegas San Dionisio with over 5,300 hectareas of vineyards and more than 700 farmers we are also committed with a sustainable approach since 1957.

Product 1 Description: Type of wine: Crianza wine, 100% monastrell. Designation of Origin Jumilla. Vines: ungrafted vines over 40 years old and at an altitude of 1000 meters Elaboration: Fermentation for 12 days with subsequent ageing for 12 months in oak barrels. Presentation: 75cl truncated cone bottle, sold in boxes of 6 bottles (also available in magnum bottle 1500ml) Service: Between 16º-18ºC. Pairing: Serve with red and game meats, stews and very mature cheeses. Tasting note: Potent and delicious aged red wine with toasted and smoked nunances from its ageing in oak, which respect and blend perfectly with the ripe fruit varietal aromas of the Monastrell. Others: High puntuation in Vivino app and several gold awards!
Product 2 Description: Type of wine: Young rose made from Monastrell variety. Designation of Origin Jumilla. Pairing: Recommended to accompany pasta dishes, salads, white fish, seafood and rice dishes. Service: Between 8º-10ºC. Tasting note: It is slightly acid in mouth. It transmits sensations of freshness and meatiness, nice feeling at the end. It has bright and clean appearance with shades of raspberry low average intensity, elegant varietal aroma of flowers and fruits.
Product 3 Description: Type of wine: Young Red Wine of Monastrell variety. Jumilla Protected Denomination of Origin. Presentation: 75cl bordeaux screen printed trasparent bottle, in boxes containing 6 bottles. Simultaneous inoculation of yeast and bacteria for its alcoholic and malolactic fermentation, in stainless steel tanks. Decanting via separation of the thick lees, remaining in contact with the fine lees for 30 days, with continuous stirring so as to extract the fermentation mannoproteins, which convey smoothness on the palate. Pairing: It es best paired with all kinds of meats, stews, rice and pasta. Service: Between 16º-18ºC. Tasting note: Violet red colour having ripe fruit aromas with balsamic notes. On the palate smooth and tasty, fresh and well-balanced and having a delicious flavourful finish.

Winery Description: San Esteban Winery (Murillo de Río Leza- La Rioja- Spain) is the first wine cooperative in La Rioja, founded in 1953. Located in the Region of the Valleys of Leza and Jubera (La Rioja), with own vineyards on three different heights in the valley, which give our wines great diversity. Our range is the reflection of the lifestyle of our winery: we belong to the Rioja DOC and therefore offer young fresh wines with many fruity flavors, red wines and white wines with a lot of body and wines with the character that provides aging in barrels (some with very good scores from Tim Atkin). But also, they are wines that represent "the rebellion" of our desire to innovate and be different: the wines of the range Kairos do not follow the rules established by DOC Rioja. Three brands are born from our way of feeling "the vineyard": • TIERRAS DE MURILLO: Our place- our history since 1953. Traditional wines, full of history. • OÑAL: Our harvest in the season of greatest abundance: autumn. Fresh wines with an innovative image and body. • KAIROS: Our rules. Wines born in their right time and "in rebellion" with the imposed norms.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 371

Winery Description: We are a winery in the north of the Jumilla PDO, born in a demanding territory where the vine is worked with respect and the wine is forged with character. Here we do not make alone: behind each bottle there are generations of winegrowers, our partners, families who have cared for these vineyards for decades and who continue to believe in this land. Monastrell and Garnacha Tintorera are our voice. Varieties deeply linked to the landscape and the people who grow them, capable of expressing the strength, honesty and identity of our origin. Our winery is an essential part of the life of our people. It maintains vineyards, employment, landscape and future. It is local economy, social cohesion and shared memory. The Lady Offererente, found in these lands, gives its name to our brand and symbolizes the collective offering of a people to wine. Each bottle is the result of common effort, a living expression of identity, pride and belonging.
Winery Location: CALLE CAPATAZ SANTIAGO, 91, 02650, MONTEALEGRE DEL CASTILLO
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 521
Product 1 Description: Oferente Blanco Barrica is born from the Airén, a grape characteristic of our area, reinterpreted from a modern and respectful perspective. A wine that highlights the versatility of this variety when worked with precision and balance. After its production, the wine is aged in French oak barrels for around 60 days, seeking the perfect harmony between fruit and wood. The wood is subtly integrated, providing soft notes and delicate toasted notes, without hiding the fresh and varietal character of the Airén. Aromas of ripe white fruit, fine nuances of butter and elegant memories of ageing appear on the nose. On the palate it is enveloping, silky and balanced, with good structure, freshness and a long and pleasant finish. An elegant and expressive white, where the fruit maintains the prominence and the wood accompanies with discretion and finesse.
Product 2 Description: Blanco Oferente es nuestra manera de reivindicar la Airén, una variedad que durante mucho tiempo ha sido discreta, pero que hoy demuestra el protagonismo que siempre mereció. Uva perfectamente adaptada a nuestro clima, capaz de conservar frescura, equilibrio y una expresión limpia incluso en condiciones extremas. Elaborado para resaltar su esencia, Blanco Oferente es un vino fresco y honesto, con aromas sutiles de fruta blanca, notas herbales y un paso por boca ágil, amable, con una acidez equilibrada y una sensación de ligereza que invita a repetir.
Product 3 Description: Oferente Tinto Joven es una expresión pura de la Monastrell, la variedad autóctona de nuestro pueblo y emblema de la Denominación de Origen Jumilla. Conocida internacionalmente como Mourvèdre, Mataró o Monastrell, esta uva encuentra en Jumilla su mayor hogar, ya que es la zona con mayor extensión de Monastrell del mundo. Elaborado exclusivamente con esta variedad, nace un vino joven, directo y profundamente varietal, que busca mostrar la esencia más fresca y honesta de la Monastrell. En nariz destacan las frutas negras maduras, notas de violeta y un toque balsámico y mentolado muy característico de nuestra zona. En boca es jugoso, equilibrado y expresivo, con taninos amables y un paso fresco que invita a seguir bebiendo. Un tinto joven con identidad, fiel reflejo de un territorio único y de una uva que habla con voz propia cuando se la deja expresarse sin artificios.
Product 4 Description: Oferente Tinto Selección es una nueva expresión de la Monastrell, variedad autóctona de nuestro pueblo y emblema de la Denominación de Origen Jumilla, donde alcanza su máxima expresión y la mayor extensión de viñedo del mundo. Elaborado exclusivamente con Monastrell, este vino realiza una crianza de tres meses en barrica, mayoritariamente de roble francés, con un pequeño aporte de roble americano, buscando siempre el equilibrio. No es un vino marcado por la madera, sino un tinto donde la fruta sigue siendo protagonista y la crianza aporta complejidad y profundidad sin imponerse. Aparecen notas de fruta negra, matices especiados y balsámicos, con un conjunto armónico y expresivo. En boca es redondo, amable y fácil de disfrutar, con estructura y frescura bien integradas. Un vino versátil, capaz de acompañar muchos maridajes, pensado para disfrutarlo sin normas, con quien quieras y con lo que más te apetezca.
Product 5 Description: Oferente Tinto Crianza is a deeper and more structured interpretation of the Monastrell, made exclusively with this emblematic variety of our town and the D.O. Jumilla. A wine that represents the most classic style of the winery and the one with the greatest presence of wood within the entire Oferente range. It is aged for between six and nine months in French and American oak barrels, combining first-use and post-use barrels, always seeking a balance between the intensity of ageing and the varietal character. Here wood plays a leading role, well integrated and perfectly tamed. Aromatically it is complex and deep, with clear nuances of aging, tertiary, balsamic and menthol notes, hints of meat juice, white spices, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg, together with an intense, ripe and seasoned Monastrell. On the palate it is broad, structured and persistent, ideal to accompany red meats and hearty stews.

Winery Description: A leading winery in the region since 1944, Bodega San Valero has the longest history in Cariñena, and has benefitted from access to some of the most prominent vineyards in the region for 75 years. The winery manages 500 grape growers cultivating over 4,000 hectars of vineyard as active members of the cooperative, where 90% of the vineyards surround the winery facility near the village of Cariñena. Bodega San Valero focuses on indigenous varieties (Garnacha and Cariñena) which account for 70% of plantings. A long history in the region brings key advantages – some 20% of the Garnacha is classified as “old vines”, ranging from 30 to 100 years, and located at extreme altitudes in very rocky soils. The winery is considered one of the most progressive and sustainable wineries in Cariñena, combining a passion and respect for tradition with the most modern winemaking techniques that Europe has to offer.
Winery Location: CARRETERA NACIONAL 330 KM 450, 50400, CARIÑENA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 447

Winery Description: Bodegas Saura is a distinctive wine project located in Caravaca de la Cruz, in a mountainous area at an altitude between 850 and 950 meters. Surrounded by a wild and protected natural environment, the winery is driven by the aim of reviving traditional viticulture and producing wines of the highest quality, deeply connected to their origin. What makes Bodegas Saura truly unique is its winemaking process: all wines ferment in handcrafted fossil limestone vats. These artisanal tanks, where embedded fossils can be observed, allow for a natural and stable fermentation, maintaining optimal temperatures without artificial cooling and preserving the pure expression of the fruit. The vineyards, bush-trained and dry-farmed, are set within a 500-hectare estate of great ecological and historical value. The result is a range of honest, expressive wines with a strong sense of identity, reflecting the landscape, tradition and the passage of time.
Winery Location: Avenida San Jorge 3, 30565, Las Torres de Cotillas , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 553

Winery Description: The history of Bodegas Serdio dates back to the 19th century, when it was founded in Cádiz, where it remained in operation until its closure in the 1970s. Now, almost 60 years later, Bodegas Serdio reopens to recover an exceptional legacy. The grandchildren of its last owner have revived the family winemaking business in Barrio de Santiago in Jerez de la Frontera. With the aim of restoring the authentic essence of Sherry, the wines in its portfolio —located in Plaza de la Merced—are older, bottled "en rama" (raw), without cold filtration and without any treatments which may alter their styles. Bodegas Serdio; genuine, pure, timeless.

Product 1 Description: Colección Divina is a wine with a deep, intense cherry-red color. On the nose, it shows floral notes alongside ripe red fruit, balsamic hints and sweet spices such as vanilla and cocoa from its time in oak. On the palate, ripe fruit and oak notes come together beautifully, giving the wine excellent balance and great aging potential. It has a powerful yet fresh and smooth entry, with a long and intense finish.
Product 2 Description: Silvano García 4 Meses is an appealing and expressive wine that immediately catches the eye with its bright cherry-red color. On the nose, it offers a wide range of red fruit aromas such as strawberries, raspberries, cherries and plums. These are subtly complemented by delicate oak notes, with hints of toast, black pepper and nutmeg adding complexity. On the palate, it is smooth, pleasant and velvety, gently coating the mouth with a soft and rounded texture. A very versatile wine, perfect to enjoy with all kinds of meat dishes or even oily fish.
Product 3 Description: Clean and bright, with a deep garnet-red color and violet highlights. On the nose, it offers aromas of raisins along with spicy and toasted notes. On the palate, it is velvety, smooth and complex, with flavors of very ripe, jammy red fruit. The finish is long and persistent. Ideal as an aperitif with foie gras and blue cheeses, and perfect for dessert time, especially with intense chocolate-based desserts.
Product 4 Description: This wine shows a deep, intense color dominated by cherry tones. On the nose, it offers ripe red fruit aromas such as strawberries and plums, combined with hints of vanilla and toasted notes from its nine months in oak. On the palate, it is smooth and velvety, with soft tannins, good acidity and plenty of fruit. Overall, this wine stands out for its perfect balance between fruit and oak. Ideal with rice dishes, it pairs beautifully with red meats, game, roasts and aged cheeses.
Product 5 Description: A bright, straw-yellow wine with an expressive and vibrant nose, offering intense aromas of tropical fruit alongside subtle hints of fennel and fresh herbs. On the palate it is smooth, fresh and rounded, with a pleasant, lingering finish that highlights the character of the variety. Overall, it is a beautifully fresh and well-balanced wine that is easy to enjoy. Perfect with seafood and all kinds of fish, as well as pasta and rice dishes, and especially delicious with smoked foods.

Winery Description: BODEGAS SOLANA DE RAMÍREZ is a family winery based in Ábalos (Rioja Alta), that belongs to the DOCa Rioja. We are dedicated for several generations to the cultivation of vines and the production and ageing of its wines. At Solana de Ramírez Winery, we know that a good wine is born from the careful care of the vineyards. We cultivate 60 hectares of our own vineyards in Ábalos and San Vicente de la Sonsierra (Rioja Alta), located from north to south from the foot of the Sierra de Cantabria to the vicinity of the Ebro river. Our winery has an annual production of 500 thousand kilos of grapes (80% tempranillo and the 20 % of graciano, garnacha, viura, sauvignon-blanc, Malvasia, Verdejo and other varieties); The lands are clay - calcareus, influencing for the currents of Cantabrian and Mediterranean air, they make that this zone is very capable in orther to produce wines of excellent quality. For aging wines we have and independent cellar in the underground with 650 barrels of American, French and Navarro Oak.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street D, Stand 355

Winery Description: From the combination of nature, history, tradition and the know-how of generations, an alliance arose, a commitment to the land itself that defines and identifies us. As a result of this commitment, in 1961, as an example of coordination and collaboration of visionary men and expert winegrowers, who knew how to listen to the terroir and understand its needs, materialized a successful project: BODEGAS SONSIERRA, with the sole objective of producing the best wine with grapes from their own vines. In San Vicente de la Sonsierra, in the heart of Rioja Alta, is where the magic happens: the excellent soils of the area, the special microclimate characteristic of the Sonsierra, the age of our vines (which in most cases exceed 40 years) and a careful and demanding viticulture. All this forms the perfect union to be a privileged and very special area that favors the elegance of Tempranillo, the characteristic and exclusive variety of most of the Sonsierra and Viñedos de Sonsierra wines.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 277
Product 1 Description: El origen de nuestro Perfume de Sonsierra surge en 2009 como fruto de la colaboración del conocido diseñador de moda David Delfín con Bodegas Sonsierra, un “tándem rompedor”. La riqueza de las notas olfativas de este vino llevó a plantearlo como si de un perfume se tratase. De esta bonita historia surge un vino único de Rioja, muy especial, lleno de aromas y matices, que se presenta en una botella y un packaging muy innovador y elegante, evocando un perfume de alta costura. En conjunto Perfume de Sonsierra 2016 dispone de todos los factores para ser considerado un vino de Rioja excelente, lleno de fragancias, atractivo y enigmático desde su diseño hasta su último sorbo. Con el lanzamiento al mercado de esta nueva añada de Perfume de Sonsierra 2016 hemos querido rediseñar la caja para que, sin dejar de evocar a una caja de perfume sofisticado, el vino guardado en ella aparezca en escena y se convierta en protagonista, como si de un escenario se tratara.
Product 2 Name: Viñedos de Sonsierra - Viñedo de Altura
Product 2 Description: Se trata de una selección de viñedos viejos situados a más de 550 m de altitud, en las faldas de la Sierra de Cantabria, con la incidencia de un clima más atlántico. Esto propicia una maduración más lenta de las uvas lo que nos permite conseguir un vino más fresco, amable y rico en aromas. Un tempranillo puro y varietal. De atractivo color rojo picota con ribetes violáceos. Su nariz expresa fielmente el carácter varietal del tempranillo, mostrando un potente aroma a fruta roja madura tipo mora y fresa complementados con notas de regaliz negro. En boca es largo y fresco, con una acidez bien equilibrada con unos taninos sedosos que le confieren redondez y un largo final.
Product 3 Description: Hablamos de una finca plantada en vaso en 1950 que se encuentra situada a 435 metros de altitud en una pequeña ladera que termina en el río Ebro. Por su gran longevidad posee raíces fuertes y profundas que le ayudan a acumular reservas en sus gruesos troncos para una mejor brotación y crecimiento. El mayor esfuerzo de cada una de estas cepas maduras va dirigido a cada racimo originando uvas de reducido tamaño pero de color, aromas y sabor más profundo y complejo. De intenso color rojo rubí con reflejos granates profundos, limpio y brillante. En nariz podemos apreciar con alta intensidad la fruta negra fresca como la cereza negra y aromas balsámicos, con toques especiados de cacao y café. Su boca es larga e intensa con un tanino bien redondeado y pulido, dejando recuerdos de los aromas registrados en nariz.

Winery Description: Bodega Son Vich de Superna is the highest winery in Mallorca (Spanish Mediterranean island) located in the mountain Serra de Tramuntana, one of the 6 wine production areas in the world classified by UNESCO. We have 10 hectares of vineyards, 9 references of wine with PGI "Serra De Tramuntana - Costa Nord" and "Vi de la Terra Mallorca". At the same time, we have the recognition of "Viticoltura Eroica CERVIM" which recognizes mountain and island producers. The varieties worked are the following: Viognier, Mantonegro, Prensal Blanc, Ull de llebre, Gorgollasa, Cabernet sauvignon. Since 2004, Son Vich de Superna, in the heart of the Tramuntana, has been dedicated to making quality wines. Vineyards with a thick layer of natural vegetation, minimum tillage, reasoned agriculture, the use of the practice of sheep grazing to control weeds and fertilize the plots naturally. This is our way of conceiving viticulture and are also ancestral agricultural traditions of the Serra de Tramuntana.
Winery Location: CTRA PUIGPUNYENT-ESPORLES ., 07194, PUIGPUNYENT , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 709

Winery Description: Bodegas y Viñedos Tábula, founded in Olivares de Duero in 2002 by José Luis Muñoz, is located in the heart of the Ribera del Duero's Golden Mile. It was born with a commitment to producing high-quality, modern wines. With 74 hectares of vineyards in Olivares del Duero, Roa, Anguix, Olmedillo, and La Horra, the meticulous care given to Tábula wines begins in the terroir and continues in the winery. The grapes are hand-harvested in 15-kilo crates and transported in refrigerated containers. They are then hand-selected by bunch and berry on two tables, fermented and aged in wooden vats, and subjected to rigorous quality control in our state-of-the-art laboratory. The traditional fermentation methods give a unique character to the wines. Then follows the oak aging, and finally, the wine rests in the bottle to ensure optimal integration and smooth tannins. To sum up, the privileged location of the vineyards, plus the harvesting process, selection and elaboration are the DNA of our wines.

Product 2 Description: Varietal composition: 100% Tempranillo Type of soil: Loamy-calcareous and clay-calcareous. Yield: 3,500 kg/ha. (26hl/ha) Age of the vineyard: over 40 years.
