Winery Description: Bodegas Tarón is a historic cooperative in Rioja Alta, founded in 1964 by winegrowers from four villages – Cuzcurrita de Río Tirón, Sajazarra, Tirgo and Villaseca – united by the same way of understanding the vineyard and its environment, today synthesized in the concept of Territorio Tarón. We cultivate more than 600 hectares, many of them old vines and unique plots, in a privileged environment where the altitude, the soils and the Atlantic climate translate into wines of marked freshness and excellent acidity. Our philosophy combines tradition and a contemporary vision of Rioja: balanced ageing, respect for fruit, measured use of wood and a clear commitment to the identity of the origin. We produce a range that ranges from fresh and accessible wines to limited production and high expression references, recognized by national and international critics.
Winery Location: CTRA. MIRANDA S/N, 26211, TIRGO
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 271
Product 1 Description: Pantocrator is the iconic wine of Bodegas Tarón, made only in exceptional vintages from a careful selection of old vineyards in Rioja Alta, with low yields and manual harvest. The altitude and soils provide tension, freshness and a great capacity for aging. Its production takes place in several phases: after fermentation, the wine rests in stainless steel tanks, followed by a 24-month aging in new American oak barrels. It is then returned to the tank to refine its balance and culminates in a long ageing in the bottle. Pantocrator is released on the market no earlier than 10 years after the harvest, when it reaches its full harmony. The result is a deep and balanced wine, with great aromatic intensity, excellent acidity, fine tannins and a long bottle finish. Pantocrator has been chosen Best Rioja in the International Wine Challenge and has received 97 Decanter points, consolidating itself as the highest expression of the Tarón Territory
Product 2 Description: Territorio Tarón is the most direct expression of the origin and identity of Bodegas Tarón in Rioja Alta. It is born from an annual selection of plots located in the four historic villages of the cooperative – Cuzcurrita de Río Tirón, Sajazarra, Tirgo and Villaseca – choosing in each harvest those that best reflect the character of the vintage. Made from Tempranillo, it reflects the landscape and personality of the territory through respectful winemaking and balanced ageing that prioritises fruit. It is a fresh wine, with excellent acidity, fine structure and marked tension, which provides balance and capacity for evolution. Territorio Tarón is a contemporary, precise and honest Rioja, which connects tradition and modernity and summarises in each bottle the wine-growing legacy, the landscape and the identity of a unique territory.

Winery Description: Bodegas TEMPORE – We are a family-owned winery located in Lécera, in the heart of the Bajo Aragón region, with deep-rooted viticultural traditions and several generations devoted to grape growing. Our project is guided by a philosophy of respect for the land and passion for wine, based on organic agriculture and minimal intervention, both in the vineyard and in the winery. The main grape varieties featured in most of our wines are Garnacha and Tempranillo, through which we faithfully express the character of our territory. Tradition, innovation, and sustainability are part of our DNA, with a clear commitment to organic wines and wines with no added sulphites, as well as to unique projects focused on the recovery of indigenous grape varieties from the area. Our mission is to craft wines with strong personality and a deep commitment to the environment. One family, four generations, and a new concept of wine.
Winery Location: CARRETERA ZARAGOZA S/N, 50131, LECERA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 373

Winery Description: At Bodegas Tierra, our only passion is the vineyard, which is why in each wine we seek differentiation by its type of soil, grape variety and orientation. We are the third generation of winegrowers with great roots in the land, which currently has 35 hectares, all of them in Labastida. The richness of our wines lies in our vineyards and the variety of soils. We preserve clay-calcareous soils in the southern area and more calcareous soils in the northern area; Each plot maintains its character, creating unique wines that faithfully reflect this land. All our work in the field is ecological with brushstrokes of biodynamics since 2000. Our work in the winery is based on respect for the identity of the grapes that come from each plot. We work with different types of barrels, as well as tanks such as concrete, porcelain and marble eggs. Each bottle reflects tradition and innovation. But always prioritizing the purity of our vineyards.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 215
Product 1 Description: Tempranillo Vineyards: Las Torcas, Grieldas, La Hueta, La Rueda, Iscorta, Las Toreras, La Tejera, Laguilera, Los Caños, Latuzarra We harvest 10 vineyards located in both the north and south of Labastida and all of them over 40 years old. Clay-calcareous soils. A selection of bunches is made manually. We destemmed when we arrived in the winery. Alcoholic fermentation in small stainless steel tanks at a controlled temperature, with spontaneous fermentation and minimal intervention. Malolactic 50% in concrete tanks and 50% in French oak barrels. Aged for 14 months in 225L French oak barrels, of which 25% new and 75% second wine and a minimum of 6 months in the bottle. TASTING NOTES Garnet pillory. Of remarkable intensity, aromas of blueberries, blackberries, cocoa, red caramel. Well structured, balanced, pleasant sensation of raspberries, cherries, cinnamon and roasted coffee. All integrated with a long finish. Recommended for fatty fish and red meat.
Product 2 Description: Singular Vineyard Pago Cuba Negra, a plot planted in 1910, sandy soil with very little depth, and a lot of rock, facing south, this makes this one of the most peculiar plots in Labastida and one of the oldest in Rioja. The grapes are selected and picked manually in 14kg boxes. Alcoholic fermentation in French oak vats, malolactic fermentation and aging in new 600L French oak barrels for 24 months. TASTING NOTES Garnet cherry well covered. Intense and aromatic nose with hints of ripe cherries, dried black plum, black pepper and mycological notes. Very fresh, tasty, fruity, sensations of black and red fruit, sandalwood, aromatic herbs, chocolates, menthols, pastry tips and roasted coffee beans. Recommended for big game, red meats and chocolates.
Product 3 Description: 45% Viura, 45% Malvasia 10% Moscatel and Palomino Vineyard: Sauro planted in 1920.Clay soil, in the foothills of the Sierra de Toloño, specifically in the Barranco del Oso. With an exclusive orientation to the morning sun. Selection in the field and harvested in 14kg boxes, destemmed and pressed. It ferments in 500L foudre new French oak 50% barrel from the second Central European oak wine and ages for 12 months on its lees, looking for the structure and complexity that these soils give us. TASTING NOTES Visually we find yellows with dandelions, with Egyptian gold backgrounds. Aromatically we can easily move to the aromatic plants of the Sierra de Cantabria with a subtle aroma of muscatel, with a fresh background that invites us to drink, its entry into the mouth is velvety, marking the acidity of its calcareous soils and with a freshness that makes it extremely long. Recommended for fish, pasta and Asian meals.
Product 4 Description: Blanco Criado en Barrica Malvasía Viñedo: Pago Cuba Negra Vendimia a mano en cajas de 14kg procedentes de nuestro histórico viñedo Pago Cuba Negra en la zona sur, plantado en 1910. Autentica Malvasía de rioja, de perfil muy diferente al resto de malvasías, suelo arenoso calcáreo con muy poca profundidad y mucha presencia de roca. Despalillado y maceración de apenas 8 horas, posterior prensado. Fermentación en barrica de 500l de roble francés nueva y criado en la misma barrica sobre lías durante doce meses. NOTA DE CATA Brillante paja dorado. Aromática e intensa en vía nasal, se marcan notas ahumadas, lácteas, mentoladas, florales, laurel, miel y toques minerales. Sabroso, envolvente, fresco, equilibrado, recuerdos de membrillo, melocotón, ciruelas amarillas, cítricos, mentoles, nuez moscada y pan tostado. Largo final sápido y toques salados. Recomendado para huerta de invierno y mariscos. TEMPERATURA DE SERVICIO 13º C
Product 5 Description: TIERRA BLANCO Fermented in barrels 70% Viura, 20% Malvasia, 10% White Grenache Anda Verde, Las Torcas, Grieldas and Saúco Alc. 13.5% vol. After a careful selection, only the vines chosen from different vineyards in both the south (Mediterranean climate) and the north (Atlantic climate) of Labastida are harvested. Soils mostly calcareous. It is destemmed and macerated at a low temperature for 8 hours, for subsequent pressing and then fermentation begins in 2,500L foudres and 225L barrels of French oak 75% second use and 25% new. The aging lasts 5 months on lees in these same barrels. TASTING NOTES Pale yellow. Medium intensity, light aromas of citrus, smoke, butter, white fruit and yellow plum. Tasty, fresh, balanced, sensations of apricot, vine peach and menthols. Recommended for fish and white meats, pasta and seafood. SERVING TEMPERATURE 12º C

Winery Description: Tobelosis an independet family winery at the heart of Rioja Alta, located in Briñas – a small village in the heart of Rioja Alta- where we also have our vineyards, together with some vineyards in Rioja Alavesa. We are focused on the production and ageing of high-quality wines, with a small annual production of 200,000 bottles. All the grapes are manually harvested, in 13-kilo crates and hand sorted at the winery. We elaborate wines from small plots of 40 to 100 years old bush vines located at the foot of the Sierra Cantabria Mountain and higher course of the Ebro River where we find clayey calcareous soils on terraces that shapes the personality of our genuine wines. Our Philosophy and work are based on Respect:: respect for our present, nature, landscape, understanding our vineyards as a small part of a whole in which they must be inserted harmoniously, taking care of them with a traditional and respectful viticulture. Respect for our future, building a wine heritage with its own recognizable identity that is inserted in the diversity of Rioja. Tobelos brings together all the ingredients necessary for creating wines of extremely high quality and classified origin.

Winery Description: Bodegas-Hotel Traslascuestas, part of Grupo Piérola, embodies our family’s winemaking legacy and spirit of innovation. Founded in 2009 in Valcabado de Roa (Burgos) at 900m altitude, among the highest wineries in Ribera del Duero, it crafts elegant wines from hand-selected Tempranillo grapes. Traslascuestas produces four wines: Roble, Crianza, Valcavado, and a special Rosado. The modern cube-shaped estate features a 10-room boutique hotel, museum, spa, gym, and restaurant, blending wine, hospitality, and culture. In 2014, an 18th-century lagar was restored to honor traditional winemaking. Powered entirely by geothermal energy, it reflects our strong commitment to sustainability. Carlos Bujanda, 4th generation of the family, also leads two wineries in Rioja and one in Rueda, offering a broader, diverse portfolio. We build close, hands-on partnerships, supporting clients through training, events, and dinners, and welcoming them annually to Spain for Grupo Piérola enotourism experiences.
Winery Location: CALLE PEDROSA A MAMBRILLA S/N, 09314, PEDROSA DE DUERO
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 122
Product 1 Description: Traslascuestas Crianza is made from 100% Tempranillo grapes sourced from 35-year-old vines with low yields (≤4,500 kg/ha). Hand-harvested in small 15 kg boxes, only the best clusters are selected. After a cold maceration (8 °C, 4 days) to enhance aromas, the wine ferments with native yeasts for about 10 days, followed by 15 days of additional maceration to build structure and balance. It undergoes malolactic fermentation on lees and ages 16 months in new French (90%) and American oak barrels. Deep cherry-red with purple hues, it offers aromas of strawberry, blackberry, fig, vanilla, coffee, leather, and cocoa, showing excellent harmony and finesse. On the palate, it is powerful, elegant, and well-balanced, with silky tannins, a smooth texture, and a long, lingering finish. Best served at 16–18 °C, it represents the depth and elegance of Ribera del Duero.
Product 2 Description: Traslascuestas Rosé Barrel Fermented is crafted from 100% Tempranillo grapes sourced from 20-year-old vines with low yields (≤4,500 kg/ha). After 24 hours of cold maceration with the must, it is gently pressed and transferred to new French oak barrels with a light and deep toast, adding complexity without overpowering the fruit. Fermentation takes place in barrel for 21 days, followed by regular lees stirring every two days for texture and depth. After 45 days, barrels are cooled to preserve freshness and prevent excessive oak influence. The result is a vibrant pink wine with violet hues, offering expressive aromas of red and tart fruits, toffee, and smoky notes, layered with buttery and candy nuances. On the palate, it is round, fruity, and toasty, with fresh acidity, creamy balance, and a long mineral finish. Serve at 10–12 °C.
Product 3 Description: Valcavado de Traslascuestas is made from 100% Tempranillo grapes sourced from 60-year-old vines with very low yields (≤1,500 kg/ha) across four small southwest-oriented plots with calcareous-clay soils. Hand-harvested in 15 kg boxes, only the finest clusters are selected. After a cold maceration (8 °C, 4 days) to enhance aromas, fermentation takes place with native yeasts for about 10 days, followed by 15 days of post-fermentation maceration for balance and volume. The wine completes malolactic fermentation on lees and ages 30 months in new French oak barrels (225–500 L). Deep intense cherry-red with a dense tear, it offers a complex, leafy nose with ripe fruit, spices, menthol, liquorice, and balsamic notes. On the palate, it shows silky yet powerful tannins, remarkable elegance, and the mineral expression of its Ribera del Duero terroir.

Winery Description: Bodegas Trenza is built on the union of talent, experience, and a deep passion for wine. Founded by winemaker David Tofterup and strengthened alongside Jonas Tofterup MW and the creative vision of Jennifer Powell, Trenza embraces a rule-free philosophy where creativity and respect for the vineyard guide every wine. Inspired by the concept of a braid, the strength created by interweaving different elements, Trenza wines combine iconic Spanish grape varieties to craft wines with distinctive personality, complexity, and balance. Sourced from dry-farmed vineyards, with over 90% organically grown grapes, Trenza wines authentically express terroir, sustainability, and artisanal excellence, earning international recognition and offering a compelling choice for quality-driven wine lovers.

Winery Description: Bodegas Valdecontina was born in El Bierzo as a project deeply linked to its territory. We work exclusively with our own vineyards and those of small local winegrowers, respecting the identity of each plot and the natural expression of varieties such as Mencía and Godello. Our philosophy is based on conscious viticulture, with minimal intervention, where time, landscape and inherited knowledge set the pace. Each wine is the result of honest work in the vineyard and precise production in the winery, without make-up, seeking balance, freshness and authenticity. Valdecontina is Bierzo in its purest form: soils, climate and tradition reinterpreted with a contemporary look, to offer wines with character, elegance and a clear sense of origin.

Winery Description: At Bodegas Valdelana, for 14 generations, family has been the essence of our wines, making them the oldest family winery in Rioja, which began its history in 1583. The passion for winemaking has been passed down from father to son. Juan Jesús Valdelana, the current owner, is the thirteenth generation, always committed to preserving this family legacy with an emphasis on viticulture, together with his two children Judit and Juan Valdelana, who are fully dedicated to research into the production of different wines, thus creating a new wine-making concept in Rioja Alavesa. The winery, located in the historic site of Elciego where six main roads of the D.O. ca Rioja converge, has been awarded for the fourth time with the prestigious international BEST OF awards as the best winery in the category of Art and Culture. It is built on six underground ashlar stone cellars dating from the 15th and 16th centuries. They house our Ethnographic Museum, which contains the remains of all the cultures and civilisations that have preceded us and that have inhabited Rioja Alavesa.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 237
Product 1 Description: Crafted from old vineyards over 70 years of age, Agnvs Crianza is a tribute to depth, time and heritage. It begins with a manual selection from the family’s oldest vines, where Tempranillo reveals its soul and Graciano adds tension and mystery. On the nose, it offers aromas of dark fruit, balsamic notes and gentle spices reminiscent of the cold winters of Rioja Alavesa. The palate is sober, powerful and enveloping, with elegant tannins and a long, warm finish that lingers beautifully. Aged in French and Russian oak, this wine captures the spirit of vineyards that have spent more than seven decades watching the sky. A Crianza with character, emotion and the profound expression that only old vines can tell.
Product 2 Description: Made in Rioja Alavesa with the soul of Tempranillo and the deep character of the barrel, this Crianza is a warm embrace of our land. On the nose it displays notes of ripe red fruits, soft vanilla and an echo of sweet spices reminiscent of quiet afternoons in the cellar. On the palate it is round, silky and balanced, with a pleasant structure and a persistent finish that conveys serenity. Each bottle keeps the history of the Valdelana family, who since 1583 have worked these vineyards with passion and respect, generation after generation An honest and elegant wine, which combines tradition and sensitivity, created for those who know how to appreciate the time, patience and emotion that only a good crianza can transmit.
Product 3 Description: Born from the family's oldest and most beloved vineyards, planted between 1920 and 1940 in Elciego, Navaridas and Laguardia, JVV Tinto is the most intimate expression of our land. These old vines grow on soils of grey limestone and Tertiary rocks, sandstones and loamy clays that mark the character of each grape and give the wine a deep and unique identity. Made by carbonic maceration, following the grandfather's teaching, this wine displays vibrant aromas of black cherry, violet, crushed pepper and toasted almonds. On the palate it is broad, silky and enveloping, with a long and elegant finish that gradually opens up to notes of rosemary and lavender. Each bottle is a numbered edition, a small treasure that collects effort, emotion and the soul of vineyards that have been telling their story for more than a century.

Product 2 Description: La variedad de la uva empleada para este vino, proviene de nuestros viñedos controlados en Morales de Toro. Cultivar la uva en esta localidad nos permite explotar todo el potencial que le otorga una climatología tan característica. La uva de este vino se vendimia a mano, solo cuando la uva llega a su punto óptimo de maduración. Ya en bodega, tras un suave estrujado, se pasa a depósito para realizar una maceración en frío que durará de 4 a 7 días, para extraer el máximo potencial aromático. Posteriormente arrancaremos la fermentación, que re realizará de forma espontánea a partir de levaduras naturalmente presentes en la uva. En esta fermentación controlamos la temperatura para que se encuentre entre 24 y 27ºC, donde trabajaremos las pieles realizando remontadas frecuentes. Tras esta etapa, el vino se pasa a barricas de roble francés y húngaro, donde se domará durante 6 meses. Por último, clarificamos y estabilizamos mediante frío para su posterior embotellado
Product 3 Description: The grape variety used for this wine, it comes from our controlled vineyards in Morales de Toro. The grapes for this wine are harvested by hand, only when the grapes reach their optimum point of maturation. Once in the cellar, after a gentle crushing, it is transferred to a tank to carry out a maceration cold that will last from 4 to 7 days, to extract the maximum aromatic potential. Tasting Notes: A remarkable mineral wine, it expresses the character of our limestone lands and fine herbs and notes of white fruits. On the palate, it is fresh and well balanced. The crianza in clay vats add a great roundness and complexity. Pale lemon yellow with golden reflections. On the nose it is complex, hints of white fruit (apple), ripe banana, subtle aromatic herbs (chamomile), an earthy background and citric character(grapefruit - blo
Product 3 Description: Grapes: Cencibel (Tempranillo) Pairing: To drink alone or accompanied by meats, fish soups and spoon stews. Tasting Notes: Young cherry red, fruity on the nose, strawberry, ripe plum, leaves, scrubland and strawberry marmelade. It is balsamic. On the palate it is structured, fleshy, ripe fruits, balsamic carácter, sweet and round tannins. Elaboration: Fermentation at 24 ºC, destemmed grapes in 10000 L inox stainless Steel vats . Mixed crianza: 3 months in second use French oak barrels and 5 months in claty amphoras. Rest in bottle: 12 months minimum. Harvest: Selection of old vineyards of Cencibel (Tempranillo) at their optimum moment of maturation Calcareous solis, 640 m. above sea level.

Winery Description: The altitude and organic work define the character of Bodegas Vetusta. Our vineyards, located between 900 and more than 1,000 metres above sea level, are among the highest in the Ribera del Duero and are certified organic, which brings freshness, balance and personality to our wines. We are a family winery with more than 20 years of experience in vine cultivation, located in Aranda de Duero, in the heart of the appellation. We seek to bring the best of our land to each bottle, with pride, honesty and a deep respect for nature and terroir. We have 40 hectares of organic Tempranillo vineyards, spread over the municipalities of Moradillo, Fuentenebro, Honrubia de la Cuesta and Santa Cruz de la Salceda, in the highest area of the south of the Ribera del Duero, a reflection of our vocation to create wines with their own identity.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street A, Stand 188
Product 1 Description: El Tallar is a single-vineyard wine that faithfully expresses the character of one of our most unique vineyards, located at an altitude of 1,012 metres in Honrubia de la Cuesta, at the highest point of the Ribera del Duero. An organic vineyard worked with minimal interventionism, where Tempranillo is complemented by a small percentage of Cabernet Sauvignon that provides complexity and structure. The extreme altitude and poor soils mark the profile of the wine, with a natural freshness, tension and elegance unusual in the appellation. Fermentation is carried out in open vats, seeking a gentle and precise extraction. Malolactic fermentation and ageing, for about 15 months in 400-litre French oak barrels, respect the identity of the fruit and the terroir as much as possible. El Tallar is a deep, serious and balanced wine, with ageing capacity, fine tannins and an acidity that surprises. A single-vineyard wine designed for those looking for authenticity, origin and emotion
Product 2 Description: VETUSTA VIÑAS DE FUENTENEBRO An organic Ribera del Duero that surprises with its freshness, minerality and elegance. Made with grapes from our vineyards in Fuentenebro, one of the most renowned areas of the denomination for the uniqueness of its soils and its authentic character. We harvest early, looking for a fresher and less ripe red fruit, to achieve an agile, fine and very pleasant to drink wine, with a natural acidity that invites you to repeat. In the winery, we age the wine separately in stainless steel, concrete and wood, and we carry out a final blend that provides balance, complexity and its own personality. International recognitions • Gold, Concours Mondial de Bruxelles 2021 • Silver, Berliner Wine Trophy 2021 • 90 points, Tim Atkin MW 2024
Product 3 Description: VETUSTA ALBILLO MAYOR is an exclusive and gastronomic white wine made 100% with the Albillo Mayor grape, the native white variety of the Ribera del Duero that at Vetusta we have recovered and enhanced to create a unique wine. It is a very limited production obtained from old vineyards in Albillo Mayor, a grape with a low yield and little presence, which makes this wine especially unique and different. ￼ Vinification is carried out with great delicacy, fermenting and aging the wine in large-format barrels on lees to preserve its freshness, complexity and texture, resulting in a high-quality white with aromas of white fruits, flowers and subtle notes provided by the wood, and a balanced, round and persistent mouthfeel. ￼ Vetusta Albillo Mayor is an oenological jewel of the Ribera del Duero, ideal to accompany seafood, fish and Mediterranean cuisine, and a unique expression of the potential of whites in a region dominated by reds.
Product 4 Description: Our first single-vineyard wine, our Grand Cru, made exclusively with grapes from a single vineyard: Carrascalón Alto, located at an altitude of 1,000 metres. An exceptional vineyard with a very unique red clay soil, which is reflected in the wine with a marked identity and unique elegance. Carrascalón Alto stands out for its aromatic complexity, its finesse in the mouth and a vibrant acidity, typical of the stony and mineral soils of the plot. A deep wine, with tension, structure and great ageing potential. Barrel aging for approximately 15 months is carried out with the utmost respect for the fruit, seeking balance and pure expression of the terroir. International recognitions • Bronze, Decanter 2021 • Gold, Berlin Wine Trophy 2023 • 96 points, Verema DNA Guide 2025
Product 5 Description: OLD YEAR In the 90s we planted our organic vineyards in the highest areas of the Ribera del Duero with a clear idea: to create an authentic terroir wine that would speak of our land without artifice. This is how Vetusta was born, our most emblematic wine, made with high-altitude Tempranillo, the result of family effort, respect for the vineyard and honest viticulture. A wine with character, depth and elegance, where ripe black fruit is combined with a well-integrated ageing and a natural freshness that makes it balanced and with great ageing potential. International recognitions • Gold, Berliner Wine Trophy 2020 • Silver, Decanter 2021 • 90 pts Tim Atkin (Ribera Special Report 2021) • 91 pts Decanter 2025 • 92 pts Verema 2026 Ferrán Centelles (Jancis Robinson, 2021): black fruit, blackberries and plums, vanilla and toasted notes, sweet tannins and good acidity.

Winery Description: Bodegas Vibe is a family winery that, succeeding a previous entity, has started a new project making wines which represent the tradition and the love of the land. We are situated within the boundaries of the town of Requena, in the hamlet of El Azagador, and forms part of D.O. Utiel-Requena. In our effort to give value to the potential of these lands we have opted decisively for typical local varieties such as Bobal in red and rosé wines and Tardana in white wines. The location of our vineyards is rich in clay and together with its geographical situation, at 700m above sea level and between the plateau and the Mediterranean sea provide them perfect conditions for the production of well structured wines with a marked character that is an expression of the soils, climate and the variety coupled with careful elaboration.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 457
Product 1 Description: Tardana 100%. Variety native to the area. It is a variety with a very late cycle of maturity being the last variety that is harvested in our region, from which it takes its name (“tarde” means late). Vintage selected with grapes of optimum maturity that are destemmed and crushed, following a prefermentation maceration at low temperature and subsequent fermentation with temperature control to get the maximum extraction of the aromatic elements.Very balanced with a medium finish.

Winery Description: Authentic Wines from the heart of Spain. If you want to see unique wines from winegrowers with history, visit us. We have always been in La Seca, province of Valladolid. We have never left, and the tradition and know-how has been passed down from generation to generation. They have taught us respect and love for everything that is ours and that philosophy of life is what we count on and live every day If you dare to meet us, come to our little corner and we will surprise you.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 141
Product 1 Description: Authentic wines from the heart. If you want to taste unique wines from winegrowers with history, visit us. We have three Verdejos from three different soils: Pagos de Villavendimia Finca Buena Vista sandy soil, Finca Matea clayey soil and Finca el Alto calcareous soil. There are traditional elaborations and red grape elaborations.

Winery Description: In the 60s, a young man from Castrelo de Miño named Obdulio Villanueva Blanco, decided to undertake a winemaking tradition that continues to this day. Protected by the good reviews he received about his wine, in September 1961 he decided to start marketing it among his neighbors and relatives. With the experience acquired and the incipient push of the Denominations of Origin (D.O.), in 1975 the first commercial brand with D.O. Ribeiro was launched on the market: Viña Senra. On December 25, 1988, Carlos Villanueva Senra (son of Obdulio Villanueva) established Bodegas Villanueva Senra (D.O. Ribeiro). During the 90s, the company continued to grow. In 1995 the Villanueva family acquired a pazo at the entrance to Salvaterra de Miño, Pazo As Barreiras. In December 1998 the winery was established, within the D.O. Rías Baixas. Currently, Grupo Bodegas Villanueva is present in 4 Denominations of Origin: Rias Baixas, Ribeiro, Rioja and Ribera del Duero.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 369
Product 1 Description: Carlos Villanueva - D.O. Ribeiro. Elaborado a partir del coupage de las variedades Treixadura y Albariño, dos de las castas preferentes del Ribeiro, que aportan estructura, cuerpo y una acidez equilibrada, dando como resultado un vino de marcada personalidad. Las uvas proceden de viñedos de suelo arcilloso situados en los márgenes del río Miño, a su paso por Castrelo de Miño, un entorno privilegiado que favorece la maduración óptima del fruto. La vendimia se realiza de forma manual, seguida de un despalillado parcial y un prensado suave a bajas presiones. El vino se elabora sobre lías, con un reposo de tres meses en depósito, y completa su afinamiento con un mes en botella antes de su salida al mercado. No se realiza fermentación maloláctica, preservando así la frescura y expresión varietal del vino.
Product 2 Description: Carlos Villanueva Edición Especial - D.O. Ribeiro Elaborado a partir de una minuciosa selección de uvas procedentes de nuestros mejores viñedos, asentados sobre suelos arcillosos en los márgenes de los ríos Miño y Avia. La vendimia y selección se realizan de forma manual, eligiendo únicamente uvas con las mejores propiedades organolépticas. Posteriormente se lleva a cabo un despalillado parcial y un prensado suave a baja presión, respetando al máximo la calidad del fruto. El vino se elabora sobre lías, con un reposo de seis meses en fudre y cuatro meses en depósitos de acero inoxidable, aportando complejidad, volumen y elegancia. Finalmente, se somete a un periodo de guarda en botella, donde completa su afinamiento y alcanza su máxima expresión.
Product 3 Description: Carlos Villanueva Godello-Treixadura D.O. Ribeiro. La vendimia se realiza de forma manual, con despalillado total y prensado suave a bajas presiones. El proceso de vinificación se inicia con gran inmediatez tras la recolección, con el fin de conservar al máximo la intensidad y frescura aromática. La fermentación se lleva a cabo respetando el carácter varietal del vino y no se realiza fermentación maloláctica, preservando así su frescura natural. Una vez finalizada la fermentación, el vino reposa tres meses en depósito y un mes en botella antes de su comercialización, alcanzando un equilibrio óptimo.
Product 4 Name: PAZO AS BARREIRAS RIAS BAIXAS ED. ESPECIAL
Product 4 Description: Pazo As Barreiras Edición Especial - Albariño D.O. Rias Baixas Elaborado a partir de una minuciosa selección de uva Albariño procedente de los viñedos centenarios de nuestra finca As Barreiras. El vino se cría sobre lías durante seis meses en fudre y cuatro meses en depósito de acero inoxidable, un proceso que le confiere una personalidad única: menor astringencia, mayor complejidad aromática, notable persistencia y una textura más untuosa. Posteriormente, completa su afinamiento mediante una crianza en botella, alcanzando así su plena expresión.
Product 5 Description: Villanueva Albariño D.O. Rias Baixas. Elaborado a partir de uva Albariño seleccionada procedente de nuestros viñedos situados en la zona del Condado do Tea, caracterizados por alcanzar un óptimo punto de maduración y una acidez moderada.La vendimia se realiza de forma manual, seguida de un despalillado parcial y prensado suave a bajas presiones, con el fin de preservar al máximo la calidad aromática de la uva.Tras un desfangado estático, la fermentación alcohólica tiene lugar en depósitos de acero inoxidable a una temperatura controlada de 17 ºC durante 15 días. No se realiza fermentación maloláctica, conservando así la frescura y expresión varietal del vino.Finalizada la fermentación, el vino reposa tres meses en depósito y un mes en botella antes de su comercialización, alcanzando un perfecto equilibrio y expresión aromática.

Winery Description: Bodegas Viña Elena focuses on producing terroir-driven wines with the variety Monastrell. Wines with character and personality that represent our origin. We are located in the northeast of Murcia, in the region of Jumilla, the original bodega was founded by Grandpa Francisco Pacheco in 1948. Francisco began by making wine in a modest homebased wine press that was later inherited by Paco Pacheco, father to the Pacheco sisters. Paco subsequently expanded the enterprise that is currently in the hands of the third and fourth generations of the Pacheco Family. This young team continue to run their wine business with the passion of their forebears, combining tradition with innovation to highlight the knowledge they have gained from their ancestors while contributing their own pioneering, contemporary knowledge about the winemaking process. "Following tradition, while looking to the future" This heading represents our whole philosophy: constantly moving towards the future, always innovating, while valuing the family legacy, tradition, and hereditary know-how.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 533
Product 1 Description: Medium intensity, ruby color. Fragant nose dominated by red berries, spices, and subtle chalky notes. Elegant and fruit-driven, this medium-bodied Monastrell is beautifully balanced, offering a graceful flow across the palate. It reveals remarkable finesse and complexity, with delicate layers and a refined chalky texture that speaks of its origin. Malolactic fermentation and ageing has taken place in concrete tank. Ageing time: 7 months.
Product 2 Description: Medium intensity, ruby color. Delicate nose, notes of fresh red berries and slightly mineral hints. It is a more mature vintage than previous one. We have a fruit-drive, medium-bodied, balanced wine with its characteristic chalky finish. Malolactic fermentation in concrete vat and ageing in concrete during 7 months.
Product 3 Description: Medium ruby in colour. Clean and expressive on the nose, with notes of fresh red berries, a light touch of balsamic and a hint of chalk. An easy-drinking, fruit-driven, well-balanced wine. Good example of an unoaked Monastrell.

Winery Description: Otxaran – Bodegas Virgen de Lorea, on the southern slopes of the Otxaran mountains, crafts Atlantic-style txakoli using DO Bizkaiko Txakolina varieties: Hondarrabi Zuri, Hondarrabi Zerratia, Sauvignon Blanc and Hondarrabi Beltza. All our wines undergo lees ageing, ferment in stainless steel, and our premium wine includes French oak work for added complexity. We produce five wines: Aretxaga, our freshest expression; Señorío de Otxaran, the classic txakoli aged for months on lees; Lainoa, a mist-inspired txakoli with an enveloping character; Lore Rosé, elegant and subtle with delicate Beltza lees work; and OTX, a high-altitude Zerratia monovarietal that represents “a return to origin.” Each wine reflects the essence of Otxaran: freshness, balance, and the unique character of these historic Encartaciones slopes.
Winery Location: BARRIO LA FLOR S/N, 48869, OTXARAN-ZALLA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 159

Native varieties Tempranillo, Tinta de Toro, Verdejo and Prieto Picudo. Gold Medal at Concours Mondial de Bruxelles 2025 TROPHY FOR THE BEST RED WINE OF THE OLD WORLD AT JAPAN WINE CHALLENGUE 2024 MUNDUS VINI GOLD MEDAL BRONZE MEDAL IN DECANTER 92 POINTS FROM TIM ATKIN.

Winery Description: Bodegas Viuda de Manjón is a family-owned winery from the Sherry Triangle (Marco de Jerez) focused on crafting wines that express the identity and character of this unique region. We work mainly with Palomino and Pedro Ximénez grapes, producing Sherry Wines, Manzanilla and still white wines (Vinos de Pasto) through traditional biological and oxidative aging methods, combined with a contemporary winemaking approach. Our philosophy brings together respect for tradition, small-scale production and a strong gastronomic focus, connecting Jerez wines with new audiences in both domestic and international markets.
Winery Location: CA-3103, KM 7, 11400, JEREZ DE LA FRONTERA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 575
Product 1 Description: Amontillado Leona wine ( Leaena - Viuda de Manjón) is a very special wine, as it combines aging under a layer of flor (8 years), typical of Fino and Manzanilla wines, with a subsequent period in which the flor disappears and the wine is exposed to oxidation (12 years). Made from Palomino grapes, this fusion of aging processes (20 years of aging in casks) makes Amontillado Leona an extraordinarily complex and interesting wine. DO Jerez-Xérèz-Sherry. Viuda de Manjón Winery.
Product 2 Description: Cream Leona(also known as Leaena) is a sweet blended wine, obtained from a selection of oxidative aged oloroso wines, sweetened with Pedro Ximénez wines. The grapes for these wines, of the Palomino Fino and Pedro Ximénez varieties, come from vineyards located in two of the most prestigious vineyards in the Marco de Jerez, the Balbaina and Miraflores vineyards. DO Jerez-Xérèz-Sherry. Viuda de Manjón Winery.
Product 3 Description: Fino Leona (Leaena - Widow of Manjón) is a fortified wine with a soft straw yellow color and a dry, fresh, and delicate flavor. It is made from Palomino Fino grapes and aged for an average of five years in century-old barrels. It is aged in Jerez de la Frontera under a layer of yeast called velo de flor. This wine flower is composed of unique yeasts that, over centuries and as a result of a natural selection process, survive thanks to the oxygen and compounds contained in the wine. DO Sherry-Xérèz-Sherry Viuda de Manjón Winery
Product 4 Description: This white wine is produced in Jerez de la Frontera, from a carefully selected selection of Palomino grapes grown in our own vineyard located in the Pago de Espartinas, one of the historic vineyard areas of the Sherry region, defined by its distinctive albariza soils. The combination of this unique soil, the Atlantic influence and a precise harvest results in a wine that clearly expresses the character of the vineyard and the identity of its origin. A still white wine from Jerez (Vino de Pasto) that showcases Palomino through a fresh, elegant and contemporary interpretation.
Product 5 Description: Manzanilla Leona (also known as Leaena) is a generous wine with a soft straw yellow color and a dry, fresh and delicate flavor. The wine is made from 100% Palomino fino grapes and aged for an average of 8 years in 150-year-old American oak casks. Its aging, which takes place under a layer of yeasts called velo de flor, is carried out exclusively in Sanlúcar de Barrameda (Cádiz), and more specifically, in a winery located just a few meters from the mouth of the Guadalquivir River. The special climatic conditions of the city favor the development of a veil of flor that is unique in the world. As a result, the wine acquires unique and differentiating characteristics. DO Manzanilla - Sanlúcar de Barrameda. Viuda de Manjón Winery.

Winery Description: In 2004, the VIVANCO FAMILY decided to make the dream of a lifetime of enthusiasm and dedication come true in Briones, La Rioja: to share with the world their passion for the Culture of Wine. With humble origins from the vineyard, wine has been the lifeblood of the family for four generations and 100 years of work and commitment. With a pioneering spirit and boundless enthusiasm, it was time to share this vocation by giving back to wine everything that wine had given them. A WINERY where wine is understood from a demanding, dynamic and current vision. A contemporary oenological project with different and unique wines, from the family's vineyards. The authentic expression of a land full of curiosities. Vivanco is much more than Culture. A FOUNDATION where the past and the present become one. A journey through knowledge and history, with a unique Museum where the essence of wine is discovered from experience, sensitivity and innovation.
Winery Location: CTRA. NACIONAL 232 KM 442, 26330, BRIONES
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 305

Winery Description: We are a family of winegrowers and winemakers. In the 80s my grandfather, José Manuel Vizcarra, was a pioneer in planting vineyards when very few people were still committed to this area. My father, Juan Carlos Vizcarra, followed in my grandfather's footsteps and began making wines in a garage. In 2007 we were able to finish the new winery and we vinified it for the first time. Our philosophy is based on RESPECT. For this reason, all our vineyards are certified as ORGANIC and the winery is designed to produce by gravity, minimizing the use of pumps as much as possible. Today, I, Celia Vizcarra, am also a winemaker and I am fully incorporated into the family winery, assuming with passion and responsibility the legacy of my father and grandfather. Our wines try to reflect each vineyard, each landscape. We put a lot of effort year after year into interpreting what each vineyard is giving us. We continue to focus on the search for fruit and balance in our wines
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 186

Winery Description: Bodegas Volver was founded in 2004 by winemaker Rafael Cañizares, the fourth generation of a family dedicated to viticulture. Our project focuses on recovering old indigenous vineyards and elevating the reputation of quality Spanish wines. We practice sustainable, minimal-intervention viticulture, cultivating vines between 30 and 90 years old with the utmost respect for the land. This philosophy allows us to create wines that authentically reflect the terroir of each unique plot. In 2024, Rafael launched the new project Rafael Cañizares Viticultor, where his daughter Sofía—representing the fifth generation—also crafts her own wines, continuing the family legacy with a fresh and contemporary vision. We produce wines under the appellations of La Mancha, Alicante, Valencia, Jumilla, and Almansa, and hold IFS, Vegan, Organic, and Winery for Climate Protection certifications, underscoring our strong commitment to environmental preservation.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 106
Product 1 Description: Volver – Finca Los Juncares | D.O. La Mancha | 100% Tempranillo From a single vineyard planted in 1957 at over 2,100 ft in La Mancha, with poor soils and extreme continental climate. Dry-farmed, minimal-intervention viticulture with hand-harvested grapes. Fermented with indigenous yeasts and aged 14 months in French oak, unfiltered. Deep purple color, aromas of tobacco, licorice, and black fruit, full-bodied, elegant, balanced, with a long, persistent finish.

Winery Description: Bodegas Xaló is like the roots of the vines themselves, our passion for the vineyard sinks in the earth and in time. Our distinguished and careful production achieved with the combination of artisan experience, and the most advanced technical means, makes the Cooperativa Valenciana Virgen Pobre de Xaló high quality wines and spirits.

Muscatel of Alexandria has ripened on the vine and in the sun throughout the summer, the grapes are traditionally selected to produce one of the best mistelas in the world.

Winery Description: Where the unexpected becomes reality and the unusual awaits exploration. Undertake a search beyond the known, revealing hidden treasures in our centuries-old vineyards and connecting with the essence of our terroir. Bodegas Ysios traces its origins to the very heart of Rioja Alavesa, nestled at the base of the majestic Sierra de Cantabria. An avant-garde boutique winery that fuses Rioja’s winemaking tradition with a revolutionary mindset. Our avant-garde mindset has been recognized internationally. The Drinks Business has recognized our winemaker Clara Canals as one of the 100 best winemakers in the world, and our winery has been honored for its innovative design at the World Travel Awards. At Ysios, we honor our roots before daring to redefine them. We blend respect for the region’s winemaking tradition with an innovative and revolutionary approach to crafting wines that are true gems of authenticity.

Winery Description: Family winery located in Los Arcos, Tierra Estella (D.O. Navarra), a historic and relevant area in the cultivation of vines. We work in a traditional and sustainable way. Without the use of synthetic fertilizers or insecticides. Own rainfed vineyards, with very low productions. The recovery of old vineyards and forgotten varieties has been one of our challenges for several years. Wines with soul and character, which reflect the terroir from which they come. No use of clarifiers, filtrations or cold stabilizations. Be wine my friend!
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 231
Product 1 Description: 100% SYRAH. Viñedo : Finca de Los Yesos, en Los Arcos ( Tierra Estella). Un pequeño viñedo, con una elevada pendiente, suelo arcillo calcáreo muy pobre, lleno de rocas blancas de Yeso ( Sulfato Cálcico) Vendimia manual el 13 de Octubre. La fermentación alcohólica se realizó en pequeñas tinas de roble abiertas, con bazuqueos manuales Posteriormente el vino se pasó a barricas nuevas de roble Francés, donde realizó la fermentación maloláctica y se envejeció durante 12 meses.
Product 2 Description: 100% Garnacha. Viñedo “La segunda”, de 90 años de edad. Vendimia manual el 24 de septiembre. Encubado en depósito durante 3 horas haciendo una maceración pelicular en frío. Posteriormente se prensó todo y el mosto resultante, una vez desfangado, fermentó en depósito de acero inoxidable a 12-13ºC. Una vez finalizada la Fermentación alcohólica, la mitad del vino resultante pasó a una crianza en barrica de roble Francés de 6 años de edad, durante dos meses y medio. La otra mitad, permaneció en el depósito, con sus lías finas, haciendo removido de éstas semanalmente.
Product 3 Description: 50% Grenache – 50% Syrah. Vineyards on rainfed clay-calcareous soils. Traditional cultivation, without the use of mineral fertilizers or insecticides. Integrated protection against fungal pathogens. Grenache : Finca La Raicilla , 85 years old. Syrah : Finca Los Almendros, 24 years old. Harvest and fermentation separately of both varieties. The Grenache was then aged for 8 months in 5,000-litre French Oak wood vats. The Syrah was aged for 10 months in single-use French oak barrels.

Its 19 hectares of vineyards are home to native varieties such as Doradilla, Tintilla de Rota and Rome, French varieties such as Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc and Syrah, and the traditional Moscatel de Alejandría and Pedro Ximén. It produces both wines within the D.O. Sierras de Málaga (reds, whites and rosés) and wines covered by the D.O. Málaga (liqueur wines or the special Naturalmente dulces). The vineyards of La Capuchina are cultivated using Integrated Production techniques and environmental care and in their elaborations special care is taken in the handling of the grapes and the wines produced.

Winery Description: Founded in 2015 by cousins Fernando and Pablo, Bodega y Viñedos Maires is a family winery rooted in four generations of vine growing in Toro, Zamora. The project combines deep respect for tradition with a contemporary vision of winemaking. Maires farms 16 hectares of estate vineyards across different areas of the DO Toro, including very old bush vines, some over 100 years old, mainly planted to Tinta de Toro, alongside small parcels of Verdejo and Malvasía. The philosophy of Maires is centered on sustainable vine growing, low yields and maximum expression of terroir. In the winery, innovation serves identity: native yeasts, careful extraction and ageing in local Quercus pyrenaica (Pyrenean oak), a distinctive element that adds finesse, balance and authenticity while reinforcing sustainability. Product 1 Description: Ademán Adalia Malvasía is a distinctive white wine made from 40-year-old Malvasía bush vines, ungrafted (own-rooted), grown on very sandy soils with the presence of pebbles in the Adalia area, within the DO Toro. Low yields of around 4,000 kg/ha ensure concentration and varietal purity. The grapes are hand-harvested and carefully selected at the winery, followed by cold maceration. Fermentation takes place in small stainless-steel tanks under temperature control, using indigenous yeasts, and the wine ages on its fine lees for two months to enhance texture and complexity. The wine is clean and bright, pale yellow with greenish highlights. On the nose it shows medium aromatic intensity with complex herbaceous, aniseed and floral notes. On the palate it is silky and well balanced, with pleasant acidity, a broad mouthfeel and a smooth finish marked by a subtle bitter touch that adds length and personality. An elegant and fresh expression of Malvasía from Toro.
Product 2 Description: Ademán Valdearanda se elabora a partir de nuestra Finca Valdearanda, con viñedos de Tinta de Toro de entre 55 y 65 años, en vaso, asentados sobre suelos de arenas y canto rodado dentro de la DO Toro. La vendimia es manual, con una cuidada selección de la uva. El vino envejece aproximadamente 12 meses en barricas de roble francés, buscando armonía entre fruta y crianza. En copa muestra un color rojo guinda con ligeros tonos violáceos. En nariz es amplio y complejo, con fruta madura y frutos rojos integrados con notas tostadas y especiadas. En boca es sedoso y equilibrado, con una acidez bien integrada, excelente persistencia y un final largo y goloso. Un Crianza elegante y expresivo, fiel al carácter de Toro.
Product 3 Description: Maires Private Collection represents the ultimate expression of the winery’s family heritage. It is produced exclusively from a pre-phylloxera vineyard over 100 years old, ungrafted and located in the El Palo area (Toro) at 820 metres above sea level. This plot, inherited from our great-grandfather, has been recovered using biodynamic vine growing and organic fertilisation. Extremely low yields of around 1,200 kg/ha ensure remarkable concentration. The wine is made from 100% Tinta de Toro. After strict grape selection and a 48-hour cold maceration, fermentation with the skins lasts 18 days. Malolactic fermentation and ageing take place for 18 months in new Spanish oak barrels with ONYX toasting. It shows an intense cherry-red colour. On the nose it is complex, with ripe fruit, balsamic notes, minerality and sweet spices. The palate is broad, deep and persistent, with ripe tannins, freshness and a long finish that reflects the authenticity of our roots.

Winery Description: Martín Berdugo is a family winery, located in the D.O. Ribera del Duero that is committed to 100% organic quality wines made sustainably only with grapes from its 87 hectares of vineyard in a single payment. In 1988 the Martín Berdugo family recovered viticulture in their ancestral lands. Vines were planted on the banks of the Duero River with an area of 87 hectares. In 2000 it was decided to build a winery at the foot of the vineyard. After a fire and a fresh start in 2013, the opportunity arose to introduce a new method of gravity winemaking. This new system avoids damaging the fruit by creating a fruitier wine with balanced tannins. In 2024, Martín Berdugo obtained European organic certification for the entire vineyard. We are looking for quality partners who share our values and are present in the different national and international markets. Please contact us at bodega@martinberdugo.com to arrange an appointment.

Winery Description: PRADOREY is a family-owned winery producing Estate and Single Vineyard wines in Ribera del Duero. Our commitment is to craft honest wines that reflect our terroir, capturing the true essence of the grapes through the combination of tradition and technology to achieve excellence. Our estate is located in the most prestigious area of Ribera del Duero, on lands that once belonged to Queen Isabella I of Castile, making it the most historically significant estate in the region. Today, it encompasses twelve vineyards divided into 159 micro-terroirs and is the largest private vineyard in Ribera del Duero, as well as the largest private estate in northern Spain. Currently, the winery carries the historic name PRADOREY ("King’s Meadow") and primarily produces wines from Tempranillo-Tinto Fino, along with Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Albillo Mayor, Malvasía, Viognier, Godello, and Garnacha. Since 2016, we have incorporated the use of clay jars, over 200 years old and with a capacity of more than a thousand liters, into our winemaking process. This method enhances the wines' freshness and highlights their fruit-forward characteristics.

Fue reconquistado a los musulmanes hacia 1056. Vinos marcados por las tierras que tenemos en nuestra comarca. Winery Description: Casa Balaguer is a winery specialized in organic and biodynamic viticulture, certified Bio and Demeter, where every stage of production is guided by strict sustainability standards and minimal intervention. We work exclusively with Mediterranean grape varieties adapted to our environment, grown on calcareous soils and hillside parcels that promote balanced and resilient viticulture. We are one of only 11 Spanish wineries belonging to Renaissance des Appellations, the prestigious and highly selective international group founded by Nicolas Joly in France, which brings together producers committed to purity of origin, soil vitality, and absolute respect for the life of the vineyard. In the cellar, we follow a low-intervention approach: spontaneous fermentations, minimal use of sulphur, and gentle ageing that allows the true identity of each vineyard to be expressed with precision. The result is a collection of deeply Mediterranean, textural wines where minerality, natural freshness, and the authenticity of the landscape emerge without artifices.

Product 1 Name: CARRO DE LA MATA. COLECCIÓN PARCELARIA (SINGLE-PLOT WINE)
Product 1 Description: Carro De La Mata is born from one of the few pre-phylloxera vineyards still surviving in Europe, planted on its own roots in the Natural Park of Las Lagunas de La Mata in Torrevieja, 70 km from our estate. In this protected landscape shaped by salt lagoons, siliceous sands and constant sea breezes we cultivate Muscat of Alexandria as an act of resilience in a fragile, luminous environment. Each cluster captures salinity, tension and true Mediterranean character. This is a vertical, honest white wine, with no makeup just the variety expressing itself in its purest form. Harvesting is done by hand in 20 kg boxes with strict selection. Destemmed but uncrushed grapes ferment in clay amphorae with 30 days of skin contact. After removing the skins without pressing, the free-run juice returns to the amphora for 6 months of ageing under a subtle, naturally formed veil of flor. The nose reveals white flowers, stone fruit, citrus peel and Mediterranean herbs. The palate is vibrant and tense, with crisp acidity and a marked saline backbone that lengthens the finish and leaves an unforgettable mineral imprint. A white wine deeply connected to the landscape that gives it life.
Product 2 Description: Rambla Peligrés is born from a parcel shaped by millions of years of geological history. During the Late Cretaceous, this valley lay beneath the sea, and the seismic uplift that formed Cerro de San Cristóbal and the Cerrico de Balaguer created the geological core that defines the vineyard today. Here, where a calcareous bedrock lies just half a meter below the surface, the roots of our Garnacha Tinta and Garnacha Gris struggle to penetrate, generating natural stress that concentrates energy and identity in each cluster. The result is fruit marked by minerality, tension and vibrant salinity. The wine is ethereal, tense and precise, avoiding opulence to faithfully express the arid, calcareous and windswept landscape of the parcel. Harvesting is done by hand in 20 kg boxes with strict selection. Fermentation takes place in concrete tanks with 30% whole clusters and gentle daily punch-downs for 12–15 days. After a light pressing, the wine returns to concrete for 10–12 months of ageing with minimal intervention. On the nose it shows wild red berries, cherry, liquorice, thyme, lavender and a hint of damp earth. The palate is direct, with crisp acidity, mineral and fine tannins.
Product 3 Description: Viña Guerán is the origin of Casa Balaguer, the founding parcel that surrounds the house and winery, acting as a silent guardian of the estate’s history. Here we work mainly with Monastrell, complemented by a subtle touch of Arcos, an ancient variety that adds nuance and depth. The soil defines everything: in the lower area, loose sands provide balance and slow, even ripening; higher up, metamorphic calcareous rock brings structure, tension and freshness. The resulting wine is a fine, luminous and elegant red, where purity and precision matter more than sheer power. Monastrell is hand-harvested and strictly sorted, fermented in concrete with 20% whole clusters and gentle punch-downs, then transferred to 500 L used oak barrels for malolactic fermentation and 12 months of ageing. Arcos ferments in 1,000 L oak vats with 50% whole clusters and ages 10–12 months in clay amphorae. The nose is subtle, with red and black fruit, dried flowers, fine herbs and a clean mineral background. The palate shows perfect balance: smooth entry, silky texture, polished tannins and lively acidity, finishing light, fresh and lightly saline, inviting another sip.

Winery Description: Since its inception, Casa de la Ermita has traced a path of innovation and diversity, being a pioneer in the introduction of varieties such as Petit Verdot and Viognier in Jumilla. These varieties, together with the emblematic Monastrell, form the heart of our winemaking identity. At Casa de la Ermita, we are committed to quality and excellence. Our philosophy, reflected in our slogan "Pride of winemaking roots. Non-conformist character and vision", is a declaration of intent and our passion for the land, the love for the art of making wine and a spirit of continuous improvement. This philosophy of explorers drives us to offer international and dynamic wines, maintaining the essence of the Jumilla terroir. We invite you to be part of our history, to explore the richness and diversity of our wines. At Casa de la Ermita, every sip is a journey, an exploration of Jumilla's unique character.

Winery Description: Casa La Rad is a distinctive winery located in Ausejo, in the Ocón Valley of Rioja Oriental, and stands as one of the largest and most biodiverse wine estates in La Rioja. Spanning 800 ha, only about 14 % is planted with vineyards, while the remainder is a balanced mosaic of woodlands, olive groves, and traditional crops that nurture a rich ecosystem and enhance vine health. The estate’s philosophy is rooted in working with nature to preserve its landscape, cultivating traditional Rioja grape varieties such as Tempranillo, Garnacha, Mazuelo, Graciano, Maturana, and Viura at elevations from 515 to 675 m. Casa La Rad’s state-of-the-art winery blends modern technology with time-honoured practices under winemaker Bárbara Palacios, focusing on letting each wine express its terroir rather than conforming to traditional Rioja aging classifications.

Product 2 Description: Naturalis Mer represents our firm belief in the potential of organically grown and processed Black and White Grenache. With Naturalis Mer we take on the challenge of cultivating and producing our wines in the least intrusive way possible within the framework of a demanding regulation that is what distinguishes organic wines. Grapes selected from the best organic vineyards 100% Black Grenache. The grapes are stripped naked, spoiled and fermented in stainless steel tanks at a controlled temperature with native yeasts and with minimal intervention, only pumping over daily until the end of alcoholic fermentation. Once this is finished, the wine is bled by gravity into cement vats where malolactic fermentation will begin without the addition of lactic acid bacteria.
Product 3 Description: Naturalis Mer represents our firm belief in the potential of organically grown and processed Black and White Grenache. With Naturalis Mer we take on the challenge of cultivating and producing our wines in the least intrusive way possible within the framework of a demanding regulation that is what distinguishes organic wines. Grapes selected from the best organic vineyards. Pre-fermentative skin maceration and fermentation with native yeasts at a controlled temperature of 14-16º in stainless steel tanks and kept on its lees making a batonage to give it more complexity and volume in the mouth
Product 4 Name: Primícia Blanco fermented in Acacia barrel (Organic wine)
Product 4 Description: Selected vineyards over twenty years old. Pre-fermentation skin maceration and fermentation at a controlled temperature of 14-16º that begins in cement tanks and ends in new acacia barrels. For a few months it will remain in the barrels aging with the fine lees to achieve more volume and unctuousness in the mouth.
Product 5 Description: Selected grapes over 25 years old from Hairy Grenache. The press must is drained without applying any pressure. In cement tanks, static settling is carried out at a low temperature to remove the coarser sludge. The clean must is inoculated so that it ferments at a controlled temperature.

As Burgos Porta we released our first organic wine in 2003, through a traditional process.The vineyards of the cellar are located in a small valley in Poboleda. This area combines both crops and mediterranean forest. The main vineyard surrounds the winery, Mas Sinén, an ancient country house dated from the 17 th century. The vineyards are owned by the family burgos porta, being planted from 1950’s. They extend trhough out a 15 hectares land, whose heigh is within 300 and 500 meters above sea level. The average age of the vines is 35 years old and the soil is a characteristic slate from the doq priorat known as llicorella.

Winery Description: After more than ten years of searching in different controlled wine production areas (Denominations of Origin) in 2010, we settled in the DO Montsant, where we found what we were looking for: old vines of native varieties and a wonderful winery built in the year 1900. We started this project with the aim of carrying out a careful production of quality wines. We emphasize that quality takes precedence over quantity with a MINIMAL INTERVENTION strategy to obtain AUTHENTIC, HEALTHY and ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY WINES. To do this, we face the recovery of old vines incorporating vitivinicultural practices that seek the balance of the plant and respect for the environment (all the vineyards are certified by CCPAE as ORGANIC FARMING practices, EUROPEAN CERTIFICATION). We incorporate the most advanced technologies in the cellar for the vinification of wines that express the personality of the territory and the native varieties. After an interruption of a generation, our family returns to work the land to obtain authentic wines, .... wines with soul.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 476

Winery Description: Celler de l'Encastell is a small family winery located in Porrera (DOCa Priorat). The project was born in 1999, promoted by Carme Figuerola and Raimon Castellví, with the aim of making wines that faithfully express the unique character of the Priorat. The winery works exclusively with its own vineyards, many of them old, planted on llicorella soils, which provide minerality, structure and depth to the wines. It produces limited production red wines, mainly Grenache and Carignan, following traditional viticulture and artisanal winemaking. In 2015, Raimon Castellví and Jaume Vallès started a new project at Els Guiamets (DO Montsant): Cal Bessó, a small family winery that combines traditional winemaking experience with innovative winemaking. They work about 10 hectares of vineyards distributed between the Les Rotes and La Presa estates, mostly of native Grenache and Carignan. Currently, all wines are organic.
Winery Location: OLIVERS 7, 43739, PORRERA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 460
Product 1 Description: White wine, fermented in 500-litre French oak (Alier) and Acacia barrels and batonage with fine lees for three months to give the wine greater volume and complexity, but at the same time preserve the exuberance of the fruit and floral aromas of the variety. 100% White Grenache
Product 2 Description: Lo Cirerer is the fruit tree long cultivated by our family, whose fruit is very present in this wine. Red wine aged 6 months in fine-grained French oak barrels and 6 months in stainless steel tanks. Blend based on the Garnacha Tinta and Garnacha Peluda varieties. Accompanied by Carignan and in a very small proportion also of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. With a slight touch of freshness provided by a small percentage of white grape varieties.
Product 3 Description: Red wine aged for 12 months in French oak barrels and new American oak barrels. 10% of the barrels are renewed every year. All the grapes produced come from the winery's own vineyard. 50% Black Grenache, 10% Carinyena, 40% Merlot, Cabernet S. and Syrah. This wine is born from the vines planted in the narrow terraces carved on the slopes of slate soil ("Llicorella") of the Priorat. Vines raised on trellises whose production is limited between 1.5 and 2 Kg per foot, which gives us 3,000 – 4,000 Kg per hectare. Alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel and polyester tanks at a controlled temperature between 26-28 ºC, maceration with skins for 15 days.
Product 4 Name: MAS D'EN CAÇADOR Vi de Paratge de Celler de l'Encastell
Product 4 Description: CARINYENA + GARNATXA NEGRA 100% red wine selection from the centenary vines of Garnatxa Negra and Carinyena from the Mas d'en Caçador estate. 14 months in 500-litre French oak barrels. Only 600 bottles produced
Product 5 Description: Red wine aged for 16 months in new fine-grained French oak barrels (Allier), 50% first use and 50% second and third use. All the grapes produced come from the winery's own vineyard. 40% Carignan from old vines 40% Grenache from old vines 20% Merlot and/or Syrah from young vines. This wine is born from the old vines planted directly in the fractured rocks of the slopes of the Priorat, in our estate "Mas d'en Caçador". The narrow profile of the slate soil of the Priorat makes it possible for the vines to be planted directly on the slate rocks on many occasions, through whose cracks the roots penetrate in search of moisture. Scattered throughout our vineyard are what we call here "Roquers", outcrops of rock that have given their name to this Roquers de Porrera. Alcoholic fermentation is carried out in 400-litre French oak barrels and in stainless steel and polyester tanks at a controlled temperature between 26-28ºC, maceration with the skins for 20 days.

Winery Description: In Binissalem, Ca’n Fumat is synonymous with wine. Joan Garcias Company was the family's first winemaker. As early as the 19th century, he was already producing red wine from grapes grown in his own vineyards. Currently, at Ca’n Fumat, we produce a limited quantity of wine using traditional methods, from grapes grown in our own vineyards: Can Caleu, es Verger, es Figueral, and sa Quarterada, all located in the municipality of Binissalem. Preserving local grape varieties is fundamental to our approach to the present, which is why we make our wines with the indigenous varieties Manto Negro, Moll (Prensal Blanc), and Callet. We also have a small number of Syrah vines, which blend exceptionally well with our Manto Negro.
Winery Location: C/ DE SA COMA 10, 07350, BINISSALEM , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 666

Winery Description: Can Marlès is a natural complex of 300 hectares, centered by a winery of organic wines protected by the DO Penedès in the Costers del Montmell area, unique for terroirs at an altitude of 540 meters, where the aquifers that are born on the northern slope of the Valley give a natural humidity and unique character to our vineyards and wines. We produce organic single-varietal wines, with aging and storage, wines made without haste, which gives them an elegant, fresh and structured character. We have 9 references on the market, including Garnatxa Blanca, Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Tempranillo, Syrah, two rosés, one of them spectacular from the Petit Verdot variety, a sweet wine and a sparkling Clàssic Penedès worked like the rest of the wines, with our own harvest and production. We have other varieties such as Parellada, Malvasia de Sitges and an ancestral recovered variety that we hope to vinify next year for the first time, Forcada, made from white grapes.
Winery Location: FINCA CAN MARLES S/N, 43812, EL MONTMELL
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 392

Winery Description: We are a family-run organic winery in the Alella DO, located in a privileged setting surrounded by vineyards and forest, just 20 minutes from Barcelona. We produce 17 different wines using grapes from our own vineyards. We also have our own winery and a historic farmhouse next to the vineyards. We cultivate a total of 25 hectares of vineyards and we are dedicated to recovering old vines in the region. We bottle approximately 40,000 bottles annually. Pansa Blanca is the grape variety we work with most, and through our wine tourism experiences, we introduce our product to wine lovers. We offer a wide range of wine tourism experiences for individuals and companies. We hold Biosphere sustainability certification and follow the production guidelines for organic and vegan wines.
Winery Location: AV/ PIERA 69, 08107, MARTORELLES , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 382
Product 1 Description: Crianza Sauló by Can Roda is a reference in regards to white wines Catalans. It is a wine lemon yellow with golden highlights, a dense appearance with the presence of persistent tears. This pansa blanca white wine is perfect to accompany cheeses, white meat, fish or nuts from the oven. To the nose, it has a good aromatic complexity, where aromas of crianza gracing the seal of the Pansa Blanca, a neat bouquet of fennel, pear, peach, vanilla, burnt cream, milk and fruits like melon or baked apple. The entrance into the mouth is slow, with a sweet and creamy feeling, well balanced with a subtle acidity that gives balance to the very pleasant lingering finish and with fruit aromas, soothing and nurturing the flavour. The alcohol content of this Alella white wine is 13.00%.
Product 2 Description: Our first example of quality red wines from the Can Roda cellar is the Syrah Grenache. It’s a clean and light wine with presence of carbon, red wine of intense color and grained violet edges, light feeling in the presence of purple glass and tears. Pleasant on the nose with good aromatic intensity and hints of fresh scents of fruit, such as raspberries, cherries and cranberries, along with delicate hints of flowers as well as a vegetable tree stem, and a very quiet mineral finish. The grape varieties used for this Catalan red wine are the Syrah and Grenache and has an alcohol content of 12.5%. Ideally, this is served between 8-12 ° C.
Product 3 Description: Our DO Alella rosé is one of the best Catalan rosés. It’s a rosé wine characterized by an attractive imperial pink color, bright and high intensity, violet reflections with the presence of thin tears. The aroma of our pink nose is intense, which includes some outstanding sweet and sour aromas, reminiscent of wild fruits such as strawberries, blackberries, currants, on a vegetable and balsamic touch. On the palate it’s a timid wine, with a light step and well-balanced acidity present, with a pleasant slightly bitter finish with a sweet and fresh sensation, which brings the memories of strawberry and eucalyptus candies.
Product 4 Description: Pansa Blanca Muscat from Can Roda is an excellent example of the best white wines of Catalonia. It is a pale yellow wine with a greenish tinge, and light looking tears. This DO Alella white wine is ideal for welcoming reception, and accompanying light dishes such as salads or fish green steam. Good aromatic, clean, pleasant expression with hints of fleshy fruits like peach, Paraguayan peach flowers like jasmine and magnolia, plant touches on some dry herbs.The entrance is light and fresh, with a subtle sweet and lingering finish of pleasing balance of bitterness, acidity and sweetness, with an aftertaste of white fruit with hints of herbs. The alcohol content is 12.5%.
Product 5 Description: So de Masia Can Roda Pansa Blanca is a pale, bright yellow wine with green reflections and a light tear. It has good intensity on the nose, clean and fresh, with aromas of Pansa Blanca. It has a bitter sensation with aromatic notes of a bouquet of flowers, fennel, and fresher aromas like watermelon and vineyard peaches, with subtle hints of dry sand. On the palate it is silky and elegant, with a pleasant light finish where the fruit, herb, and mineral notes reappear. It is one of the most sought-after Pansa Blanca wines. The alcohol content of our Catalan white wine is 13%. It is made using manual harvesting in 15 kg boxes, gentle pressing with a pneumatic press, and exclusively using the first must and soft-press fractions up to 0.4 atm of pressure. This DO Alella white wine is perfect for finger foods like canapés, for example. It can also accompany potatoes, croquettes, fish rice, or shellfish dishes.

Winery Description: We are an estate winery in Conca de Barberà (Catalonia), a cool-climate area known for its cool summers and clay-limestone soils. Our vineyards date back to 1781 and the winery was established in 1991. We are certified as an Elaborador Integral, ensuring full control from vineyard to bottle. Our entire production is certified organic. We own and farm 80 hectares, selecting only the best parcels and plots to ensure quality, consistency, and long-term stability. We specialize in Guarda Superior cava and premium still wines, with a strong focus on the local varieties Trepat and Parellada, valued for their freshness, elegance, and aromatic precision. In 2021, we received the Best Catalan Sparkling award.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level , Street C, Stand 482
Product 1 Description: A Guarda Superior Reserva Cava produced as an Elaborador Integral, ensuring full control from estate-owned vineyards through to bottle ageing. Organic certified, it delivers a clean, precise style with a fine mousse and vibrant freshness, making it an excellent match for food-driven wine programs. Tasting note: Bright green-tinged lemon colour with a very fine bead. Aromas of white fruit (green apple, pear) with subtle yeast nuances. On the palate, it shows lively acidity, a light structure and a precise, persistent finish.

Winery Description: Celler Casajou is a small rural winery in the Anoia River Valley crafting parcel-based sparkling wines with limited production and a deep focus on the vineyard and village. From Sant Jaume Sesoliveres, Laia Esmel and Jaume Vilaseca work old Xarel·lo vines to capture the profound essence of the valley, the river crossing it, and its clay and limestone soils. They practice respectful, traditional dry-farmed viticulture, letting nature express itself through every bottle.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 141
Product 1 Description: The sparkling wine from the La Caldereta vineyard comes from an emblematic plot of Celler Casajou, located on a small south-facing slope in Sant Sadurní d'Anoia, near the Lavernó stream. This vineyard, planted in 1963 in a vase drive, occupies 1.63 hectares of sandy-calcareous soils with clayey textures, at an altitude of about 177 meters
Product 2 Description: They are the gentle pressings of all the vineyards that we vinify. Co-fermentation of five vineyards of Xarel·lo and Garnacha Tinta de La Teixonera. Fermentation is spontaneous with the indigenous yeasts of the vineyard and at the end of fermentation in the bottle.
Product 3 Description: The village sparkling wine of Sant Jaume Sesoliveres is the pure expression of our village, a sparkling wine that captures the living landscape of the Anoia River Valley. It is born from Xarel·lo vineyards surrounding it, worked with deep respect and close collaboration with local growers, to capture the authentic soul of the village.
