Winery Description: The Celler Cooperatiu de Cornudella de Montsant building is one of the architectural jewels of the Priorat, an authentic Cathedral of Wine built in 1919 and inspired by Catalan agrarian modernism. Its imposing building, located at the foot of the Serra del Montsant, is much more than a production space: it is a symbol of cooperation, shared effort and roots in the territory. Here, generations of farmers have worked side by side to preserve the essence of a unique landscape, defining wines that honestly express the personality of our land. The winery produces wines with their own identity, which are born from vineyards mainly of Grenache and Carignan, cultivated with respect and dedication next to the Montsant Natural Park. Each bottle is a tribute to tradition and a look to the future.
Winery Location: COMPTE DE RIUS 2, 43360, CORNUDELLA DE MONTSANT , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 472

Winery Description: In the village of Capçanes, in 1933, a few families decided to join forces to create a common project that would help them preserve their way of life: viticulture. Thanks to the courageous spirit of its people, today we inherit centuries-old vineyards and a winery with 90 years of history. Our winery has adapted to the passage of time, always open-minded, demonstrating that a well-organized community is capable of creating great wines through cooperation. In the 1990s, before having a local Designation of Origin, the first Kosher wines in Spain were already being produced, achieving great international recognition. The first single-varietal Garnacha Tinta wine from the region arrived in 1996, putting the village of Capçanes on the wine map. Today, we dare to say that we are a model of sustainability, allowing local people to live on their land with dignity.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 446
Product 1 Description: VARIETIES: 100% Garnacha Tinta Origin: Selected from century-old vines planted in the traditional bush vine system. Very low yields: 400 to 500 g of grapes per vine. Hand-harvested at the end of September. WINEMAKING: Foot-pressed and quickly separated from the skins. Fermentation begins in stainless steel tanks. Aged on lees for 3 months after fermentation. AGING: Biological aging on lees in French oak barrels for 8 years. Barrels are half-full to encourage the formation of flor yeast and controlled oxidation of the wine during the aging process. ANALYSIS: 15% vol. alcohol 6.3 g/l total acidity >0.2 g/l residual sugar TASTING NOTES: Intense golden color. Ripe fruit on the nose with notes of stone fruit, orange peel, cider, dried herbs, and chamomile. Dry in profile, it offers a high aromatic concentration and depth on the palate. A rich expression of delicate floral aromas reminiscent of chamomile; orange peel, yeast and pastry, toasted almonds, and lactic notes.
Product 2 Description: VARIETIES: 100% Garnacha Tinta Origin: Selected from the fifteen best estates of very old vines, 60 to 110 years old. Planted on slopes and terraces at varying altitudes, between 300 and 550 meters. Clay, granite, and slate soils. Very low yields: 400 to 750 grams of grapes per vine. Hand-harvested from mid-September to mid-October. VINIFICATION: Fermentation at controlled temperature (24-28ºC). 30-day maceration with the skins. Alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in stainless steel tanks. A small portion is vinified with the stems to add freshness to the wine. Gentle filtration before bottling (only if necessary). AGING: 12 months in French foudres (3000 L), lightly and medium toasted. Aged in stainless steel tanks for two months before bottling. ANALYSIS: 15% Vol. Alcohol 4.7 g/l Total Acidity >1 g/l Residual Sugar TASTING NOTES: Bright ruby ​​red color of medium-low intensity. Aromatically expressive, with raspberry jam, and floral and mountain herb notes that give it a fresh.
Product 3 Description: VARIETIES: 100% Cariñena Origin: Selected from very old vines, 75 to 110 years old. Planted on slopes at varying altitudes, up to 550 m. Clay, granite, and slate soils. Very low yields: 400 g of grapes per vine. Hand-harvested at the end of September. WINEMAKING: Fermentation at controlled temperature (24-28ºC). 30-day maceration with the skins. Alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in 3000 L French oak foudres. Light filtration before bottling (only if necessary). AGING: 12 months in light to medium toasted 3000 L French oak foudres. ANALYSIS: 14.5% Vol. Alcohol 4.7 g/l Total Acidity 0.5 g/l Residual Sugar TASTING NOTES: Medium-intensity garnet color with violet reflections. Aromatic, with abundant forest fruits, wild herbs, and spices; berries, violet, red currant, and cherry. On the palate, it is fresh, full-bodied, and rich in aromas: forest fruits such as currants, blackberries, and blueberries; black fruit jam, plum compote, and mineral notes, along with hints of licorice.
Product 4 Description: VARIETIES: 50% Garnacha Tinta, 50% Garnacha Gris. Origin: Selected from vineyards in Capçanes. Hand-harvested, starting at the end of August. Limited production of 4,000 bottles. VINIFICATION: Destemming and direct pressing of the grapes. Direct pressing of the Garnacha Tinta. Alcoholic fermentation at a controlled temperature (14-16°C) in stainless steel tanks. Lees aging during part of the process. Clarified and gently filtered before bottling. AGING: 10 months in 3000L French oak foudres. ANALYSIS: 13.3% vol. Alcohol 5.6 g/l total acidity 0.8 g/l residual sugar TASTING NOTES: Pale pink color, bright onion skin, low intensity. Delicate fragrance on the nose. Delicate aromas of white flowers and red fruits: strawberries, raspberries… mingle with a floral fragrance characteristic of aged Garnacha wines. On the palate, its elegance, finesse, and long finish are surprising. Its silky texture is balanced by a good acidity that provides great freshness.

Product 1 Name: Bessons 2023 - La Vinya del Pi (cupatge sequera) DOQ Priorat
Product 1 Description: THE ESTATE Vines grown on steep slopes, on slate and sandstone soils, in the municipality of Torroja del Priorat. The climate is semi-arid Mediterranean continental, where the austere conditions drive the plant to express to the extreme the characteristics of the resulting wine. BESSONS 2023 - LA VINYA DEL PI CUPATGE SEQUERA DOQ PRIORAT Varieties: 40% Grenache, 40% Carignan, 20% Syrah. Aging: French oak barrels, new and one year old. Production: Limited, 2100 bottles. Vintage: Dry and warm year. Winemaker: Toni Sánchez-Ortiz
Product 2 Description: THE ESTATE El Vilà is a vineyard plot in Horta de Sant Joan planted with white grenache in 1996. Certified organic and managed with regenerative agriculture practices. It covers 0.6 Ha with mainly limestone soil. DUES VOLTES GARNACHA BLANCA 2024 Single-varietal white wine from Garnacha Blanca. Carefully hand-harvested with double selection in the vineyard and at the winery. Destemmed and directly pressed. Fermentation in stainless steel tanks at a controlled temperature below 20 ºC for 20 days. In the final stage of fermentation, the wine is racked and aged on fine lees for 8 months in 600 L French oak barrels. The wine was bottled in spring 2025 after gentle filtration.
Product 3 Description: Beautiful old-vine parcel located in the Partida de Cretes, in the Algars River valley, in Arenys de Lledó, in the Matarraña region.This bush-trained Garnacha Tinta, planted over 50 years ago on clay-limestone soils, is farmed according to organic and regenerative agriculture principles. DUES VOLTES GARNATXA NEGRA 2024 Single-varietal red wine made from Garnacha Tinta. Carefully hand-harvested. 48 hours of cold maceration followed by a 20-day fermentation. By closely monitoring the tannins on the palate, a gentle pressing is carried out to avoid bitter notes on the finish. Aged for 12 months in 225 L French oak barrels of first and second use.Several rackings are carried out until a clean wine is obtained. Bottled in November 2025 without fining or filtration.
Product 4 Description: THE ESTATE Vines cultivated on steep slopes, over Priorat slate and sandstone soils. The climate is semi-arid Mediterranean continental, where the austere conditions drive the plant to express to the extreme the characteristics of the resulting wine. LLOP 2023 DOQ PRIORAT Varieties: Blend Grenache, Carignan and Syrah. Grapes harvested by hand and berries sorted through a selection table. After two days of cold soak maceration, fermentation is controlled by manual punching down of the skins between 1 and 2 times a day. The fermentation lasts about 20 days, and then after a gentle pressing the wine is transferred to French oak neutral barrels
Product 5 Description: THE ESTATE A combination of three vineyards growing Parellada, Macabeo, and Xarel·lo in La Secuita, Tarragona. LOOPS ANCESTRAL WHITE 2024 A sparkling wine made through a single fermentation (ancestral method). The three grape varieties are fermented separately. Fermentation begins with the Macabeo and Xarel·lo, and when they are about to finish fermenting, they are blended with the Parellada, which is just starting its fermentation. Once the blend is nearly done fermenting, it is bottled, and fermentation finishes in the bottle. After 6 months of bottle aging, disgorgement is carried out to remove the lees.

Winery Description: Números Vermells is a project that began with great enthusiasm in 2008, with the vinification of a single barrel, which resulted in the first vintage of wine on the market. The passion for wine drives a very artisanal production in a small garage in Torroja. The most important thing is to take care of a very carefully selected raw material, where the varieties, vineyards, and slopes are worked and managed separately. This allows, when deemed appropriate, for special batches to be bottled, always prioritizing ripe fruit, minerality, and the depth that our very special llicorella brings.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 506
Product 1 Description: Aiaiai is a light and easy-going wine from Priorat, with a very good balance between minerality and fruit, made from the youngest vines, between 20 and 30 years old. A blend mainly of Grenache and Carignan, together with a small proportion of Syrah, grapes from different parts of Priorat (Poboleda, Torroja and Bellmunt). Aging in 500-liter French oak barrels and amphorae for 8 months. *Production of 3000-3500 bottles
Product 2 Description: Carignan de Porrera, planted in 1919 on a hillside with a 70% slope, 100% llicorella. Very fresh vineyard, 350 grams of grapes per plant. It is a very mineral, complex and elegant wine that reminds us of the aromatic herbs that we find on the same mountain (thyme, rosemary, fennel..). *Limited production of 800 bottles.
Product 3 Description: En Números Vermells classic: Blend of 70% Peluda Grenache from old vineyards in Bellmunt del Priorat, 25% Syrah from Poboleda and 5% very old Carignan from Porrera. Elaboration similar to the previous one. Aging in 500 and 300 liter barrels. Great complexity and mountain notes. Very mineral, with black fruit and bay. *Production of 1300 to 1800 bottles, depending on the vintage.
Product 4 Description: En Números Vermells Etiqueta Negra: Blend of 70% Red Grenache and 30% Carignan. Wine made from old vines (between 50 and 100 years old) of coster, with a very small production. Fermentation is carried out separately in open barrels and in clay amphoras. Subsequently, the wine ages in 500L and 300L barrels, as well as in amphoras, for 14 months. We craft wines with their own distinct personality, combining respect for the land, an innovative perspective, and minimal intervention practices. Minimum intervention has become a pillar of the winery, always maintaing and prevailing common sense, both taking care of the plants and the wines. Innovation and creativity is also essential, finding in wines like the first low alcohol Parellada with a DO. The generational continuation is allowing for a fresher outlook, with new ideas and and bold perspectives that bring harmony between heritage and innovation.

Product 1 Description: Time is the essential role in the aging and maturation of these wines. Serie 6 was born from the abundance of Parellada in Terra Alta, a variety often overlooked due to its naturally low alcohol levels. Considering the growing trend toward lower-alcohol wines, it was decided that this variety deserved attention and a place in the winery. Serie 16 and Serie 26 are made entirely from Carignan, another underrated variety that is highly valued at home, with vines dating back to 1973. The vinyeard is harvested twice; the first half for the S16 and the second half, weeks later for the S26. The first wine was crafted to achieve greater freshness and dynamism, while the second was made to be rounder and more elegant, aimed at those who prefer traditional wines and a fuller drinking experience.
Product 2 Description: Naturalment is a project that seeks to showcase the full potential and versatility of White Grenache through textures. The project is built on a thoughtful and carefully designed framework. Starting with Naturalment Blanc, a fermentation in stainless steel, showcasing the variety. From there the other textures have space to build. Naturalment Pansificat, sweet wine made from grapes that have been dried out on straw mats. Continuing with Naturalment Ancestral, a pet-nat portraying the freshness and crispness of the variety with a subtle integrated bubble. Naturalment Brisat, our traditional name for Orange wine, a fermentation on stainless steel with 15 days of skin contact. Naturalment Àmfora, showing how the wine reacts when in contact with clay both during fermentation and short ageing. Naturalment Malolàctica is a Bourgogne inspired wine, alcoholic and malolactic fermentation in used barrels. More textures are being created as vintages pass.
Product 3 Description: Serendipity is a project that seeks to innovate within traditional processes. The project was started simply because a rosé was missing from the winery. Serendipity Rosé was then created, a wine given a deeper color and a truly gastronomic character. Later, Serendipity Double Mass was developed, as a playful reinterpretation of the traditional “double mass”: it is made lighter than a red, ideal for chilling, with a softer hue, and is best paired with fatty fish rather than meat. Finally, Serendipity Late Harvest was produced, inspired by the Port method but without fortification, allowing the sweetness and character of the grapes to be expressed naturally.

Winery Description: La Botera is the project that one day in 1986 led 5 families of winegrowers from Batea to partner to work together and make their dream come true: to market the fruit of their work in the vineyards. The wines of La Botera are the result of the effort and dedication of all the members of which today we can already consider a single and large family. Our vineyards are located in the municipality of Batea, within the DO Terra Alta, we currently cultivate around 180 hectares of different varieties, among which the Garnacha blanca, Garnacha negra and Cari laena stand out, emblematic varieties of the area. With different altitudes and types of soil, where the rocky soil stands out. Rich in limestone and poor in organic matter. We care about making our wines following sustainable processes. We make vegan wines and attached to the EBREEBIOSFERA Biosphere Reserve.

Product 1 Description: From the intrigue of how to make our most representative wines go one step better, born this project, a kind of experiment of what would happen if…?. The fusion of land and sea, two opposite aspects, but that make that the wine reaches its maximum expression. 100% white Grenache - Aged 6 months under the sea at 10 meters Deep in the Delta del Ebro (Mediterranean sea) by Thalassa sea wines. Pale yellow in color with gray reflections, very bright. With varietal smels, very intense, fresh fruity and mineral. In mouth, it has a long trajectory, very round, fleshy and very fresh interlacing of white fruit and citrus. It is very clean, with native herbs and a luxurious acidity. Deep finish with very good persistence.
Product 2 Description: Mudèfer is a wine that comes from the oldest vineyards of the winery. Located in very particular valleys, surrounded by forests and between 400 and 550 m of altitude, where the annual rainfall does not exceed 400 l/m2 and, therefore, there is almost no need for phytosanitary treatments. These vineyards are cultivated on natural terraces with “honeycomb” soil, which are strong, deep, calcareous and permeable soils. 75% Carignan and 25% Grenache. Fermentation at controlled temperature and with an aging of 8 to 10 months in French and American barrels. The wine has a bright and clear surface of a ruby ​​red color. It has a wide variety of delicate nuances, touches of toasted and smoked fruits, due to the aging in French oak, on a background of very ripe red fruit almost candied and contributed by the aging in American oak. In the mouth, it is broad and generous, and expands throughout the oral cavity without difficulty and conveys the sensation of a velvety wine.
Product 3 Description: Vila·Closa Blanc is a young wine 100% White Grenache from DO Terra Alta, made with a balanced combination of old vines -which provide structure - and young people -which give freshness and nerve-. They are fermented separately and then aged on lees to round off their profile. Pale yellow with gray reflections and bright, it seduces on the nose with elegant aromas of grapefruit, apricot, white flowers and tender almonds. The palate is long, frank and evocative: white fruit and citrus are intertwined in a fleshy and fresh way, with herbs from the environment and a vibrant acidity that draws a deep and persistent finish. This wine has been recognized internationally with gold medals in competitions such as the Concours Grenaches du Monde. Vila·Closa Blanc is an authentic Terra Alta experience: fresh, refined and with character, perfect for those looking for elegance and expressiveness.

Winery Description: “Each wine must embody the culmination of a desire, of a dream… the feeling of belonging to something greater, far superior and far more transcendent than all of us.”

Product 3 Description: A glass of wine is worth more than a velvet coat. This saying has never been more true than with this wine, thanks to its unique grape variety: Garnacha de la Figuera. An invitation to awaken your senses.

Winery Description: Celler Masades is a small family winery located in Segura, Tarragona, in the Conca de Barbera, within the natural surroundings of Vall del Corb. The project cultivates the only vineyard in the municipality, located at 800 metres above sea level, in a mountain area outside traditional viticultural boundaries. Altitude, continental climate and poor soils shape the fresh, precise and expressive character of the wines. The project was created to revive viticulture in this unique environment through a contemporary vision, focusing on mountain viticulture that highlights terroir, freshness and identity. The vineyard is farmed under certified organic standards, growing white varieties such as Albarino, Garnacha Blanca and Gewurztraminer, resulting in distinctive wines. Led by Maria, the winery targets importers, fine dining restaurants and specialised wine shops seeking singular wines in limited production. Crafted with precision and altitude driven freshness for global markets.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 444
Product 1 Description: This white wine is made from certified organic Albarinyo, grown using sustainable and environmentally friendly farming practices. Harvesting is carried out by hand with careful selection of the best clusters, and the grapes are transported under refrigerated conditions to preserve freshness and natural aromas. Winemaking begins with gentle whole-cluster pressing, followed by fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks. Throughout fermentation, the wine remains in contact with its lees (sur lies), enhancing aromatic complexity, structure, and mouthfeel while maintaining varietal purity. In the glass, it shows a pale yellow color with greenish highlights. On the nose, it displays elegant aromatic intensity, with clear varietal character, apricot notes and subtle herbal nuances. On the palate, it is balanced, fresh, fruity, and well-structured, offering a clean and expressive finish.
Product 2 Description: Made from 100% Gewürztraminer grown from certified organic grapes, cultivated using sustainable and environmentally respectful practices. Harvesting is carried out by hand with careful selection of the best clusters, and the grapes are transported in refrigerated boxes to the winery to preserve freshness and natural aromas Winemaking begins with gentle whole-cluster pressing, followed by fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks. The wine remains on its lees for six months (sur lies), enhancing aromatic complexity, texture, and structure while preserving varietal purity. In the glass, it displays a pale yellow color. On the nose, it offers elegant aromatic intensity, with pronounced varietal character, rose notes, and delicate floral nuances. On the palate, it is balanced, fresh, and structured, with expressive aromatics and a harmonious finish. An aromatic and expressive white wine, produced in limited quantities, highlighting freshness, varietal purity, and balance
Product 3 Description: MASADES is a white wine made from 100% certified organic Albariño, grown under sustainable farming practices. Harvesting is carried out by hand with careful vineyard selection, and the grapes are transported under refrigerated conditions to preserve their aromatic integrity. Winemaking begins with gentle whole-cluster pressing, followed by fermentation and aging for 11 months in French oak barrels, with periodic bâtonnage to enhance volume, complexity, and seamless oak integration. After barrel aging, the wine is further refined in bottle. In the glass, it shows a pale yellow color with golden highlights. On the nose, it is elegant and complex, with aromas of green apple, pear, and citrus notes, complemented by subtle oak influence. On the palate, it is precise, structured, and fresh, offering an excellent balance between fruit, acidity, and texture, with a long finish. A high-expression, gastronomic white wine, suitable for both immediate enjoyment and aging.

Winery Description: Rooted in the land and faithful to its essence, Celler Mas Ramoneda is the reflection of a way of understanding wine that unites tradition, landscape and passion. Between vineyards worked with respect and meticulous care for every detail, wines with their own identity are born, parceled estate wines, capable of expressing the character of the territory and the soul of those who make them. Each bottle is an invitation to discover authentic flavors, made with patience, sensitivity and a deep love for the vineyard. At the foot of the Comiols mountain pass between La Noguera and El Pallars Jussa, in the pre-Pyrenean interior of Lleida, Mas Ramoneda gives shape to wines that are born from the land and speak with their own voice.

Product 1 Description: White wine made from red grapes (Blanc de Noirs). Made with Grenache noir harvested between September and October, seeking the optimal moment of grape ripeness, and made in stainless steel tanks where alcoholic and malolactic fermentation took place, and subsequently rested until bottling.
Product 2 Description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Red Grenache, harvested between September and October seeking the best ripening time for the different grapes and made in French oak vats with a capacity of 5,000 litres (Fudres), where it ferments and rests for 6 more months. Finally, it remains in the bottle for 12 months before being released to the market.
Product 3 Description: Wine made with red Grenache, Syrah and Monastrell grapes, harvested between the end of September and mid-October, looking for the optimal moment of ripening of the grapes and made in stainless steel vats for 17 days at 15ºC. Then the wine is kept for 3 months in the same tanks with its lees waiting naturally for the achievement of malolactic fermentation. Finally, it is in the bottle for 12 months before being released on the market.
Product 4 Description: Wine made from 100% Monastrell grapes, harvested in mid-October at the optimal ripening time and fermented in stainless steel tanks for 22 days at 13.5ºC. Afterward, the wine is kept for 3 months in the same tanks with its lees, where it undergoes stirring, a process known as "batonage."
Product 5 Description: A blend of white Grenache, Malvasia de Sitges and Viogner harvested at the end of September looking for the best moment of ripeness of the different grapes and made in stainless steel vats for 32 days at 13ºC. The wine is then aged for 2–3 months in the same tanks on its lees, during which stirring is carried out in a process known as batonnage.

Winery Description: With more than 100 years of history, we are one of the benchmark wineries of the Montsant Denomination of Origin, in the Priorat region. We work to preserve the essence and personality of our origins, supported by today’s knowledge and innovation. Our wines and olive oils are currently present in more than 25 countries. Our bond with the landscape is what makes the difference between simply making wine and truly loving it. The goal of Celler Masroig is to craft high-quality products while respecting tradition and showcasing the distinctive character that defines us. We work with persistence and conviction on red clay soils to convey the values that shape the winery’s identity. This soil, predominant in our area, has a direct influence on grape quality. Garnacha and Cariñena (Carignan / Mazuela) are the native grape varieties of the territory. The light reflected by the red earth onto the grapes plays a key role in the ripening process.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 454

Winery Description: Mas Vicenç is a family winery built inside a traditional Catalan farmhouse commonly named 'Masia'. At the foot of the 'Coll de Cabra', the property borders the Serra de la Voltorera mountain range where the Alt Camp region is separated from the Conca de Barberà. The winery stands out for its authenticity and for being surrounded by vineyards and other typically Mediterranean crops. As a result of this landscape, with small plots separated by majestic dry stone banks, a range of products is born that goes from wine and olive oil, to nuts and Mas Vicenç's own flower honey. The story begins in 1953 when the farmer Vicenç Ferré, at 90 years old and with a whole life dedicated to the agriculture, was able to acquire the property. Since then, five generations have passed in which the cultivation of the vineyard has always been transcendental for the family and, it is in 2005, when the first wines of Mas Vicenç begin to be produced from the most appreciated grapes of the family estates. It is a pure family work with the boost provided by the youth where the aim is to create modern and innovative wines that re-evolve the tradition.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 440
Product 1 Description: L’arlequí is an aged red wine made with Carinyena, Cabernet and Merlot, with great structure and fineness. Elegance, personality and persistence in every drop, it represents the origin and personality of Mas Vicenç, being the first wine produced in the winery in 2005.
Product 2 Description: White wine from a century-old vineyard, planted in 1912, and fermented in clay amphora. 100% Macabeu with wild essence and emotional value, a tribute to the winemaking tradition of Cabra del Camp and the post-phylloxera winemaking revolution of our great-grandfather. Its salinity and notes of raw almond make up a great wine with a Tarragona identity.
Product 3 Description: MACABEU, MOSCATELL AND GARNATXA BLANCA. The best way to take a very fresh wine comes from our white El Terrat, a wine to uncover the good vibes flowing. It is a fusion of freshness, joy, color and aroma resulting in a wine with an exuberant fruity sensation. A new proposal that invites you to enjoy life, to laugh and to dare. Terrat 2020 is awarded the gold medal for the best young white wine in the “Premis Vinaris” 2021.
Product 4 Description: It is a 100% Grenache, harvested by hand and aged for 16 months in 500-liter French oak barrels. A very fine red wine, with herbaceous and fruity sensations and very elegant, marked by river pebbles and a unique and refreshing natural acidity. It is a beautiful coincidence turned into a wine tribute.
Product 5 Description: The Sea Amphora 100% Malvasia by Mas Vicenç: It is a white malvasia wine aged 400 days under the sea, preserving the floral notes and enhancing the salinity that identifies our vineyards. It has a limited edition of 150 units and it is a clear tribute to the Mediterranean Sea and our Roman past of ancient Tarraco.

Winery Description: Celler Matallonga is a small family project that was born in 2010 with the intention of enhancing the value of the territory and preserving dryland vineyards located 650 m in the middle of the forests of Fulleda, a territory of continental character and great personality. We make organic wines under the influence of the lunar calendar, working with traditional varieties adapted to our environment. Our philosophy is based on respect for the land, sustainable viticulture and minimal intervention in the winery, with the aim of honestly expressing the origin and identity of each wine. Our wines are characterized by their balance, freshness and authenticity, reflecting the dry climate, the clay-limestone soils and the uniqueness of the landscape. Limited productions, artisanal care and a clear commitment to quality define our project.

Skin maceration for 24 hours and low-temperature fermentation in stainless steel tanks, with the aim of preserving maximum aromatic expression and varietal purity. Aged on fine lees until just before bottling, adding complexity, body, and balance on the palate.
Product 2 Description: 100% Syrah. From 30-year-old dry-farmed vines, grown at an altitude of 650 meters. Skin maceration throughout fermentation in stainless steel tanks, with the aim of preserving maximum aromatic expression and varietal identity. Aged on fine lees until just before bottling, contributing an intense expression of red fruit, body, freshness, and remarkable balance on the palate.
Product 3 Description: 100% Merlot. From 30-year-old dry-farmed vines grown at 650 meters above sea level. Organic rosé wine made using minimal intervention methods and hand-harvested grapes. Skin maceration for 1 hour, fermentation, and aging in 500-liter barrels. Limited edition.

Winery Description: Celler Mir is a historic winery located in Subirats, with a winemaking legacy dating back to 1776 and spanning 17 generations of the Mir family. Winery Description: Technology and low interventionism. DO. Costers del Segre. Equipped with the latest oenological technology, the Cérvoles Celler winery has a bespoke design that takes into account the size of the different plots of vines so that the grapes from a single variety and specific plot are fermented separately in different tanks. The system used to transfer the harvested grapes is particularly important, these being loaded through the lowest part of the tanks in order to protect the fruit more effectively, among other reasons because this prevents lacerations in the grapes skins. The winery has used different types of slow-growing oak for its barrels, specially roasted. Those who can supply the barrels that contribute to the appropiate nuances and character for Cérvoles are the ones selected in order to preserve the balance and complexity of our wines; in other words, the characteristic bouquet of this company’s wines.

Winery Description: In the heart of the Côte des Bar, in the village of Essoyes, a site known as “La Pitancerie” was transformed by the Cistercian monks of the Abbey of Molesmes in the 13th century. This historic site became a place of restoration in those remote times where the “Pulmenta Regularia”, the “Pitance” and the “Genérale” were served. Today, converted into a vineyard, it has regained its original splendor with the production of fine Champagne wines full of subtle and unique aromas. After 7 generations, Julien Dautel and his family are stepping forward to give a new dimension to this historic project. Concerned about environmental values, the cuvées are produced in the purest Champagne tradition and the vineyard is managed using a “sustainable viticulture”. Julien Dautel strives to work his 3.5 hectare property with this respect for the environment, giving the tillage an important role that provides strength and character to the vineyard. Likewise, biodiversity plays a key role in highlighting the suppleness and minerality of this land. The vineyards are composed mainly of Pinot Noir, a favorite variety in the Côte des Bar.

Winery Description: Cisteller is the viticultural and winemaking project of Jessica Madigan and Sergi Canals. We are two winemakers who met studying at UC Davis in 2015. We traveled the world together working in many incredible wine regions like Burgundy and Central Otago all the way to the slopes of the Mosel, Rioja Alavesa and the Priorat. Along the way, we conceptualized the Cisteller project using ideas collected from our travels. Should style dominate regional typicity? In a region ruled by large scale industrial winemaking through the last several decades, this question becomes even more complex. We dedicate our efforts to discovering new depths for our wines by asking questions and unraveling beliefs. While the traditional method is the highest expression for our sparkling wines, our approach is not champenoise. As we are in the mediterranean, we would like our wines to reflect this.

Winery Description: Fernando’s determination, together with Irene’s extensive professional and international experience in the wine world and their shared passion for viticulture, led them to fulfill a long-held dream: the creation of Clandelvino. This family-run winery was born from a deep respect for the land and a strong commitment to authenticity, with the aim of crafting wines that truly express their origin. Since 2018, they have been working in a long-forgotten area, focusing on the recovery and preservation of very old vineyards that few were willing to maintain. Through this work, they help protect a valuable viticultural heritage while reviving grape varieties that were close to disappearing from the region. All their wines are made without chemical intervention, allowing nature to speak freely and honestly in every bottle. Every step of the process at Clandelvino is carried out by hand, from vineyard work to the final labeling of each bottle.

Its proximity to the Atlantic and the Mediterranean, abundant rainfall during the winter and the wide thermal oscillation between day and night due to the altitude are the main factors that define our terroir. Winery Description: Located in Calce, in Northern Catalonia, the Gauby estate originates from a long-standing family farming tradition. Initially, the vineyard consisted of only 10 ares of vines cultivated with the help of horses by Gérard's grandfather, at a time when polyculture was essential for survival. In the mid-1980s, Gérard took over the estate and began its development. Today, the farm covers 100 hectares under polyculture, including around 40 hectares of vineyards, some with vines over 120 years old. In 1996, the estate converted to organic farming, eliminating chemical inputs in favor of natural preparations. The vineyard is set in a preserved environment with rich and diverse soils combining limestone, marl, and schist, allowing deep root systems. Since 2014, all new plantings have followed agroforestry principles to protect soils, enhance biodiversity, and mitigate the effects of climate change.

Winery Description: Dominio del Challao was born from a deep, almost vital need to give shape to a desire: to make wines as they were once made, with our feet rooted in history but with our hands and gaze set on the present. It takes shape in Rioja Alavesa, a place where landscape and culture, history and viticulture blend seamlessly, giving life to something truly unique. Behind this desire is Manu Michelini, a young Argentine vintner who began his path in 2015 alongside his parents, Gerardo Michelini and Andrea Mufatto. With Dominio del Challao, he seeks to interpret the terroir of Rioja Alavesa—particularly Labastida—in a delicate and elegant way, creating a connection with wines from 100 years ago while adapting them to today’s methods.

Product 1 Description: Angelita del Challao is a selection of several parcels located in Labastida (Castrijo, Arenales and Sauco), created with the intention of shaping our idea of what a true “village wine” should be. Crafted from a blend of ten varieties —with Tempranillo as the guiding thread— it expresses the richness and diversity of its origin through a floral character, an agile texture, and an extended aging period (20 months) that brings depth and dimension. It is a wine that seeks to gather the nuances of the Bastidarra landscape into a single bottle, with sensitivity and a strong sense of belonging. Its name pays tribute to La Angelita, the first town in Argentina where Catalina, Manuel’s grandmother, lived after emigrating from Spain in the mid-20th century. In this way, the wine also embodies a family memory that crosses oceans and generations.
Product 2 Description: Challao Garnacha was created with the intention of exploring the character of high-altitude Garnachas—those that have revealed their typicity and adaptability in cooler ecosystems. Sourced from Las Ginebras —our vineyard located at 600 meters above sea level, on the slopes of Mount Toloño in the central valley of Labastida— this Garnacha develops through a slow, extended ripening process, with naturally late harvests. The result is a balsamic, profound wine with a weightless texture and a contemplative character, inviting us to think of “height” not only as altitude but also as perspective. It is aged for 20 months in a single large-format foudre with wide staves, designed specifically to contain its energy and guide its evolution with patience and precision.
Product 3 Description: Virna —a term of Latin origin that evokes the idea of spring— is the youngest wine in our portfolio, both in its aging and in its recent addition. The 2022 harvest marked our fourth year working in Rioja Alavesa—a brief yet revealing period that allowed us to deepen our understanding of our parcels. It was within Angelita del Challao, our village wine, that we identified two vineyards with notably reddish, iron-rich soils and a strong clay presence. In these sites, nature seemed to move at a quicker pace: the wines matured gracefully and reached their peak earlier. That early, almost intuitive balance became the seed for Virna—a youthful, vibrant red that captures a fresher expression of its origin.

Winery Description: At Dominio de Montelahorra, we have been dedicated to wine for more than six decades. Our history begins in 1957, when we were one of the first twelve wineries in the Ribera del Duero. We are in La Horra (Burgos), a place with centuries of winemaking tradition, where underground cellars from the twelfth century excavated in the rock are still preserved. We have grown up surrounded by vineyards, learning to take care of them and to make wines that reflect the identity of our land. Thanks to this experience, today we offer wines with personality, which express the unique character of the soil where they are born. We have 200 hectares of our own vineyards, located in the heart of the "Golden Triangle" of the Ribera del Duero (Roa - La Horra - Gumiel de Mercado), at an altitude of 800-850 metres. Most of our vines are goblet-planted, following tradition, and we are very lucky to have several hawthorns that are more than 100 years old. These century-old vineyards, authentic treasures of viticulture.

Malolactic fermentation took place in new 225-litre French oak barrels, where the wine rested for more than 16 months. The extreme climate and the diversity of loam soils, clays, limestone and sands mark a unique terroir, where human factors, the different clones and patterns of our vines give rise to wines with soul. Each plant is carefully cared for throughout the vegetative cycle, from dry pruning to harvesting, including the different tasks of the vineyard, green pruning, pruning, leaf removal, etc., to gain the best quality of the grapes and be reflected in the expression in our wines, respecting the rhythm of the vineyard.

Winery Description: UNIQUE WINES FOR UNIQUE PEOPLE In the heart of the Valencian Iberian Valley, Dominios de MGP produces wines that are born from absolute respect for the land and precise work on each plot. Between Moixent, Font de la Figuera and Fontanars dels Alforins we grow Mediterranean varieties that express identity: reds with structure and freshness, vibrant and aromatic whites, elegant rosés and sweet ones that excite. Each wine reflects a unique terroir, diverse soils and viticulture that prioritises sustainability, balanced pruning and harvesting by hand. Our purpose is to recover the essential and transform it in the future, combining tradition and technique to create honest, authentic wines with soul. MGP's Domains represents our most careful wine project, while Proyecto Origen activates the territory through experiences and culture. Each bottle tells a story: that of the landscape, that of those who work it and that of an origin to which we always return.

Winery Description: Since 1996 at Doniene Gorrondona we have been working our vineyards and making txakoli, the wine that has always been produced in Basque farmhouses. We produce young wines for aging that are the result of our way of understanding the natural environment and viticulture, of the uniqueness of the native varieties - Hondarrabi Zuri and Hondarrabi Beltza -, and of the soils and biodiversity of our vineyards. In our work, we approach vineyard management from a comprehensive perspective and committed to environmental sustainability. Each plot is treated with an individual approach: from its care and maintenance to the harvest, which is carried out with carefully controlled yields. Subsequently, we carry out the vinification of each plot separately, thus ensuring the maximum expression of its unique qualities.

Winery Description: Bodegas Don Sancho de Londoño – The fruit of a family’s effort, a dream realized. Bodegas Don Sancho de Londoño is a family-owned project based on three pillars: the land, the vineyard, and the people who make it possible. Founded in 2004 by José Ramón and Raquel, raised in families of vinegrowers and shepherds, the winery combines tradition with a passion for hard work. Located in the heart of Rioja Alta, it cultivates 40 ha of its own vineyards and manages another 80 ha of high-altitude vineyards (500–800 m), mainly Tempranillo, Garnacha, and Viura, including old vines up to 115 years old. For over 20 years, we have produced private-label wines for one of the largest U.S. importers, with several references awarded 90+ points by Parker, Wine Spectator, and Wine Enthusiast. Our offer includes: - DOCa Rioja: Joven, Crianza, Reserva, and Gran Reserva of limited production - Everyday wines in bottles and Bag-in-Box (0.75–15 L) - Private-label projects and tailor-made wines

Winery Description: The Jumilla Protected Designation of Origin has a winemaking tradition that dates back to the remains of Vitis vinifera – along with tools and archaeological remains – found in Jumilla dating back to 3000 BC, the oldest in Europe. The production area, at altitudes ranging from 320 to 980 meters and crossed by mountain ranges reaching up to 1,380 meters, is bordered on one side by the southeasternmost part of the province of Albacete, including the municipalities of Hellín, Montealegre del Castillo, Fuente Álamo, Ontur, Albatana, and Tobarra; and on the other by the northern part of the province of Murcia, with the municipality of Jumilla. It comprises more than 20,000 hectares of vineyards, mostly dry-farmed and trained in the traditional bush vine system, located on predominantly limestone soils. Old vines in the Jumilla PDO represent more than 20% of the total area, with the Monastrell variety being the most prevalent (90% of the old vines).

Winery Description: The Pla de Bages Designation of Origin is a distinctive winegrowing region located in the heart of Catalonia, closely connected to local wine culture and the iconic landscape of Montserrat. It brings together 16 family-run wineries, all cultivating their own vineyards, which cover approximately 500 hectares divided into small plots surrounded by woodland. Pla de Bages stands out for its preservation of dry-stone constructions, a rural heritage that shapes the agricultural mosaic and reflects a long-standing relationship between the land and the vine. The recovery of native grape varieties, such as picapoll, strengthens the identity of a designation known for producing balanced, elegant wines deeply rooted in their territory.

Product 1 Description: Selection of the best grapes for young wine, which will be fermented at a controlled temperature in inert stainless steel tanks. Once finished, a second malolactic fermentation is carried out in order to create a more pleasant sensation on the palate and provide complexity. The use of non-inert barrels and containers is avoided, as the aim is to bottle the essence of the Tempranillo variety "naked", preserving its primary aromatic palette.
Product 2 Description: The finest 100% Airén grapes from old vines have been carefully selected. These grapes have been fermented in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks; their unique production method revives a practice dating back more than 100 years in La Mancha, where white must is produced together with its skins (casca), in what were formerly known as "vinos encascados" (skinned wines).
Product 3 Description: Tempranillo grapes from old vineyards near Manzanares. Exhaustive selection of grapes. Fermentation takes place at a controlled temperature in stainless steel tanks. Once completed, malolactic fermentation takes place to improve mouthfeel and complexity. After completing the second fermentation, the wine is aged in French and American oak barrels for 4 to 6 months in our fully sustainable underground cellar.
Product 4 Description: 90% of the grapes were harvested on 9 August 2023, and a clean must was obtained through static settling. The remaining 10% of whole grapes, destemmed and crushed, which had been harvested two days later, were added to this must. Fermentation took place in the presence of some of the white skins at a controlled temperature of 18 °C. The wine was then aged in barrels with its lees for five months. It was stabilised by natural cold weathering in the Sierra de Gredos for two months with intervention. La Cendra Albillo Real 2023 is a wine with a beautiful straw yellow colour. It is intense on the nose, with lots of fresh white fruit, such as pear, apple and green melon. In the background, it offers hints of aniseed, fennel and local herbs. There are also subtle spicy nuances contributed by the ageing in wood. It is a very fresh and balanced wine, with mineral notes of granite rock and an elegant finish full of pleasant aromatic sensations.
Product 5 Description: Cold pre-fermentation maceration for 3 days at less than 10 °C. Addition of selected indigenous yeasts. Fermentation in temperature-controlled stainless steel tanks, with pumping over and phenolic control of the macerating must. Spontaneous malolactic fermentation at low temperature and periodic stirring of the lees in the tank. Olimpo 21 is a wine with an intense cherry red colour with blue tones. It displays powerful aromas of fresh black fruits (blackberry and plum) and blue flowers (violet), with spicy nuances in the background from French oak, while remaining elegant, with very polished tannins, hints of black liquorice and a long finish full of aromatic sensations, where the fruit-wood combination reaches its maximum expression.

Winery Description: In Briones, at the heart of Rioja Alta, Finca Allende interprets the terroir with a contemporary vision grounded in precision, elegance, and deeply sustainable viticulture. Since 1986, under the guidance of Miguel Ángel de Gregorio, the winery has worked a mosaic of old vines across small parcels of clay-limestone soils and deep gravel, cultivated without herbicides, using organic fertilisation and mechanical tilling to preserve soil life and the natural balance of the vineyard. Hand harvesting and double selection ensure purity before a low-intervention vinification process that combines stainless steel and wooden vats. Ageing in French oak and bottling without filtration allow each wine to retain the authenticity of its origin. From this philosophy emerge wines of great character and finesse, including Aurus, Calvario, Mártires, Marure, Gaminde, and Mingortiz—singular expressions from historic vineyard sites. With limited production and presence in more than forty countries, Finca Allende has become a benchmark of modern Rioja. Wines of origin, precision, and respect for the land: the purest expression of Briones.

Finca Bacara stands out for its focus on bold, expressive wines with a modern edge, reflected as well in the artistic design of its bottles. Wines such as Time Waits for No One are known for their deep aromas, vibrant fruit and smooth tannins. Committed to sustainability and low-intervention winemaking, the winery seeks to preserve grape purity and express the authentic essence of Jumilla in every glass, offering high-quality wines at accessible prices.

Winery Description: The Finca Biniagual is a farm, which is primarily focused on viticulture. That’s why we cultivate, besides wine, on 180 hectares acreage also: olives almonds citrus fruits (oranges, clementines and lemons) figs pomegranates carob Furthermore, we also grow green fodder and grain for our approximately 300-head big flock of sheep. All this, just like cork oaks, is part of the typical landscape of Mallorca. By maintaining this sustainable and mixed form of agribusiness, we are doing our part in preserving the majorcan landscape’s diversity, which is extremely popular worldwide. By carrying out this sustainable and varied agriculture, we participate in maintaining the diversity of Majorca’s landscapes, so appreciated all over the world.

Winery Description: Finca El Molar is a family project located in Fuentealbilla (Albacete), in the heart of the PDO Manchuela. Guided today by Rus Jiménez as a generational replacement, the project was born from respect for the vineyard and the desire to give continuity to a way of understanding wine linked to the place. Our vineyards are located between 650 and 750 meters above sea level, on limestone and alluvial soils. The altitude, the thermal contrasts and the influence of the Solano wind mark the character of La Manchuela and favour a slow, balanced ripening with a defined varietal profile. We work mainly with local varieties, under organic viticulture and practices aimed at soil regeneration, such as permanent plant cover and reduced tillage. The aim is to accompany the vineyard so that each plot expresses its own character. In the winery we apply minimal intervention and vinify each plot separately, respecting the identity of the grape. Winery Description: We are a small family winery located in Quintanar de la Orden, Toledo province, at the heart of the La-Mancha region. Winey was established in 2015, literally as a garage, and here we process all the grapes coming from our own family vineyards (old-bush vines, head pruning and dry farming). We have several hectares divided in 8 micro-plots and all belong to our family. Our aim is to recover and maintain native grape varieties, which were traditional to the area and well-adapted to the drought conditions as Cencibel, Brujidera, Airén, Verdoncho, and many more. The vast majority of our vineyards are over 40 years old and, as you can imagine with these very rough conditions our approach to viticulture is naturally organic, as we don’t use any chemical fertilizer or pesticide. Then, every plot is harvested by-hand and grapes are carried to the winery where a minimal-intervention approach is followed. Micro-vinifications take place in different sizes, shapes and material vessels, for instance we have: tinajas (clay-pot), concrete, stain-steel and wood-cask. We only use indigenous yeast. Some of the wines are unoaked and some have a bit of maturation in old barriques.

At the same time we try to look for personal experiences and stories, our philosophy is to always make wines with some story behind them, something that transmits an emotional experience, authentic wines and with something different either by their dedication, elaboration or variety (always small productions). We are located in San Martín de Unx, a village located in the Baja Montaña of Navarre, our cultivation is very focused on Grenache and we give maximum importance to the "mountain" environment that surrounds our vineyards.

Product 1 Description: When and How... A special wine for me, "the spoiled child". First harvest in 2011, the first year of Aitana's (my daughter's) life, so I decided to dedicate a wine to her. It had to be something delicate, subtle, with "grace"... And what better than a rosé, a different rosé, with character and that would allow a good evolution in the bottle. I hope I succeeded... At least it is a wine that is born full of good intentions, and when you put all the love into making a wine, it hardly goes wrong, I hope you like it. Varietal : 100% Grenache. Barrel: Fermented in barrels (4 months American oak) and aged on lees Area and vineyard: San Martín de Unx (Navarra), vineyards located in a mid-mountain area.
Product 2 Description: When and How... As the saying goes, there is not one without two, I hope there are two without three... In 2015, Daniela, my second daughter, was born, a volcano of expressiveness, noise, joy and tears, but above all of happiness, a happiness that transmits and sweeps wherever it goes... in short, a hurricane of feelings. An intense, powerful wine with many nuances, this is Daniela: a marked lees work in jars, which gives it a differentiated character. Varietal: White Grenache 70%, rest Chardonnay, Viura and Sauvignon blanc. Tinaja/amphora: Fermented in clay amphora and aged on its lees for 6 months Area and vineyard: San Martín de Unx (Navarra), vineyards located in a mid-mountain area.
Product 3 Description: Cuando y como... Comienza a fraguarse en 2015, elaborado entre dos amigos locos por el vino, Luis Moya y un servidor (Gonzalo Celayeta). Pretendíamos meter en una botella de vino nuestra bandera (la variedad Garnacha), reflejar los matices del origen del viñedo (San Martín de Unx) y queríamos ir más allá dando un aspecto ancestral al vino con una crianza sobre lías en ánforas de barro. Además buscábamos ánforas a la antigua usanza, de gran volumen, viejas y envinadas, donde el barro estuviera “pulido” y donde las paredes gruesas permitieran una crianza larga y delicada. Se antojaba una Kimera, y como tal, nos costó encontrarlas pero el resultado y la espera han merecido la pena. Varietal : Garnacha 100%. Tinaja/ Anfora: Crianza sobre lías de 12 meses en tinaja de barro de 4.000L. Zona y Viñedo: San Martín de Unx (Navarra), viñedos ubicados en zona de media montaña.
Product 4 Description: When and How... After more than twelve years making Grenache in San Martin de Unx, exploring, researching... We concluded that in certain plots, especially located in high areas and with soils with a fairly sandy component, (light textures in general), we obtain wines that express more finesse and freshness than concentration. The wines obtained from these vineyards generally have low color intensity but in the mouth they surprise with their length and volume, something that a priori seems difficult to expect, hence their similarity or "twinning" with "El duende", a mythological character of small size, elusive, timeless, caretaker of nature and the forest, but despite everything wrapped in magic and power. Varietal : 100% red Grenache Barrel aging: Aged 15 months in French oak barrels. Area and Vineyard: Single-vineyard wine, San Martín de Unx (Navarra)
Product 5 Description: When and How... In 2012 I found the time to develop a personal project that would transmit the values of both Grenache and San Martín de Unx in a bottle of wine. I decided to call it "The Piano", taking into account that I find it a harmonious, enveloping and deep instrument (like this wine), which transmits the values of those who play it and that when listened to live, glass of wine in hand, produces very pleasant sensations. I even dared to pair it with a song that I have heard so many times ("River flow in you", by Yiruma), in the end paying tribute to the person who has dedicated so many hours of piano to me. Varietal : 100% Grenache. Barrel: Aged for 12 months in American oak barrels of at least 5 wines. We try to minimize the presence of toasted and smoked products. Area and vineyard: San Martín de Unx (Navarra), vineyards located in a mid-mountain area.

Winery Description: Opened in 2005 by the Izagirre family, the winery was conceived to enrich Biscay’s wine culture and redefine and develop its txakoli, selling it in the Basque country, Spain and further afield. Behind each bottle of Gorka Izagirre is the hard work of a team of dedicated professionals who manage each vineyard and oversee the entire production process with a common goal in mind: guaranteeing our wines’ quality and uniqueness. Ours is a diverse family of wines, each conceived to be enjoyed at specific moments. Trust us, you’ll be blown away by their liveliness and freshness. We use local grape varieties that only grow in this privileged corner of the Basque Country, such as Hondarrabi Zuri, Hondarrabi Zerratia and Hondarrabi Beltza. The strong character of these grapes lend a unique personality to our wines, allowing them to adapt perfectly to each occasion.

Product 1 Description: The wine that encapsulates the very best of our vineyards. G22 is the result of patience, observation and tireless tasting. This special blend, the result of years of work, is made from the finest grapes from our most exceptional vineyards. Aged on its lees over several months, G22 has a fantastic capacity for evolution. It is a versatile, elegant and complex wine that manages to harness the very essence of Hondarrabi Zerratia.
Product 2 Description: A young txakoli that straddles modernity and tradition with every sip The result of a 50% blend of our indigenous Hondarrabi Zuri and Hondarrabi Zerratia grapes, Gorka Izagirre is a fresh, joyful and aromatic wine with a well-defined body and structure that surprises with every sip. The grapes derive from 30 hectares of vineyards that are cultivated with the utmost care and attention. They are distributed around 10 uniquely prepared plots in 3 different valleys. Each valley has a different soil, altitude and microclimate, giving this txakoli an exceptional character.
Product 3 Description: This red wine is Bodega Gorka Izagirre’s latest creation Ilun—meaning “dark” and “god of the night” in the Basque language—takes us to a once-forgotten place that is slowly recovering its status in the world of txakoli. Produced entirely from the little-known Hondarrabi Beltza grape, it is notable for its freshness, uniqueness and unmistakable Atlantic character.
Product 4 Description: An intense and refined oak-fermented white wine Zura is the result of our desire to ferment Hondarrabi Zerratia grapes in a clean and light oak vat. It is a wine that perfectly respects the character and personality of our indigenous grapes. Fermented in a 5,000-liter French oak vat, the must is turned into wine and aged on its fine lees over a two-month period. The txakoli then stays in the same vat for eight more months in an attempt to achieve the perfect harmony between fruit, wood and lees. It is then left to mature in the bottle for several months, where it becomes more refined and develops its personality and body. Zura acquires its nuances and intensity over time, resulting in a more complex and satisfying experience.

Winery Description: Granja Nuestra Señora de Remelluri is a very old wine-growing estate; the first documents found speak of viticulture in Remelluri as early as 1620. Until the 19th century it belonged to the church and in the 1960s, the Rodríguez Hernandorena family acquired the estate and began a meticulous process of restoring the vineyards. The plots have always been worked naturally and organically, and today, the entire estate is certified organic. Located in Labastida (Álava), in the foothills of Mount Toloño, the Remelluri vineyards extend along three small valleys that surround the winery. Lindes de Remelluri started during the 2010 harvest when we decided to craft estate wines at Granja Nuestra Señora de Remelluri using grapes exclusively from our 90 ha of vineyards. For the families of winegrowers from San Vicente de la Sonsierra and Labastida who had always brought their grapes to Remelluri, we wanted to produce a wine, their wine, in which their hard work and the taste of their terroir is reflected. By 2020, we welcomed new winegrowers who asked to become part of this exciting project, including those from Salinillas de Buradón, Rivas de Tereso, Peciña and Ábalos.

Winery Description: In 2003 the Cusiné family, who have traditionally had a passion and dedication for producing extraordinary wines in the Penedès area, were attracted to the Priorat captivating area. They selected their first property in the higher areas of the Priorat to start a new and exciting project with the young winemaker Jordi Fernandez. The dry climate together with the magnificent terroir, dominated by Llicorella (slate) stone and the old native varieties Garnatxa and Carinyena, quickly seduced them. In accordance with our philosophy of being always respectful to the environment and biodiversity, we cultivate our vineyards organically, without pesticides or herbicides. We do not irrigate our vines so that their roots are as deeply as possible, in order to find water, better withstand periods of drought and more at the same time remove all the soil. Following our innovative spirit, in 2012 our vineyards were certified as Biodynamics by Demeter. Gratavinum is one of the most innovative winery in Priorat region, and in 2017 one of our wines, Silvestris, did rank among the best natural wines in the world by Decanter Magazine.

Winery Description: Coviñas is a cooperative wine group based in the Valencia region with over 60 years of history. It brings together 3,000 families managing more than 10,000 hectares, of which 20% are organic. Our annual production reaches 12–14 million bottles, and we manage over 90 million liters of bulk wine, providing great versatility and responsiveness. We produce wines under the Utiel-Requena PDO and Cava PDO, highlighting the native Bobal grape alongside Tempranillo, Garnacha, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, Macabeo, Sauvignon Blanc, Tardana, and Chardonnay. Our wines are present in over 30 countries, supported by decades of international experience and projects tailored to importers and distributors. Our philosophy is people-centered, fostering trust and long-term collaborations while combining tradition, quality, and sustainability.

Product 1 Description: Bellamarina nace en la confluencia entre la frescura mediterránea y la exclusividad, combinando delicadeza y estilo. La gama incluye un blanco elegante y un rosado de inspiración provenzal, pensados para seducir a quienes buscan vinos que combinan diseño, tendencia y disfrute. Bellamarina captura la esencia del verano eterno, ofreciendo vinos ideales para momentos de luz, conversación y celebración sencilla, convirtiéndose en la elección perfecta para un consumidor urbano, socialmente activo y atento tanto a la estética como a la calidad en la mesa.

It is not just a range: it is the gateway to the Coviñas universe, perfect for those looking for quality, authenticity and good wine without artifice.
Product 3 Description: El Jugón es la propuesta más joven, fresca y desenfadada de Grupo Coviñas, pensada para quienes disfrutan del vino de manera espontánea y sin complicaciones. Nacida para acompañar los momentos cotidianos, esta gama combina juventud, frescura y carácter mediterráneo. Sus vinos son jugosos, con un punto dulce que los hace fáciles de beber y perfectos para disfrutar en cualquier ocasión. Incluye blancos y rosados frescos, y tintos amables y frutales, ideales para tapas, reuniones informales o momentos de ocio con amigos. El Jugón es una gama que proyecta diversión, frescura y autenticidad para vivir el vino con naturalidad y sin artificios.
Product 4 Description: Veterum is our tribute to the oldest vineyards of the Coviñas Group, those centuries-old vines that have stood the test of time rooted in the land of Utiel-Requena. The range brings together four unique wines: Veterum Tardana, 100% Tardana white, elegant and fresh, which rescues a native variety of late ripening. Incluye varietales como Chardonnay, Verdejo, Sauvignon Blanc, Blanc de Noir y Tardana, cada uno trabajado para expresar al máximo sus aromas y características únicas. Flavours of white peach, baked apple, and citrus zest mingle with delicate toasty and nutty undertones, revealing both freshness and depth. The finish is long, clean, and elegant, leaving a lasting impression of harmony and finesse that reflects the purity of Macabeu and the precision of Brut Nature style.

Product 3 Description: It displays a pale gold colour with fine, delicate bubbles that rise steadily to form a persistent and elegant crown. The nose is refined and expressive, revealing the distinct varietal character of Xarel·lo with aromas of white flowers, orange peel, and fresh anise, accompanied by subtle notes of lavender, green apple, and dried fruits. On the palate it is crisp, dry, and well balanced, showcasing vibrant acidity and a silky mousse that enhances its natural freshness. Flavours of citrus and white fruit unfold alongside mineral and Mediterranean herbal nuances, leading to a long, precise finish marked by purity and finesse, the true expression of Xarel·lo in its Brut Nature form.

Winery Description: Jorge Piernas is a small boutique winery, a family project that was born in Bullas (Murcia) in 2015 with the intention of creating quality wines. Where the Monastrell and Macabeo varieties, native varieties are the axis of the project where today 12 hectares of old and new vineyards are already being worked. Viticulture work is essential in this project, where organic and respectful cultivation are a key element in obtaining the best grapes. Everything is worked manually among the old vineyards practicing precision viticulture. The wine-growing area of Bullas is characterised by old vineyards at altitude and very limestone soils with a significant presence of gravel. Then in the winery we try to carry out a logical oenology, respecting what comes from the vineyards and without applying oenological products to the wine, thus reflecting as much as possible the landscape where our grapes are born. The wines rest in cement tanks, barrels and amphoras until they are bottled.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 390

Winery Description: José Antonio García is a passionate winemaker who cultivates over 150 micro-plots spread between Valtuille de Abajo and Corullón, exclusively old vines and primarily Mencía, though also including Godello, Doña Blanca, and other local varieties. His approach combines respect for the environment with minimal intervention, following organic viticulture practices and spontaneous fermentations with wild yeasts. By avoiding systemic treatments and tilling the soils as in days gone by, José Antonio seeks to preserve the biodiversity and authenticity of his terroir. José Antonio García's wines reflect the unique character of the mountains and valleys of El Bierzo. His creations stand out for their freshness, elegance, and the honest expression of a landscape rich in history and mineral diversity. His work is inspired by the precision of Burgundy, but with a deeply Bierzo soul, where small plots and artisanal processes are essential to achieving singular and distinctive wines.
Winery Location: El Puente s/n 0, 24530, VALTUILLE DE ABAJO , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 320

Winery Description: CAN XANET is a small vineyard of two hectares as well as a winery, both located in the north of Mallorca, in the foothills of the Sierra de Tramuntana and overlooking the sea. With a limestone soil and a special microclimate due to its location and using two types of foreign grapes and two Mallorcan ones, it makes a range of 4 red wines, 2 coupages and two single varietals of just over a thousand bottles each, as well as a rosé and a white, having as a project philosophy to make elegant wines in the Mediterranean. All wines have scores above 90 tento points in Parker as well as in Peñin. Production is between 15 and 20 thousand bottles.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 684

Winery Description: A family wine project in the Penedès, developed on an estate with documented origins dating back to the year 997. Josep Beltran is first and foremost a farmer, currently transitioning towards biodynamic viticulture, working his own vineyards organically with minimal intervention. The winery produces wines and ancestral-method sparkling wines in limited editions through spontaneous fermentations that express terroir. Highlights include Les Contrades wines and ancestral bottlings, such as the Ancestral Syrah Rosé and the new Macabeu & Sumoll Black Ancestral.
Winery Location: BRRI. CASTELLETA 5, 08793, AVINYONET DEL PENEDES , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 452

Aromas of tart apple, pear, plum and citrus, with a hint of vegetal notes and violet flowers in the background.
