Winery Description: Josep Foraster is a family winery located in Montblanc. We are dedicated to the production of "terroir" wines with the local varieties of the Conca de Barbera: macabeu for whites and trepat for reds. Organic and respectful viticulture; and elaboration adapted to the varieties.
Winery Location: C/ DE LA ERMITA DE SANT JOSEP S/N, 43400, MONTBLANC , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level , Street C, Stand 482

Winery Description: Josep Grau Viticultor is Josep Grau’s major life project. His wines are not influenced by trends, opinion leaders’ tastes or fads. Instead, they strive to be authentic and deeply imbued with the essence: Grau is convinced that outstanding wines can be made with very little, avoiding artifice and respecting the natural language of the vineyard. Altogether, in Montsant, Josep Grau farms 36 hectares of vineyards. Grau was attracted by the diversity of soils and terroirs in Montsant and their potential to make different wines. Since 2003, he has gradually incorporated vineyards that he acquired from winegrowers who no longer wanted to farm their vines, usually old Garnacha and Cariñena plots. Priorat was Josep Grau’s next foray into the region. He took this step after more than a decade monitoring this area of great telluric and mineral energy. In Priorat, we farm 6 hectares of vineyards in Gratallops.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 460

Winery Description: Juan Carlos Sancha, S.L., was founded in 2005 by Juan Carlos Sancha González, Doctor of Viticulture and Enology, Technical Engineer in Agricultural Industries, Degree in Oenology, Master in Viticulture and Oenology from the University of Polytechnic of Madrid, Diploma of Advanced Studies (Research Sufficiency). The company is engaged in the planting, cultivation of vineyards and the production, aging and marketing of wines under the Rioja Qualified Designation of Origin. Located in the municipality of Baños de Río Tobía (La Rioja), the winery was built in 2008, beginning in 2009 the commercialization of its wines. Modern and avant-garde design, it is equipped with the best existing technology to produce quality wines. Currently it has 27 ha of its own vineyard spread over more than 95 plots in the municipality of Baños de Río Tobía. The entire vineyard is cultivated using organic farming techniques, which will be produced in the own winery. The capacity is 130,000 kg of grapes.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street C, Stand 355

Winery Description: Júlia Bernet comes from a family devoted to farming. Its beginnings date back to 2003, when, after a disastrous and poorly paid harvest, Xavier and Cristina decided to return to making wine at home, just as their grandparents had done. Gradually, the grapes that had previously been sold in bulk began to be vinified in their own winery, and today the entire 7.5 hectares of vineyards are vinified in the small cellar. Around 30,000 bottles of sparkling wine are produced from mountain calcareous terroirs, with the distinctive feature that the vineyards are arranged in small dry-stone terraces and planted almost entirely with the Xarel·lo variety. The production is fully organic. It is based on respect for the terroir and the surrounding environment, mainly high-altitude mountains surrounded by pine forests. In the winery, the focus is on minimal-intervention winemaking in order to produce Corpinnats that truly represent and express the territory.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 602

Winery Name: JUVÉ & CAMPS / FINCA ESPIELLS / PAGOS DE ANGUIX
Winery Description: A contemporary expression of a family legacy dating back to 1796. A wine group with a global vision of the sector, bringing together the wineries Juvé & Camps (long-aged sparkling wines), Finca Espiells (still wines from the Penedès) and Pagos de Anguix (still wines from Ribera del Duero), alongside the distribution companies Primeras Marcas and Wine Merchant, as well as Insolity, creator of exclusive wine experiences. The group oversees the entire process, from its own agricultural estates (100% organic and cultivated using regenerative practices) to the glass, guided by an unwavering commitment to quality, excellence and sustainability. The Juvé family embodies a balance between tradition and innovation, with a sensitive yet rigorous approach and a clear vocation for the future.
Winery Location: SANT VENAT 1, 08770, SANT SADURNI D'ANOIA
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 145
Product 1 Description: Finca Espiells is the collection of still white wines from Juvé & Camps, embodying the most authentic expression of the Penedès. Its origins date back to 1957, when the Juvé family acquired their first estate in Espiells, setting in motion a project that has since evolved into one of the region’s most significant wine estates. This legacy is expressed through organic wines that pay tribute to that founding year, capturing the character and diversity of the Penedès. Set in a privileged location and grounded in a centuries-old tradition, the winery harmoniously combines respect for the land with an ongoing pursuit of excellence in each of its creations.
Product 2 Description: Juvé & Camps is a family-owned winery with a long-standing viticultural tradition, founded in 1796, and a producer of sparkling wines since 1921 in the Penedès region. Today, under the leadership of Meritxell Juvé, fourth generation of the family, the winery remains firmly rooted in its heritage while embracing a strong commitment to innovation. For more than 15 years, Juvé & Camps has farmed its 252 hectares of vineyards organically and practises regenerative viticulture to protect the environment, ensuring full control over the entire winemaking process. This century-old estate is renowned for its mastery of blending and as a pioneer of Brut Nature and long ageing, creating balanced and complex sparkling wines with outstanding ageing potential, elegance and a deep connection to the terroir
Product 3 Description: Pagos de Anguix is the Juvé family’s winery in Ribera del Duero, established in 2018 in the heart of the so-called Diamante Dorado. With 80 hectares of estate-owned, organically farmed vineyards planted at over 850 metres above sea level, it embodies a true “frontier Ribera”, where extreme climatic conditions and altitude give rise to wines of striking freshness and vibrancy. Under the oenological direction of José Manuel Pérez Ovejas, the winery produces four wines (Ocho Dos Dos, Costalara, Barrueco and Prado Lobo) each expressing the voice of the land with precision and authenticity. True to the Juvé family legacy, Pagos de Anguix brings together rigour, sustainability and excellence, channeling more than two centuries of winemaking passion into the Ribera del Duero.

Winery Location: CTRA CAN ROSSELL S/N, 08770, SANT SADURNI D'ANOIA
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 141

Winery Description: We are winegrowers and olive growers, with our own vineyards and 50 years of history. We focus on the premium segment of wines and extra virgin olive oils. Our main winery and vineyards are located in Vallbona de les Monges (Lleida), where we produce under the D.O. Costers del Segre, and we have another smaller winery with vineyards in Collserola (Barcelona), where the exclusive wine ‘Vinyes de Barcelona’ is produced. Everything is certified organic, with manual harvesting for better selection and limited production. Our wines and oils are highly rated in specialized guides, and we are present in some of the best restaurants in Catalonia. We are a social economy company with a clear mission: to create employment opportunities that promote the social inclusion of people with diverse abilities or in vulnerable situations, through the production of the finest wines and oils from our region.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 346
Product 1 Description: 100% Macabeo variety. Certified organic rainfed viticulture. Manual harvest. Most of the must ferments at a controlled temperature in American and French oak barrels. Ageing is carried out on the lees of the wine for 6-8 months with weekly battonage to increase the volume in the mouth and seek a finer and more elegant integration of the wood into the wine. The rest of the must ferments in stainless steel tanks and then some is aged in cement tanks and another in amphora. Good harmony with all kinds of rice, ceviche and roasted vegetables.
Product 2 Description: Brut Nature sparkling wine according to the traditional method (second fermentation in the bottle), under the D.O. Costers del Segre. Manual harvest. The base wine ferments at a controlled temperature (17-18ºC) in stainless steel tanks. The subsequent blend of the Macabeu and Parellada varieties seeks freshness and elegance. The bottle is drawn in the months of February and March, with a minimum rest in cava of 15 months at a temperature ranging between 12 and 15ºC, with humidity also controlled. Disgorgement is done by hand and at room temperature, progressively and in small batches. Before putting the cork stopper in the bottle, we have just filled it with the same sparkling wine from the harvest, without adding additional sugars.
Product 3 Description: Garnacha Tinta, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cariñena. Certified organic rainfed viticulture. Harvested by hand in small boxes of 10-12 kilos. Subsequently, the grapes ferment with the whole grain in pigeage tanks with periodic sinking of the cap and at a controlled temperature of 25-28ºC. The aging is done in cement tanks for 4 months and then rests in the bottle. Intense nose, with notes of ripe grape, aromas of black plum and liquorice and a warm touch. On the palate it is sweet and round, with a good volume and a marked presence of the sweet touch of Grenache. Hints of tobacco and raisins with mineral notes. Good harmony with all types of game meats. Excellent accompaniment to dishes based on duck or traditional meat cannelloni.

Winery Description: Our Winery is a young project that was born in 2016, as an initiative of the third generation of vine growers of the Pelayo’s family (3 Brothers), with the aim of recovering vineyards, old vines and making quality wine by taking up the ancestral techniques of the Region of La Manchuela. We are located in Alcalá del Júcar, in the province of Albacete, one of the towns with most charm of Spain, which was declared a Historic-Artistic patronage by Royal Decree in 1982. Located in a natural area formed by the gorge of the river Júcar, in an area that offers infinite possibilities for rural and adventure tourism. Our vineyards, framed between the valleys of the Júcar and Cabriel rivers, are cultivated at a height of 700 meters above sea level and are very close to the winery in the area of Las Eras, within the municipality of Alcalá del Júcar (530 m above sea level) and covers 33 hectares of indigenous vines recovered from Macabeo,Bobal and Cencibel, aged between 30 and 80 years.
Winery Location: BATÁN 9, 02210, ALCALA DEL JUCAR , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 166

Winery Description: La Conreria is a family-owned winery founded in 1997 by winemaker Jordi Vidal. A benchmark within the DOQ Priorat, it was a pioneer in the production of white wines in the appellation and is currently the leading winery in terms of white wine volume and organic vineyard surface. Located in Escaladei, a region defined by a demanding terrain and a strong winemaking tradition, La Conreria is committed to manual and respectful viticulture, focusing most of its efforts on vineyard work. This philosophy is based on a clear belief: wine is made in the vineyard, not in the winery. Our wines aim to faithfully express their origin and the work behind each plot, always prioritizing fruit as the core of their sensory profile. This approach allows us to offer a diverse and balanced portfolio, well aligned with current international market trends.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 588
Product 1 Description: Les Brugueres Blanc is an elegant, identity-driven wine born in the heart of Priorat. It represents the first white wine ever produced within the denomination. Made from 100% Garnacha Blanca, it undergoes a 75-hour pre-fermentative skin maceration, followed by fermentation at controlled temperature and subsequent aging on fine lees in stainless steel tanks for 5 months. Pale yellow in color with greenish highlights, it displays an intense aromatic profile of tropical fruits and apricot, with subtle mint notes emerging as the wine opens. On the palate, it is glyceric and full-bodied, filling the mouth with texture. It shows a very well-balanced acidity and a long, persistent finish. Alcohol content: 13.5%
Product 2 Description: Primera Vinya is the first historic vineyard of La Conreria, a symbol of the estate’s origins and local tradition. It serves as a benchmark for the winery’s entire production. GRAPE VARIETIES 100% Garnacha Blanca WINEMAKING PROCESS First stage of fermentation with indigenous yeast. Skin maceration for 48 hours. Fermentation at 15 °C in 400-liter French oak barrels. Aging on lees in the same barrel for 9 months. Limited production of three barrels. TASTING NOTES Straw yellow color, intense nose of ripe stone fruits, with clear notes of incense, hints of freshly cut hay, and subtle mint in the finish. Slightly tannic on the palate, with a glyceric texture, where the oak respects the wine’s character and acidity is perfectly balanced, very lively. Long finish. ALCOHOL CONTENT 14%
Product 3 Description: GRAPE VARIETIES 60% Carignan and 40% Garnacha Negra. WINEMAKING PROCESS First stage of fermentation with indigenous yeast. Cold maceration and fermentation with skins. Aged for 12 months in 500-liter French and Austrian oak barrels. Minimum cellar aging of 18 months. TASTING NOTES Intense cherry-red color with purple highlights. Very fresh nose reminiscent of red fruits, with clear notes of Mediterranean herbs and subtle floral hints, all layered with gentle smoky aromas and wet slate. On the palate, it is full-bodied yet very fresh, remaining lively throughout its long finish. ALCOHOL CONTENT 14.5%

Winery Description: From my native Penedès, with glass demijohns, oak, and stainless steel. La Fita was born in 2021 with the aim of giving value to the family vineyards of Cal Nogués and Can Patomas and capturing their unique landscape in every bottle. After several harvests in Argentina, Austria, and Priorat, I returned to my native Penedès with the ambition of showing the world, through our wines, the full potential of this land and revaluing the family vineyards. The vineyards are grown organically and vinified with minimal intervention but maximum precision. The result is sincere and vertical wines that faithfully express the unique soils of the Anoia River Basin.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 228
Product 1 Description: Ancestral 2024: 100% Macabeo, a sparkling wine made using the ancestral method from the vineyards of Can Patomàs. The grandparents used to make cava years ago by purchasing base wine. Now, the bubbles from home are also made with grapes from home, everything makes more sense! Fine and well-integrated bubbles, as we bottle aiming for 4.5/5 bars of pressure instead of the "usual" 6, creating a refreshing wine with aromatic intensity on the nose and volume and roundness on the palate. --- Awarded Best Ancestral of Catalonia by the Guia de Vins de Catalunya 2024 ---
Product 2 Description: The La Fita wine range includes: Vinya de Creu 2024 – 80% Macabeo and 20% Malvasía de Sitges, co-fermented with spontaneous yeasts and aged 6 months in glass demijohns. Fresh, vertical, and low in alcohol. Sumoll Negre 2024 – 100% Sumoll Negre, delicate yet robust, with vertical acidity and moderate tannins, aged in old American oak barrels. Ancestral 2024 – 100% Macabeo, made using the ancestral method, fine and integrated bubbles, refreshing, intense on the nose, and with volume on the palate. Awarded Best Ancestral in Catalonia by the 2024 Catalonia Wine Guide. Els Arpiots 2023 – 80% Xarel·lo and 20% Macabeo, representing the union of the two family branches. Aromas of white fruit such as vineyard peach. Xarel·lo de les Granges 2023 – 100% Xarel·lo, from the Mulet-Artis family, 7 days with skins and 6 months in stainless steel. Expresses care for the land and family tradition.
Product 3 Description: Vinya de Creu 2024: 80% Macabeo and 20% Malvasía de Sitges. Harvested on the same day, aiming to capture the aromatic profile of the Macabeo and the acidity of the Malvasía. Co-fermentation of both varieties with spontaneous yeasts and aged for 6 months in glass demijohns. It is a fresh and vertical wine with low alcohol content. The wine that started the project.

Winery Description: The project La Forastera has its origins in 2018 when we started to work on some old vineyards and orchards. In total the surface stretches 3,4 ha. of vineyard, partly in production, other parts need to be replanted, and some orchards with almond and olive trees (1,1 ha.). The property is owned by my family in law and is situated in the hills of Font-Rubi (Penedès - Catalunya), located in a zone which is called Vinyes de les Serres Velles which means Vineyards of the old mountains. An hour land inwards from Barcelona. The grape varieties we work with are Parellada, Macabeo and Sumoll and Xarel.lo. Varieties typical for the Penedès. The wines are made with the use of indigenous yeast, unfiltered, no added sulphur nor the use of any other oenological tricks. Just pure fermented grape juice. Our idea is that the vineyards provide healthy grapes and with minimal intervention we create beautiful wines with skin maceration variable from 6 hours to 6 weeks to 6 months more or less.

Winery Description: LAFOU Celler was founded in 2007 and was born out of a desire to make wines that reflect the greatness of the Grenache grape in the extraordinary winemaking region which is Terra Alta. The region's landscape, the vine terraces and the ravines "fous" are an ideal setting for this grape variety to express itself to the full.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 408
Product 1 Description: Winemaking plot by plot. The grapes are harvested manually and are immediately refrigerated at 5ºC in the winery. They are then transferred to stainless-steel tanks with an aerial pump over (pigeage) system. The grapes are fermented at 26ºC with three daily pump overs, which results in a more harmonic extraction of the tannins. The wine is then aged for 6 months in 300L European oak barrels. This wine includes a small percentage of the Morenillo variety as part of a project to recover this local grape. The name “El Sender” means “The Path”, which was inspired by a path that winds through the vineyards at Mas Gabrielet.
Product 2 Description: A pioneer in the white garnatxa grape style, different tasks are carried out to extract the best virtues of each grapevine. Pale yellow and with a rich aromatic expression, in which the citrus and floral notes give way to nuances of ripe fruit and tender almond. In the mouth, it has a generous structure and a lively acidity, with a long finish.

Winery Description: Family-run winery located in the Rías Baixas D.O. We work with our own carefully managed vineyards and a philosophy that respects the environment, seeking to express the authenticity of the terroir in every wine. The harvest takes place at the optimal moment of ripeness, and the winemaking process combines traditional techniques with modern technology. Our wines stand out for their balance, elegance, and personality, reflecting the unique character of their origin. Our production is carefully controlled and limited, allowing us to guarantee a high standard in every bottle.

Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 335

Winery Description: On the axis between the Pyrenees and the Ebro river valley, there stands the largest gypsum mountain range in Europe, a unique place where we make fine wines: it is called “La Serra Llarga”. As our grandparents would say, we live in the best part of the country, possibly even the best part of the world, to grow fruit. The secret lies in the soil of our terroirs, rich in gypsum, that provides our wines with freshness and salinity, making them absolutely gastronomic. In Lagravera we maintain all our production processes as naturally as possible, observing and accompanying the grape without relinquishing any technical advances that might ensure the high quality of our wines. We heal the vineyards with plants and take care of them observing the moon and the stars, respecting the flora, the fauna and the cosmos. This means recovering our great grandparent's heritage, while getting diverse nuances and elegant complexities in every vintage.
Winery Location: CTRA. TAMARITE 3, 25120, ALFARRAS , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 612

Winery Description: Bodega La Haya was founded in 2001 in Tenerife, within the Valle de La Orotava D.O.P., as a continuation of a family winemaking tradition. We work with historic vineyards in Los Realejos, where volcanic soils, trade winds and Atlantic influence create a unique environment. Our vines, which are more than 200 years old, are grown ungrafted using the ancestral Braided Cord system, exclusive to the area and a symbol of artisanal and respectful viticulture. We make white wines with a strong identity from Listán Blanco and other valuable native Canarian varieties. Our philosophy combines tradition and technology to preserve the authenticity of the vineyard. Production is very limited – 13,000 bottles per year – which guarantees exclusivity and maximum quality. As a differentiating element, we participate in an innovative underwater breeding project, The current range includes five limited edition whites, designed for markets that value origin, history and differentiation.

Product 2 Description: Located at the edge of the town towards the mountains, the ‘Camino del Bosque’ (Forest Path) gives its name to this wine, made with traditional local varieties Macabeo and Garnacha Blanca. Garnacha Blanca contributes volume on the palate, notes of citrus peel and fennel. The philosophy behind this wine is based on respect for the historical blends of the area, where the varieties coexisted on the same plot. It seeks to enhance the synergy between both grapes and result in a wine with identity, balance and the ability to evolve in the bottle. Ageing 6 months on its lees without light battonage. Half in concrete and half in 500-litre untreated oak barrels. Homogenisation and storage in stainless steel prior to bottling, to finish ageing in the bottle inside the cave.
Product 3 Description: It comes from an area called “El Pedregal” (translated: “The Rocky Ground”. It is a difficult land to work where a great quantity and variety of stones do not allow to see the ground beneath. It aims to show the tremendous potential of this variety, the only one in the world that gets its name from the place where it was born. Vineyards: Two plots located in El Pedregal, about 600 meters above sea level. The vines are about 40 years old. Silt and clay horizons with a diversity of stones and boulders. Winemaking: Hand harvest with selection in the vine & secondly on the selection line. Spontaneous fermentation (from its wild yeasts) at 23-25ºC and soft extraction at controlled temperature. Light pressing. Maceration during 12 days, until pressing. Ageing: 12 months in wooden foudre, concrete and 500L oak barrels in the cave.

Winemaking: Both varieties are elaborated & aged separately, and remain about 75 days with their skins. Ageing: The Garnacha Blanca is aged during 18 months in clay jar/amphora. The Muscat of Alexandria, 20 months in 500L untoasted french oak barrel.
Product 5 Description: “Paco El Feo” is the nickname that my grandfather’s brother received because of all the mischief he did, and how honest he was. And it’s also how my father baptized this wine‘s vineyard when he saw it. The plot was completely abandoned, isolated and in a plagued area of rabbits, for which we had to fence it off. As Paco, this wine is direct, deep & with energy, aiming to show the maximum expression of this variety with highest quality & potential, through frankness with the vine and minimal intervention in the winery. Vineyard: Small plot of 80 year old vines. It has extremely poor soils and high sand content in its first horizons, which reduces water retention during maturity. Presence of calcareous veins. Hand harvest with selection in the vine & secondly on the selection line. Spontaneous fermentation (from its wild yeasts) in a wooden foudre, daily battonage, maceration during 12-15 days. 14 months in 500L French oak barrels in the cave.

Product 2 Description: For all those people who are passionate about innovation, who dare to try new things and who value a quality product made with extreme care, we present the only barrel-aged patxaran. Starting from our Patxaran Gaizka (91 points in the Peñin Guide) made with boneless sloes, we wanted to age it in barrels with an intermediate toasting with wood in the traditional style. The use of American oak barrels from the forests of Ohio gives the patxaran nuances of vanilla and caramel, providing an elegant yet complex result. Sloe, vanilla, wood and anise are some of the aromas that welcome us. Once tasted, the unctuous impact of the texture makes us want to explore the patxaran, finding a clear presence of the freshness of the sloes with echoes of fresh wood, which contrast with the presence and sweetness of notes of anise, cherry and vanilla.
Product 3 Description: Para todas aquellas personas apasionadas de la innovación, atrevidas en probar cosas nuevas y que valoren un producto de calidad elaborado con un mimo extremo, os presentamos este vermouth Barañano EGURREZ envejecido en una barrica que anteriormente fue utilizada para madurar whisky escoces de Islay de la marca Ardbeg. Debido a que esta barrica ha estado durante 20 años envejeciendo whisky escoces, serán el humo y la turba los principales aromas que va a aportar a nuestro vermouth, además de una untuosidad, solidez y persistencia excepcionales. El vermouth que hemos introducido en esta barrica está elaborado inspirado en una receta de nuestro tatarabuelo de 1881 que tras 15 meses de envejecimiento se ha visto sometido a un escrutinio exhaustivo para garantizar que la madera y el vermut alcanzan un nivel de armonía y equilibrio deseados por nuestros expertos. Un vermut único, atípico, madurado en una barrica irrepetible.

Winery Description: LLANOS NEGROS WE ARE LOOKING FOR PENINSULA DISTRIBUTORS AND INTERNATIONAL IMPORTERS Located in the municipality of Fuencaliente de La Palma - Canary Islands, in the south of the island, where its soils are volcanic and very young. The vineyards bury their roots in the ashes that were once spewed by the different volcanoes. Viticulture in Fuencaliente is configured as a closed landscape of singular beauty in a difficult and fragile environment. It is impossible to evaluate the wines of the Llanos Negros without knowing the environment from which they come and the special characteristics that their production requires. Heroic viticulture has excellent quality potential, but it involves an enormous economic and human effort. Our cultivation system does not allow us to introduce any type of mechanization, so the work must be done by hand. Winery Description: EX VITE VITA "Life stems from the vine" The winegrowing tradition of the Llopart family has been rooted in the family Estate in Subirats since the XIV Century. Our 102 hectares of ecologically cultivated mountain vineyards are located on shady slopes on the highest areas of the Penedés, where they grow on Miocene soils. Our oldest vines, planted 70 to 90 years ago, are located in a protected natural area in Catalunya (PEIN). Our family has been producing quality sparkling wines for more than 135 years, strongly defending the traditional method and craftsmanship of the wine, with respect for sustainability and always seeking the authenticity of lengthy ageing. Llopart is co-founder of the new Collective brand of the European Union CORPINNAT. This brand distinguishes great sparkling wines made in the heart of the Penedès, with indigenous grapes grown organically, manually harvested and vinified at the estate.

Its name comes from the family motto Ex Vite Vita, paying tribute to the essential origin of all wines: the vine (vite). Limited and numbered edition of 4,250 bottles. Product 3 Description: 100% Xarel·lo from the Vinya del Paulino (planted in 1935) Aged for more than 12 years. Minimum rest of 6 months in the cellar after disgorgement. Brut Nature Limited production of 1,132 bottles, of which we have disgorged 862 in February 2025. The remaining 270 continue the aging process in the Family Wine Library. Llegat Familiar is a wine with an eternal vocation, the mark that the passage of time has left on us and on the landscape, it is the culmination of everything we have learned and the sublimation of the uniqueness of the estate. Recognized as Best Wine, Best Sparkling Wine, and Best Sparkling Wine of Xarel·lo by the Guía de Vins de Catalunya 2025.

Product 1 Description: Toro is a lesser-known region of Spain but home to some of its finest wines made from the Tinta de Toro grape, the original un-grafted variety of the Tempranillo grape, which produces wine with more colour and higher tannin levels than Tempranillo elsewhere in Spain. Traditionally associated with bull-fighting and bull running and for its gusty robust reds, the region is now producing more elegant and modern wines. Bos, which is produced for us at the Covitoro winery, displays all the typical deep colour and rich fruity aromas but has been made with deliberately restrained tannins to provide smoother, much more elegant drinking. Fittingly the label features an elegant image of the the region’s defining image and the wine is named after the genus for cattle.
Product 2 Description: A deep violet-red.An intense aroma of chocolate, forest fruits (blackberries, blackcurrants, etc.) and vanilla.Persistent and full of flavour, thanks to the perfect balance of acidity and mature tannins.Suitable for combining with a wide range of dishes, from meat, starters and rice to heavier dishes such as stews and barbecues.

A base wine is made from free run juice in stainless steel tanks at controlled temperatures. A second fermentation in pressurized stainless steel tanks creates natural bubbles while retaining the fresh fruit flavours.

Son vinos de un tempranillo intenso y afrutado, con uvas de vides de al menos 30 años, que crecen en altura en viñedos propiedad de la bodega. Nos encanta su presentación nueva que refleja la herencia clásica de la región y transmite el mensaje de rabiosa actualidad sobre la importancia del trabajo de las mujeres.

Winery Description: Los Insensatos is a project that goes beyond a simple brand, representing a philosophy based on passion, creativity and innovation. Under the direction of the winemaker Fátima Ceballos, a multidisciplinary team works from the historic winery of the Cañada Navarro, in the Sierra de Montilla, with the aim of renewing the way of understanding and making the wines of the region. The project is committed to the reinterpretation of wine from a modern perspective, promoting native varieties and seeking the maximum expression of the terroir, without renouncing inherited knowledge. Through limited and exclusive productions, Los Insensatos highlights the uniqueness of the territory, prioritizing talent and quality over rigid tradition. With a young, fresh and carefree identity, its philosophy is based on creating unique wines capable of generating intense experiences, sharing and enjoying the passion for wine to the fullest.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 158
Product 1 Description: El Barco is a wine deeply linked to the origin of the family and the landscape that surrounds it. It comes from the first vineyard planted by Los Insensatos' grandfather, Manuel and Santiago, after the great loss caused by phylloxera. In those vines he took his first steps as a winegrower and winemaker. The vineyard is located in Cerro Macho, one of the highest areas of the Sierra de Montilla, and is one of the highest vineyards in the appellation. Its century-old vines, which are more slender in size than the traditional goblet heads of the area, grow well aerated, in organic cultivation. Made from Pedro Ximénez grapes, it ferments and is aged in concrete jars, on lees and under a veil of flor. In the glass it shows a delicate and precise profile, with fresh aromas and subtle herbaceous and citrus notes. On the palate it is vertical and balanced, with a marked freshness, fine texture and a long and serene finish. El Barco is the beginning of a history and the continuity of a way of understanding the vineyard.
Product 2 Description: Lechinar is the subtlety of the mountains transformed into wine. Coming from Pedro Ximénez vines grown in an environment surrounded by lechines olive trees and the breeze of the Benavente stream, this wine exudes a delicate, almost silent freshness; like a sunrise to the south. Its nose invites with fresh, soft fruit, perhaps pear, with a sweet background that embraces the palate. On the palate it is voluminous and generous, balanced, full-bodied and elegant. It is the wine that is born from patience, from manual harvesting and from the calm of a quiet hillside.
Product 3 Description: El Pretil comes from a plot near the press, with lighter and shallower soils, where the grape fights to live – compact, thicker-skinned – giving rise to a wine with a firm soul and character. Fermented in concrete jars and aged for 7 months under a veil of flor on fine lees, El Pretil embodies the sincere tradition and mineral purity of the land of Antehojuela. On the nose there is clean minerality, freshness, spicy brushstrokes; On the palate, its character is vertical, saline, persistent and with a vibration reminiscent of stone, wind, and landscape. It is a wine for those who value honesty: without artifice, without ornaments, straight to the origin "A white that does not seek complacency: direct, sincere, with the salt of the mountains, the minerality of the soil and the humble footprint of the grape that struggles to be."

Winery Description: From Vilobí del Penedès, Loxarel works the land with the conviction that wine must express the place where it is born. The Penedès offers an ideal Mediterranean climate, diverse soils and a distinctive light that filters through each bunch. The boundaries of the DO -the first in the world to be 100% organic- are, for Loxarel, a framework for exploring the identity of the territory: organic and biodynamic wines that breathe the landscape and capture the essence of their surroundings. At its winery in Vilobí del Penedès, Loxarel crafts amphora wines, characterful natural wines, expressive sparkling wines and native-variety wines that are once again coming into their own.

Winery Description: FLORENTINO MARTÍNEZ MONJE is the soul and the strength of Luberri-Monje Amestoy. LUBERRI is a life project with which we express how we understand wine, and how we live, enjoy and make enjoy it. We convey something very simple yet deep: a very own personality. And for this we have a basis of unquestionable quality, the Tempranillo grape which is native to our region, Rioja Alavesa. From this reality, we create something unique, the Luberri character.The base is the carbonic maceration method, traditional of Rioja Alavesa. In crianzas and in high-expression reserves, we do a first grape selection in the same vineyard picking the best fruits of the oldest vines. Then, to make the wine, the cellar is equipped with cutting edge technology such as stainless steel tanks, cooling equipment and other advanced features. Another strength is the barrel room, furnished with 750 barriques of French and American oak.

The wine is then aged for twelve months in new Burgundy-style French oak barrels and for two more months in a concrete egg-shaped tanks. The process ends with six months of ageing in bottles before the wine is placed on the market. With Las Salinas Beltza we wanted to reinvent ourselves, using traditional techniques to create a well-structured wine, keeping the fruity identity of Luberri wines intact but with a sophisticated touch that makes it a very special wine. PAIRING: White and red meats. Roasted lamb, pork or beef, game, poultry, stewed meats, rice dishes, stewed vegetables, mushrooms, cured and blue cheeses. CONSUMPTION TEMPERATURE: 14ºC
Product 3 Description: VARIETAL CONTENT: Tempranillo (95%), Viura (5%). GRAPE HARVEST: September-October. Product 1 Description: GRAPE TYPE: RED VARIETY: TEMPRANILLO & VIURA VINTAGE: 2024 ORIGIN: RIOJA ALAVESA A scintillating wine from vineyards between Viñaspre and Elvillar, made with Tempranillo and a touch of Viura. It rests for a year in concrete tanks, revealing remarkable freshness and vibrancy. Part of the wine is made using the traditional carbonic maceration technique. On the nose, it is fresh and displays abundant red fruit. On the palate, it is smooth and refreshing, very pleasant to drink.
Product 2 Description: GRAPE TYPE: RED VARIETY: TEMPRANILLO VINTAGE: 2024 ORIGIN: RIOJA ALAVESA Tempranillo predominates, accompanied by other white varieties (Garnacha, Viura, Malvasía, etc.). The vineyard sits at an altitude of 580 meters, with clay-limestone soil and a gentle southeast slope. On the nose, it offers elegant, mineral aromas with hints of red and black fruit. On the palate, it is balanced and fresh, with lively yet delicate tannins.
Product 3 Description: GRAPE TYPE: RED VARIETY: GRACIANO VINTAGE: 2024 ORIGIN: RIOJA ALAVESA This single-varietal Graciano is born in Elvillar, a single-vineyard wine that expresses altitude and character. On the nose, with its intense color and vibrant aroma, it reveals black fruit, violets, and a touch of fresh herbs. On the palate, it is energetic and elegant, with firm tannins and a long finish that leaves the fresh imprint of its mountain origin.
Product 4 Description: GRAPE TYPE: WHITE VARIETY: VIURA VINTAGE: 2024 ORIGIN: RIOJA ALAVESA From old Viura vines in different vineyards of Elvillar, this wine reflects the tranquility of its land and the wisdom of time. On the nose, subtly aged in oak barrels, it offers hints of citrus and spice. On the palate, it is ample and structured, with an elegant finish.
Product 5 Description: GRAPE TYPE: RED VARIETY: TEMPRANILLO & GRACIANO VINTAGE: 2024 ORIGIN: RIOJA ALAVESA A village wine made exclusively from Elvillar vineyards. Tempranillo defines its character, while Graciano adds freshness and balance. Oak aging results in a complex wine that doesn't compromise its terroir. On the nose, it offers fresh red and black fruit, subtle floral notes, and a slightly herbaceous background. On the palate, it is smooth and well-defined, with fine tannins, good acidity, and a clean, persistent finish. A balanced wine, true to its origin.

With a total of 23 hectares, we cultivate the vineyards on terraces due to the steep orography of the area and we work on licorella soils. We produce wines that convey the character of the area with the carignan and grenache varieties, mainly.

Product 1 Description: Young red wine with a cherry red color with bluish tones that denote complexity. Made from 60% grenache, 35% carignan and 10% cabernet sauvignon. 20% of the wine is aged for 6 months in oak barrels, which are then mixed with the rest of the wine. It is then aged in stainless steel tanks before bottling. The nose highlights the aroma of ripe red fruit with subtle touches of wood. Elegant on the palate and persistent aftertaste.
Product 2 Description: A classic and elegant red wine with modern touches and excellent balance. Made from 65% Carignan, 25% Grenache, and 10% Cabernet Sauvignon. Aged for 12 months in french (75%) and american (25%) oak barrels. It features prominent aromas of red fruit with hints of wood and chocolate, as well as balsamic and mineral notes.
Product 3 Description: Dry white wine with a light lemon color. Made from 80% white Grenache and 20% Macabeo. Fermented in stainless steel and matured on fine lees for 4 months. It has a medium intensity and aromas of green fruit, stone fruit, citrus, floral, autolytic and mineral. Good acidity and aging potential.

Winery Description: Majuelos Iberia is a wine project developer specialized in the creation and management of distinctive Spanish wine projects with a strong international focus. Our work is rooted in respect for origin, tradition and terroir, combined with a strategic vision aimed at building wines that are coherent, recognizable and commercially relevant in international markets. Behind Majuelos Iberia is a multidisciplinary team with solid experience in viticulture, winemaking and international trade, working closely and with long-term commitment on each project. We believe in wines that tell an authentic story, in the value of terroir, and in making thoughtful decisions from the vineyard through to market positioning. Our projects span several Spanish wine regions, highlighting native grape varieties, local landscapes and individual styles. Each wine is crafted with consistency and honesty, preserving its identity while meeting the expectations of demanding importers and consumers.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 124

Winery Description: WE WERE BORN IN THE VINEYARD GENERATIONS AGO. WE ARE THE SUM OF OUR ANCESTORS AND THOSE WHO WILL COME AFTER US. WE DON’T FOLLOW ANY LEADER: WE FOLLOW OUR INSTINCT. WE BREAK RULES, LIVE TO THE FULLEST, AND MAKE THE WINE WE WANT TO DRINK. WE ARE PROUD OF WHO WE ARE: THE GOOD… AND THE MALCARÁCTER. MALCARÁCTER IS HIGH-ALTITUDE TEMPRANILLO, AN ORGANIC WINE THAT SPEAKS OF OUR LAND. AND IT IS ALSO TINTA ROSA, OUR OTHER SIDE: FRESH, IRREVERENT, AND FREE. WINES BORN IN THE D.O. RIBERA DEL DUERO AND IN THE D.O. TORO, WITH ALL THE STRENGTH AND PERSONALITY OF THESE UNIQUE LANDS. WE ARE MALCARÁCTER. AND WE DON’T KNOW HOW TO BE ANYTHING ELSE.

Product 1 Description: Tinta Rosa is a project created in 2015 by three friends united by their passion for wine and for the centenary vineyards of Toro. We make wines in small productions from vines between 60 and more than 120 years old, currently in conversion to organic, seeking to express the authenticity and character of the territory. - Tinta Rosa 3 months is our freshest and most accessible version: vibrant fruit, balance and smoothness after a brief aging in barrels. - Tinta Rosa Selección, with 12 months in barrels and grapes from 60–80 year old vines, offers more complexity, structure and elegance. - Tinta Rosa Integral Elaboration is our most exclusive wine, from a pre-phylloxera vineyard in 1906 and made entirely in barrels, with 22 months of aging and an extremely limited production.
Product 2 Description: Malcaracter: High-altitude Tempranillo born in the coolest areas of Fuentenebro, at almost 1,000 metres above sea level. An organic wine that combines freshness, fruit and elegance. Its production and ageing process, 50% in concrete and 50% in French and American oak barrels for 3 months, provides balance, softness and an authentic expression of the terroir. Malcarácter Limited: The most serious and profound version of our project. Organic Tempranillo from selected plots in Honrubia de la Cuesta and Fuentenebro, at an altitude of almost 1,000 metres. Fermented in stainless steel and aged for 12 months in pre-owned French and American oak barrels, it offers exceptional concentration and complexity.
Product 3 Description: Malcarácter Verdejo is our most honest and fresh interpretation of the D.O. Rueda. It comes from a single organic plot in Pozaldez, at an altitude of 790 metres, where sandy soils with pebbles provide purity, tension and varietal expression. The night harvest and fermentation in stainless steel preserve all the freshness of the fruit, while its 6 months on fine lees give it volume, creaminess and a very elegant texture. On the nose it shows intense aromas of green apple, pear, citrus and a typical herbal touch of the Verdejo. On the palate it is vibrant, balanced and with a long and clean finish, marked by refreshing acidity and a subtle mineral hint. An organic, modern and versatile wine, perfect to share and enjoy at any time.

Winery Description: MANCHÓN & MIERES is a boutique winery, located in the municipality of Pesquera de Duero. In the heart of the Golden Mile. Our first elaboration was in 2014. We understand wine, the result of the creative activity of the human being, as a cultural product, with complexity comparable to a work of art. We understand wine as the expression of a land, marked by the rigor of the climate, the exceptionality. of the soil and the work of a family determined to achieve the maximum excellence of its wines, in which power and elegance go hand in hand. We have 17 hectares of vineyards in Pesquera de Duero, in a privileged location due to its altitude of 900 meters. The wines linked to the MANCHON MIERES winery are different and distinguished from others in their surroundings because we only use grapes from our vineyards, in a single payment, to give rise to personal wines with a constancy of quality over time.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 136

Winery Description: Marco Abella – A Story of Roots and Passion The Marco family, winemakers since the 15th century in Porrera (Priorat), moved to Barcelona in the 19th century. A century later, Olivia Bayés and David Marco decided to return to their roots, building a modern winery and recovering the family vineyards, guided by the passion and sensitivity that only a family of poets can convey. Family is our core value, deeply committed to a land that gives prestige and character to our wines. Each bottle of Marco Abella reflects the essence of the terroir that nurtured it. Our estate vineyards, located between 450 and 750 meters above sea level on slate soils (llicorella), allow optimal phenolic ripening and impart freshness, finesse, and balance to the wines. We work with native varieties, Garnacha and Cariñena, to create authentic, expressive wines that faithfully convey the typicity of our terroirs, blending tradition, modernity, and elegance in every glass.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 542
Product 1 Description: CLOS ABELLA – The flagship wine of Marco Abella Clos Abella is the iconic wine of Marco Abella, the first produced by the winery and the most internationally recognized. It represents the essence of the estate and the purest expression of its terroir. It comes from old family vines since the 15th century, located around the winery in the El Perer vineyard, at 450–550 meters, north-facing. Made from Cariñena and Garnacha, parcels are harvested and vinified separately through microvinifications. After fermentation in French oak barrels, the wine is also aged in oak, achieving complexity, structure, and unique character. Llicorella gresosa slate soils, formed over 360 million years ago, limit yields and add depth and minerality. On the nose, it is intense and profound, with ripe black fruit, orange peel, sweet spices, cocoa, and balsamic notes. On the palate, it is silky, velvety, and fresh, with fine tannins and a long finish. A wine elegant and highly seductive.
Product 2 Description: LOIDANA – The Gateway to Priorat Loidana is an invitation to discover Priorat through freshness, elegance and authenticity. Conceived as a welcoming introduction to this prestigious appellation, it represents the most approachable and joyful expression of Marco Abella’s character, without renouncing typicity or respect for the land. It is born in a unique high-altitude vineyard environment, sourced from seven estate-owned plots located between 500 and 750 meters above sea level, on the summits of seven different mountains with varied orientations and slate soils. This altitude brings freshness, finesse and a distinctive mineral expression. Made from Cariñena, Garnacha and Cabernet Sauvignon, each plot is vinified separately in concrete tanks, followed by ageing for 8 months in French oak barrels. Aromatic and expressive, it offers notes of red and black fruits, flowers, spices and cedar. On the palate it is smooth, velvety and fresh, with a vibrant finish. Versatile and food-friendly.
Product 3 Description: LOIDANA BLANC – The white essence of Priorat Loidana Blanc expresses the great aromatic intensity and authenticity of Marco Abella’s terroir from the highest vineyards of Porrera, in the heart of Priorat. It is a versatile and joyful wine, perfect for any occasion, reflecting a fresh and luminous interpretation of the region. It is born in the Masos d’en Ferran and La Creu vineyards, located between 500 and 600 meters above sea level, on north-facing slopes that preserve natural freshness while providing finesse and vibrancy. Crafted from a unique blend of Picapoll, Garnacha Blanca, Macabeo and Viognier, each vineyard and variety is fermented separately in French oak barrels, with no ageing, in order to preserve the purest expression of the terroir. On the nose, it is intense and expressive, with notes of tropical and white fruit, white flowers and a mineral background. On the palate it is fresh, complex and vibrant, with lively acidity and a long, elegant finish.
Product 4 Description: MAS MALLOLA – Vi de Vila of Porrera Mas Mallola is Marco Abella’s Vi de Vila and the purest expression of the village of Porrera. It is born in the La Mallola vineyard, the estate’s highest plot, reaching up to 750 meters above sea level. This altitude, combined with its south-facing orientation and the influence of Mediterranean sea breezes, allows for slow, balanced ripening, resulting in a refined, elegant wine with a subtle saline note. Made from Garnacha and Cariñena, the grapes are harvested and vinified by zones through microvinifications to respect the vineyard’s natural differences in ripeness. After fermentation in oak vats, the wine is aged for 13 months in French oak barrels. Marked by the minerality of llicorella slate soils, it shows intense aromas of fresh red fruit, flowers and hints of anise, fennel and sweet vanilla. On the palate it is fresh, smooth and well-balanced, with velvety tannins and a long, harmonious finish.
Product 5 Description: OLBIA – A white wine with the soul of a red Olbia is born in the Masos d’en Ferran estate, a small north-facing amphitheatre in Porrera at 600 meters above sea level. Its unique location, slate llicorella soils and cool microclimate give the wine a deep, complex personality strongly shaped by its terroir. Produced in very limited quantities, Olbia expresses the purest essence of Priorat in a white wine. Made from Garnacha Blanca and Viognier, the varieties are vinified separately. Fifty percent of the wine is fermented and aged for 6 months in French oak barrels, while the remaining half is fermented in stainless steel and aged on fine lees, adding structure, texture and balance. On the nose, it shows great aromatic intensity with notes of ripe fruit, white flowers, chamomile and pronounced minerality. On the palate it is dense, fresh and creamy, with a long, persistent finish. A gastronomic white wine with ageing potential.

Winery Description: The Mar de Envero winery is made up of a team of people committed to the production of quality wines in harmony with their environment. In accordance with the philosophy of our winemaker, Manyo Moreira, we practice respectful viticulture, oriented towards the conservation of biodiversity and based on the principles of the circular economy. We manage the surpluses from both the field and the winery, reusing them as organic fertilizers for our vineyards. In this way we reduce costs, close the production cycle and strengthen our plants in a natural way. We are firmly committed to the native varieties of Galicia, which have been acclimatising to the territory for generations and which, in our opinion, are the ones that best know how to express their character. In addition, we work on the recovery of forgotten varieties, trying to restore them to the deserved prominence they once had. Winery Description: Making time work for us. We are the fifth generation of a family from Sant Sadurní d’Anoia with a tradition in cava-making since 1897. Drawing on our experience, we make versatile and fine brut nature cavas based on the unique Xarel·lo variety in a traditional coupage with Macabeo and Parellada. We work patiently over time to obtain long-aged sparkling wines with vinosity and their own distinct character. Following a sustainable approach towards our environment, we make use of organic farming in all our cavas. Experimentation is at the heart of our range of microtiratges. These are small batches of unique and innovative cavas made from selected coupages of exceptional vintages. They are ephemeral and unrepeatable and we trust that they will satisfy the desire of sparkling wine lovers wishing to discover very personal cavas.

Winery Description: Bodegas Martinez Lacuesta is a family project since 1895 dedicated to the production of the iconic Fine Rioja Wines, located in the sub-area of Rioja Alta. One of the wineries that started that revolution called Haro in the world of wine and that prevails to this day. The family has been in charge of the property since the beginning of the property within the 4th and 5th generation. Our philosophy and style could be summed up in "Afinadores de vinos": - Fine, finished and silky wines, where the winery is responsible for making them exclusively with vineyards around Haro and accompanying their evolution through the fruit route. "Gentle wines" - We feel more comfortable working with lower alcohol content and with a freshness in abundance that allows us to reflect the terroir of Rioja Alta and achieve longevity. - Fine wines for their "thinness". Without opulence or exaggerated tannins. - Wines where time is key for us, especially in the bottle, to develop their "caress".

Winery Description: Masaveu Bodegas, belonging to the business group Corporación Masaveu, was born in 1974 when this family acquired Bodegas Murua in the Rioja Qualified Designation of Origin. In its beginnings, this winery produced wine privately, born from the passion of this family and their connection to the wine world, but later they decided to focus on commercialization, remodeling and adapting the winery and pushing it to the highest quality standards with the production of excellent wines. Thus began a winemaking adventure that has grown to be present today in different parts and regions of the country: Murua (DOCa Rioja), Fillaboa (DO Rías Baixas), Leda (Vino de la Tierra de Castilla y León) and Valverán (Asturias). There, Masaveu Bodegas produces white, rosé and red wines of different varieties and characteristics, and also creates a risky but traditionally rooted drink, such as ice cider.

Product 1 Description: Este vino procede de la histórica Finca Fillaboa, de unos viñedos de 50 hectáreas de superficie asentado en ondulantes laderas que linda en su parte sur con los ríos Tea y Miño, frontera natural con Portugal. Fillaboa pertenece a la Asociación Grandes Pagos de España. Ocho de sus pagos conforman este ‘coupage’, que son los más representativos y de mejor calidad. La textura del suelo es franco-arenosa con abundancia de cantos rodados y la edad del viñedo oscila entre los 18 y 31 años.
Product 2 Description: Leda Viñas Viejas es el vino que encarna los principios de Bodega Leda. Es un vino multiterroir que procede de unos viñedos ecológicos que tienen entre 70 y 100 años y se encuentran extendidos a lo largo del valle del Duero, con diferentes microclimas y fechas de maduración. Se trata de un vino certificado en ecológico.
Product 3 Description: Sobre una pequeña colina en Elciego se sitúa Bodega Murua, lugar donde desde los inicios se ha trabajado con la mirada puesta en la elaboración de vinos de máxima calidad a partir de viñedos propios. Dividido en 8 pagos plantados mayoritariamente con variedades tintas (tempranillo, garnacha, graciano y mazuelo), y dependiendo de matices como la composición y estructura del suelo, la orientación y la exposición solar de los racimos, se ha buscado que cada variedad sea capaz de expresar, de la mejor manera, los diferentes terruños que componen la finca.

Winery Description: Mas Bertran was born in the heart of Penedès in 2005, in the garage of our parents in Sant Martí Sarroca. A humble beginning that became a vital project, deeply rooted in the land and in memories. The vineyards of Xarel·lo, Macabeo, Parellada, and Sumoll have witnessed childhoods among the vines, autumns of youth with grapes ready to harvest, and a legacy flowing from parents to children. Looking back is reliving joyful moments; looking forward is turning those memories into a dream. Each wine and Corpinnat reflects three generations who listen to nature. We intervene as little as possible, allowing the vineyard to speak freely, honoring the essence of each vintage, always unique. Since 2017, 100% organic, born from sincere conviction. Tradition and innovation coexist with constant care throughout every step of the process. From this fusion come Balma, La Graua, Argila, Mas Bertran X80, Xarel·lista, Sumollista, El nostre mètode Xarel·lista and El nostre mètode Sumollista.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 604

Winery Description: We are a small producer that crafts elegant and distinctive organic wines from hand-harvested grapes grown in our mountain vineyards (+700 m altitude) in Costers de Segre, near the Priorat border. We do not use herbicides or pesticides and our cellar is powered entirely by solar energy. We rely on indigenous yeasts and age our wines in wooden barrels, amphoras, cement eggs, and granite eggs. Additionally, we have an artistic project that empowers the territory through art: The Artists’ Vineyard.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 334
Product 1 Description: Saó Expressiu – Grenache (70%), Cabernet Sauvignon (20%) and Syrah (10%) Organic mountain red wine made in La Pobla de Cérvoles (Costers del Segre) from old-vine grapes grown between 700 and 800 m in altitude. 100% manual harvest, viticulture without herbicides or pesticides, fermentation with native yeasts and 14 months of ageing in French oak barrels. Aromas of ripe black fruit, plum and blackberry, with notes of cocoa, coffee, spices, Mediterranean herbs and a mineral background. On the palate it is intense, deep and elegant, with mature tannins, great volume, balanced acidity and a very long, persistent finish. A complex and expressive red wine that captures the full depth of mountain wines and the genuine character of the Les Garrigues landscape.
Product 2 Description: Troballa Negra – garnacha negra (100%) Tinto ecológico de montaña elaborado en La Pobla de Cérvoles (Costers del Segre) a partir de garnacha negra de la finca Vinya del Mas Blanc, situada a 800 m de altitud. Viticultura sin herbicidas ni pesticidas, vendimia 100% manual, fermentación con levaduras autóctonas y crianza en ánforas, huevos de cemento y huevos de granito. Aromas de frutos rojos y negros maduros, con notas de especias, sotobosque, regaliz y un fondo mineral. En boca es profundo, fresco y envolvente, con taninos finos, tensión y un final largo y persistente. Un tinto auténtico y expresivo, que refleja con pureza la garnacha de montaña y la identidad del territorio de Les Garrigues.
Product 3 Description: Troballa Blanca – White Grenache (100%) Organic mountain white wine made in La Pobla de Cérvoles (Costers del Segre) from White Grenache grown in the Llinars estate, at an altitude of over 700 m. 100% manual harvest, viticulture without herbicides or pesticides, fermentation with native yeasts and partially in contact with the skins. Aged for 6 months in cement and granite eggs. Aromas of ripe white fruit, citrus peel, flowers and Mediterranean herbs, with a subtle mineral touch. On the palate it is structured, broad and fresh, with subtle tannins, tension and a long finish after 6 months of ageing in cement and granite eggs. A unique and profound white wine, expressing with purity the mountain-grown White Grenache and the identity of the Les Garrigues landscape.

Winery Description: MASCARÓ - Unique Cavas and Spirits Family Winery since 1946: Since 1946, the Mascaró family has been crafting cavas and spirits from carefully selected raw materials, using traditional production methods and respecting the essence and heritage of the craft to obtain unique products. Our Cavas de Guarda Superior embody the legacy of our ancestors. They are made with hand-harvested grapes from our organic vineyards at the “Mas Miquel” estate. Our brand has a strong reputation for producing Brandy. Our brandies originate from local wines distilled in copper pot stills using the double distillation method and aged statically in 300-liter French oak barrels. Our aging cellars are located in the heart of the Penedès region. For the past 10 years, we have also been producing Vermouth under our brand Siset. It all begins with the search for raw materials (wine, wine spirits and botanicals) which we work with exceptional care to obtain vermouths with a unique style.

Winery Description: MAS d’en GIL is an agricultural estate located in Bellmunt del Priorat, at the South of the D.O.Q. PRIORAT. It was owned by the Scala Dei Charterhouse since the 12th century, forming part of the historic Priorat. Francesc Gil Borràs, one of the first Catalan oenologists, founded the winery in 1867, giving it his name. The Rovira Carbonell family, with 4 generations in the world of wine, has been producing the fruits of this estate since 1998. Preserving the biodiversity of this agricultural site is one of MAS d’en GIL’s fundamental objectives. Located on top of a hill, it becomes a balcony to the south of Priorat with beautiful views of the entire region. Its landscape becomes the essence of the Mediterranean: holm oak and pine forests surround vineyards, centuries-old olive trees and almond trees. The diversity of terroires allows the production of red and white wines within the DOQ PRIORAT, organic wines following the biodynamic method.

We farm sustainably and hold organic certification, preserving the vitality of our licorella, chalky clay, and granite sand soils, while benefiting from a privileged microclimate that allows us to grow high-quality grapes even in the driest years. Our wines are balanced, expressive, and carefully made, reflecting an artisanal process that brings together the heritage of the Old World with the vibrant energy of the New, celebrating the enduring legacy of Montsant and Priorat.

Winery Description: Mas Guineu Vinyaters is a small project located in a great place. We are integral winegrowers, we make wine from the vineyard. Sons of growers deeply rooted in the territory, in 2.021 we took a step forward. The last step to close the circle, transforming our grapes into lively, good wines, committed to respectful and organic work in the vineyards and with the minimum intervention in the winery. We reclaim the craftsmanship of our ancestors, with today’s knowledge but without modern haste Situated between the Headwaters of the Foix River and the Mediterranean, sheltered by the Font-Rubí mountains at 400 meters above sea level, halfway between Barcelona and Tarragona, lies the Mas Guineu Estate. A Mountain estate with calcareous soils and a clay-limestone texture, featuring fossils and pebbles that reflect its marine past. The vineyard is dry-grown, and the grapes have been certified organic by the Catalan Council for Organic Agricultural Production since their beginning. With our agriculture we not only contribute to the maintenance of the crops, but also to the environment and the landscape. We put the essence of the place where we live and work into a bottle.

Product 1 Description: Co-fermentation of Monastrell and Parellada from two plots located at the highest point of the estate. A wine that combines body and elegance through three different vinification processes. The Parellada is vinified by pressing whole bunches, while the Monastrell is destemmed, crushed and fermented in a stainless steel tank together with the Parellada must. Part of the Monastrell is set aside for carbonic maceration, which gives it freshness and expressiveness. Once both fermentations are complete, the wines are blended and left to rest on their lees in stainless steel for 10 months before being bottled unfiltered. The result is a unique, refreshing, silky and vibrant cuvée.
Product 2 Description: 100% Xarel·lo from the El Prat vineyard, located on the lower terrace of a small valley surrounded by terraces. Harvested by hand in small boxes, destemmed and macerated for 10 days in 500-litre oak barrels. Spontaneous fermentation with native yeasts. After fermentation, it is light racked to a stainless steel tank and aged on lees for 10 months before being bottled unfiltered. A smooth, elegant and refreshing skin contact wine, with fruity expression both on the nose and in the mouth.

Winery Description: Masia de la Roqua: Authentic Wines from the Massís del Garraf Masia de la Roqua is a family-run winery located in the Massís del Garraf, a Mediterranean territory defined by limestone soils and maritime influence. Annual production ranges between 10,000 and 15,000 bottles, all organically certified, with a clear focus on native grape varieties such as Xarel·lo, Malvasia de Sitges, and Sumoll. The project is based on sustainable viticulture and high-quality winemaking, with minimal intervention, aimed at faithfully expressing the Garraf terroir and ensuring consistency and long-term continuity. With a 9th-century farmhouse as its starting point, Masia de la Roqua combines tradition and knowledge with a forward-looking vision focused on landscape preservation, environmental responsibility, and sustainable development of the project.

Product 1 Description: El Truc Blanc is a white wine crafted primarily from Muscat à Petits Grains, sometimes complemented with a touch of other varieties. Its name evokes the Catalan tradition of "truc", the region's popular card game. The vineyards were planted in 2010 and offer grapes with great aromatic expression. The winemaking is gentle and careful, with battonage during the process to provide creaminess and texture to the wine, enriching its palate profile. El Truc Blanc aims to be an easy, perfumed and pleasant wine. On the nose it displays floral and fruity aromas characteristic of Muscat. On the palate it shows fresh and balanced, with a silky texture that invites uncomplicated enjoyment. It's a wine designed for everyday pleasure, reflecting the Mediterranean character of the Garraf and the philosophy of making honest and accessible wines. Ideal for those seeking an aromatic, expressive white that's easy to enjoy at any time.
Product 2 Description: Fugaç is the purest expression of Malvasia de Sitges, an aromatic variety with a long tradition on the Catalan coast. The vineyards were planted in 2009 on a small plot surrounded by Mediterranean forest, an environment that imparts unique character to the wine. The winemaking respects nature: manual harvest, skin maceration, and spontaneous fermentation with indigenous yeasts, without additives. The result is a white wine that combines aromatic complexity with elegance and finesse. On the nose, Fugaç unfolds intense floral notes alongside herbaceous nuances from the forest surroundings. On the palate it shows minerality, freshness and honesty, with vibrant acidity that perfectly balances its structure. It's a wine that speaks of its origin, of the Garraf and the proximity to the Mediterranean. Its name, "Fugaç" (fleeting), evokes the brevity of special moments it deserves to accompany. A wine for demanding palates seeking authenticity and connection with the territory.
Product 3 Description: Pèlec is an orange wine crafted from Muscat, reviving traditional winemaking methods that were almost forgotten. The vineyards were planted in 2010 and yield grapes with great aromatic expression. The process includes skin maceration for 8 days, allowing the extraction of phenolic compounds, aromas and characteristic color. Fermentation is carried out with indigenous yeasts, without adding any additives, respecting the wine's natural evolution. Pèlec seduces with its distinctive aromas: floral and fruity, complex and enveloping. On the palate it offers bright acidity that brings freshness and balance, inviting you to enjoy glass after glass. The name "Pèlec" comes from "pelagons", the puddles that appear when it rains in certain areas of the Garraf, evoking the connection with the landscape and the natural cycle of the vineyard. Ideal for curious consumers open to different sensory experiences.
Product 4 Description: Repte is a tribute to Sumoll, a native Catalan variety that was on the brink of extinction. This 100% Sumoll red wine is born from vineyards planted in 1947 on a north-facing slope, over calcareous soil that provides minerality and structure. The winemaking respects the nature of this delicate yet expressive grape: fermentation with indigenous yeasts and 8 days of maceration to extract color, aromas and tannins. The result is a structured wine, with fresh acidity and rich tannins that give it personality. Repte displays an elegant and complex profile in the glass, with notes of red fruits, spices and a mineral background that reflects its origin. It's a wine with character, that invites reflection on the value of recovering nearly lost varieties. Its name, "Repte" (challenge), symbolizes the endeavor to rescue Sumoll from oblivion and restore the prestige it deserves. A wine for enthusiasts who appreciate authenticity, history and commitment to traditional Catalan viticulture.
Product 5 Description: Ulivel·la is a white wine that captures the essence of the Garraf, combining Xarel·lo planted in 1959 with Malvasia de Sitges planted in 2009. This generational blend brings complexity and balance to the wine. The winemaking is meticulous: manual harvest, fermentation with indigenous yeasts and gentle pressing to preserve aromatic delicacy. The result is a fresh, mineral and aromatic wine that speaks of its Mediterranean origin. On the nose, Ulivel·la unfolds complex aromas of Mediterranean forest: aromatic herbs, white flowers and mineral notes. On the palate it shows bright acidity that brings freshness and a crisp, inviting finish. It's a harmonious wine that balances aromatic richness with structural elegance. The name "Ulivel·la" evokes the landscape where the grapes are born, among olive trees and Mediterranean forest. A wine for those who appreciate the genuine expression of the territory, the minerality and freshness characteristic of Garraf wines.

Winery Description:
Michael W. Salverda Wines is a small, hands-on project working between Stellenbosch and the Massís del Garraf in Penedès. The focus is simple: clear wines that reflect place, vintage and variety, with minimal intervention in the cellar.

The story began in 2020 with a Chenin Blanc in Priorat. Today, harvests follow a steady rhythm: early in the year in Stellenbosch, six months later in Penedès. This cycle shapes how each vineyard is farmed and each wine is made.

In the Massís del Garraf we farm our own vines in L’Arboçar and Olivella, exposed to sea winds, altitude and cool nights for fresh, saline whites. Product 1 Description: 2.220 Bottles 13,5% Varieties: 95% Merlot and 5% Picapoll Negre Harvested in the early hours of the morning. Cold pre-fermentative maceration for 4 days. Fermentation carried out with indigenous yeasts, followed by maceration with gentle pump-overs, avoiding cap punching, for 20 days. No use of the press. Malolactic fermentation takes place in six-year-old French oak barrels. Clarified with vegetable proteins, lightly filtered, and bottled. Aged in 500L barrels previously used for white wine for 6 months in barrel, 4 months in egg, and a minimum of 10 months in the bottle. A vintage marked by a significant and early water deficit. Nevertheless, regenerative viticulture has managed to mitigate the imbalance. During the winemaking process, we introduced changes that I personally believe have been highly positive. We have succeeded in expressing this estate wine with greater brilliance and distinction.
Product 2 Description: Varieties: Syrah, Grenache, Merlot, Picapoll Negre and Mandó 13,5% Harvested at night to preserve the grapes fresh. Each variety was fermented separately, as well as its aging, which was carried out in materials such as wood, cement and ceramics. It was not necessary to clarify, it was only filtered and stored for a minimum of 12 months in the bottle. A very unusual vintage. Getting here has not been easy. A year in which the storm "Gloria" left us with very severe rains in spring. That forced us to work the vineyard like never before. Among other things, a very aggressive pandemic made us make balances to be able to continue with our work normally. Despite everything, we are very proud of the result. We seek to produce fine wines, with little extraction, and that last over time.
Product 3 Description: Variety: Malvasia Manresana 676 bottles 9,5% Hand-harvested. Grain-by-grain selection. Spontaneous fermentation in stainless steel tanks and maceration for 267 days with its skins. No pigeage, only daily pumping over until the end of fermentation. It is then aged in amphora for 30 days and bottled unfiltered. The entire process has been carried out without the addition of oenological products or sulfites. Finally, we have aged it for 2 years in the bottle. The fermentation is incredible, the aromatic complexity it acquires. It's great to hold it up for a few more years in the bottle. Bottling on the moon "turning off", so it will be stored much better in the bottle. The 2021 vintage, a year of extreme acidity to be able to make wines that will become very large in the bottle.
Product 4 Description: 13% Varieties: Syrah, Cabernet Franc, Carinyena, Picapoll Negre, Garnatxa negra, Merlot and Sumoll Negre. Collected at night. Maceration with the skins in a light and cold way for about 10 days at 20ºC. Fermentation with own yeasts, pumped over without sinking the cap, bleeding and malolactic fermentation in tank. Clarified with pea protein. Suitable for vegans. Light filtering and bottling. Aged in wood for 3 months. Visually clean, ruby red color with violet tones. Characteristic nose, ripe fruit, notes of wood and sweetness. On the palate balance has been sought, it is light, refined and always ready.

Winery Description: Otazu is a family-owned estate located in the north of Spain and devoted to wine, with more than 150 contemporary art pieces integrated into its spaces. All its wines are made from grape varieties such as Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Chardonnay, expressing the uniqueness of the geography of its 93 hectares of single-estate vineyard. Centuries of winemaking tradition, reflected in a 12th-century manor and a centenary winery from 1840, inspired a family and a team committed to producing high-quality wines in an environment where wine and art merge in perfect harmony. At Otazu, contemporary art is appreciated through close collaboration with artists for the presentation of its wines, as well as through the permanent collection, the annual exhibition, and the monumental art pieces that enrich the natural beauty that frames it.

Product 1 Description: Altar (D.O.P. Pago de Otazu) is a 100% Cabernet Sauvignon red wine. The production of this wine began with a manual harvest, in October, in two selected Cabernet Sauvignon vineyards that we own. Before fermentation, a cold maceration was carried out at 8ºC for a week. The malolactic fermentation was carried out with fine lees in French oak barrels. It is aged in French oak barrels for 18 months, followed by aging in the bottle for a minimum of 60 months. On the nose, it is a complex and fine wine, with aromas of wild berries. Elegant, fine and silky on the palate. Altar's new label integrates perfectly with our artistic vision through a collaboration with the artist Héctor Zamora, who created the work Existencia (2019). Each bottle will bear a unique imprint made with our Otazu soil. The hand works the land, the land draws the hand, and through this hand, Zamora evokes the deep connection between the winegrower and the land, their work and dedication to create a wine that remains faithful to its terroir. This label is a tribute to the symbiotic relationship between wine and art.
Product 2 Description: Pago de Otazu 2022 (D.O.P. Pago de Otazu) is a blend of Merlot (61%) and Cabernet Sauvignon (39%) made from grapes from our D.O.P. Pago vineyards, harvested manually in 12-kilo boxes to keep the fruit in its optimal condition until pressing. The production process begins with cryomaceration at 5ºC for seven days, after which alcoholic fermentation takes place in small concrete tanks of 40 hectolitres and malolactic fermentation in French oak barrels. The resulting wine is perfected with a passage in French oak barrels. A deep cherry red wine. It has a complex nose, dominated by aromas of red and black berries. The time spent in barrel leaves us with spicy notes with a floral background. Mineral, long and fine. It is ideal to accompany roasts, fish with garnish, suckling pig, small game, Iberian platters, brothy rice, pâtés and cheeses.
Product 3 Description: Pago de Otazu Chardonnay 2023 (D.O.P. Pago de Otazu) is a 100% Chardonnay wine. The grapes were harvested manually in September. 80% fermented in French oak barrels from different forests and 20% fermented in concrete tanks with an ovoid shape, with its lees. Subsequently, a 6-month aging was carried out: 80% in French oak barrels with weekly bâtonnage of the lees and 20% in concrete tanks with an ovoid shape, next to its lees. Bright yellow color, with golden reflections. On the nose, it presents floral aromas with citrus and fresh fruit notes, with a spicy background. On the palate, it is elegant and long, with a fine minerality. This wine can be served at a temperature of 10°C - 12°C and is perfect for harmonizing with bluefin tuna, salmon, sardines, mackerel, tartare, ceviche, tiradito, sushi, seafood, rice, foie, Iberian ham, seasonal vegetables, cured cheeses, grilled fish, white and red meats.
