Winery Description: Pazo de Valdomiño is a traditional Galician distillery renowned for crafting high-quality spirits with a perfect blend of artisanal methods and innovative techniques. Our portfolio includes traditional Galician liqueurs, white aguardiente, herbal liqueur, coffee liqueur, cream of orujo, triple-distilled gin, tequila, rum cream, and pacharán. We also specialize in creating custom spirits, including light versions, tailored to meet specific market demands. At Pazo de Valdomiño, we are guided by core values: artisanal quality, purposeful innovation, sustainability, social responsibility, trust and closeness, and a passion for excellence. Every bottle we produce reflects these principles, ensuring exceptional quality and authenticity. Our business serves two primary markets: the HoReCa channel, where we distribute our own brands, and the retail sector, offering both branded products and private label solutions. While 90% of our production is sold domestically, we are steadily expanding our international footprint. Sustainability and responsible consumption are at the heart of our operations. From our natural Galician surroundings to our use of traditional copper alembics
Winery Location: CENTINELA 1, 36750, TOMIÑO , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 365
Product 1 Description: ADA Organic Gin is a premium organic gin range produced using certified organic alcohol and a selection of 15 botanicals. The portfolio includes a classic Organic Dry Gin, defined by a fresh herbal and citrus-driven profile with a clear juniper dominance, and an Organic Berries Gin, offering a sweeter yet balanced expression with pronounced red berry notes. Both gins are triple distilled, ensuring smoothness, balance and consistency. The brand’s commitment to sustainability is reflected not only in the organic production process but also in its fully recycled and recyclable packaging, making ADA Organic Gin a strong fit for premium and environmentally conscious spirits portfolios.
Product 2 Description: All products are produced under the Orujo de Galicia Geographical Indication, ensuring certified origin and quality standards. Orujo de Galicia is obtained through the double distillation of Albariño grape pomace in traditional copper stills, delivering a clean, refined and well-balanced grape marc spirit. Herbal Liqueur is produced by cold maceration of seven selected aromatic and medicinal herbs in Orujo de Galicia spirit, followed by distillation, controlled sweetening and resting periods before and after bottling. Coffee Liqueur is crafted through a 31-day maceration of selected coffees from Honduras and Vietnam in Orujo de Galicia spirit, followed by filtration and sweetening to achieve full balance and consistency.
Product 3 Description: El Cilantro is a traditional Spanish herbal liqueur, produced according to a proprietary recipe established in 1877 and passed down through generations. Its origin in Goián, within the Baixo Miño area of Pontevedra, guarantees authenticity and a strong sense of place. Positioned as a premium digestif, El Cilantro stands out for its distinctive sensory profile, derived from the maceration of coriander seeds and selected medicinal herbs in high-quality grape marc spirit (Aguardiente de Orujo). This process delivers a balanced, aromatic and highly recognisable product, well suited for specialised and premium spirits portfolios.
Product 4 Description: Founded in 1996, Pazo de Valdomiño was established with the purpose of producing a premium-quality grape marc spirit within the Orujo de Galicia Denomination of Origin. The distillery is located in the O Rosal Valley, at the mouth of the Miño River, an area recognised for its ideal microclimate for viticulture. Pazo de Valdomiño produces spirits exclusively from 100% Albariño grape pomace, complemented by carefully balanced infusions of herbs, fruits and coffee. The result is a portfolio of distinctive digestifs, characterised by their differentiated colour, flavour and aromatic expression. Thanks to their quality and consistency, Pazo de Valdomiño is widely recognised as one of Galicia’s leading distilleries, with products that appeal to premium and specialised markets.

Winery Description: At Pedro Escudero Family Winery, we craft exclusively white wines from the VERDEJO, SAUVIGNON BLANC and VIURA varieties. Origin: La Seca – Valladolid – Spain. In the very heart of Verdejo area, in La Seca, we cultivate our vineyards. This family project has always been driven by a deep respect for origin. The vineyard and its location within the municipality of La Seca, on the renowned gravelly plains that stretch toward the Duero River, are our roots. Over time, we have learned that imposed limits work against us. Defending our life project with absolute freedom is our purpose—and this is the spirit we wish to share through our wines.
Winery Location: Ctra. Pozaldez, sn, 47491, LA SECA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 498
Product 1 Description: Coming from the family’s first vines in a plot called “El Cuadro” at Pago de Fuente Elvira, La Seca, the character of this wine depends very much on the weather conditions of each particular year. Production is low, grapes are hand selected and the wine is made in French oak vats for between six and eight months with its own yeast, undergoing periodic batonnage. It is then aged with the lees in tanks for a long period. Finally, it rests in our underground cellar for as long as we decide, minimum 10 months.
Product 2 Description: A wine representing the closest relationship between wine-grower and terroir. The process of seeking the most essential features of a single plot makes Pedro Escudero’s Verdejo reflect a truly native character. This 100% Verdejo wine from the “El Viejo” plot at Pago de Fuente Elvira is made in small stainless steel vats at very low temperatures. First-stage fermentation is kept going as long as possible with the grapes’ own yeasts, helping to express an earthier character. After fermentation, the wine rests on its lees for at least six months and then spends one to two months in the bottle before being released.
Product 3 Description: This wine marks a turning point for this winery, made with the idea of offering a much more rounded Verdejo with a combination of subtle touches rarely found in wines from our area made with this grape. It is a blend of four different batches of grapes from the same plot, on clayey/sandy soils among pine groves with plenty of surface pebbles. For each batch we use a special wine-making technique, playing with fermentation in stainless steel and wood under different conditions. Each method brings out different characteristics, which are all essential to the final result. Pure equilibrium in a unique blend.

Winery Description: Founded by Masters of Wine Andreas Kubach and Sam Harrop, Península Vinicultores is based on the values of authenticity, competitiveness, and transparency. We manage all aspects of viticulture, vinification, production, and sales for both family-owned estates Bodegas Fontana and Bodega Bideona. We created Bideona to contribute decisively to a new generation of Rioja wines –more expressive of origin than method of production –and to the long term economic and environmental sustainability of the landscape and ecosystems surrounding the historic vineyards. Bideona produces terroir-driven, site-specific wines from historic, low-yielding vineyards in Rioja Alavesa. We cultivate about 300 parcels of incredible vineyards in the villages of Villabuenade Álava, Samaniego, Laguardia, Leza, Baños de Ebro, Navaridas, Lanciego and Elciego. The average vineyard size is around 0.3 ha and the average age around 50 years old, with many parcels planted in the 1920s, 30s and 40s.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 355
Product 1 Description: While mostly Viura, these old vineyards also contain a small amount of Malvasía Riojana and Cayetana Blanca. Harvested by hand in small boxes, the bunches were pressed whole, and the must was lightly racked. About a fifth of the must was fermented in large, used French oak barrels to give a layer of texture and complexity without adding excessive oak character, and the rest was fermented in concrete tanks. After fermentation, the two components were blended, and the wine remained in concrete tanks until bottling. Las Parcelas Blanco displays a subtle but intriguing nose that opens up in the glass with notes of stone fruit, herbs and white flowers. Both juicy and refreshing, it leads into a long chalky finish and proves its quality without the need for oak ageing.
Product 2 Description: D.O.Ca Rioja Village: Villabuena Grape Variety: Tempranillo field blend Vineyard age: Avg. 50 years old Soil: Sandstone, limestone marl Elevation: 520 - 570 m asl Limited release: 5,537 bottles In order to understand the expression of each village, all of our village wines are made in the same way. The vinifications are straight forward, avoiding any winemaking technique that could hide or diminish the personality and beauty of each village. For this range of wines, only the best old vineyards of each village are selected. The old massale selections that remain in these old vineyards are an important part of the historical personality of each municipality. Each village wine is composed of 8-14 vineyards throughout the municipality. These vines are harvested by hand in small crates and fermented in small stainless steel and concrete tanks. Extraction was carried out by gentle manual pumping over to respect the expression of these vineyards, without over extracting structure or colour.
Product 3 Description: Cofrades lies at the foot of the Sierra Cantabria, in a beautiful lieu-dit where Mediterranean vegetation alternates with nearly century-old vineyards. Here, at 562 meters above sea level, Cofrades is surrounded by blackthorn, fennel, rosemary, and lavender on a gentle southeast-facing slope, with a line of oaks and junipers shielding it from the northern winds. The soils are poor, clay-limestone in nature, with compact sandstone rock appearing at a depth of 60 to 85 cm, and containing 10% active limestone. Cofrades exhibits the varietal and clonal diversity characteristic of early 20th-century massal selections in Leza. Predominantly Tempranillo, with Viura in poorer sections, it displays significant intravarietal diversity. In addition to these main varieties, vines of Benedicto, Morate, Mencía, Garnacha, Graciano, Malvasía Riojana, and Cayetana Blanca can also be found.
Product 4 Description: D.O.Ca Rioja Village: Lanciego Vineyard: Galtzada Age: Planted in 1952 Size: 0.46 ha Soil: Calcareous clay Elevation: 593 m asl Garnacha with various clones The grapes were hand-harvested in small crates on September 19, 2023. To capture the essence of this site, we avoided any winemaking techniques that might diminish it and respected the differences in morphology and ripeness among the various Garnacha clones. After manual sorting, the clusters were destemmed and lightly crushed. The grapes were fermented in two small, open wooden vats. During fermentation, extraction was carried out with gentle manual punch-downs and occasional pigeage to draw out the vineyard’s character without over-extracting structure or colour. Galtzada is the pure expression of cool-climate Garnacha. It combines the lightness, elegance, and delicacy of the variety with the deep fruit concentration of old vines and the mineral tension of Rioja Alavesa’s soil. 1,178 bottles were produced.
Product 5 Description: Península Vinicultores produces a range of mountain wines from high-altitude vineyards in the Sierra de Gata. The range is a testimony to the diversity of Spain as a wine producing country and its tradition of also producing lighter, gastronomic styles of red. We aim to contribute to the preservation of the parcels of old vines that still exist in the Sistema Central, by building market access for these vineyards, thus making them economically viable for our grower partners. The base is a field blend from Sierra de Gata in northern Extremadura, close to the Portuguese border. The vines are on small hillside terraces of blue granite, surrounded by chestnut and pine woods.

Product 1 Description: Una representación de dos prominentes terruños de Alicante, las tierras altas de Vinalopó de Macabeo y Merseguera, y las Tierras Marinas con su Viognier y Moscatel de Alejandría. Preciosas notas de primavera. Aromas a jazmín, galán de noche, notas cítricas de lima y piel de naranja. Bonitos aromas de infusiones mediterráneas… Cuando toma botella las notas de hinojo y anisados típicas de la zona toman posición en copa, muy fresco en boca y con buen volumen. Variedades: Macabeo 33%, Viognier 33%, Merseguera 33% y Moscatel 1%
Product 2 Description: Una fusión de paisaje Mediterráneo de subzonas de Alicante, con la Monastrell procedente de la garriga de Alto Vinalopó y la Giró y la Alicante Bouschet de los bosques balsámicos de la Marina Alta. Plena explosión de los montes y sierras mediterráneas, aromas de Bouquet garnit, pino, romero, flor de romero. Frescura plena Mediterránea. Boca plena y llena de equilibrio. Variedades Monastrell 70% , Giró 27%, Alicante Bouschet 3%
Product 3 Description: Preciosa parcela pegada al monte. Debe su nombre el apodo del tío Veneno, pues era bastante serio, malcarado y duro con sus vecinos. Pero no todo iba a ser malo y nos dejó en su recuerdo un magnífico viñedo excepcional. Preciosa y seria expresión de Monastrell donde predomina la fruta y nuestros montes. Notas de lavanda, jara, monte bajo, carrasca y pinos mediterráneos y la barrica acompaña dando complejidad a este conjunto. Magnífica boca, seria, grande y equilibrada, con garra. Un vino de gran guarda preparado para vivir. Variedad Monastrell 100%
Product 4 Description: Giró, variedad única que nos une la Marina Alta desde los años 1500 con Mallorca y Cerdeña donde también se encuentra. Sensible al Oídio y de muy baja producción que fue perdiendo lugar por variedades más productivas, hoy en día es un pequeño tesoro que debemos cuidar y presentar como se merece. Preciosa expresión de monte bajo, tierra mojada, monte umbrío. Con una boca poderosa que nos recuerda a los suelos férricos y las notas sanguíneas; taninos muy nobles con equilibrio dándole longitud y una elegante profundidad que le permitirá ser un vino de larga guarda. Variedad Giró 100 %
Product 5 Description: Vino de gran origen, fuerza y pureza. Rememora a los antiguos blancos ‘Brisats’ que se hacían en nuestra zona del Levante y que en la actualidad se denominan ‘Orange wines’ o ‘skin-contact wines’, más conocidos como blancos brisados. Bonitas notas de pétalos de rosa, rosas secas, naranja y cítricos. En boca es amplio, fresco con preciosos recuerdos a infusión de Camomila, te de roca y manzanas. Cierta estructura que lo prepara para vivir muchos años y muy mineral. Vino de gran carácter, fuerza y alma. Elaborado siguiendo la antigua tradición de elaboración de vinos blancos macerando su mosto con las pieles. Variedad Moscatel 100% .

Winery Description: DipWSET and Master of Wine candidate, Pepe Rodríguez de Vera entered the world of wine after discovering that high-quality family vineyards were being used for bulk production. This realization led him to start vinifying on his own and to highlight the value of a unique territory. He began humbly, making wine in his garage with the help of family members, and has since followed a path of continuous learning and exploration. His philosophy is built on three pillars: singular vineyards, sustainable winemaking, and personal interpretation. He restores old, neglected vineyards to give them back their rightful prominence, intervenes as little as possible in the cellar so the wine can express its origin and typicity, and brings a creative vision inspired by local culture. His work aims to reveal the hidden potential of unique regions and craft exceptional wines with a distinctive identity.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 104

We offer a curated selection of wines and cavas that represent the diversity of Catalonia, from our own signature projects to the representation of historic wineries. Our own brands: badaBADOC: Medium/high-end wines, mostly monovarietal, designed to show the most representative of each Catalan D.O. Papet Del Mas: A Cava with soul, born in an underground garage, unbeatable in quality/price. NEW - Seguim: Our new icon. A luxury red D.O. Terra Alta 100% Garnatxa Peluda. Product 1 Description: Summary: badaBADOC transports us to the heart of the D.O.Q. Priorat with a powerful and authentic red wine, born in Llicorella soils at an altitude of more than 280 metres. It is the result of a manual and respectful harvest with 33-year-old vines. This wine stands out for its characterful blend, dominated by 60% Samsó (Cariñena), and balanced with 20% Grenache and an interesting 20% Hairy Grenache. Its 10-month aging in 100% French oak barrels gives it structure and elegance. To the eye it has an intense garnet color. On the nose it offers very expressive aromas where ripe fruit clearly predominates. On the palate it is powerful and vigorous, with marked tannins that demonstrate its strength and personality. A modern Priorat of 14.5% vol ideal for meats and cheeses.
Product 2 Description: Summary: Papet del Mas represents the essence of honest Cava with identity. Born from a unique family history in an underground garage, this Brut stands out for its unbeatable value for money and a tremendously versatile profile. Made under the D.O. Cava with the traditional blend from the heart of the Penedès, where Xarel·lo (50%) predominates, providing body, accompanied by Macabeo (25%) and Parellada (25%). To the eye it is pale in colour with golden hues and a fine bubble that forms a homogeneous crown. On the nose it is an explosion of youth, with very fresh primary notes dominated by soft fruits and citrus touches. On the palate it is round, light and elegant. Its fine acidity makes it very balanced, culminating in a persistent finish with hints of sweet orange.
Product 3 Description: Portium Brut is the freshest and most vibrant expression of Raventós Rosell. A Cava D.O. made mainly with native varieties (45% Macabeo, 30% Xarel·lo, 20% Parellada) and a distinctive touch of Chardonnay (5%). After a minimum ageing of 9 months (Cava de Guarda), it presents itself as a young and cheerful sparkling wine: To the eye: Pale straw color, clean and bright. On the nose: Fresh white fruit predominates on a light pastry background, the result of its contact with the lees during the second fermentation. On the palate: It is a frank, dry cava with a very pleasant acidity that provides liveliness. An ideal Brut for its freshness and versatility, perfect for those looking for the authenticity of traditional Cava with a modern and fruity profile.

Winery Description: Perelada is one of the flagship wineries of the Designation of Origin Empordà, one of the oldest wine regions in Spain, defined by its location between the Pyrenees and the Mediterranean. Its origins date back to 1923, when the Mateu family, specializing in the metal sector and the founder of the automotive firm Hispano Suiza, settled in Perelada Castle, in Girona. There they would fulfill a visionary dream: to make wines in a unique setting, revitalizing the long winemaking tradition of Empordà. In 2022, the mission of generations of the Suqué Mateu family culminated with the inauguration of a new winery, the first in Europe to obtain LEED® Gold certification, the highest-level international classification in sustainable building. Designed by the renowned RCR Arquitectes, winners of the Pritzker Prize in 2017, it combines cutting edge oenology with a project driven by landscape architecture, integration into the surrounding area, and top-level wine tourism.
Winery Location: Paratge la Granja, s/n, 17491 Peralada, Girona, 08034, BARCELONA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 308
Product 1 Description: The most elegant expression of an estate offering extreme conditions, caressed by the Mediterranean Sea and lashed by the Tramuntana wind. 12 hectares open to the sea as if it were a Roman amphitheatre. Its slate soils, steep slopes beside the Mediterranean and vines ruffled by the Tramuntana wind make a fascinating landscape, home to some of Perelada’s most iconic wines. The Garbet estate is the source of a superb, elegant Grenache, the result of low yields, rigorous selection and meticulous ageing, which offers complexity while respecting the essence of the place: Aires de Garbet.
Product 2 Description: Amfitrió and Obsequi are wines rooted in their land, speaking of gatherings, shared tables, and the perfect balance between tradition and innovation. They are, in essence, an invitation to the Empordà, a manifestation of Perelada’s welcoming spirit.
Product 3 Description: Terraces, slates, Mediterranean and Tramontana make up an extraordinary wine, full of character, complexity and precision. Finca Garbet comes from one of the most impressive wine-growing landscapes in the world, a terraced vineyard that opens onto the sea, from which they receive the perfect breeze, humidity and freshness for a correct ripening of the grapes. It is pure coexistence between the sea, the land, the sun and the wind. The four natural elements combined to give light to a wine full of emotion.
Product 4 Description: From the estate that gives it its name, behind Malaveïna hides a beautiful love story and a wine full of finesse marked by its unique origin. The origin of Finca Malaveïna is a legend behind which lies the story of a woman who had the misfortune of earning the enmity of her neighbors for falling in love with the enemy, which cost her the nickname of "bad neighbor" with which the territory that was her home was baptized, and which now hosts an ideal terroir for the cultivation of the varieties that make up this powerful red wine.
Product 5 Description: From Perelada’s oldest Cariñena vines, between 60 and 80 years old, Garrigal is born. An elegant, well‑balanced wine with remarkable varietal expression, reflecting the passage of time and the character of its terroir. In La Garriga, each vine is a living legacy. As the decades pass, its roots sink deep into the soil, capturing the mineral richness and the very soul of the land. The fruit they produce is no longer impetuous, but concentrated and full of nuance.

Winery Description: Perelada & Chivite is one of the Top 20 and fastest-growing companies in the Spanish wine industry, having carried out major investments in recent years.​Its evolution has been guided by passion and excellence, values that have positioned the group as one of the most respected winemaking legacies in Spain. With roots dating back to 1647, the origin of Chivite, the group combines centuries of tradition with a forward-looking vision. Today, Perelada & Chivite holds a strong presence across Spain’s main appellations of origin and manages more than 450 hectares of vineyards. Owned by the Suqué Mateu family, the company remains committed to preserving the identity of each production area, promoting respect for terroir and landscapes, and crafting a complete collection of distinctive wines. Thanks to its wide network of wineries, Perelada & Chivite offers a comprehensive and competitive portfolio designed to meet the demands of both on-trade and off-trade markets.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street D, Stand 164
Product 1 Description: Colección 125 range was created to celebrate the anniversary of the winery’s first export, honoring itspioneering spirit. Since 1993, Colección 125 Blanco has been a benchmark for white wines, selected for banquets by the Spanish Royal House. This barrel-fermented Chardonnay elevates the prestige of white wine in Spain Carefully selected Chardonnay grapes from the “Las Encinas” plot in Legardeta Estate are hand-harvested and collected in 18 kg boxes to preserve their quality. Incthe winery, the grapes undergo gentle pressing after a brief maceration, with only the highest quality free-run juice being selected. This juice ferments and matures on its lees, enhancing its complexity. The wine then ages for 12 months in French oak barrels, adding depth and defining its character.
Product 2 Name: Dominio de Elbio Dominio de Elbio
Product 2 Description: The second wine of the project bears the name of the estate, alluding to the fact that it is a wine made with the best grapes of the same. It represents the culmination of the unique characteristics of the estate and the area. With a limited production run, it offers an experience that stands out for its elegance and depth. This wine is a tribute to the terroir of La Horra, reflecting its unique character and the bold vision of the project.
Product 3 Name: Perelada Cava Gran Claustro Brut Nature Gran Reserva
Product 3 Description: Gran Claustro is our most iconic cava, which began as a special reserve bottled for a special occasion: the visit of President Dwight D. Eisenhower to Spain. The visit of the President of the United States in 1959 was the perfect occasion to bottle a sparkling wine inspired by the best champagnes of the time. The success of this sparkling wine was such that Perelada decided to create Gran Claustro, whose name refers to the cloister of the Friary of Carmen, where the Carmelite friars made wines for the County of Perelada back in the 13th century. Today, Cava Gran Claustro is the embodiment of Perelada’s expertise in sparkling wines: an elegant, versatile wine which, like all good hosts, aims to please those who drink it.
Product 4 Description: Made with the Tempranillo and Graciano varieties, from old vessels grown in soils with high limestone content and high altitude. Powerful, but at the same time fine and silky with extraordinary balance. Fruity, floral, but with the complexity and minerality provided by the best vineyards of the Sonsierra, in the foothills of the Sierra Cantabria. Preparation: De-stemming, without crushing, cold pre-fermentation maceration for 5 days. Alcoholic fermentation for 10 days at a controlled temperature. One year of aging, divided between 225l barrels and 2500l French oak foudre.

Winery Location: CARRER MONTSERRAT 73, 08770, SANT SADURNI D'ANOIA

Winery Description: Pérez Barquero represents the pinnacle of quality in Montilla-Moriles and is one of the largest and most consistent wineries in all of Andalusia. It offers a very prestigious traditional range and at the same time several modern wines, including sparkling and still wines without flower or oxidation. It has 233 hectares of vineyards, mostly Pedro Ximénez, located in the best Superior Quality vineyards in the Sierra de Montilla and Moriles Alto, and buys grapes from another 400 hectares. It reflects all the potential of the Tempranillo grape, harmoniously capturing the richness of flavors and aromas typical of the Ribera del Duero from an authentic expression. Since then, wine has been the treasure and heritage of this house. Ecology and tradition go together when you commit to respecting the land. Abundance and generosity is what we achieve with love, respect and above all with work and effort. The grateful vineyard gives us its best grapes that we transform into an excellent wine with the personality of this land, our climate and our Mencía and Godello varieties. That is why we simply continue with the work that has always been done in the vineyard: natural fertilizers and above all respect for the natural environment that surrounds us. Finally we take care of the plots as if each one were unique, respecting their uniqueness. We also carry out traditional work. We harvest the vines manually at their optimal moment so that they arrive in perfect health.

Color limpio y brillante con tono amarillo verdoso. Aromas de cítricos y piña en nariz. Con una acidez fresca y sabores a frutas tropicales.
Product 2 Description: Driven by a singular vision, our winemaker, Ruth, embarked on a unique project, selecting the finest wines from both Dominio de Punctum and Bodegas Albero. This exceptional wine, a testament to her artistry, transcends Traditional boundaries. Grown in our vineyards in the province of Cuenca, near central Spain, where wine culture has thrived for decades, the grapes benefit from an altitude of 800 meters above sea level. The continental Mediterranean climate, with its abundant sunlight, and the clay soil, which retains essential water, contribute to the unique character of these grapes. Carefully hand-picked, then fermented in small tanks pumped over several times a day, ending in a true expression of Ruth’s passion and expertise.
Product 3 Description: Chillable Red Wine nace del deseo de crear algo nuevo y divertido. Con un enfoque fresco e innovador, dejamos que nuestras uvas orgánicas nos guíen en la elaboración de este tinto. La aplicación de prácticas de agricultura ecológica en la producción de uvas permite que nuestros vinos alcancen la mejor calidad posible. También otorga al vino un reflejo más fiel del terroir local y de los sabores naturales de la uva.

Winery Description: Our story began in 2016, when three wine enthusiasts joined forces to create PURA VIÑA, a project devoted to crafting authentic, unpretentious wines that clearly express the terroir of northwest Murcia. More than a name, PURA VIÑA is a working philosophy and a way of life. Founders Santiago González and Juan Francisco Carmona understood the importance of locating vineyards in one of the best areas for Monastrell. They were joined by Rafael Moreno, the project’s winemaker and a deep connoisseur of the region, to bring the vision to life. Today we cultivate 8 hectares across two strategic valleys, where variations in orientation, climate, and soil allow us to shape each wine with its own character. The altitude and privileged environment of these valleys offer ideal conditions to produce fresh, elegant Monastrells full of identity.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 308
Product 1 Description: Master blend of our Monastrell parcels from the two most iconic valleys in our vineyard area, seeking balance between grapes from our coolest sites and those from the sunniest slopes. The result is a faithful expression of our region, shaped through our viticulture criteria and winemaking approach. We obtain a fresh Monastrell with an easy, smooth palate, pleasant aftertaste and long drinkability. The variety and the character of our soils take center stage, ensuring that the oak ageing never masks the wine’s primary qualities. Ageing: Six months on its lees in stainless steel tanks, followed by three months in fourth-use French oak barrels.
Product 2 Description: Selection of the finest grapes from the best parcel of our vineyard in the Paraje del Aceñiche, on limestone soils. This is a single-vineyard wine from our shaded parcel, where we obtain cooler grapes with a more continental character while preserving the Mediterranean essence of Monastrell. The result is a subtler wine, with lower fruit intensity and a pronounced mineral character provided by the rocky soils; a more intimate wine in which the soil takes center stage. The Monastrell vineyard is located at 800 meters above sea level, on the northern side of the Aceñiche Valley, combining very poor limestone soils with 30-year-old vines and extremely stony, shallow soils with vines over 50 years old. The valley’s orientation, perpendicular to the sunrise, results in fewer hours of sunlight, producing fresher grapes with lower alcohol levels and delicate, floral aromas. Hand-harvested in 12 kg boxes, followed by careful selection and destemming. Spontaneous fermentation with native yeas
Product 3 Description: Selection of the finest grapes from our vineyard located in the Paraje de la Venta del Pino, on limestone soils. This is a single-vineyard wine, specifically from our sun-exposed parcel, where we obtain grapes with a strong Mediterranean character: greater fruit expression, volume on the palate, intensity, aromatic profile and an immediate, expressive style. The vineyard is planted with Monastrell vines dating from 1976, at 650 meters above sea level in the Venta del Pino Valley. The valley’s orientation, parallel to the sunrise, allows for longer sun exposure throughout the day, resulting in grapes with more body, higher fruit concentration and a warmer mouthfeel. Hand-harvested in 12 kg boxes, with careful selection on the sorting table and destemming. Spontaneous fermentation with native yeasts in open tanks, followed by pressing and aging for 9 months in fourth-use French oak barrels, and a further year in bottle before release. Limited production of 1,000 bottles.

Its balanced acidity gives way to a long and persistent finish with a pleasant fruity aftertaste. A versatile and pleasant Cava that invites you to continue enjoying.

Winery Description: Recaredo is a family of winegrowers and winemakers specialising in terroir-driven, long-aged sparkling wines —wines that speak of their origin with honesty and transparency. Since 1924, they have learned from time itself, continuing to write a story of passion and commitment to craftsmanship. They produce exclusively vintage Brut Nature wines, using grapes from vineyards cultivated according to organic and biodynamic principles. All grapes are harvested by hand; 100% of Recaredo’s Corpinnats are aged with natural cork stoppers, and disgorgement is carried out manually, with no added sugars. Ageing periods range from 30 months to more than 25 years in the case of the most special library wines. Through this way of understanding wine —rooted in deep respect for the land— Recaredo expresses the purity of the Corpinnat landscape with wines of great depth, long ageing potential and a living spirit. A unique commitment, audited and certified by Bureau Veritas.

Single-estate character Serral del Vell is a place of great beauty – an area full of Xarel·lo and Macabeu vineyards, where the imposing Montserrat Mountain watches over a space that is topographically and geologically distinct from its surroundings. The Serral del Vell estate stands on a small plateau (serral) carved out of the Bitlles Valley Highlands and the winding gullies that run into the Lavernó Ravine. The plateau has several large, gently sloping terraces that men have shaped by creating margins and embankments.
Product 4 Description: Depth and transparency. Complexity and freshness.Recaredo Terrers represents the most sincere, precise expression of the traditional grapes of Penedès, with special prominence of the Xarel·lo variety. We make Recaredo Terrers from a mosaic of family-owned vineyards. The plots are located in the Corpinnat territory, the birthplace of great sparkling wines within the historic winegrowing area of the Penedès south of Barcelona where at the end of the XIX century winemaking of these sparkling wines was initiated following the traditional method. Biodynamic growers Recaredo Terrers has been cultivated according to the principles of biodynamic agriculture, a step beyond organic. The biodynamic approach allows us to make wines that are rich in nuances, have excellent ageing potential, and respect the natrual environment they come from. We let plant cover grow spontaneously between the vines. This cover crop plays a crucial role loosening the soil, regulating water retention and drainage (essential in a dry farming system), and helping to foster biodiversity.Infusions of plants are applied to the vines to control the presence of fungus in the vineyard and strengthen the vine’s defences.

Winery Description: Son Prim. La casa del Flaco. A name that already gives you clues: This winery was born in the house of the great-great-grandfather —tall, thin, known as “the skinny one”— and it still carries his spirit: simple, authentic, and honest. Son Prim is a family-owned winery in Sencelles, crafting wines with a Mallorcan soul—without artifices, without pretence, and with that calm, precise, character-driven way of doing things that only makes sense when family is behind it. The story doesn’t begin with endless vineyards or castles. It starts in the 90s, with Jaime Llabrés planting a few vines “just to see what would happen.” Chardonnay, Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet… international varieties that many claimed would never work in Mallorca. Spoiler: they did. In 2003, the family decided to take the leap and build the current winery, with the first “serious” harvest arriving in 2004. Since then, every vintage has been a small declaration: “we make the kind of wine we want to drink.”

Winery Description: Bodegas Tampesta is a family winery located in Valdevimbre, in the heart of the D.O. León. We were born with a clear idea, to make wines with personality and to value unique native varieties such as Prieto Picudo and Albarín Blanco, as well as Godello. We work the vineyard with a sustainable approach and careful production, seeking freshness, balance and authenticity. Our range includes fresh and gastronomic wines, barrel ageing and special limited production editions, designed for those looking for different wines with identity. Tampesta is León in its purest form, with character, tradition and a contemporary look.

Product 1 Description: Golán Crianza is the most structured interpretation of the Prieto Picudo within the Tampesta range. Made from selected vineyards, this wine undergoes 20 months of aging in French barrels, an unusual period for the variety, which allows it to develop complexity and depth without losing the identity of the origin. Golán Crianza is a wine with character, the result of patient and precise work in the winery, where the crianza is integrated in a balanced way with the varietal expression. A reference that shows the potential of Prieto Picudo for long ageing and wines with a long history, providing a more ambitious and different vision of the D.O. León.
Product 2 Description: Maneki is a unique expression of Albarín Blanco, one of the rarest and most characterful native grapes of León. Fermented in stainless steel and aged for six months in a selection of American and Eastern European oak barrels, this limited-production wine (3,500 bottles) blends freshness, texture, and subtle complexity. On the nose, it reveals citrus notes, ripe white fruit, hints of vanilla and light spice from the oak. The palate is elegant and balanced, with a silky mouthfeel, lively acidity, and a long mineral finish that reflects the limestone soils of Valdevimbre. Maneki is a gastronomic white wine with personality — refined, expressive, and crafted to showcase the full potential of Albarín Blanco.
Product 3 Description: A fresh and elegant Godello, made in stainless steel tanks to preserve all its aromatic purity. Neko shows notes of green apple, white peach, soft flowers and a slight hint of fennel. On the palate it is balanced, with good breadth and a marked minerality that reflects the limestone soils of Valdevimbre. A versatile and gastronomic white, which combines freshness, finesse and a very clean character.
Product 4 Description: Shiva is the most personal and emotional side of Bodegas Tampesta. A sweet wine made from Albarín Blanco, a native variety that is unusual for this type of production, which reflects the restlessness and creative freedom that define the project. Like all Tampesta tags, Shiva has a special meaning for its owner. This new wine takes its name from Shiva, the new member of his family, his dog, and symbolizes closeness, calm and enjoyment. A wine thought without haste, made with care and sensitivity, which seeks to show another side of the Albarín, more friendly and enveloping, without losing freshness or identity. Shiva is a wine that speaks of bonds, of shared time and of the most human part of Tampesta. A new member of the family that arrives to complete the range with a different, honest and very special proposal.

En boca es estructurado pero ágil, con taninos finos y una frescura natural que alarga el final.

Winery Description: Tandem is a boutique winery located in Lacar, in the heart of the Yerri Valley, at the foot of the Camino de Santiago. Located in the northwestern end of the DO, the Urbasa and Andía mountain ranges close the DO to the northwest and are just 55 km from the Bay of Biscay. The combination of clay loam soils, cold microclimate with Atlantic influence, dry farm, sustainable viticulture, minimal treatments exclusively with organic fungicides, no herbicides are used, regenerative soil work that allows the optimal texture to be maintained for the development of the vineyard and an altitude of 600 meters allows to produce very healthy grapes with natural acidity. We make our wines with a philosophy of minimal intervention, fermenting in stainless steel with pigeage no pumping over, using gravity and aging them in underground concrete tanks to fine naturally settling down. The wines we age do so in 300-litre French and Central European 300 litres oak barrels. The wines are fresh and elegrant.

Winery Description: Small and new winemaking project promoted by Alejandro Perfecto. Based on the family vineyards located in Aldeanueva de Ebro and Alfaro (Rioja Oriental). Vineyards that our family has been cultivating for several generations, today take on their own voice with small, artisanal and plot elaborations. Our goal is to give our particular version of a still unknown area of Rioja and for this we try to make brave elaborations that leave variety, vintage and the unique character of each plot of grape origin very visible. Tempranillo is consciously dispensed with to give voice to varieties with a longer cycle and better adapted to the arid conditions of the area such as Garnacha and Mazuela (Cariñena). In the case of white, the Viura is chosen. We are waiting for you all with open arms!

It is aged for 5 months in stainless steel with a movement of lees to end up being an unctuous, deep wine with the freshness of Grenache, which is extremely easy to drink.
Product 2 Description: Vineyard: Montesa, Alfaro Year planted: 1977 Variety: Viura Viura white wine, the queen variety of Rioja. From a plot almost 50 years old that provides us with concentrated and fresh whites every year. It goes through 500-litre barrels for between 7 and 11 months on its lees to assemble the wine, round off its acidity and enhance its ageing capacity. A wine that recalls the great moment that Rioja is experiencing with its whites.
Product 3 Description: Vineyards: Lobera, Alfaro (1960)      Valcaliente, Aldeanueva de Ebro (1988) A varietal Garnacha red representative of the area, sourced from two vineyards in two neighboring towns with different yet complementary characteristics. More open and fruit-forward in the case of Alfaro; more introverted and profound in the Aldeanueva vineyard. A lightly extracted red wine in which the focus is primarily on fruit expression, with aging in 500-liter barrels for around 11 months to accompany the wine during its maturation. A wine that fully represents a historic Garnacha-growing area like ours.
Product 4 Description: Vineyard: Esparragal, Alfaro Year of planting: 1984 Variety: Mazuela (Mazuelo, Cariñena, Carignan) The most distinctive and surprising wine in our range. In our area, Mazuela expresses itself with a naturally fresh profile, featuring its characteristic herbal notes and a balsamic touch that makes it especially intriguing. The winemaking focuses on restrained extraction so the grape can express itself more honestly. Its acidity and depth make the wine much longer than it is wide on the palate. A wine to discover how this minority variety expresses itself in our region.

Winery Description: Tenoira is a family winery in the heart of El Bierzo. In 1994, motivated by the conviction that El Bierzo has unique natural characteristics for vine-growing, they bought an old, completely abandoned vineyard. This was transformed into a grazing area and for six years it was used as a free pasture for their cows, so that cattle farming, to which they had devoted their whole lives, could be added to the project. Tenoira brand wines are made with quality grapes from its 23 hectares of vineyards growing the Mencía and Godello varieties. The vines are between 22 and 60 years old and the wines are produced with maximum control of all production phases, applying new viticulture techniques. The greatest possible respect is shown to the environment and the excellent properties of the grape varieties from a single 18-hectare plot called Paraje de La Padorniña.
Winery Location: EL GUINDALEDO S/N, 24500, VILLAFRANCA DEL BIERZO , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 470
Product 1 Description: La Padorniña Godello Sur Lie – Organic is a distinctive and elegant white wine that reflects the character of its unique origin in La Padorniña, a singular vineyard site located in Villafranca del Bierzo. Produced in a limited edition of 6,000 bottles, this wine is crafted exclusively from estate-grown, organically farmed Godello grapes, harvested only during the coolest hours of the day to preserve freshness and aromatic purity. The vineyards are planted on clay-rich hillside soils with a southwest orientation at an altitude of 550 metres, and feature 22-year-old vines. A privileged microclimate with both continental and Atlantic influences contributes to the wine’s balance between structure, freshness and expressive complexity. In the winery, the grapes undergo several hours of maceration before the extraction of the free-run juice (mosto yema), without pressing. Fermentation takes place at controlled temperatures, followed by an extended eight-month ageing on fine lees
Product 2 Description: Tenoira Godello Organic is an authentic and refined expression of the Godello grape’s full potential when grown at altitude. Produced in a limited run of just 5,000 bottles, this young white wine is made exclusively from estate-grown grapes certified in organic viticulture. The vineyards are located on clay-rich slopes with a southwest orientation at 550 meters above sea level, planted with 22-year-old vines and shaped by a distinctive microclimate influenced by both continental and Atlantic conditions, which lends the wine natural freshness and complexity. The winemaking philosophy combines precision with respect for the fruit: a low-temperature pre-fermentation maceration enhances aromatic expression, followed by temperature-controlled fermentation and two months of ageing on fine lees, adding texture and elegance while preserving vibrancy. In the glass, it shows a bright yellow colour with golden highlights. The nose is intense and expressive, offering a wide range of fruit aromas
Product 3 Description: TENOIRA MENCÍA ORGANIC is a limited-production red wine —25,000 bottles— that authentically expresses the character of the Mencía grape variety and the unique environment from which it originates. The grapes come exclusively from our own estate, located at an altitude of 550 meters, on clay soils with rounded stones, a type of terrain that promotes balanced water retention and contributes complexity and structure to the wine. The vines, with an average age of 22 years, benefit from a microclimate influenced by both continental and Atlantic conditions, allowing for slow, harmonious ripening that preserves freshness and aromatic intensity. Produced using organic farming practices, Tenoira Mencía Organic is vinified through temperature-controlled fermentation in stainless steel tanks, ensuring the preservation of pure fruit expression and varietal character. After fermentation, the wine undergoes four months of aging in oak barrels, adding elegance, subtlety, and complexity.

Winery Description: Roberto Oliván, 40 years old, from Viñaspre (Álava), starts the Tentenublo project Wines in 2011 with the sole objective of making a living from viticulture and to revalue his family's wine farm. To this end, after years of sell the production to large firms, decides to follow the path of the Producer-harvester and putting an end to the mockery of the market with grape prices ridiculous. The only path to a viable exploitation was to complete the Circle: to become a "harvester" again. He works 13 hectares of his own vineyards spread over 39 plots, all of them own. In the vineyards, limestone loam soils alternate on erosion slopes and red sandstone loam soils in Planes at an altitude of 600 m. Viticulture and elaborations based on observation, smallholdings, Multivarietalism (Tempranillo, Garnacha, Viura, Malvasía, Jaén Blanca, etc.), mass selection, altitude and two types of soil to achieve the wines that were drunk 40 years ago in the family home.

Winery Description: PASSION Terra del Priorat was born from the conviction that great wines are not "invented", they are discovered: they were already written on the rocks, on the slopes of the slopes, in the silence of summer nights. Our job is simply to give them a voice. We chose to settle in Priorat because here the vineyard is not a simple agricultural plantation: it is landscape, memory and risk. Every metre of terrace, every vine that clings to llicorella or limestone, represents a conscious decision to bet on excellence and not on comfort. Our passion translates into precise and respectful viticulture, which accepts low yields in exchange for depth and authenticity in varieties that dialogue with the territory as mother tongues and that understand the climate and expand the aromatic and textural register, but above all in vinifications that seek transparency, letting each plot tell its story without unnecessary makeup. Winery Description: Small ARTISAN winery located in Solsonès, in no man's land. Toni Cuspinera has his own vineyards in PRIORAT and buys grapes from other parts of Catalonia (MONTSANT, TERRA ALTA, CONCA DE BARBERÁ, PENEDÉS). He produces natural wines with a classic and gastronomic profile, WITHOUT added SULPHITES and WITHOUT DEFECTS in the glass. It stands out for having older vintages: very fresh white wines and red wines with structure. His ancestral Xarello stands out for its elegance. Winery Description: At an altitude of 1,000 meters in the town of Atauta in Soria, there is a unique valley that, with only 4 km in length and 1 km in width, constitutes a true oenological and ethnographic gem. In this distinctive enclave, on the Sorian slope of the Ribera del Duero, DOMINIO DE ATAUTA literally hangs, aiming to reflect in its wines all the peculiarities that the Tinto Fino variety of PRE-PHYLLOXERA VINES, with over a century of age, is capable of offering. The tradition of a valley where its inhabitants have been making wine for centuries, the altitude that places it practically at the limit of grape cultivation, the extreme climate due to scarce rainfall and large temperature variations, and a wide variety of soils are the ingredients that make the Atauta Valley a truly unique land. Dominio de Atauta, in turn, belongs to the TERRASELECTA family group, with wineries in a selection of unique locations in 8 different denominations of origin (Ribera del Duero, Rioja, Rueda, Zamora, Rías Baixas, Monterrey, Tierra de Castilla, and Jerez).

Its presence in four of the main wine-producing regions of our country establishes Terras Gauda as one of the leading winery groups in Spain. Geographical expansion is one of the pillars of the Group’s philosophy. The diversity and uniqueness of each region are respected, while experience and knowledge are shared and capitalised upon. The Group is present in more than 60 countries.

Product 1 Description: Heraclio Alfaro is a wine that reflects the contemporary identity of the Rioja D.O.Ca., born from estate-owned vineyards located in Alfaro, in Rioja Oriental, where a Mediterranean climate with continental influence and stony soils bring character and uniqueness to the grapes. Made from traditional Rioja varieties, with Tempranillo as the backbone, it combines oenological precision with respect for its origin. On the nose, it is expressive and elegant, with aromas of ripe red and black fruit, spicy notes and subtle balsamic and mineral nuances. On the palate, it is balanced and enveloping, with fine tannins, good structure and acidity that provides freshness and length, leading to a persistent and harmonious finish. A gastronomic, modern wine that remains true to its territory, combining tradition and innovation and positioning itself as an authentic and versatile expression of the new Rioja.
Product 2 Description: Petit Pittacum is a red wine that offers an approachable and faithful expression of the Bierzo D.O., made from Mencía grapes grown on the region’s characteristic slopes and terraces, on slate and clay soils. A wine that reflects the Atlantic-continental character of Bierzo and the identity of its most emblematic grape variety. On the nose, it is fresh and expressive, with aromas of ripe red fruit, floral notes and subtle mineral nuances. On the palate, it is juicy and well balanced, with soft tannins, good acidity and an easy, enjoyable mouthfeel, leading to a clean and pleasant finish. A young, gastronomic and honest wine that combines freshness, typicity and respectful winemaking, positioning itself as a gateway to the Pittacum philosophy and to the great wines of Bierzo.
Product 3 Description: Terras Gauda is an emblematic white wine from the Rías Baixas D.O. that faithfully expresses the Atlantic character of the O Rosal Valley. Made from a carefully selected blend of Albariño, Caíño Blanco and Loureiro, it comes from estate-owned vineyards located on gentle slopes with privileged orientation and granite soils, influenced by the proximity of the ocean. On the nose, it stands out for its aromatic intensity and complexity, with notes of white and citrus fruit, floral hints and herbal nuances characteristic of Loureiro. On the palate, it is broad, fresh and well balanced, with well-integrated acidity, notable structure and a long, persistent finish. A gastronomic, elegant and expressive wine that combines tradition, innovation and respect for the environment, and has established itself as one of the leading references among Spanish Atlantic white wines.

Winery Description: Adega Terras Mancas, located in the Miño Valley, in Soutomanco (Ourense), combines tradition, sustainability, and a passion for wine. Its 10 hectares of own vineyards, cultivated on terraces with Albariño, Treixadura, Godello, Loureira, Caiño Tinto, Garnacha Tintorera, and Sousón, reflect an extreme care for the Galician terroir. Its wines—fresh, elegant, and with great personality: Terras Mancas Blanco, Barrica, and Tinto—have been awarded Great Gold and Gold Medals at CINVE, Vinespaña, and Brussels. With a clear philosophy: the art of turning the simple into something extraordinary, the winery transforms each harvest into a unique experience, blending innovation and tradition in every bottle, managing to convey to the consumer the essence of the landscape, the history, and the passion of those who tend the vines with tenderness and dedication.

Product 1 Description: Es un vino plurivarietal que expresa la esencia del Valle del Miño. Elaborado con Albariño, Treixadura, Godello y Loureira de viñedos propios en terrazas, combina frescura, elegancia y complejidad. Destacan sus aromas cítricos y florales, reflejos dorados y un fondo herbáceo que refleja el terroir gallego. En boca es equilibrado, con acidez marcada, textura sedosa y un final persistente que invita a descubrir cada matiz. Reconocido por su calidad, encarna el arte de hacer de lo simple algo extraordinario, fusionando tradición y precisión en cada detalle. Un vino refinado, auténtico y memorable, ideal para quienes buscan excelencia y conexión con el origen en cada copa.
Product 2 Description: Un Albariño excepcional que combina frescura y complejidad gracias a su crianza en barrica. Elaborado con uvas de viñedos propios en terrazas del Valle del Miño, presenta aromas de fruta blanca madura, toques florales y ligeros matices tostados que aportan profundidad y estructura. Product 3 Description: Vino joven y vibrante que refleja la riqueza del Valle del Miño, elaborado con Brancellao, Caiño Tinto, Sousón y otras variedades autóctonas de viñedos propios. Destaca por su frescura, intensidad aromática y notas de frutos rojos maduros, con sutiles matices herbáceos y un fondo mineral. En boca es equilibrado, con taninos suaves, estructura elegante y final persistente, ofreciendo una experiencia auténtica y placentera. Terras Mancas Tinto 2024 encarna el arte de hacer de lo simple algo extraordinario, combinando tradición y cuidado en cada cosecha, ideal para quienes buscan vinos de carácter, personalidad y conexión con su origen.

Winery Description: Tierra de Sabor is much more than a brand: it is a tribute to the rich diversity and quality of the wines of Castilla y León. Here, tradition and innovation meet to create unique wines that connect with people and elevate every experience. Our region brings together the essence of 16 Protected Designations of Origin (PDO) and the Protected Geographical Indication (PGI), reflecting the character, personality and identity of every corner of Castilla y León. With more than 81,000 hectares of vineyards, mostly protected by quality figures, our wines stand out for their authenticity, history and commitment to excellence. The purpose of Tierra de Sabor is clear: to celebrate, promote and position the wines of Castilla y León in the national and international markets. We invite you to discover at Barcelona Wine Week how we reinvent tradition to offer the best of our land in each glass. Tierra de Sabor is the reflection of a region that lives by and for quality, where each wine tells a story that deserves to be shared. Come and savour the essence of Castilla y León!

Winery Description: Jorge Muga's project at Bodegas TIHOM is a dream come true, born from his passion and desire to give his wines a more personal and independent approach. After a long career as a winemaker at the renowned family winery, he decided to embark on this path with his wife, Nuria. In an old building, located in the heart of the historic Barrio de la Estación in Haro (La Rioja), they produce original wines, seeking to highlight minority grape varieties without forgetting the classic "coupages". The launch of their first wines on the market was truly audacious: Rioja reds without Tempranillo (made with Mazuelo and Graciano) and whites without Viura (with Maturana Blanca and Garnacha Blanca). Far from rejecting the classic majority varieties, they seek to showcase the potential of more challenging grape varieties which undoubtedly have a special and unique charm. In a second, upcoming "wave" of wines, they wish to delve deeper and offer their own take on the great Rioja classics.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 357
Product 1 Description: THM Tinto 2023 is TIHOM’s contemporary interpretation of a classic Rioja. Produced in the Haro area, it comes from poor, loose soils of ancient Tertiary terraces with rounded stones and sand, favouring deep root development and natural vineyard balance. The blend is built on 50% Tempranillo and 25% Garnacha, completed with Graciano and Mazuelo, seeking freshness, structure and complexity. The 2023 vintage was the driest of the last five years, marked by a warm summer and highly irregular rainfall, demanding precise viticulture and careful harvest decisions. Each variety is aged separately for 12 months in barrel, followed by malolactic fermentation in spring and ageing on lees. In the glass it shows medium colour intensity with bright red tones. On the nose, ripe Garnacha fruit stands out alongside Tempranillo. The palate is balanced and fluid, with an attractive harmony of sweetness, acidity and bitterness, resulting in a direct, gastronomic wine with ageing potential.
Product 2 Description: THM Rosado 2024 is a fresh and expressive Rioja rosé, made from a carefully selected blend of red and white grapes, seeking balance, subtlety, and gastronomic appeal. It comes from vineyards managed with respect for the environment and the natural rhythm of the vine. In appearance, it shows an attractive pale pink color, clean and bright. On the nose, it is delicate and inviting, with aromas of fresh red fruit such as strawberry and raspberry, complemented by floral notes and a light citrus background that adds vibrancy. On the palate, it is lively, fresh, and well balanced, with well-integrated acidity that enhances its refreshing character and lengthens the finish. A precise and elegant rosé, with good volume and a clean, persistent mouthfeel. A versatile and contemporary wine, ideal as an aperitif or paired with Mediterranean cuisine, fish, rice dishes, and light meals.
Product 3 Description: THM Blanco 2024 is a Rioja white wine made exclusively from Garnacha Blanca, a variety that brings breadth, aromatic expression, and a distinctive Mediterranean character. It comes from carefully managed vineyards aimed at preserving freshness and balance. In appearance, it shows a pale yellow color with bright reflections. On the nose, it is elegant and expressive, offering aromas of ripe white fruit, citrus, and dried flowers, complemented by subtle spicy and toasted notes from fermentation and aging in Hungarian oak. On the palate, it is broad, smooth, and fresh, with well-integrated acidity that provides tension and length. After its time in oak, the wine spends 6 months in concrete, refining the texture, enhancing fruit purity, and bringing overall harmony. The finish is clean, persistent, and marked by a delicate mineral note. A white wine with character, precision, and strong gastronomic appeal.
Product 4 Description: TIHOM Blanco is a wine of precision and depth, born from the dialogue between vineyard, time and material. It is made from Maturana Blanca and Garnacha Blanca, two native varieties that here express their own identity and a clear ageing potential. Maturana Blanca is aged for one year in Nevers oak, bringing structure, finesse and aromatic complexity. Garnacha Blanca is aged in Hungarian oak foudres, adding volume and texture. After this stage, the wine is blended and continues its evolution for a further year in concrete tanks, resting on part of its lees, which enhances creaminess and integration while preserving freshness and tension. On the nose it is subtle and elegant, with notes of white flowers, stone fruit and a mineral background. On the palate it is broad, precise and persistent. TIHOM Blanco offers a personal, serene and contemporary interpretation of Rioja.

Winery Description: Bodegas y Viñedos Rauda is a wine cooperative located in Roa de Duero, in the heart of the Ribera del Duero wine region of Spain. Founded in 1956 by a group of local vine growers, it became one of the earliest viticultural associations in the area and remains rooted in cooperative values. The winery works with vineyards owned and tended by its members, covering around 190–200 hectares of mainly Tempranillo grapes, with some Albillo, planted in rich clay-limestone soils and shaped by the region’s extreme continental climate. Rauda combines time-honored winemaking traditions — such as fermentation in concrete tanks — with modern techniques and quality controls. Its portfolio includes young and oak-aged reds, crianza, reserva, and more expressive “autor” wines under labels like Musai. The cooperative’s wines reflect the character of Ribera del Duero and are distributed both nationally and in export markets.

Product 1 Description: Musai de Tinto Roa is a premium 100% Tempranillo wine from Bodegas y Viñedos Rauda in Ribera del Duero, made with selected grapes, aged long in oak, around 15 months and offering complex fruit, spicy and toasted oak aromas with a balanced, expressive palate
Product 2 Description: Tinto Roa Joven is a vibrant young red wine from Bodegas y Viñedos Rauda, made with 100% Tempranillo grapes from Roa vineyards. It shows intense cherry-red color, fruity aromas of red berries, and light, juicy tannins, offering freshness and easy drinkability — great with grilled meats or tapas.
Product 3 Description: Tinto Roa Crianza is a 100% Tempranillo red wine from Bodegas y Viñedos Rauda in Ribera del Duero. Aged 12 months in French and American oak, it offers cherry-red color, ripe fruit with balanced oak and smooth, persistent tannins, perfect with grilled meats, stews, or cured cheeses.
Product 4 Description: Tinto Roa Reserva is a classic 100% Tempranillo red wine from Bodegas y Viñedos Rauda in Ribera del Duero. Aged over 12 months in French and American oak barrels and rested in bottle, it shows intense cherry-red color, ripe fruit aromas with spicy oak notes, and a smooth, elegant palate, ideal with grilled red meats, roasts or aged cheeses.
Product 5 Description: Tinto Roa Roble is a 100% Tempranillo red from Bodegas y Viñedos Rauda in Ribera del Duero. Aged about 5 months in French and American oak, it shows intense cherry-red color, ripe red fruit with balanced oak, and a fresh, pleasant palate — ideal with pasta, rice, or semi-cured cheeses.

Winery Description: Titerok-Akaet is the wine project of Juan Daniel Ramírez, an agricultural engineer, and Marta Labanda, an oenologist. The project is characterized by the recovery of historic vineyards, the care of the Lanzarote landscape, and the production of respectful wines through minimal intervention, in which only low doses of sulfur are applied. Marta and Dani together form Titerok-Akaet and their own family.

Product 3 Description: Vino de la primera parcela en propiedad, en el Valle del Malpaso, Haría, al norte de la isla de Lanzarote Elaborado con las tres variedades blancas mayoritarias de la isla, Malvasía volcánica, Listán blanco y Diego. In 1985, he started making wine at the family-owned Castell del Remei winery. With this company, and while on the lookout for mountain lands and vineyards, Tomàs also started the Cérvoles winery in 1997. In 2003, in the same area, he decided to start his most personal project to date, which ended up becoming the winery that bears his name in the village of El Vilosell.

Winery Description: TORELLÓ Viticultors We are a family-owned winery with an unbroken winemaking heritage dating back to 1395. Today, the estate is led by the 22nd generation. From the heart of Penedès, just 33 km south of Barcelona, we craft premium wines and long-aged sparkling wines certified by Corpinnat. Our values: • 100% estate-grown vineyards • 100% organic farming • 100% hand harvesting • 100% estate vinification These commitments reflect our dedication to preserving our origin, landscape and identity. We specialise in extended ageing and work mainly with native varieties, which convey the character and authenticity of our terroir. Tradition, innovation and respect for the land shape every wine we produce. Our export experience and international recognition position us as a reliable partner for markets seeking excellence and authenticity. See you at BWW. Thank you!

Product 1 Description: Blend: 79% Merlot and 21% Cabernet Sauvignon The wine ferments in stainless steel tanks with pump-overs carried out three times a day. Malolactic fermentation then takes place in concrete tanks. After blending the two varieties, the wine ages for 12 months in French oak barrels (Allier and Vosges) and American oak. It is then bottled and matured for two more years. Cherry in colour with a purple rim, clean and dense in the glass. The nose shows deep aromas, with a range of black fruits such as blueberries, blackberries and blackcurrants, accompanied by a pleasant hint of rosemary. Subtle spices like vanilla and cinnamon appear, along with delicate lactic notes. On the palate, it offers a smooth entry. Polished tannins reveal a lively acidity, complemented by light herbal nuances on the finish. Balsamic touches evoke hints of tobacco. 90 Peñín
Product 2 Description: Grape varieties: 57% Xarel·lo, 23% Macabeo y 20% Parellada The base wine is aged in oak barrels before being bottled. Minimum 48 months of bottle ageing. Every year, poignettage is carried out, which causes the yeasts to mix with the wine again. This enriches the sparkling wine's aromas and flavours. Disgorging without added sugars. Straw yellow colour, clean and transparent. Fine bubbles that form a constant rosary. Pleasant aromas on the nose reminiscent of fresh flowers, honey blossom and rosemary. Pleasant milky notes reminiscent of custard and caramelised brioche. Light toasted notes which, taken together, provide good structure. A complex sparkling wine with many nuances and a very pleasant sensation of bubbles in the mouth. A balance of complexity between ageing and freshness makes it long and light. Notes of fine brioche, subtle toasted notes and fruit. 93 Parker 93 Timt Atkin 92 Peñin
Product 3 Description: The grapes are carefully sorted and gently pressed in pneumatic presses. Only the highest-quality first fraction of the must is used. Our presses incorporate Inertys technology, which protects the must from oxidation throughout this stage. This wine is crafted across five different vessels before bottling: amphora, demijohn, concrete egg, stainless steel tank, and oak and acacia barrels. Each contributes its own character, adding a wide range of aromas and flavours and giving the wine excellent ageing potential. The result is a bright, clean yellow wine with golden-green reflections. The nose is intense and complex, offering ripe fruit alongside fennel and camomile. Ageing in diverse vessels brings subtle earthy, toasted and vanilla notes. On the palate, it is silky and fresh, with a balance of minerality, creaminess and gentle reduction. Apricot notes return on the finish, shaping a harmonious and distinctly Mediterranean profile. 92 Peñín 92 Tim Atkin
Product 4 Name: TORELLÓ SPECIAL EDITION BARCELONA Brut. CORPINNAT
Product 4 Description: Blend: 53% Xarel·lo, 24% Macabeo and 23% Parellada El Torelló Special Edition Barcelona is our particular tribute to the city of Barcelona, through the iconic images featured on the label. From the Sagrada Família, the Arc de Triomf to the statue of Columbus. This special Corpinnat is the youngest of the Torelló range. With a minimum of 18 months in the bottle, it is made as a Brut with a low dosage of liqueur d'expédition. It presents a new golden-yellow colour with golden-grey reflections and a constant stream of bubbles. On the nose, it shows sweet and green notes reminiscent of almond, fresh herbs such as mint and fennel, along with brioche, candied fruit and a mineral touch. On the palate, it is lively and fresh, with an agile mouthfeel, good structure and nuances of ripe summer fruit. It is versatile to be enjoyed at any time of the day.
Product 5 Description: The grapes come from our own estate, are organically grown and harvested by hand. They arrive whole at the winery, pass through the sorting table and are gently pressed by variety. Inertys technology protects the must from oxidation. In winter, the coupage is carried out, the wine is bottled and the second fermentation takes place in the bottle. Torelló Tradicional spends a minimum of 50 months in the bottle. Each year, poignettage (bottle shaking) is carried out, allowing the yeasts to mix back into the wine. This enriches it with aromas and flavours. It is a Brut Nature with no added sugars. The back label indicates the date of disgorging. The wine has a straw yellow colour with fine, persistent bubbles. The nose is dominated by pear and notes of brioche, caramel and baked fruit. On the palate, it is fresh and delicate, dry, with hints of fresh herbs, white flowers and creamy notes that give it a very pleasant finish. 92 points Parker 91 points Peñín

Winery Description: Since 1860, generation after generation, always relying on a great team and betting on synergy between us, we have been growing, learning and improving. synergy between us, we have been growing, learning and improving until we have achieved our own to achieve our own expression: an authentic Txakolí. Product 1 Description: This is the family's most emblematic Txakoli, bearing their name and showcasing the work carried out generation after generation. Product 3 Description: This unique blend of native grapes was created as a tribute to the ancestral Txkaoli of our forefathers. Winery Description: UKAN is a new project in Rioja Alavesa led by the Eguren Kertudo family. Koldo Eguren, the fifth generation of the family, leads this project with which he seeks to transfer the landscape of Rioja Alavesa to a great wine using what he has learned from previous generations and incorporating the young and contemporary vision he has acquired in his professional career. It is a boutique winery that focuses on the production of only two wines, UKAN and Senderos de Ukan, both of which are produced in limited quantities. The base of the project lies in the Sonsierra of Alava; small plots from 30 to 90 years old in the surroundings of Laguardia and neighbouring municipalities where sustainable and precise viticulture is carried out that interprets each vineyard individually. The attention to detail extends to the production process, totally artisanal plot by plot, carried out in its facilities located in Laguardia. Elegant, precise wines with great personality that show the identity of Rioja Alavesa.
Winery Location: CALLE LA PAZ 15 PABELLÓN 2, 01300, LAGUARDIA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 231
Product 1 Description: The elegance of the old vines of Laguardia. UKAN is the winery's icon. The result of a meticulous selection of vineyards, which gives rise to three old Tempranillo vines with silt-clay soil and calcareous base. The three vineyards are located in Laguardia, are cultivated in goblet, made separately and then assembled into an elegant and structured wine. UKAN is harmonious, complex, full of nuances and with great ageing potential.
Product 3 Description: The freshness and balance of Rioja Alavesa in a bottle. Senderos de UKAN is the result of a careful selection of Tempranillo vineyards from different villages in Rioja Alavesa. The grapes, harvested by hand in 15kg boxes, are later selected on arrival at the winery and made in an artisanal way. Minimal intervention in order to achieve a balanced, fluid wine, full of fruit and freshness ready to be enjoyed from the first moment.

Winery Description: U MES U is a winery located in Font-rubí, in the heart of the Alt Penedès, committed to sustainable agriculture within the DO Penedès and DO Cava appellations. Its driving force is the production of wines and cavas with a distinct personality, far removed from convention. This path blends curiosity and observation, experience and knowledge, to craft fresh, elegant cavas and wines with depth. Among its wine ranges are Anais, Dahlia, and De Llevant, while its cavas include names such as Cygnus, Rara Avis, Caelus and Julià&Navinès.
Winery Location: Mas Romaní S/N, 08736, FONT-RUBI , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 248

Winery Description: Valdealto is a family-owned winery with a legacy spanning more than 300 years. Located in the Sierra de la Moneda, a singular corner of Extremadura where vineyards coexist with Mediterranean forest, poor soils and a climate that demands the very best from each vine, we craft wines that stand out for their freshness, balance and authenticity. We work exclusively with our own grapes, sourced from small plots cultivated under organic viticulture. Each harvest is carried out by hand, plot by plot. Our vineyards grow on sandy, sandy-clay and stony soils rich in quartzite, under a continental climate with slight Atlantic influence. These conditions allow us to obtain grapes with natural concentration, elegance and a distinctive character that defines Valdealto. In the winery, we apply minimal intervention: native yeasts, micro-vinifications and ageing in French oak barrels and foudres. Our aim is to express a fresher, finer and truly authentic Extremadura.
Winery Location: CARRETERA N-630, KM. 634, 06800, MERIDA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 734
Product 1 Description: VALDEALTO Late harvest SWEET WINE VARIETY: Viognier TYPE OF SOIL: Sandy-clay VINEYARD: “La Serrana”, Valdealto Estate YIELDS: 1,900 kg per hectare VINTAGE: The autumn rains, followed by a particularly wet winter with March being the wettest month, guaranteed optimal wa- ter reserves. Spring, marked by cool tempe- ratures and irregular rainfall, favored early budding and allowed flowering and fruit set to proceed without setbacks. The summer remained cool until the end of July, when high temperatures arrived, becoming more moderate again from the end of August and until the harvest, which took place the third week of October. WINEMAKING: After destemming, the must macerated with its skins for five hours. Cold settling was performed, and fermenta- tion took place at low temperature in stain- less steel tanks. The process continued with work on fine lees until bottling. SUGAR: 125g/l. ALCOHOLLEVEL: 12,5%.
Product 2 Description: VALDEALTO Supremum 2022 VARIETY: Syrah TYPE OF SOIL: Sandy, stony and poor in organic material. VINEYARD: Plot “Las Rozas de Grau”, Valdealto Estate. YIELDS: 2,800 kg per hectare. VINTAGE: The beginning and end of autumn was rainy with mild temperatures. The winter was dry, with some rain in its last stage. During the spring, rain was scarce, despite some isolated precipitation. The flowering was somewhat early and the fruit set was excellent. Green pruning work was carried out. The summer was hot in the month of July, with cooler temperatures in the month of August. The harvest was brought forward in search of fresher wines, which took place in the third week of August. WINEMAKING: The grapes were destemmed but not crushed. An eight-day cold pre-fermen- tation maceration was carried out, followed by fermentation in stainless steel tanks with indigenous yeast. AGED: 14 months in French oak barrels with medium toasting. ALCOHOL LEVEL: 14,5%.
Product 3 Description: VALDEALTO Viognier VARIETY: Viognier. TYPE OF SOIL: Sandy-clay VINEYARD: Plot “La Serrana”, Valdealto Estate. YIELDS: 4,400 kg per hectare.
