Spring, marked by cool temperatures and irregular rainfall, favored early budding and allowed flowering and fruit set to proceed without setbacks. The summer remained cool until the end of July, when high temperatures arrived. The harvest began the second week of August, with grapes of excellent balance. WINEMAKING: Once the grapes were destemmed, the must macerated with its skins for five hours. Cold settling was carried out, and fermentation took place at low temperatu- re in stainless steel tanks. The process conti- nued with work on the lees until bottling. ALCOHOLLEVEL: 12,5%.

Winery Description: Bodegas Valdemar is a family winery with more than 135 years of history, led by Ana and Jesús Martínez Bujanda, 5th generation of the Valdemar family. Based in Rioja Alavesa, it owns around 300 hectares of vineyards in the three sub-zones of Rioja. Combining tradition and innovation, as well as practicing sustainable agriculture, it produces three ranges of wines in Rioja: the classic Conde Valdemar, micro-vinifications of plots with native varieties such as Maturana and Graciano, as well as La Gargantilla wines from a unique estate. In the heart of the Ribera del Duero, Fincas Valdemar wines are made, which show the uniqueness of Tempranillo in this region. In 2019, he opened his boutique winery Valdemar Estates, in Walla Walla, Washington state. It thus becomes the first non-European winery to establish itself in the second largest wine region in the United States.
Winery Location: CAMINO VIEJO DE LOGROÑO 24, 01320, OYON , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 225
Product 1 Name: Conde Valdemar Finca Alto Cantabria Singular Vineyard
Product 1 Description: The result of combining the nobility of vines over 40 years old and a land of great quality: this white wine from the exclusive Alto Cantabria vineyard will make you feel unique. A wine impossible to forget and with an overwhelming personality. It is our best example to show that we were pioneers in working with white wines from the plot with our traditional varieties. A wine with an optimal point of creaminess and elegance, thanks to its fermentation and aging in French oak barrels, difficult to achieve with other varieties. Straw yellow in colour with greenish reflections, clean and bright. It shows great intensity with aromas of stone fruit such as apricot and peach, accompanied by subtle hints of smoke. In the background, delicate notes of nuts reminiscent of hazelnut appear, adding complexity. On the palate, it has a sweet entry and a great amplitude, with memories of its aging on fine lees. Its saline character brings freshness and personality.
Product 2 Description: If there is a wine that best demonstrates our history, our way of giving value to Rioja wines, it is our Gran Reserva. A wine that shows the greatness and potential of the grapes of our land. Unique, capable of living for years. One of the greatness of Rioja that is difficult to imitate outside our borders. Our wine is not described with nuances of color, aromas and flavors. It is the feelings that we have carried inside us for more than 130 years that best define him: passion, effort, dedication, precision, patience, pride. Selection of plots of old vines in Rioja Alavesa. Ruby red colour, clean and bright, with a very high layer. It stands out for its intense and complex aroma, where black fruit and plum are combined with hints of liquorice, accompanied by balsamic notes of bay leaf and a Subtle hint of black tea that adds depth. On the palate, it is elegant and smooth, with a structure that maintains its nerve and character. The finish is broad, savoury and round.
Product 3 Description: The experience and enthusiasm of five generations are concentrated in the production of this iconic wine, an exclusive selection of Jesús Martínez Bujanda (4th generation of Valdemar Family). The search for the most unique soils and the best plots of native varieties with a genuine character are the basis on which we create our most precious treasure. Power, race, maturity, structure, complexity, elegance... We do not run out of attributes to define this wine. Strict manual selection between our plots La Recaja (Tempranillo from vines planted in 1979), Balcón de Pilatos (Maturana) and Seis Alhajas (Graciano). Cherry red colour, bright and with a high layer. It displays an intense expression of ripe black fruit and liquorice, accompanied by balsamic notes, fine spices, cocoa, a subtle smoky background and hints of dried fruits. It shows a wide and silky entry, with hints of sweet spices and liquorice. It is a structured but friendly wine, with an elegant finish.

Winery Description: Valdequemao, the flagship brand of the San Isidro Cooperative, is embarking on a new phase in the 2020 harvest under the Valdequemao Vides & Vinos label, an autonomous management structure dedicated to producing wines with their own identity. The project draws on an exhaustive selection of the best plots and wines, with comprehensive control of the entire process. Each production has a clear objective: to express the uniqueness of the origin through wine and oil, under the philosophy that defines the brand: ‘Wines and Oils with Origin’. Valdequemao currently develops three lines of wines: Single Varietal Collection, Classics and Experimental Wines, which represent the balance between tradition, precision and creativity.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 721
Product 1 Description: .Pardina huele a las flores, a tierra, a pueblo… Un vino que habla de sus orígenes y tradiciones, de sus gentes y su cultura, de su arte y su legado. Este vino joven, fresco y fácil de beber es sin duda un buen introductor para descubrir la originalidad de la variedad Pardina, autóctona extremeña, de Tierra de Barros, de Villafranca.
Product 2 Description: Un Pardina “halbtrocken”, cuyo azúcar residual es consecuencia de una parada fermentativa por frío (0% azúcares añadidos), logrando preservar de este modo el equilibrio dulce-ácido de la uva. Un vino rebosante de frescura varietal: cítricos, fruta blanca, mentolados… que por su baja graduación y el perfecto equilibrio entre azúcar residual y la acidez natural del vino hacen las delicias de todo tipo de públicos. Un vino para maridar con amigos, delivery y tapeos desenfadados…
Product 3 Description: Estamos ante un vino descaradamente clásico, fino, fresco y expresivo, con el que la Cooperativa San Isidro de Villafranca hace un giño a sus orígenes y su añejo saber hacer. Un prototipo del clasicismo enológico. Es un vino parcelario, pero con terruño de bodega. Esto es, este vino es un coupage, no de suelos, sino de vinificaciones y añadas, en homenaje a las vinificaciones antiguas: Los CVC o Conjunto de Varias Cosechas. En el coupage final de la presente Edición, se ensamblaron vinos con 12 meses de estancia en barrica viejas, así como vinos de media crianza en barricas nuevas y vinos en contacto con las lias. Presenta un bonito color rojo picota de ribete evolucionado, con una nariz en la que predominan los recuerdos especiados, propios de la madera vieja. En boca es fino, de taninos pulidos, que lo hacen un acompañante excepcional
Product 4 Description: Suave, fluido y sedoso. Así es nuestro Tempranillo más jovial. Un vino en el que buscamos la máxima expresión varietal, desnudándolo de interferencias: “Sólo Tempranillo”. Tempranillo by Valdequemao es una caricia sensorial. Un vino ligero como una pluma, a la vez que sedoso en su trago, con un recorrido marcado por un delicioso recuerdo de frutos rojos.
Product 5 Description: Valdequemao Roble es el pequeño de sus grandes vinos “Clásicos” de la propiedad. Un vino que mantiene ese respeto por el viñedo y por la uva en su vinificación, en un trabajo de precisión excelsa, dónde el empleo de las maderas desarrollan un papel clave, siendo seleccionadas específicamente para aportar elegancia y sin enmascarar los aromas y sabores provenientes de la uva. Verdad, nitidez y franqueza. Todo va por delante. Un vino con intensidad frutal, arropada por notas de toffes, cremas y sutiles torrefactos. En boca, posee un trago memorable y potente, en el que las papilas palpitan por un segundo trago.

Winery Description: Grape by grape, harvest after harvest, the history of Valdesil has been carved out for four generations on the substrate of a family legacy made up of a mosaic of small vineyards – pezas – scattered on the most extreme slopes of the Valdeorras valley, in the Sil river basin, together with a way of understanding vine cultivation based on the utmost respect for the land. Throughout these four generations we have recovered vineyards condemned to disappear and preserved ancestral grape varieties that no one else bet on. And on this journey of no return, we have managed to create legendary wines that arouse emotions, transcend understanding and take root indefinitely in our memory.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 165
Product 1 Description: The Asadoira plot has an area of 3.83 ha, and is located in the village of Córgomo. Its privileged orientation southeast ensures your full exposure to the magic of morning light, being sheltered from the rigor of the afternoon heat. Grown by the Prada Gayoso family for four generations, in 1971 1.41 ha were replanted with a mass selection of Godello of Pedrouzos, pioneering the installation of the first trellis in Valdeorras to face the cooling that the climate had suffered since the 40s, becoming much colder and more humid, reducing the thermal integral and making it difficult for the grapes to ripen. The soil is managed following a conservationist philosophy, through the use of a vegetation cover throughout the year, and the plants are cared for following their circadian rhythms.
Product 2 Description: O Chao is a single-vineyard wine that is produced exclusively with grapes from a single peza (plot), from which it takes its name wine. The O Chao fish is located in the parish of As Ermitas (Santa María), in the municipality of O Bolo. It was planted by Mr. Manuel Gayoso Díaz in 1941, during his time as a professor of Theology at the seminary of Las Ermitas. The wine from this plot was used in the Eucharist ceremony of the seminary/sanctuary for 10 years. The wine shows an elegant and extraordinary complexity on the nose, a creamy texture, great body and a Excellent balance, with an amazingly long and mineral finish
Product 3 Description: Pedrouzos is a single-vineyard wine that is produced exclusively with the grapes from a single tiny peza (plot), of which the name of wine takes its name. The Pedrouzos fish is one of the most important vineyards in the world. most iconic in the world, as it is the origin of the Godello. It is located in the village of Portela, in the municipality of Vilamartín de Valdeorras. It was replanted by Mr. Jose Ramón Gayoso in 1885, after the destruction of the European vineyard by phylloxera. It is the first Godello vineyard in the world, and one of the first in the world to have been planted using only one variety.
Product 4 Description: Pezas da Portela is a tribute to Portela, the origin of the Godello. It is a village wine that is produced exclusively from the 11 historical pezas (plots) located in the slate slopes of the village of Portela, in the municipality of Vilamartín de Valdeorras. All 11 pezas were planted throughout the first half of the twentieth century by the sons of D. Jose Ramón Gayoso, continuing his father's legacy as a world pioneer in the cultivation and production of wines from Godello, and for this they used a mass selection of Pedrouzos.
Product 5 Description: Valdesil is a tribute to the Sil River, the backbone of Galicia, which as it passes through Valdeorras forms a narrow valley. A pioneering and revolutionary wine in Spain, as it is the first white wine aged on its lees in tank. It is made exclusively with grapes from vineyards owned by the family settled on schist rock, located in the parishes of Portela (San Xulián) and Córgomo (Santa Marta), in the municipality of Vilamartín de Valdeorras. The vineyards are managed following the circadian rhythms of the plants, and a vegetation cover is maintained throughout the year, ensuring a living soil without erosion. The wine shows the traits of schist soils with its delicate citrus and mineral notes, very elegant, followed by aromas of delicate stone fruit, interspersed with herbal notes of fennel and the notes of aging on its fine lees. On the palate sample An extraordinary balance, with a medium to high body, unctuous, and an excellent structure based on its acidity.

Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 603

Winery Description: Vallformosa is a historic winery in the Penedès (Barcelona) with more than 150 years of experience, specialized in the production of high quality wines and cavas that combine tradition, innovation and sustainability. Unlike other wineries, Vallformosa does not base its model on its own large vineyards, but on a close collaboration with more than 400 wine-growing families in the territory. This model guarantees total control from the vineyard to the bottle, betting on quality and respect for the environment. Sustainability is one of its strategic pillars. It reduces water and energy consumption, reuses and recycles most of its waste, opts for lighter bottles and, in 2024, became the first Spanish winery certified as a B Corp, a recognition of its social and environmental impact. Vallformosa represents a way of understanding life: celebrating every moment, bringing wine and cava closer to people to turn everyday life into something extraordinary.
Winery Location: LA SALA 45, 08735, VILOBI DEL PENEDES , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 164

Winery Description: In the heart of the Ribera del Duero region, between Aranda de Duero and Peñafiel, lies Valreinas Vineyard and Winery. This newly established winery eagerly embraces the challenge of offering the wine market its wines, imbued with experience, expressiveness, and a distinctive family character that makes them truly unique.

Product 1 Description: Valreinas Crianza. This 100% Tempranillo wine is aged for 12 months in French and American oak barrels. It boasts an attractive deep burgundy color, notable for its brilliance and clarity. The nose offers an intense aroma of black fruit, perfectly integrated with notes of vanilla and subtle toasty hints imparted by the oak. On the palate, it is full-bodied, fleshy, and structured, with velvety tannins that provide a long and persistent finish. Ideal for pairing with aged cheeses, oily fish, red meat, and roasts.
Product 2 Description: Valreinas Joven. A 100% Tempranillo red wine that reflects the purity of the fruit and the youth of the vineyard. It presents a clean cherry color with violet hues, characteristic of its youth. On the nose, primary aromas of blackberries and wild berries stand out, integrated with subtle balsamic and licorice notes. On the palate, it is full-bodied and pleasant, with balanced tannins, good acidity, and a smooth finish with hints of dark fruit. Ideal to accompany cheeses, pasta dishes, and white fish.
Product 3 Description: Valreinas Piripintado. Made with 100% Tempranillo grapes, this rosé stands out for its freshness and aromatic expression. It has an attractive, clean, and bright pale strawberry color. On the nose, it is intense and expressive, with clear primary aromas of fresh strawberry over a delicate citrus background. On the palate, it is fruity, full-bodied, and very fresh, with citrus notes that provide a pleasant finish. A balanced and easy-to-enjoy wine, ideal for pairing with vegetables, salads, rice dishes, and white fish.
Product 4 Description: Valreinas Reserva. Made with 100% Tempranillo grapes, this wine undergoes a long aging process of 26 months in oak barrels and 12 months in the bottle, for a total aging of 38 months. It presents an elegant, medium-intensity garnet color. The nose is dominated by aromas of ripe red fruit such as plum and blackcurrant, along with spicy notes, hints of tobacco leaf, and licorice. On the palate, it is deep and complex, with velvety tannins that lend elegance and persistence. Ideal for aged cheeses, meat stews, oily fish, and red meats.
Product 5 Description: Valreinas Roble. Made with 100% Tempranillo grapes, this wine is aged for 4 months in French and American oak barrels. It displays a deep, clean, and bright Bordeaux color. The nose is intense and balsamic, with a predominance of black fruit perfectly integrated with the subtle toasty notes from the barrel. On the palate, it is full-bodied, round, and elegant, with a persistent finish and hints of roasted coffee. A balanced and versatile wine, ideal for pairing with cheeses, pasta, white meats, and white fish.

Winery Description: CHERUBINO VALSANGIACOMO is a 100% family-owned winery, founded in 1831 in Switzerland and currently run by the 5th generation of the Valsangiacomo family, dedicated to the production and export of wines and grape musts. We operate three wineries in the Valencian Community—two owned by the company and one leased—as well as another winery in Castilla-La Mancha dedicated to producing organic wine and must. We produce wines under the Valencia PDO and Utiel-Requena PDO, as well as varietal, organic, and vegan wines, vermouth, and wine-based cocktails. Our brands: El Novio Perfecto: a very popular wine among a young market segment, 10% ABV and semi-sweet. Aigua de Valencia: a very Valencian product, a wine-based cocktail with orange juice, 8.5% ABV, lightly sparkling. Vermouth Vittore: the oldest vermouth in Valencia, crafted since 1904 using the family's own artisanal recipe created by Benedetto Valsangiacomo (third generation). Bodega Bobal de San Juan: 100% Bobal red wines produced in our San Juan de Requena winery, fermented in raw concrete tanks, sourced from old, dry-farmed bush vines.

Winery Description: Valtravieso in DO Ribera del Duero was acclaimed as a First Growth by Tim Atkin MW in 2023, 2024 and 2025. Nestled in one of the region’s highest limestone moorlands at an altitude above 900m, it produces high-altitude wines with a unique character. Minimal intervention winemaking allows us to preserve the grape’s natural quality, reflecting the distinctive terroir, resulting in elegant, profound wine endowed with mineral freshness and captivating tension. Valtravieso extends its commitment also to other Designations of Origin such as DO Arlanza, DO Ribera del Júcar and DO Jumilla, aiming to revive traditional vineyard areas and highlight native varietals with a distinct approach that preserves the identity of each region. This initiative is embodied in the project named "Valtravieso Viñedos Olvidados".
Winery Location: Finca La Revilla, s/n. 0, 47316, Piñel de Arriba
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 294

Winery Description: Our wines are made up of traditional varieties from the Canary Islands, such as Listán Negro, Negramol and Listan Blanco. These varieties have evolved over decades in a demanding environment, developing a unique maturity and expression that translate into wines with their own character. The age of the estate's vines is a distinguishing factor: many of them are around 40 years old, which brings aromatic depth and complexity to our wines. These old vines are cultivated with respectful methods, with manual harvesting at the optimum moment of ripeness and careful management that prioritizes the health of the soil and the plant over intensive production. Each vineyard plot receives individualized treatment and is often vinified separately to preserve its identity. Plots such as Hoya Oscura or Reventón are examples of how specific conditions: orientation, soil type and exposure, can influence the final characteristics of the wine

Product 2 Description: This is a single-estate wine made with Listán Negro and Negramoll, fermented in stainless steel and macerated for 30 days. Its clean and direct character faithfully reflects the volcanic landscape of the Caldera de Bandama

Winery Description: Boutique Winery of Jerez de la Frontera, production of quality wines from the Pago de Macharnudo to the bottle. VEC brand. Family business with limited production of high quality fortified sherry wines.

Winery Description: Vega Aixalà Winery is a family dream come true: we founded it in 2003 after recovering and rebuilding our grandfather's old vineyard on the outskirts of Vilanova de Prades. From a young age, we grew up watching wine being made in the traditional way, and resuming this project has meant a life change for us, as well as a return to our roots. We harvest the grapes by hand, and our process is highly artisanal: we create high-quality wines with character, wines that captivate. We produce organic and natural wines in limited quantities.

Winery Description: Venta d’Aubert is an organic winery founded in the 80s in the heart of the Matarraña region in Aragón, Spain; and part since 2022 of art gallery Albarrán Bourdais and Solo Houses. A reinterpretation of the heritage of a Venta – a stopover for meeting and convergence – which operates as a platform for winemakers to capture with every bottle a unique interpretation of the monumental landscape. Embedded beside the striking natural park of Puertos de Tortosa-Beceite, the winery works with two guest winemakers, Stefan Dorst and César Fernandez Díaz, who are given full creative freedom for their craft in the cellar.     As custodians of 18 hectares of low-yield vineyard – certified organic since 2013 – as well as 200 hectares of oak forests and olive groves, the team has for decades been committed to upholding the biodiversity of the land and fostering the regeneration of clay-limestone soils with regenerative agricultural principles, which bring both breadth and tension to all the wines.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street A, Stand 413
Product 1 Description: The Venta d'Aubert Solo 200, in essence, is "HORIZON". Undulating clouds pour over the mountains of the Ports, where the crystal clear sky meets the vastness of the Cretan highlands. It is a balanced and gastronomic white wine, with a waxy and mineral character. Elegant, full-bodied and looking for the lingering freshness of White Grenache and Viognier. He wants to convey the frankness of the landscape, as if you could drink it and chew it. A social wine, to be shared. Like the clouds on the horizon that inspire it, the Venta d'Aubert Solo 200 is frank and crisp, soft to the touch and endless. Direct press of each variety separately, vinified in stainless steel Composition: 50% Grenache Blanc 50% Viognier 89 GUIA PEÑIN / 90 PARKER WINE ADVOCATE / 92 TIM ATKINS /
Product 2 Description: The Venta d’Aubert Solo 100, in essence, is “ESCARPMENT”. The Puertos de Tortosa-Beceite mountains, whose rugged, rocky faces look down on upon the vineyards, are the Matarraña’s guardians, as well as its bedrock. Is a raw but delicate, mid-weight red wine, made by Cesar Fernandez. It is a minimal intervention expression of the dark, mediterranean Red Grenache, Syrah and Monastrell grapes in a transitional climate on poor, clay-limestone soils. On the nose, it leads with bright red berries and follows with notes of a balsamic, herbaceous, Mediterranean underbrush. On the palate, it leads with freshness and plump fruit, and follows with a very light grip that ties the wine together structurally. A wine for low-key tapas dinners with friends, or to drink on its own. The Venta d’Aubert Solo 100 is rustic and rugged, like the mountains that surround the vineyard, and that is what keeps it grounded. 92 GUÍA PEÑIN / 91 ROBERT PARKER WINE ADVOCATE / 89 TIM ATKINS /
Product 3 Description: The Venta d’Aubert Solo 300, in essence, is “SANCTUARY”. The Venta is a shelter, a place to recharge, re-energise and restore balance after a long voyage. It holds the promise of tomorrow. Is a naked red wine in perfect harmony, made by Cesar Fernández. Winery Description: Wines of Great People Located in the heart of the Priorat, Vinícola del Priorat is the heiress of the local cooperatives of the villages of Gratallops, El Lloar, La Vilella Alta and La Vilella Baixa, founded since the year 1917. Vinícola del Priorat today is a single cooperative winery under the auspices of 140 families that manage more than 300 small plots within these four towns. A project born from the partnership of people to adapt to new times and based on quality and professionalisation. Vinícola del Priorat is nowadays the only cooperative in the Priorat region that manages all the production process, from vine growing and wine making to commercialization of the wine. Our families have known how to keep alive the tradition and millenary culture of wine in this territory, working hand by hand with the team of professionals from Vinícola del Priorat. The rugged landscape of the Priorat, with vines growing on steep slopes that can exceed 30% of unevenness, the distinctive slate soil and the advanced age of the vineyards (the centuries-old vineyards are our treasure) are the cornerstone of our wines.

Winery Description: ViniGalicia is a Galician winery with more than 80 years of history, born in 1940 with Casa Penouzos and consolidated over three generations as a project committed to viticulture, tradition and quality. With 73 hectares of vineyards and an annual production of more than 12.7 million bottles, ViniGalicia produces wines and spirits that reflect the diversity and richness of Galicia. Present in the five Galician Denominations of Origin – Ribeira Sacra, Rías Baixas, Ribeiro, Valdeorras and Monterrei – it includes wineries such as Vía Romana, Terriña, Vía Atlántica, Marqués de Sanfiz and Lagar de Deuses. More than fifty wine-growing families are part of this project, based on respect for the land, native varieties and know-how passed down over time. Currently, ViniGalicia exports to more than 49 countries, bringing the essence of Galician wine to international markets.

Product 1 Description: Procedente de la D.O. Rías Baixas, este vino 100% Albariño expresa el carácter atlántico de viñedos con una edad media de 40 años, cultivados sobre suelos franco-arenosos y bajo un clima oceánico marcado por la influencia del mar. La elaboración comienza con una maceración en frío para preservar el potencial aromático de la variedad, seguida de una fermentación a baja temperatura que permite conservar aromas primarios y desarrollar notas fermentativas elegantes. Posteriormente, el vino permanece un mínimo de 7 meses en depósito a temperatura controlada antes de su clarificación, embotellado y afinado en botella. En copa presenta un color amarillo pajizo con reflejos verdosos, limpio y brillante. En nariz es intenso y sutil, con aromas de fruta de hueso, cítricos y un delicado toque de lichi. En boca es amplio, fresco y vibrante, con un ligero carácter salino y un final equilibrado y persistente. Ideal para sushi, mariscos y carnes blancas.
Product 2 Description: Coming from the D.O. Valdeorras, this 100% Godello wine faithfully expresses the character of a territory marked by slate soils and terraces that accompany the course of the Sil River. The vineyards, which are more than 30 years old, are located in plots of Petín, Larouco, O Bolo and Vilamartín de Valdeorras, between 301 and 632 metres above sea level, in a Mediterranean-oceanic climate with Atlantic influence. After a cold maceration of the free-run must, the wine ferments in stainless steel at a controlled temperature and undergoes a minimum ageing of two months on lees with weekly bâtonnage, followed by refining in the bottle. In the glass it has an attractive pale yellow color with golden reflections. On the nose it is intense and fresh, with aromas of white fruit and stone, citrus notes and balsamic and nutty nuances. On the palate it is broad, structured and elegant, with well-integrated acidity and a long and persistent finish. Ideal to pair with seafood, fish, white meats and oriental cuisine.
Product 3 Description: Procedente de la D.O. Ribeira Sacra, este vino 100% Mencía expresa el carácter de la viticultura heroica en bancales situados entre los 200 y 600 metros de altitud, con pendientes extremas de hasta el 80%. Los viñedos, con una edad media de 25 años, se asientan sobre suelos franco-arenosos de origen granítico, en un clima atlántico con influencia mediterránea y marcada regulación térmica de los ríos Sil y Miño. La fermentación alcohólica se realiza en depósito de acero inoxidable a temperatura controlada, seguida de fermentación maloláctica. Posteriormente, el vino permanece 3 meses sobre lías, se clarifica con proteína de guisante y se estabiliza antes de su embotellado. En copa presenta un color rojo picota con ribetes púrpura. En nariz es elegante e intenso, con aromas de fruta roja, flores y fondo balsámico. En boca es fresco, equilibrado y glicérico, con buena acidez y un final agradable. Ideal para carnes rojas, caza, pastas, pescados grasos, quesos y embutidos.

We invite you to experience ATLANTE, a family-run winery rooted in generations of vine-growing tradition in the unique Valle de la Orotava D.O., North Tenerife, Canary Islands. For decades, our family cultivated these volcanic slopes, providing grapes for bulk wines. In 2013, confident in the exceptional quality of our grapes, we took the leap to bottle our own estate wines under the ATLANTE brand. We currently produce 10,000 bottles of meticulously crafted wines from indigenous Canarian varietals, showcasing the unique volcanic terroir. While we currently sell a portion of our grapes, we have the capacity to expand production, always prioritizing small-batch, high-quality wines from our three hectares of unique vineyards. ATLANTE represents the soul of Tenerife – volcanic, authentic, and unforgettable. We are seeking international distribution partners who share our passion for distinctive, terroir-driven wines.

Winery Description: Founded in 1965 in Pedro Muñoz, Vinos Coloman has grown to become one of the leading wineries in Castilla-La Mancha. A total of 480 members carefully tend to 5,000 hectares of their own vineyards, ensuring quality and complete control from the very beginning. In our 30,000 m² facilities, tradition and technology come together to extract the best from each grape through rigorous and modern production processes. Our wines rest in oak barrels, where they develop spicy ageing aromas, balance, and an exceptional bouquet. Our environment —with more than 3,000 hours of sunlight per year, limestone soils, and a climate of strong contrasts— gives our wines a truly distinctive character. We produce emblematic varieties such as Airén, Verdejo, Macabeo, Tempranillo, Syrah, Graciano, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Garnacha Tintorera, creating wines with personality, body, and finesse. A winery with soul, origin, and vision: wines crafted to surprise and captivate the palate.

Winery Description: Vinos de Bellite is a biodynamic wine project based in the historic village of Olite, Navarra — founded by Annabelle Borra, after years of winemaking in Bordeaux and the U.S., where she contributed to several 100-point Parker wines. Drawn by what she sees as the most beautiful vineyards in the world, Annabelle settled in Navarra to create wines rooted in authenticity, place, and integrity. Working exclusively with old-vine Garnacha, all vineyards are dry-farmed, hand-harvested, and cultivated according to biodynamic principles. In the cellar, whole-cluster fermentation and ageing in clay amphorae or large-format oak allow for pure, unmasked expression. Each wine is made in small quantities, with care and intention — letting the vineyard speak.

Notes of citrus, fennel, white flowers and a touch of salinity define this elegant and age-worthy Garnacha Blanca.

The vineyard is fully biodynamic, and 2023 marks the first solo release of this unique site. A portion of whole-cluster fermentation and ageing in clay amphorae capture the purity of fruit and structure. A wine of freshness, red fruit, subtle spice and length — elegant, vibrant, and full of place.
Product 3 Description: Borra de la Vega is a biodynamic Garnacha grown on dry-farmed vineyards in Olite, Navarra. It’s a vibrant, expressive wine that balances red fruit, fine herbs, and savoury spice — with freshness, energy, and length at its core.

Winery Name: VIÑOS DE ENCOSTAS - XOSE LOIS SEBIO
Winery Description:
Viños de Encostas is a winemaking project led by Xosé Lois Sebio, whosejourney began in 1998 in the Ribeiro region. After his time at the Galicia Enology Station and over two decades as the technical director at the Coto de Gomariz winery, Sebio gained extensive expertise in viticulture, ampelography, and varietal recovery.

The Viños de Encostas project started in 2008, including the production of renowned wines in three different regions of Galicia: Rías Baixas, Valdeorras, and Ribeiro. Within Ribeiro, Viños de Encostas focuses on producing wines from old vineyards, with the goal of preventing their abandonment and restoring them to their former glory. Since 2016, efforts have been dedicated to reviving historic vineyards in the Gomariz Valley, often regarded as the “Golden Mile” of Ribeiro.

Winery Description: A project inspired by a Burgundian philosophy, focused on the recovery of old vineyards in a little-known valley in La Rioja: the Iregua Valley. We practise respectful viticulture based on observation, working with native grape varieties and historic plots. A young and vibrant Rioja whose wines have received praise from critics and consumers alike, winning, among other awards, the prize for ‘Oenological Innovation’ from the Guía de Vinos de la Vanguardia in the last edition of the BWW. Vinos del Panorámico is an artistic project that highlights the value of those ‘corros’ or “majuelos” of native grape varieties that their ancestors used for ‘house wine’ and which today retain the essence of great wines. Hence their commitment to interpreting the vineyard as a photographer would, imprinting their own personality on it. Based on this soulful viticulture that observes rather than intervenes, this winery trusts in the expert hands of small winegrowers.

Winery Description: Vinos Llámalo X is a family-run project located in Villarrobledo (Albacete), led by the fourth generation of winegrowers, born out of a desire to recover the identity of wine in the face of industrial homogenization. Our philosophy is rooted in authenticity and respect for the land, applying responsible practices that minimize environmental impact. Our vineyards are located on a high plateau in the interior of Albacete, at 720 meters above sea level, in an environment of extreme climate and low rainfall, where we practice traditional dry-farmed viticulture across 15 hectares of old vines and diverse soils. We are committed to varietal recovery, working with varieties such as Airén, Pardilla, Macabeo, Montonera, Bobal, Crujidera, Cencibel, Listán Prieto, Moribel, Tinto Fragoso, Garnacha and Monastrell, and we stand for a slow, unhurried approach to winemaking, guiding each process with precision and without artifice.

Our parents have been part of the origin of the project, dedicating themselves mainly to the sale of grapes to other wineries and to maintaining and expanding the vineyards with new plantations, purchases and exchanges in the different places of Valtuille de Abajo. Winery Description: Vinos Rabilargo was born in 2019 and established its micro winery in 2022 in Miranda del Castañar. All our wines come from our own vineyards, planted on terraces and with an average age of 90 years. We work with native varieties such as Rufete, Aragonés (local clone of Tempranillo) and Rufete Serrano Blanco. Since our inception we have worked recovering abandoned vineyards, cultivating them ecologically, with an emphasis on restoring the biodiversity of soils and vineyards. In the winery we use low-intervention winemaking processes and different ageing methods, such as barrels, clay jars, demijohns and concrete tanks, all in order to highlight the natural characteristics of the grapes and the terroir.

Winery Description: Vinos Tudanca is a family business that over five generations of women winegrowers have developed a deep love for the vineyard and in the production of wines of exceptional quality. The wines come from almost century-old vineyards of Tempranillo grapes (which are owned by the family). Most of the vineyard is located in the heart of the Ribera del Duero in the town of La Horra and the rest is located in Gumiel de Mercado, both within the province of Burgos. In total, there are thirty-six hectares that are cared for each season by our agricultural technicians.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 218

Winery Description: Vinos Valtuille is a small family winery and Marcos García Alba, one of the last generation of producers and winemakers in El Bierzo. Marcos took on the challenge in early 2000 to produce high quality wines, making a large investment in facilities and technical resources to move forward with his family dream. Meticulously self-taught, he takes care of the vineyard as it has always been done in Valtuille de Abajo, where he has 15 hectares with centenary vineyards. The youngest sister Elena, who is in charge of the General Management and the sales department, joined the winery in 2014. Since then, both siblings have worked in perfect tandem so that the project continues to grow and improve year by year. They decided to maintain the best part of their elders’ work, the raw material and the vineyards, and made an effort to show it to everyone else. They have invested in quality rather than quantity. All this work has become Pago de Valdoneje, named after one of their grandfather’s centenary vineyards. They only produce wines from their own grapes and defend the idea of a small winery as a means to produce quality.
Winery Location: LA FRAGUA, S/N, 24530, VALTUILLE DE ABAJO , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 415

Winery Description: Bodegas Vega Norte is a winery located in the northwest of La Palma, in the Canary Islands, where unique pre-phylloxera vineyards grow between 1000 and 1500 meters on eroded volcanic soils. This Atlantic environment, with high minerality and great climatic contrast, gives rise to fresh, saline wines with a marked personality. We grow native varieties such as Albillo Criollo and Listán Prieto through heroic viticulture and manual harvesting to preserve their distinctive character. In our winery we combine tradition and modern techniques to produce vibrant whites, expressive rosés and reds with an Atlantic identity. Each bottle reflects a unique origin and environmentally friendly production, offering European distributors an authentic, differentiating proposal with high potential in markets that value history, territory and quality.
Winery Location: CMNO BELLIDO 3, 38780, TIJARAFE
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 645
Product 1 Name: Vega Norte Albillo Criollo "Nuestro rayo verde"
Product 1 Description: Albillo Criollo” is a single-variety white wine that stands out for its purity and elegance. Made 100% from Albillo Criollo grapes, this wine has an alcohol content of 13.5%. It appears clean and transparent, with steely and greenish reflections. On the nose, it offers a notable presence of ripe fruits such as peach, melon, apricot and pear, framed by a floral background of orchids and herbal notes of anise and fennel. On the palate, it is balanced, with delicate acidity and a long aftertaste. This wine is perfect for those seeking a white wine with character and complexity.
Product 2 Name: Vega Norte rosado "Un vino y una flor"
Product 2 Description: Un Vino y Una Flor is a rosé wine with an elegant strawberry hue and violet highlights, clean and bright. Made exclusively from Negramoll, it has an alcohol content of 13.5%. On the nose, it offers aromas reminiscent of forest fruits and tropical notes, with strawberry and guava standing out. On the palate, it is fresh, luscious, and intense, perfectly balanced with a distinctive personality. This wine is ideal for those seeking a rosé with character and freshness, perfect to enjoy on a summer afternoon.
Product 3 Description: Donde Caben Cuatro is a red wine made from four exceptional pre-phylloxera grape varieties: Listán Prieto (60%), Vijariego Negro (20%), Castellana (15%), and Negramoll (5%). With an alcohol content of 14%, this wine displays a deep cherry-red color with violet hues. On the nose, it stands out for its powerful expression of ripe fruit, gaining complexity through notes of cocoa and mineral nuances. On the palate, it is fruity, mineral, and saline, showing persistence and balance. This wine is ideal for those seeking a red with depth and complexity.
Product 4 Description: Tinto X Selección is a red wine that displays a cherry color with a medium-high body and violet highlights. Made from 40% Listán Prieto, 30% Vijariego Negro, 10% Almuñeco, 10% Castellana Negra, and 10% Negramoll, it has an alcohol content of 15%. It offers medium-high aromatic intensity, with notes of cocoa, black pepper, spices, balsamic nuances, toasted aromas, and blackberries. When the glass is swirled, the cocoa and red fruit aromas become more pronounced. On the palate, it is dry, with a long, fresh finish and pleasant tannins. On the retronasal, red fruit and balsamic notes appear. This wine is ideal for those seeking a red with aromatic complexity and body.
Product 5 Name: Vega Norte white young "Me Quedo en Blanco"
Product 5 Description: Me Quedo en Blanco is an exquisite blend of 75% Listán Blanco, 15% Forastera Blanca, and 10% Albillo Criollo. With an alcohol content of 13.5%, it appears clean and bright with steely highlights. On the nose, it stands out for its expressive tropical fruit aromas—mango, banana, pineapple, and melon—set against a floral backdrop. On the palate, it is well balanced, luscious, and straightforward, with notable persistence that delivers layers of fruit and floral notes. This wine is ideal for those seeking a rich and complex tasting experience, perfect to pair with light and fresh dishes.

Winery Description: Vino Taruguín is a small, artisanal wine project based in San Esteban de Gormaz, Soria, one of Spain’s highest and coolest wine-growing areas. Our work is rooted in old vineyards, farmed with deep respect for their natural balance and identity. We focus on freshness, purity and origin, crafting wines that reflect the character of Soria’s landscape and climate. All wines are made through handcrafted, low-intervention winemaking, with minimal manipulation in the cellar, allowing the vineyards to speak clearly. At Barcelona Wine Week we will present two wines: Taruguín – A fresh, vibrant expression of our old vineyards, highlighting elegance, tension and clarity. Corral de Taruguín – A more structured and complex wine, still driven by freshness and balance, showing the depth and potential of Soria’s old vines. Vino Taruguín represents an honest approach to winemaking: old vines, freshness, minimal intervention and a strong sense of place in Soria.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street B, Stand 256
Product 1 Description: Elaborado con uvas procedentes de Soto de San Esteban, en un paraje en alto que los habitantes conocen como Corral, muy aireado y con orientación noreste, suelo arenoso con guijarros, de gran drenaje y altitud por encima de los 900 metros. Un terroir único que hemos elegido para elaborar un vino de máxima expresión territorial.
Product 2 Description: Taruguín contiene uvas de todos nuestros viñedos, a ambos márgenes del río Duero. Empleamos todas las variedades presentes en el viñedo tradicional, con predominancia del Tinto Fino. El vino, una vez sometido a una lenta crianza en barrica y en botella, presenta franqueza después de varios años, mostrando una mineralidad excepcional y una integración perfecta de sus taninos, acidez y aromas terciarios.

Winery Description: Vins del Tros was born in 2009 when Josep Arrufat decided to start a project to make single-variety wines with traditional varieties from their land, from the vineyards of his property. Three years later, one of these wines, Senyora Carmen, reached the hands of Xavier Orobitg, who felt in love with this wine and proposed to join the project. We are committed to indigenous varieties with an ecological cultivation, respectful at all times of the environment and our wine heritage. Making wines from small plots, with minimal intervention in the winery to be able to transmit all the potential offered by Grenache white and red, Carignan and Morenillo. For the elaboration and aging of our wines we use clay amphorae with a capacity of between 100 and 1,000 liters, for both our white and red wines.
Winery Location: C/ Major, 12, 43782, Vilalba dels Arcs , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street B, Stand 63

Winery Description: Winegrowers since 1448: Vins El Cep was born from the union of four families of winegrowers and four estates. Winemakers since 1980: In the 80s, with clear ideas about what they wanted to achieve and the necessary drive, they founded Vins El Cep. The backbone of this project was, and always will be, these four friends who combined their passion, knowledge, and love for their land, and who have made the business what it is today. Pioneers in biodynamics: In 2000, with the experience derived from this direct contact with the land, we decided to go down the path of organic farming. Not long afterwards, determined to keep improving on all levels, we took things a step further and implemented biodynamic agriculture. Sustainability: We are a sustainable, responsible and efficient winery. We work every day to fulfill our commitment to the landscape. We work sustainably with renewable energies, respecting the environmen. Certified Integral Producers: We close the production cycle in all our products. 100% is made in our winery and everything comes from our vineyards.
Winery Location: CAN LLOPART DE LES ALZINES S/N, 08770, SANT SADURNI D'ANOIA , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street C, Stand 198
Product 1 Description: CLAROR es sinónimo de pureza, es la esencia del Cava, la máxima expresión del Mediterráneo, las variedades tradicionales del Penedès y la intensidad de las viñas viejas. El primer Cava elaborado siguiendo los principios de la agricultura biodinámica. Un Cava de larga crianza que representa la máxima expresión del "terroir". Un gran reserva con matices muy sutiles y complejos. VITICULTURA Las uvas para este Cava provienen de los terruños del Paraje de Can Prats, situados en los Costers del Anoia. De éstas 5,5 hectáreas de agricultura biodinámica se obtienen uvas que tienen un grado de madurez y acidez óptima. NOTA DE CATA Cava biodinámico con una personalidad muy singular. Un rosario fino y persistente. Franco y fresco Claror muestra gran complejidad aromática con notas de manzana, almendra tostada y sutiles matices minerales. Muy fino, elegante con un buen equilibrio . El paso por boca tiene una buena acidez y es envolvente, con un final persistente. Un cava muy gastronómico.
Product 2 Description: Un gran clásico de Vins el Cep. Personalidad y elegancia. Cuatro viñedos y cuatro variedades, con el Xarel·lo como base. Fruto de nuestro conocimiento y nuestra experiencia y fiel reflejo de nuestros terruños. NOTA DE CATA Color amarillo pajizo con tonos dorados. Burbujas finas y persistentes. Un cava brut nature, franco y agradable. Aromas de manzana y notas de brioche obtenidas durante la crianza. Un cava delicado con buena textura en boca. Elegante y complejo de gran expresividad.
Product 3 Description: CLOT DEL ROURE, nombre de la viña de donde proviene este vino. Vino de terruño de viña vieja, elaborado siguiendo los principios de la agricultura biodinámica. Esta viña de 77 años de raíces profundas y suelo calcáreo, aporta la máxima expresión del Xarel·lo. Pura elegancia y riqueza de matices. NOTA DE CATA Una nariz muy singular que muestra su carácter varietal con notas florales y de fruta blanca y cítrica (manzana y pomelo), también recuerdos de hinojo y anisados que aumentan su complejidad. Intensidad de aromas marcados por la mineralidad, algo salino. Expresivo, fresco y muy persistente en boca.

Winery Name: VINS I CAVES JOAN SEGURA PUJADAS
Winery Description: Bodega Joan Segura Pujadas: Tradition, Innovation and Excellence in Wines and Cavas. Immerse yourself in the Penedès wine landscape with Joan Segura Pujadas, a family-run winery with more than a century of history, just 45 minutes from Barcelona. We combine artisanal tradition with innovative techniques, creating wines and cavas that reflect the authenticity of our land and the passion that defines us. What makes us unique: Family winery: small in size, large in tradition and illusion. Sustainable vineyards: we grow our grapes respecting the environment and applying ecological practices that guarantee the highest quality. Wide range of products: from white, red and rosé wines to special edition cavas, for all palates. Commitment to quality: each bottle seeks a perfect balance of aroma, flavor and body. Recognitions: wines and cavas awarded at Decanter, Concours Mondial de Bruxelles, Peñín, Tastavins Academy We are waiting for you to discover our collection and essence.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 298
Product 1 Description: Cava made with 60% Parellada grapes from the mountain areas of the Penedès. This Parellada brings freshness, a delicate fruity expression reminiscent of apple, and a long, harmonious finish. It is a versatile cava, ideal for any occasion: from a welcome drink or an aperitif to enjoying it in summer or pairing it with more robust dishes. We offer this cava in Brut Nature and Brut styles, designed for those who prefer greater volume on the palate and a subtle touch of sweetness. We always work with extended minimum ageing, allowing us to produce cavas classified as Reserva and Gran Reserva. Brinqus Cava it is Reserva (minimum 24 months of aging).
Product 2 Description: A range of young wines, without barrel ageing, crafted to express the fruit in its purest form and the true identity of each variety. White wine made from Macabeo grapes grown in the Penedès Mitjà, from vineyards located in Torrelavit. Rosé and red wines made from Garnacha grapes from the high-altitude Penedès area, in the Mediona region.
Product 3 Description: Joan Segur Pujadas Cavas represents our origins and our essence. We produce a white Reserva cava, Brut Nature, using the classic Penedès trilogy: Parellada, Xarel·lo and Macabeo, which brings balance, freshness and complexity. Our Rosé Reserva cava is made from 100% Garnacha. We add a subtle touch of sugar in the expedition liqueur to define a Brut style, providing volume and roundness that harmonise with the wine’s fruity intensity and natural freshness.
Product 4 Description: Laia Cavas is our most exclusive range, produced only in the finest years and limited to around 3,000 bottles per vintage. The range includes a Rosé Pinot Noir Reserva Brut Cava, combining the delicacy and finesse of Pinot Noir with balanced, refreshing acidity. The Laia Gran Reserva Cava, made from Pinot Noir Blanc de Noirs, Chardonnay, and a small blend of Parellada, Xarel·lo, and Macabeo, has been awarded 93 points by Decanter. This gem from the 2023 vintage offers a prolonged tasting experience in the glass, perfect for savoring over hours. An exceptional cava, ideal for pairing with high-end gastronomy or simply enjoying a special, leisurely glass.
Product 5 Description: Laia represents the most exclusive range of Joan Segura Pujadas. These two wines are crafted as carefully produced micro-vinifications: one white wine and one red wine. The Xarel·lo white wine, sourced from the family’s oldest vineyards, expresses fresh fruit and character. The Tempranillo red wine, awarded on multiple occasions (Academia Tastavins, Peñín), is made from mountain Penedès grapes and refined with a subtle touch of oak.

Winery Description: L’Apical, a reflection of the autochthonous varieties of Penedès. From our first vintage, in 2012, we have always made use of ecological viticulture, respecting the environment and being sustainable. The oenology applied here is that of minimal intervention, with the intention of making the most of every variety. A project with an exponential growth: a great effort, enthusiasm and oenological inquisitiveness.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 236

Winery Description: Named after its founder in 1985 "Vins Miquel Gelabert" was established for research and development to improve the growth of the vineyads in the region of Mallorca in an effort to produce the finest quality of wine. "VinsMiquel Gelabert" combinestraditional artisan methods used by winemakers of the past along with modern technology to produce wines rich with personality and unique character. From the very beginning, the wines produced "Vins Miquel Gelabert" have received both national and international recognition. The owner, Miquel Gelabert, attributes the admiration of his company's products to the belief of "never stop surprising those who decide to taste our wines".
Winery Location: SALAS 50, 07500, MANACOR , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 628

Winery Description: VINS NADAL WINERY where wine embraces the land, tradition and culture We are a family winery deeply committed to regenerative viticulture and sustainability, in which we take care of each vineyard in a personalized and artisanal way. Preserving native grape varieties and connecting our past and the cultural richness of Mallorca, with a future in a common environment that belongs to all of us and we must protect. At Vins Nadal, in the heart of Mallorca, in Binissalem, we have not only been making wines for almost 100 years: we tell stories that are born from the land, the vines and the soul of our family's identity and our relationship with this island.
Winery Location: RAMON LLULL 2, 07350, BINISSALEM , Spain
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 668
Product 1 Description: Sauvignon Blanc 60% Giro Ros, Prensal, Moscat, • Barrica: 30% en barrica durante 2 meses. Fruta tropical y cítrica con notas verdes de pasto, piso forestal y especias (vainilla).
Product 2 Description: Prensal, Giro Ros, Moscatel. Fruta blanca, tropical y un toque de jazmín.
Product 3 Description: Manto Negro Aromas a fruta de licor y fruta negra (Grosella, mora). Boca con tipicidad varietal.
Product 4 Description: Barrica: Francesa. Tiempo en barrica: 18 meses. Aromas de fruta licorosa y fruta de bosque muy bien integrados a los aromas de la barrica (vainilla,azúcar quemado)
Product 5 Description: Manto Negro, Callet y otros, Syrah, Cabernet Fruta roja con notas de naranja y caramelo

Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street C, Stand 461

Winery Description: Vinum Pro Nobis was founded with a singular purpose: to recover the agricultural heritage of our ancestors. We're not just winemakers — we're custodians of history, working to bring back grape varieties that were nearly lost forever. Based in Mancor de la Vall in the heart of Mallorca, we are dedicated to identifying surviving ancient vines across the island, analysing their DNA and replanting them in carefully selected plots. Every variety we save is a recovered story, a rediscovered flavor, a piece of the soul of our restored island.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street E, Stand 672
Product 1 Description: 22 Unces es nuestro blanco de edición limitada, una microvinificación de Giró Ros 100 % pensada para la alta gastronomía. Es un vino con personalidad, estructura y una complejidad aromática propia de los grandes blancos mediterráneos. La uva se selecciona a mano y se macera en frío antes de un prensado muy suave. La fermentación es espontánea en barrica de roble francés, con una pequeña parte de uva desgranada a mano. El vino cría 6 meses sobre sus lías, sin filtrar, lo que aporta textura y profundidad. En copa presenta un color pajizo dorado. En nariz ofrece notas de miel, cera, fruta tropical madura y suaves tostados. En boca es voluminoso, armónico y muy persistente, sostenido por una acidez que equilibra su potencia. Marida especialmente bien con platos de alta : confit de pato, porcella rostida, foie, guisos y estofados. Añada: 2023 Variedades: Giró Ros 100 % Grado alcohólico: 14 % vol. Producción: 500 botellas Alérgenos: contiene sulfitos (pocos sulfitos añadidos).
Product 2 Description: Cucavel·la es nuestro rosado de parcela, elaborado con las variedades autóctonas Mantonegro y Callet: un vino refrescante pero serio, pensado para disfrutar desde el primer trago y, al mismo tiempo, mostrar la personalidad de las variedades tintas mallorquinas. Un rosado con presencia, complejidad y un punto gastronómico que lo aleja de los vinos “fáciles” de verano.En la copa, Cucavel·la muestra un delicado color salmón pálido. En nariz despliega aromas nítidos de fruta de hueso (melocotón, albaricoque) y toques cítricos muy frescos. Con aireación en copa aparecen sutiles notas ahumadas y ligeros recuerdos de fermentación en barrica perfectamente integrados. En boca es un rosado refrescante y equilibrado, con buena tensión, paso ágil y un final afrutado que invita a seguir bebiendo. Es un vino muy versátil en la mesa.
Product 3 Description: Peremateu es nuestro blanco de entrada, pero en el mejor sentido del término: un vino pensado para abrir la puerta al universo Vinum Pro Nobis, marcado por la frescura, la fruta blanca y el equilibrio entre las variedades locales y una uva internacional. Un blanco mediterráneo fresco, directo y muy gastronómico.Se elabora a partir de una selección manual de uvas Moll, Giró Ros y Malvasía.A la vista presenta un color blanco pajizo con reflejos verdosos, que anticipan frescura. En nariz dominan los aromas de fruta blanca, especialmente pera, acompañados de notas de flores blancas y sutiles recuerdos de piel de melón. Aparecen ligeros toques cítricos y herbáceos que aportan vivacidad. En boca tiene una entrada amable, con presencia pero sin pesadez; es fresco dentro del carácter mediterráneo, con un claro balance entre fruta, acidez y volumen. La palabra que mejor lo define es “equilibrio”.
Product 4 Description: Pinyol Vermell es el resultado de una microvinificación de Esperó de Gall, una variedad autóctona recuperada. Es un tinto singular, elaborado con raspón, que apuesta por la personalidad y la expresión pura de una uva casi perdida. Tras una maceración en frío de tres días, el mosto fermenta de forma espontánea en barrica de roble francés, incorporando un porcentaje de uva entera con raspón. El remontado y el “punxat” se realizan a mano. El vino no se filtra ni se estabiliza, preservando así su identidad más auténtica. En la copa se presenta como un tinto de color rubí pálido, que ya anticipa un estilo más fresco y delicado que los tintos clásicos de extracción marcada. En nariz, Pinyol Vermell exhala aromas de especias puras que se entrelazan con la fruta (grosella, frutos rojos). Con el tiempo en copa surgen elegantes notas ahumadas procedentes del roble. En boca tiene una entrada muy amable, y enseguida envuelve el paladar de tacto aterciopelado. 92 puntos Peñin.
Product 5 Description: Tral·larel·lo es nuestro tinto más juvenil: un vino afrutado y refrescante, concebido para acompañar momentos informales, compartir y socializar durante los meses de calor. Encapsula la cara más ligera y directa de la variedad Escursac. Se elabora a partir de una selección manual de la uva en el campo y una segunda selección en bodega. Tras una maceración en frío de tres días, el vino fermenta de forma espontánea en barrica de roble francés. La vinificación es de tipo semi carbónica, lo que potencia el carácter frutal y la frescura. Vino sin filtrar ni estabilizar, manteniendo su autenticidad. En la copa presenta un color púrpura pálido, muy vivo. En nariz dominan las notas de fruta roja fresca –grosellas, cerezas– con una evolución hacia ligeros matices torrefactos. En boca es un vino fresco, ligero y muy afrutado, con un retrogusto que vuelve a la fruta roja y una sensación general de jugosidad y facilidad de trago. Es el vino más desenfadado de la bodega. 91 puntos Peñin.

Winery Description: Vinya els Vilars is a family-run winery in Arbeca (DO Costers del Segre), where viticulture is lived with passion and deep respect for the land. Since 2002 we have worked exclusively with our own vineyards under certified organic production, caring for each vine with the conviction that quality begins in the field. Our continental climate, poor soils and strong thermal contrasts allow us to obtain high-quality grapes that truly express the character of our territory. Over the years we have become a highly visited winery among European professionals and wine lovers seeking authenticity, small-batch production and a genuine story behind each bottle. At Vinya els Vilars we craft wines with soul: expressive, structured and true to our way of understanding this craft. Every bottle invites you to discover who we are and the passion that has driven us from the very beginning.
Winery Location: CAMI DE PUIG-GROS S/N, 25140, ARBECA
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 1, Level 0, Street A, Stand 188
Product 1 Description: Nena is a wine-tribute to María José, Antonio's wife, the essential soul of Vinya els Vilars and a constant presence in the winery since always. Always at the foot of the cannon, he is the one who welcomes all the caravans and each visitor with a sincere smile. Cheerful, close, affectionate and tremendously hardworking, María José represents the hospitality and family spirit that define this project. Made 100% with Syrah, Nena is a rosé wine full of life, expressive and friendly, which invites you to enjoy without complications but with emotion. A wine that reflects its character: luminous, generous and honest. Its label reads: "Open me and feel my perfume. Bring me close to your lips and savor me patiently, without haste. I invite you to taste the fruit that our land gives us." An invitation to open the bottle, let yourself go and enjoy the moment, calmly, as important things are done.
Product 2 Description: Gerar is a very special wine for Vinya els Vilars, as it takes its name from Gerard, who has grown at the same time as the vineyards of the winery and is an active part of the project. Intelligent, conscientious and hardworking, with his own ideas and fully involved in the winery, he represents the present and, above all, the future of this family history. This wine is born from a careful selection of grapes, seeking greater depth and precision, and reflects a way of working based on observation, perseverance and respect for the vineyard. Gerar is a wine with character, balance and ambition, which expresses the maturity of the project and the natural evolution of Vinya els Vilars. A wine that speaks of generational change, commitment and a new look, without losing the roots or the essence that have always defined the winery.
Product 3 Description: Roble is the youngest wine of Vinya els Vilars, a casual and versatile wine that represents the most immediate and enjoyable part of the project. It is also the favourite of Gerard and Aleix, the children of the family, and reflects that young energy that is also part of the winery. Made from Syrah and Merlot, Roble is an accessible, balanced and easy to enjoy wine, without sacrificing the identity of the house. The fruit is the protagonist, accompanied by a friendly wood passage that provides structure and roundness without detracting from freshness. A wine designed to be shared, for any time and without complications, which invites you to uncork, enjoy and repeat. The youngest and most versatile expression of Vinya els Vilars, faithful to the character of its land and its people.
Product 4 Description: Quim is much more than a wine, it is a tribute to Quim Aldomá, father and grandfather of the current owners of the winery, and to a way of understanding life and viticulture based on effort, perseverance and respect for the land. Made 100% with Macabeo, Quim surprises with its overwhelming personality, far from the stereotypes of the variety. It is a wine with character, depth and structure, reflecting the austere landscape of Costers del Segre and the identity of the person who gives it its name. The 2025 vintage has been recognized as Best White Wine of the D.O. Costers del Segre in the Costers del Segre Best Wines Competition, a recognition that endorses the work in the vineyard and the conviction of betting on a Macabeo with soul and ambition. An honest wine, with memory and a future, which invites you to discover the full potential of Macabeo when you work with respect, conviction and time.
Product 5 Description: Vilars takes its name from the fortified Iberian village of Vilars, located in Arbeca, a unique historical enclave that gives identity not only to this wine, but also to the winery. A place with deep roots, defensive character and strong bond with the land, values that inspire this wine and the philosophy of Vinya els Vilars. Made from Syrah and Merlot, Vilars is aged for 12 months in French oak barrels, which gives it complexity, structure and elegance without overshadowing the expression of the fruit or the character of the vineyard. It is a serious, balanced and profound wine, which speaks of history, landscape and time. A wine that connects past and present, reflecting the strength of the Costers del Segre territory and the desire to make wines with identity, memory and projection.

Winery Description: Vinya l’Hereu de Seró is a family-owned wine producer with a long tradition of either wine-growing and wine-making elaborating wines made out of our own vineyards. Our philosophy as winegrowers is producing wines that are the mirror of our specific terroir in Vinya l'Hereu, composed of clay soils, continental climate and the particular soil configuration of the Pre-Pyrenees area. And so we look for fresh and well balanced wines that show all this power, character and personality. Product 1 Description: Ikewen, sinónimo de “orígenes”, es el vino “de pueblo” con el que buscamos embotellar Gran Canaria en una sola botella: mezcla de tres parcelas en San Mateo, con viñas viejas sobre suelos volcánicos y en altura (≈1.100–1.460 m), donde conviven Listán Negro, Listán Prieto y un field blend de blancas autóctonas. Vinificamos por parcelas, con maceraciones largas y porcentaje de racimo entero, para preservar frescura y carácter; el vino reposa mayoritariamente en acero inoxidable con un pequeño cupo en roble francés, y se embotella sin clarificar ni filtrar. Cada añada marca su propio pulso, nuestro papel es acompañar, para mostrar el territorio tal y como fue ese año: fruta roja tensa, salinidad atlántica y la verticalidad que da la altitud.
Product 2 Description: Sansofí, sinónimo de “bienvenido”, es un vino de parcela única en San Mateo (Gran Canaria) que nace de viñas muy viejas en altura, sobre suelos volcánicos de texturas mixtas y con una orientación norte —la única de la bodega— que aporta frescura y tensión atlántica; representa el lado más serio y vertical del proyecto. En copa, Sansofí es el vino más tenso de la gama: fruta roja contenida, trazo vertical y marcada mineralidad volcánica; suele abrirse con tiempo y el propio proyecto lo considera su ideal, el vino que sintetiza lo mejor de cada variedad dentro de un marco más estricto.
Product 3 Description: Tidao, sinónimo de “unión”, procede de una parcela singular en San Mateo (Gran Canaria), con coluviones de brechas ricas en sílice —más compactas y menos porosas— que aportan tensión y finura; son viñas muy viejas (≈130 años) a ~1.100 m de altitud y orientación SE, plantadas en mezcla tradicional con Listán Negro y otras variedades autóctonas, donde altitud, orientación y suelo se combinan para dar lugar a un tinto de trazo preciso y marcado carácter atlántico. El resultado es un vino esbelto y vertical, de fruta roja nítida, tanino fino y persistente y final salino; Tidao busca mostrar el paisaje tal y como es: un vino de altura, calibrado por el suelo, la orientación y el clima atlántico, reconocible por su elegancia y su capacidad de hablar del lugar.
